title: ReGain: Restoring Subject Fidelity in Personalization on Synthetic Images
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models are personalized to a subject by DreamBooth fine-tuning on a handful of its images. Increasingly, these images come from a diffusion model rather than a camera. We show that fine-tuning on such synthetic images degrades subject fidelity, producing oversaturated color and excess high-frequency detail. To isolate the cause, we fine-tune two models from the same base model with the same DreamBooth recipe, one on real photos of a subject and one on synthetic images of that subject generated by the first. We trace the degradation to classifier-free guidance (CFG). For the model personalized on synthetic images, the angle between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions, and with it the norm of their difference, is much larger than for the model personalized on real photos. This inflation grows toward high frequencies and also appears at other prompts semantically close to the subject, such as its class noun, but not at unrelated ones. We propose ReGain, a training-free correction applied at sampling time that measures how much each frequency band of the guidance is inflated relative to the base model and scales that band down accordingly. ReGain needs no real photos. On Stable Diffusion v1.5, ReGain closes 51-64% of the subject-fidelity gap to the model personalized on real photos, as measured by DINO, DINOv2 and CLIP-I. It also improves subject fidelity on SDXL and SD 3.5 and preserves text alignment on all three backbones.

AI.tldr: 合成图像上的DreamBooth微调会因CFG引起的噪声预测差异膨胀而降低主体保真度，本文提出免训练采样期修正方法ReGain，通过按频带缩放过度膨胀的引导来恢复细节。
AI.motivation: 个性化扩散模型（DreamBooth）越来越多地使用扩散模型生成而非相机拍摄的图像来微调，但作者发现这类合成图像的微调会导致主体保真度下降，表现为过饱和颜色和过多高频细节。作者希望定位该退化现象的成因并加以修复。
AI.method: 作者用同一基座模型和相同DreamBooth配方分别对主体真实照片和由首个模型生成的合成图像进行微调，对比分析退化来源，将问题定位到无分类器引导（CFG）。随后提出ReGain：一种无需训练、在采样时应用的修正方法，测量每个频带的引导相对于基座模型的膨胀程度，并据此对该频带进行相应缩放。
AI.result: 分析表明，合成图像个性化模型的条件/无条件噪声预测夹角及其差值范数远大于真实照片个性化模型，且这种膨胀向高频增长，并在与主体语义接近的其他提示（如类别名词）上出现。ReGain在Stable Diffusion v1.5上以DINO、DINOv2和CLIP-I衡量，弥补了向真实照片模型主体保真度差距的51-64%；在SDXL和SD 3.5上也提升主体保真度并保持文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: 合成图像上的DreamBooth微调退化的根源是CFG引起的逐频带引导膨胀；ReGain作为一种无需真实照片、免训练的采样期修正方法，能有效缩小主体保真度差距并跨多个骨干模型保持文本对齐。

title: Unveiling the Value of Motion for Cinematic Camera Trajectories
summary: Cinematic camera motion is a fundamental storytelling tool, defined not only by where the camera is positioned in the scene, but also by how it moves in terms of direction and speed. Recent work on camera trajectory generation and alignment to text relies on pose-centric representations. While in principle a network could derive direction of movement and speed, we find that in practice this might not happen. In fact, in this paper we discover that decomposing the camera trajectory representation from the traditional per-frame poses to direction and speed has surprising benefits across multiple tasks, including trajectory-to-text alignment as well as text-to-trajectory generation. To accurately evaluate the former, we introduce a simple and reliable protocol that overcomes the limitations of prior evaluation baselines. For the latter, building on this representational insight, we propose a novel generative model for camera trajectories, CineGEN, that achieves superior performance across a variety of metrics. We also propose a novel dataset, CineScript, containing movie clips that are enriched with scene descriptions as well as higher-level metadata. This novel data allows us to test models' ability to capture high-level cinematographic information. We show that, despite its simplicity, representing camera trajectories through direction and speed not only helps numerically to achieve better alignment and generation, but also inherently encodes complex directorial intent.

AI.tldr: 将相机轨迹表示从逐帧位姿分解为方向与速度，能在轨迹-文本对齐和文本-轨迹生成任务上带来显著收益，并据此提出CineGEN模型、CineScript数据集与新评测协议。
AI.motivation: 电影相机运动是核心叙事工具，其语义不仅取决于相机在场景中的位置，还取决于运动的方向与速度。现有轨迹生成与文本对齐工作依赖以位姿为中心的表示；尽管理论上网络可以从位姿中推导出方向与速度，但作者发现实践中这往往不会发生，因此需要更贴合语义的表示方式。
AI.method: 将传统逐帧位姿的相机轨迹表示分解为方向与速度；针对轨迹-文本对齐，提出一个简单可靠的评测协议以克服既有评测基线的局限；针对文本-轨迹生成，基于该表示洞见提出生成模型CineGEN；并构建CineScript数据集，包含配有场景描述与更高层元数据的电影片段。
AI.result: 方向-速度表示在轨迹-文本对齐与文本-轨迹生成两类任务上均带来数值上的提升；CineGEN在多项指标上取得更优性能；CineScript数据可用于测试模型捕获高层电影摄影信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: 以方向与速度表示相机轨迹虽然简单，但不仅有助于在对齐与生成上取得更好的量化结果，还内在地编码了复杂的导演意图。

title: EPIC: Epipolar-Consistent 360° Immersive Stereo Video Generation
summary: Immersive displays can enable rich and diverse virtual experiences. Manually authoring every possible experience to realize this potential, however, is prohibitively expensive, difficult to scale, and impractical. Generative AI models could remove this bottleneck, but today's models are built for conventional displays and cannot generate the high-resolution, stereoscopic $360^\circ$ content required for immersive viewing. Further, temporal and stereo inconsistencies that may be tolerable on conventional displays can become highly disruptive when viewed through an immersive headset. Here, we address this gap with a zero-shot generative pipeline that extends existing video diffusion models into 4K stereoscopic $360^\circ$ videos. Inspired from binocular vision and depth perception, we develop an epipolar-aware $360^\circ$ image matching metric that captures the temporal and stereo geometric inconsistencies across views. We then use this metric as a preference signal for direct preference optimization with limited training data. Our work enables $360^\circ$ stereo video generation and provides a scalable path for bringing generative content to immersive displays, allowing diverse mixed reality experiences on demand.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本生成流程，将现有视频扩散模型扩展为4K立体360°视频，用于沉浸式显示。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式显示能提供丰富虚拟体验，但手动制作所有体验成本高、难扩展、不现实。生成式AI虽有潜力，但现有模型针对传统显示，无法生成沉浸观看所需的高分辨率立体360°内容；且时间与立体不一致在头显中会非常明显。
AI.method: 受双目视觉和深度感知启发，设计极线感知的360°图像匹配度量，捕捉跨视角的时间与立体几何不一致；将该度量作为偏好信号，在有限训练数据下进行直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: 实现360°立体视频生成，并验证该极线感知匹配度量可用于DPO偏好信号以提升一致性。
AI.conclusion: 为将生成式内容引入沉浸式显示提供可扩展路径，支持按需的多样混合现实体验。

title: No Corners Cut: State-Grounded Transitions for Mid-Stream Prompt Switches in Video Generation
summary: Streaming video generators allow users to dynamically modulate video synthesis via mid-stream prompt switching. Existing streaming methods can respond to the updated instruction while still cutting corners, prematurely realizing goals or taking heuristic shortcuts that bypass necessary intermediate state changes needed for a plausible transition. In this study, we present SEGUE, a novel framework that makes this process explicit and trains the generator to execute these transitions faithfully. At each switch, a training-free planner parses the latest frame and prompts, writes a few segue prompts with roles and durations, and then hands control back to the user's prompt. Furthermore, to address the inherent difficulty of training causal models on short-lived temporal schedules without corrupting preparatory supervision, we introduce SPANDMD, which evaluates each active prompt using the full rollout as temporal context while retaining its DMD residual only within the prompt's assigned span. On OpenTrans-360, a benchmark of 1,800 switches that scores how the old state exits and the new one begins, SEGUE ranks first on all eight transition metrics and raises the overall score over the strongest baseline from 0.866 to 0.887. It also ranks first on four of six instruction-response metrics of StreamAV-Bench, while the planner transfers to frozen autoregressive generators without retraining. Project Page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/No-Corners-Cut-6C5D/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SEGUE 框架，通过训练-free 规划器生成过渡提示并配合 SPANDMD 训练机制，使流式视频生成器在中途切换提示时忠实执行状态过渡，在 OpenTrans-360 上八项过渡指标全部第一。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频生成方法虽能响应中途更新的指令，但存在"抄近道"问题：过早实现目标或采用启发式捷径，跳过了可信过渡所需的中间状态变化，导致过渡不自然。
AI.method: SEGUE 将过渡过程显式化并训练生成器忠实执行：每次切换时，训练-free 规划器解析最新帧与提示，写出若干带角色与时长的 segue 提示，再交还用户提示的控制权。针对因果模型在短暂时序调度上训练易破坏预备监督的难题，提出 SPANDMD——以完整 rollout 作为时序上下文评估每个活跃提示，但仅在该提示所分配的区间内保留其 DMD 残差。
AI.result: 在 OpenTrans-360（含 1,800 次切换、评估旧状态退出与新状态开始的基准）上，SEGUE 在全部八项过渡指标中排名第一，总体得分由最强基线的 0.866 提升至 0.887；在 StreamAV-Bench 的六项指令响应指标中有四项排名第一；规划器还可无需重训练地迁移到冻结的自回归生成器。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模过渡过程并结合 SPANDMD 的时序约束训练，可有效解决流式视频生成中的"抄近道"问题，实现更可信的提示切换过渡，且规划器具备良好的可迁移性。

title: SCALE: Synthetic Calibration via Agreement Labeling in Embedding Space
summary: Foundation models for computational pathology are usually evaluated using AUC and accuracy, while calibration is often left untested. This matters because a model can be accurate on average but still assign overly confident probabilities to cases that are difficult even for pathologists. We study calibration across eight pathology foundation models. Using pathologist agreement as a measure of diagnostic difficulty, we find that calibration error is consistently higher on low-agreement cases than on high-agreement cases. This pattern is not apparent from aggregate expected calibration error (ECE) alone. We then propose synthetic agreement calibration, a method for improving calibration without collecting multi-annotator labels. Given a trained linear probe, we select high-confidence embeddings as class anchors and interpolate between anchors from opposite classes. The interpolation weights encode a continuous notion of diagnostic ambiguity, which we use as a synthetic agreement signal to retrain the probe with agreement-aware label smoothing. On MHIST, which includes annotations from seven pathologists, synthetic agreement calibration recovers most of the calibration improvement obtained by label smoothing based on real pathologist agreement, while substantially reducing low-agreement ECE relative to the uncalibrated baseline. Discrimination metrics are preserved. On PatchCamelyon and BreakHis, public histopathology datasets without multi-annotator labels, the method improves calibration across the evaluated foundation models, whereas annotator-dependent approaches cannot be used without additional expert annotation.

AI.tldr: 病理基础模型常用AUC与准确率评估而忽视校准。该研究在八个病理基础模型上发现，基于病理学家一致性的低一致病例校准误差更高，聚合ECE无法揭示。作者提出"合成一致性校准"：无需多标注者标签，通过类锚点嵌入插值构造连续诊断模糊信号，用一致性感知标签平滑重训线性探针。在MHIST上恢复了基于真实一致性的多数校准提升，并显著降低低一致ECE；在PatchCamelyon与BreakHis上同样改善校准，且判别指标保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有计算病理基础模型评估主要依赖AUC与准确率，校准问题较少被检验。模型可能在平均意义上准确，却对连病理学家都难以判断的病例给出过度自信的概率，这在临床决策中十分危险。同时，多标注者标签获取昂贵，需要一种无需额外专家标注即可改善校准的方案。
AI.method: 以病理学家一致性作为诊断难度度量，在八个病理基础模型上分析校准误差与一致性的关系。提出合成一致性校准：基于已训练的线性探针，选取高置信度嵌入作为类锚点，在相反类别的锚点之间插值，插值权重编码连续的诊断模糊性，作为合成一致性信号，结合一致性感知标签平滑重新训练探针。
AI.result: 低一致性病例的校准误差始终高于高一致性病例，且该现象无法从整体ECE看出。在含七位病理学家标注的MHIST上，合成一致性校准恢复了基于真实病理学家一致性的标签平滑所取得的大部分校准改善，相对未校准基线大幅降低低一致ECE，同时判别指标保持不变。在无多标注者标签的PatchCamelyon与BreakHis上，该方法对多个评估的基础模型均改善校准，而依赖标注者的方法在缺乏额外专家标注时不可用。
AI.conclusion: 校准应作为病理基础模型评估的必要维度，尤其在诊断歧义较大的病例上。合成一致性校准提供了一种不依赖多标注者标签、可推广至公共数据集的实用校准改进手段，在提升校准的同时不损害判别性能。

title: Hard-Region Supervision: #1 on the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Leaderboard
summary: We describe our winning entry to the Waymo Open Dataset 2D Video Panoptic Segmentation Challenge. The task asks for a semantic class at every pixel of every frame and, for countable objects, an identity that holds across 100 frames and across five overlapping cameras. We build on DVIS++, a cascade of a segmenter, a tracker, and a refiner, as our baseline. We propose hard region supervision (HRS) to improve the baseline. In particular, we use the baseline to define the hard region as where it makes mistakes, and design a loss and an auxiliary prediction head for this region. The auxiliary head is used only in training and removed at test time, so at inference the model trained with HRS has the same architecture as the baseline. In addition, we propose three test-time steps that further improve the results: a two-model ensemble, a merge of the segmenter's output into the final panoptic map, and cross-camera identity linking. On the challenge test set, our entry reaches 0.3547 wSTQ, 0.2071 wAQ, and 0.6075 mIoU, ranking first on all three metrics. It is 3.6 wSTQ points ahead of the second entry and 2.4 points ahead of our DVIS++ baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出硬区域监督（HRS）与三项测试时优化策略，基于DVIS++在Waymo开放数据集2D视频全景分割挑战赛中取得第一名，wSTQ 0.3547、wAQ 0.2071、mIoU 0.6075，三项指标均居首。
AI.motivation: 任务要求在每帧每像素给出语义类别，并对可数目标在100帧、5个重叠相机间保持身份一致。基线DVIS++在困难区域仍存在错误，且跨相机身份关联不足，因此需要针对性提升。
AI.method: 以DVIS++（分割器、跟踪器、精炼器的级联）为基线。提出硬区域监督（HRS）：用基线定义其出错区域为硬区域，为该区域设计损失函数与辅助预测头；辅助头仅用于训练，测试时移除，故推理架构与基线一致。另提出三项测试时步骤：双模型集成、将分割器输出合并进最终全景图、跨相机身份链接。
AI.result: 在挑战赛测试集上，该方法达到0.3547 wSTQ、0.2071 wAQ、0.6075 mIoU，三项指标排名第一；wSTQ领先第二名3.6个点，领先DVIS++基线2.4个点。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期硬区域监督与测试期多策略融合，可在不改变推理架构的前提下显著提升视频全景分割性能，并验证了方案的有效性与领先性。

title: SpatialCORE: Confidence-Aware Grounded Spatial Reasoning in Large Vision--Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress across visual perception tasks, yet spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness, especially for questions that require reasoning over visual space. Recent spatial-reasoning methods incorporate generated grounding, where models predict bounding boxes, masks, or other localization outputs for task-relevant objects as part of their reasoning trace. However, these approaches typically optimize final-answer correctness alone, allowing correct answers to be rewarded even when the model does not reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. We introduce SpatialCORE (Spatially COnfident REasoning), a post-training framework that turns the model's own confidence in generated grounding into a learning signal for spatial reasoning. Its central idea is to reinforce grounding that is both accurate and confident, encouraging the model to reason from confidently localized task-relevant objects. SpatialCORE realizes this through a self-regulating spatial reward that weights each predicted bounding box's matching quality by its coordinate-token confidence. An answer gate further ties grounding optimization to final-answer correctness. SpatialCORE achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source and specialized spatial reasoning models across diverse benchmarks, and transfers effectively in zero-shot settings to unseen data distributions. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/SpatialCORE.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialCORE 后训练框架，将模型对生成式 grounding 的自置信度转化为空间推理的学习信号，通过自调节空间奖励与答案门控实现 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在视觉感知任务上进步显著，但空间推理仍是持续短板，尤其是需要对视觉空间进行推理的问题。现有空间推理方法虽引入生成式 grounding（预测边界框、掩码等定位输出作为推理轨迹的一部分），但通常只优化最终答案正确性，导致即便模型未基于高置信度定位的任务相关对象进行推理，正确答案仍会获得奖励。
AI.method: SpatialCORE（Spatially COnfident REasoning）是一个后训练框架：(1) 自调节空间奖励——用每个预测边界框的坐标 token 置信度对其匹配质量加权，从而强化既准确又高置信的 grounding；(2) 答案门控（answer gate）——将 grounding 优化与最终答案正确性绑定，鼓励模型基于高置信定位的任务相关对象进行推理。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，SpatialCORE 在开源模型与专门的空间推理模型中均取得最先进（SOTA）结果，并能在零样本设置下有效迁移到未见数据分布。
AI.conclusion: 将模型自身的 grounding 置信度作为学习信号，可有效提升 LVLMs 的空间推理能力，且具备良好的泛化性；源码已公开。

title: Soft Spatial Reasoning
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly perform spatial reasoning through chain-of-thought (CoT), encoding intermediate reasoning as autoregressive sequences of discrete language tokens. Such hard thinking requires committing to a single token at each step, even when the correct spatial interpretation remains uncertain. This early commitment constitutes premature discretization: an incorrect token selection can propagate errors through subsequent reasoning. We propose Soft Spatial Reasoning, a post-training framework that introduces soft thinking for spatial tasks in LVLMs. At each intermediate reasoning step, the LVLM forms a continuous soft state by mixing token embeddings rather than selecting a single token, allowing multiple candidate continuations to influence the next step. The appropriate degree of softness, however, can vary across reasoning steps: retaining multiple candidates may preserve a useful spatial interpretation, but if those candidates imply conflicting spatial relations, mixing them may interfere with subsequent reasoning. At the core of Soft Spatial Reasoning is AdaptSoft, a controller that uses the current hidden state and predictive uncertainty to adapt the degree of softness at each reasoning step. To train AdaptSoft, we introduce a gradient-alignment learning objective that provides a step-specific learning signal for softness control without intermediate reasoning supervision. Across diverse spatial benchmarks, Soft Spatial Reasoning outperforms hard and fixed-soft CoT baselines using the same backbone, as well as a range of existing LVLMs. The source code is available at https://github.com/rafiibnsultan/Soft_Spatial_Reasoning

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Soft Spatial Reasoning 后训练框架，用连续软状态替代离散 token 选择，并通过 AdaptSoft 控制器自适应调节每步软化程度，缓解空间推理中的过早离散化问题。
AI.motivation: LVLM 通常以链式思维（CoT）进行空间推理，将中间推理编码为自回归的离散语言 token 序列。这种"硬思考"在每步必须锁定单一 token，即使正确空间解释尚不确定，从而造成过早离散化，错误 token 会沿推理链传播误差。
AI.method: 提出 Soft Spatial Reasoning 后训练框架：每步通过混合 token 嵌入形成连续软状态，而非选择单一 token，使多个候选延续共同影响下一步。核心为 AdaptSoft 控制器，利用当前隐状态与预测不确定性自适应调节每步软化程度；并设计梯度对齐学习目标，在无中间推理监督下提供步级软化控制信号。
AI.result: 在多个空间基准上，Soft Spatial Reasoning 优于相同主干的硬 CoT 与固定软化 CoT 基线，也优于多种现有 LVLM。
AI.conclusion: 自适应软化可有效缓解空间推理中的过早离散化，验证软思考在后训练阶段对 LVLM 空间任务的价值。

title: MetaSteer: Context-Conditioned, nonlinear Steering via Attention-Projection Adaptation
comment: Preprint. Code and pretrained model checkpoints will be released shortly
summary: Steering large language models typically relies on linear, context-independent interventions in activation space, an assumption that recent work has challenged and that can induce an information bottleneck when a fixed representation must encode many behavioral distinctions. We introduce MetaSteer, a method that learns nonlinear interventions with context-dependent effects and applies them to attention projection matrices, producing activation effects that vary with the input context by construction and requiring no linear concept-geometry assumption. Framed as preference-based optimization, MetaSteer is trained once on a pooled preference corpus and transferred zero-shot to unseen concepts and out-of-distribution contexts. We find that, despite using low-rank adapters, MetaSteer induces structured, context-dependent changes in hidden-state trajectories while partially preserving aspects of their local trajectory dynamics, including velocity and curvature. We evaluate MetaSteer on three controlled text-generation benchmarks and three agentic settings across multiple model families and scales. MetaSteer matches or outperforms strong task-specific steering baselines on most aggregate comparisons in the zero-shot regime. Across the evaluated settings, stronger text-generation steering is associated with stronger agentic steering performance. We further discuss geometric trajectory effects, capability retention, and safety considerations raised by transferable steering.

AI.tldr: MetaSteer 提出了注意投影矩阵上的非线性、上下文相关干预方法，通过偏好优化训练一次即可零样本迁移到新概念和分布外场景，在多个文本生成与智能体基准上匹配或超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型引导方法通常假设激活空间中的干预是线性且与上下文无关的，这一假设近期受到质疑；当固定的线性表示需要编码多种行为区分时，会产生信息瓶颈，因此需要一种不依赖线性概念几何假设、具有上下文相关效果的引导方法。
AI.method: MetaSteer 学习具有上下文相关效果的非线性干预，并将其作用于注意力投影矩阵，使激活效果天然随输入上下文变化，不再依赖线性概念几何。该方法被形式化为基于偏好的优化，在池化偏好语料上训练一次，随后零样本迁移至未见概念和分布外上下文；实现上使用低秩适配器。
AI.result: MetaSteer 尽管仅使用低秩适配器，仍能在隐藏状态轨迹中诱导结构化、上下文相关的变化，同时部分保留局部轨迹动力学（如速度和曲率）。在三个受控文本生成基准和三个智能体设置、多个模型家族与规模上评估，在零样本条件下大多数总体比较中匹配或超过强任务专用引导基线。在所评估的设置中，更强的文本生成引导与更强的智能体引导性能相关联。
AI.conclusion: MetaSteer 表明非线性、上下文相关的干预可有效引导大模型，并具备零样本迁移能力；本文还讨论了其几何轨迹效应、能力保持以及可迁移引导带来的安全性问题。

title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to additional reflection information. Specifically, we build on top of the open-source Qwen-image-2512 and observe a significant performance gain from 0.747 to 0.808 on GenEval and from 32.97 to 35.53 on GenEval2 Soft-TIFA. Moreover, attempts with more powerful external critics (e.g., GPT5.6-Luna) show that multimodal models with strong judge capabilities can anticipate a higher self-evolving ceiling. Last but not least, mixed text-rendering outcomes show that our self-improvements may not be uniform across different tasks. Our study aims to shed light on the current hot recursive self-improvement research line to enhance the user experience when using multimodal models without external supervision or guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniEvo-VL 自演化框架，让统一多模态模型在测试时利用自身"自我批判"作为特权信息，通过教师-学生双上下文蒸馏（最小化同一采样轨迹上的去噪扩散分布差异）实现自我纠错学习。基于 Qwen-image-2512，GenEval 从 0.747 提升至 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 从 32.97 提升至 35.53，无需外部监督。
AI.motivation: 现代多模态模型已将生成与理解统一于单一系统，因而具备给出并利用自身反馈的能力。作者希望利用这一"统一"特性，在测试时计算（test-time compute）中让模型从建设性的自我纠错反馈里学习，摆脱对外部更大教师模型或人工监督的依赖，从而推动递归自我改进（recursive self-improvement）研究，提升多模态模型的用户体验。
AI.method: UniEvo-VL 让同一个多模态模型以不同上下文同时充当教师与学生：学生仅看到原始问题（vanilla question），教师则额外以模型自身的自我批判（self-critique）作为特权信息（privileged information）进行条件化。训练目标是最小化二者在"学生自身采样轨迹"上的逐状态去噪扩散分布之间的散度（per-state divergence），从而实现自蒸馏式自我演化，且无需独立的外部教师。
AI.result: 在开源 Qwen-image-2512 上，图像生成能力显著提升：GenEval 由 0.747 升至 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 由 32.97 升至 35.53，同时保持了对额外反思信息的敏感性。使用更强外部评判者（如 GPT5.6-Luna）的实验表明，具备强评判能力的多模态模型可预期更高的自演化上限。此外，混合文本渲染任务的结果显示自我改进在不同任务上并非一致提升。
AI.conclusion: UniEvo-VL 证明统一多模态模型可在无外部监督或引导的条件下，借助自我批判完成测试时自我演化，并在图像生成基准上取得一致增益；但自改进效果存在任务异质性，且其上限与模型自身的评判能力相关。该工作为递归自我改进方向提供了实证参考。

title: Anchor-ECC: Local Integrity Checking for Watermarked LLM Outputs via Error-Correcting Codes
comment: 18 pages, including references and appendices; 1 figure and 11 tables
summary: LLM watermarking has become an effective approach to distinguishing AI-generated text from human-written text by embedding detectable patterns during generation. However, a small post-generation edit may change the meaning of the text without removing its overall watermark signal, creating a risk that the modified content is still attributed to the original model. We propose Anchor-ECC, which incorporates the error-correcting code (ECC) constraints and explicit boundary anchors into the watermark structure and pairs them with a dynamic-programming decoder to detect and localize post-generation edits. Across Qwen3-8B, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and OPT-125M, the approximate-hard setting achieves about 99.7% block-level true positive rate (TPR) with at most 7.6% false alarm rate (FAR) for edit detection under mixed insertions, deletions, and substitutions, while preserving the distinction between watermarked outputs and unwatermarked text. Additional quality experiments identify lower-perplexity configurations that retain strong edit-detection performance. Together, these results extend LLM watermarking from source identification to local integrity verification while supporting configurable trade-offs between detection reliability and generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anchor-ECC，通过将纠错码约束与显式边界锚点融入水印结构，并配以动态规划解码器，实现LLM生成文本的生成后编辑检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM水印主要用于区分AI生成文本与人类文本，但生成后的细微编辑可能改变文本含义却不消除整体水印信号，导致被篡改内容仍被归因于原模型，存在归因风险。因此需要从"来源识别"扩展到"局部完整性验证"。
AI.method: Anchor-ECC将纠错码（ECC）约束与显式边界锚点（boundary anchors）整合进水印结构，并设计动态规划解码器，用于检测并定位生成后编辑（插入、删除、替换）。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和OPT-125M上，近似困难设置下实现约99.7%的块级真正率（TPR），假警报率（FAR）至多7.6%，同时保持水印文本与未水印文本的可区分性；额外的质量实验识别出低困惑度配置仍具强编辑检测性能。
AI.conclusion: Anchor-ECC将LLM水印从来源识别扩展到局部完整性验证，并支持检测可靠性与生成质量之间可配置的权衡。

title: Matisse: Evidence-Space Reasoning for Active 3D Reconstruction
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://xihangyu630.github.io/matisse/
summary: How can a 3D reconstruction system acquire and retain useful information to understand the geometry of a scene from partial views under a limited computation budget? Existing active view acquisition methods typically estimate uncertainty over observed or instantiated geometry, limiting their ability to reason about unseen structure, while long-horizon reconstruction methods often retain redundant observations. We introduce Matisse, a training-free framework that unifies active reconstruction and keyframe selection by leveraging evidence provided by a pretrained generative 3D model. Matisse estimates Evidential Uncertainty from cross-attention evidence associated with 3D latent tokens and derives an Evidential Information Gain to guide both view acquisition and keyframe selection based on the expected reduction in posterior entropy. Matisse supports multi-object scenes through occlusion-aware, object-balanced aggregation and propagates uncertainty through intermediate latents to avoid full reconstruction during planning. Matisse reduces Chamfer distance by 12.7%, 3.8%, and 9.2% on GSO30, YCB-V, and Replica, respectively, relative to the best baseline on each dataset, and achieves a $1.50\times$ end-to-end speedup over the best active reconstruction baseline on GSO30 with the same reconstruction backend. In the GSO30 keyframe selection experiment for long-horizon reconstruction, Matisse achieves comparable Chamfer distance using 14% of the input views compared with Stream3D.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Matisse，一个免训练框架，通过预训练生成式 3D 模型的证据不确定性统一主动重建与关键帧选择，在多个数据集上优于基线并实现加速。
AI.motivation: 现有主动视角获取方法通常仅在已观测或已实例化几何上估计不确定性，难以推理未观测结构；而长时序重建方法常保留大量冗余观测。核心问题是如何在有限计算预算下，从部分视角获取并保留有用信息以理解场景几何。
AI.method: Matisse 利用预训练生成式 3D 模型提供的证据：从与 3D 潜在 token 关联的交叉注意力证据中估计证据不确定性（Evidential Uncertainty），并推导证据信息增益（Evidential Information Gain），基于后验熵的期望减少来指导视角获取与关键帧选择。通过遮挡感知、物体平衡的聚合支持多物体场景，并在中间潜在表示上传播不确定性，避免规划期间的完整重建。整个框架免训练。
AI.result: 在 GSO30、YCB-V、Replica 上，Chamfer 距离相较各数据集最佳基线分别降低 12.7%、3.8%、9.2%；在相同重建后端下，于 GSO30 上相比最佳主动重建基线实现 1.50 倍端到端加速。在 GSO30 长时序重建关键帧选择实验中，以 14% 的输入视角达到与 Stream3D 相当的 Chamfer 距离。
AI.conclusion: Matisse 表明，借助预训练生成式 3D 模型的证据不确定性，可在免训练条件下有效统一主动重建与关键帧选择，在显著减少视角与计算量的同时提升重建精度与效率。

title: Consensus-Aware Multi-Source Fusion for Reference-Guided Camouflaged Object Detection
comment: 20 pages, including 2 pages of appendix; 9 figures and 4 tables
summary: Reference-guided camouflaged object detection aims to segment a target whose visual appearance closely resembles its surroundings by exploiting auxiliary reference samples. The task remains difficult because reference samples contain inconsistent target cues, while generic visual representations are not inherently aligned with the target specified by the references. To handle these problems, we present a consensus-aware multi-source fusion framework. Reference-Conditioned Dual-Backbone Fusion (RCDF) couples trainable PVTv2 query features with frozen DINOv3 representations and uses reference-conditioned correlation to select foundation-model evidence before multi-scale fusion. The framework also aggregates multiple references through cross-reference consensus aggregation and injects reference information at semantic depths matched to the query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results further show that reference consensus, target-conditioned foundation features, and hierarchical decoding provide complementary improvements under the evaluation protocol. The source code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出共识感知的多源融合框架，用于参考引导的伪装目标检测。核心模块RCDF将可训练PVTv2查询特征与冻结DINOv3表示耦合，通过参考条件相关性选择基础模型证据并进行多尺度融合，同时通过跨参考共识聚合整合多参考，并在与查询特征匹配的语义深度注入参考信息。实验验证了方法的有效性及各组件互补性。
AI.motivation: 参考引导伪装目标检测需借助辅助参考样本分割与周围环境外观高度相似的目标。该任务难点在于：参考样本包含不一致的目标线索，而通用视觉表示与参考所指定的目标并不天然对齐。
AI.method: 提出共识感知多源融合框架。核心为参考条件双骨干融合（RCDF）：将可训练PVTv2查询特征与冻结DINOv3表示耦合，利用参考条件相关性在选择基础模型证据后进行多尺度融合；并通过跨参考共识聚合整合多个参考，同时在与查询特征匹配的语义深度注入参考信息。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了所提方法的有效性。结果表明，在评估协议下，参考共识、目标条件基础特征与分层解码带来了互补的性能提升。源代码将在录用后公开。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过参考共识聚合、目标条件基础模型特征与分层解码的协同，有效应对参考线索不一致及通用表示与目标不对齐的问题，实现参考引导伪装目标检测。

title: Hear the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation
summary: Recent joint video-audio generation models have achieved strong semantic correspondence and temporal synchronization. However, applications such as AR/VR and interactive gaming further require stereo audio to provide an immersive sense, which remains largely overlooked. Effective stereo audio requires the perceived sound location to evolve consistently with the motion of its corresponding visual source. We refer to this property as Dynamic Spatial Correspondence and propose StereoBind, a framework that binds visual source motion to stereo sound generation. StereoBind uses motion tracks to coordinate visual motion and stereo audio through three complementary mechanisms. Visual Motion Binding establishes source-aware audiovisual correspondence, the Spatial Track Encoder captures absolute source positions, and Residual Track RoPE models relative motion. For supervision and evaluation, we construct StereoWorld-29K, a large-scale stereo audio-video dataset with paired motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audiovisual spatial consistency. Experiments show that StereoBind substantially improves spatial alignment in stereo audio generation over existing models while preserving overall audiovisual quality.

AI.tldr: StereoBind 提出将视觉源运动与立体声生成绑定，通过运动轨迹实现动态空间对应，并构建数据集与基准验证效果。
AI.motivation: 现有联合视频-音频生成模型虽具备语义对应和时间同步，但 AR/VR、交互游戏等应用需要立体声营造沉浸感，而立体声要求声音感知位置随视觉源运动持续变化，现有工作对此关注不足。
AI.method: 提出 StereoBind 框架，利用运动轨迹协调视觉运动与立体声，包含三种互补机制：Visual Motion Binding 建立源感知的音视频对应；Spatial Track Encoder 捕获绝对源位置；Residual Track RoPE 建模相对运动。同时构建大规模立体声音视频数据集 StereoWorld-29K（含配对运动轨迹）与评测基准 StereoWorldBench。
AI.result: 实验表明 StereoBind 在立体声音频生成的空间对齐方面显著优于现有模型，同时保持整体音视频质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉源运动绑定到立体声生成并定义动态空间对应，StereoBind 提升了立体声生成的空间一致性，为沉浸式音视频生成提供了数据集、方法与评测基准。

title: Agentic Relative Camera Pose Estimation via Learned Ranking and Verification
comment: 22 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: A wide range of approaches have been developed for camera pose estimation, including correspondence-based methods, end-to-end pose regression, and recent 3D geometric foundation models. Our key observation is that no single estimator is optimal for diverse challenges, such as wide baselines, lack of texture, appearance changes, and occlusions. Further analysis reveals substantial performance variation across both benchmarks and individual image pairs, with different estimators exhibiting complementary strengths. We introduce PoseAgent, an agentic framework for relative camera pose estimation that dynamically orchestrates pose estimators through learnable ranking and verification. Given an image pair, a profiling agent first extracts appearance, semantic, and geometric features relevant to pose estimation, e.g., scene type. A learned ranking agent then predicts the relative competence of multiple pose estimators given the image-pair profile. The top-ranked estimator is executed, and its predicted pose is assessed by a learned verification agent that estimates the corresponding pose error. When verification fails, PoseAgent adaptively invokes lower-ranked estimators until a candidate is accepted or the execution budget is reached. For pose verification, our verification network predicts pose errors more accurately than prior models. For pose estimation, PoseAgent improves AUC@5 degree up to 4.2% over the strongest standalone estimator on each of ARKitScenes, MegaDepth, ScanNet++, and RealEstate10K. On ARKitScenes, PoseAgent also outperforms VLM-based agents, which include a VLM ranker with the same verifier and fallback policy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned ranking and verification.

AI.tldr: PoseAgent是一个智能体框架，通过可学习的排序与验证网络动态调度多种相机位姿估计器，在多个基准上提升了相对位姿估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有位姿估计方法（对应点方法、端到端回归、3D几何基础模型）各有优劣，没有单一估计器能应对宽基线、弱纹理、外观变化、遮挡等多样挑战，且不同估计器在不同基准和图像对上表现差异大、具有互补性。
AI.method: PoseAgent先由profiling agent提取与位姿估计相关的外观、语义和几何特征（如场景类型）；再由可学习的ranking agent根据图像对画像预测多个估计器的相对能力；执行排名最高的估计器，并由可学习的verification agent估计位姿误差进行验证；验证失败时自适应调用更低排名的估计器，直至候选被接受或达到执行预算。
AI.result: 验证网络预测位姿误差比先前模型更准确；在ARKitScenes、MegaDepth、ScanNet++和RealEstate10K上，AUC@5°相比各基准上最强的单一估计器最高提升4.2%；在ARKitScenes上还优于使用相同验证器和回退策略的VLM排序器智能体。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了可学习的排序与验证机制的有效性，动态编排多个互补估计器能提升相对相机位姿估计的鲁棒性与精度。

title: Event-Driven Refresh and Recurrence Memory to Reduce Stale Grounding in Referring Video Object Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to produce a pixel-accurate mask sequence for an object specified by natural language. Sa2VA combines a multimodal large language model with SAM2 for grounded segmentation; however, its inference typically grounds the query from a small fixed set of initial keyframes and then relies on propagation. In long or dynamic videos, this can cause stale grounding and persistent false positives when the object composition changes (e.g., distractors enter or the target disappears/re-appears). We propose Event-Driven Refresh + Recurrence Memory (EDRRM), an enhancement that selectively re-invokes Sa2VA only at stable change points. EDRRM triggers refresh boundaries using an EMA-smoothed event score computed from tracking-derived cues (births/deaths and coarse composition/layout changes) with temporal constraints. A recurrence memory further retrieves anchor frames via CLIP similarity to re-condition the model on re-appearance events. Experiments on Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS, and ReVOS show that EDRRM achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off relative to fixed-window and FrameDiff-SSIM baselines, maintaining comparable or superior J&F scores at substantially lower average refresh-call budgets and reducing false-positive failures. End-to-end runtime analysis further confirms that the overhead introduced by tracking, CLIP-based recurrence matching, and the identifiability gate remains modest relative to the dominant Sa2VA inference cost, thereby validating the efficiency of the proposed pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EDRRM（事件驱动刷新+循环记忆）增强方法，用于提升Sa2VA在RVOS任务中的长视频分割稳定性与效率。
AI.motivation: Sa2VA在长或动态视频中仅在少量初始关键帧上进行定位，随后依赖传播，导致目标构成变化（干扰物进入、目标消失/重现）时出现定位过时和持续假阳性问题。
AI.method: EDRRM仅在稳定变化点选择性地重新调用Sa2VA：利用跟踪线索（出生/死亡、粗粒度构成/布局变化）计算EMA平滑事件分数并在时间约束下触发刷新边界；同时通过循环记忆基于CLIP相似度检索锚帧，在重现事件时重新对模型进行条件化。
AI.result: 在Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS和ReVOS上，EDRRM相对固定窗口和FrameDiff-SSIM基线实现了有竞争力的精度-效率权衡，在显著更低的平均刷新调用预算下保持相当或更优的J&F分数，并减少假阳性失败；端到端运行时分析表明跟踪、CLIP循环匹配与可识别性门控带来的开销相对Sa2VA推理成本较小。
AI.conclusion: EDRRM通过在稳定变化点选择性刷新并结合循环记忆，有效缓解长动态视频中的过时定位与假阳性问题，在保持或提升分割精度的同时降低刷新开销，验证了其精度-效率权衡的有效性。

title: Distill the Visual Evidence, Not Just the Answer: Cross-World On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: A central goal of vision-language model (VLM) distillation is to transfer both the teacher's language capabilities and its visual understanding. However, existing methods primarily supervise the student's output, leaving visual understanding implicit. Our analysis reveals that a student can match the teacher's answer without relying on the same visual evidence, raising the question: how can we ensure the student responds to the visual information that actually determines the answer? To this end, we propose \textbf{Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)}, which explicitly supervises the student's response to changes in visual evidence. For each example, CW-OPD constructs two visual worlds that share the question and scene context but differ in answer-critical evidence, yielding different answers. We perform on-policy distillation in both worlds and distill the teacher's cross-world belief transition, encouraging the student to match not only \emph{what} the teacher predicts but also \emph{why} its prediction changes with the evidence. A gradient analysis shows that this term is invariant to errors shared by both worlds and supplies a corrective signal invisible to endpoint matching alone. In this way, CW-OPD makes reliance on the relevant visual evidence an explicit distillation target rather than an implicit consequence of output matching. To diagnose whether a model truly grounds its answers in visual evidence, we introduce CWBench, which measures cross-world consistency via Cross-World Pair Accuracy (CWPA). Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that CW-OPD outperforms the strongest baseline by \textbf{1.2} points on average, and the 4B student exceeds DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) by \textbf{22.4} CWPA points on CWBench. Code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨世界同策略蒸馏（CW-OPD），通过构造共享问题与场景但答案关键视觉证据不同的两个视觉世界，显式监督学生模型对视觉证据变化的响应，蒸馏教师的跨世界信念转移，使学生不仅匹配教师的预测结果，还匹配预测随证据变化的原因。同时提出CWBench评测基准，用跨世界配对准确率（CWPA）诊断模型是否真正基于视觉证据作答。实验显示CW-OPD在Qwen3.5-4B上平均超越最强基线1.2分，4B学生模型在CWBench上超出DeepSeek-V4.1（552B）22.4 CWPA分。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型蒸馏的核心目标是同时迁移教师的语言能力与视觉理解能力，但现有方法主要监督学生输出，使视觉理解只能隐式习得。分析发现，学生可以在不依赖与教师相同视觉证据的情况下匹配教师答案，这引出一个问题：如何确保学生对真正决定答案的视觉信息作出响应。因此需要一种能显式监督学生对视觉证据变化之响应的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 提出跨世界同策略蒸馏（CW-OPD）。对每个样本构造两个视觉世界，二者共享问题与场景上下文，但在答案关键证据上不同并导致不同答案。在两个世界中执行同策略蒸馏，并蒸馏教师的跨世界信念转移，使学生不仅匹配教师预测的"什么"，也匹配其预测随证据变化的"为什么"。梯度分析表明该项对两个世界共有的误差具有不变性，可提供端点匹配无法察觉的纠正信号，从而将依赖相关视觉证据变为显式的蒸馏目标。此外提出CWBench，通过跨世界配对准确率（CWPA）衡量跨世界一致性，用于诊断模型是否真正基于视觉证据作答。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，CW-OPD平均比最强基线高出1.2分；4B学生模型在CWBench上以CWPA指标超出DeepSeek-V4.1（552B）22.4分。代码已发布于https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD。
AI.conclusion: CW-OPD通过显式监督学生对视觉证据变化的响应，弥补了现有输出监督蒸馏中视觉理解隐式化的不足，使依赖相关视觉证据成为显式蒸馏目标；配合CWBench与CWPA可有效诊断并验证模型的视觉证据归因能力，实验证明该方法以更小模型取得显著优于基线与大模型的跨世界一致性表现。

title: Training LLM Judges from Language Feedback via Position-Selective Self-Distillation
summary: We study training LLM judges from natural language feedback, especially for subjective tasks where the verdict depends strongly on which evaluation criteria the judge invokes and how it weighs them. The dominant approach, outcome-supervised RL (e.g., GRPO), credits every token in the rollout with a single scalar determined only by the accuracy of the final verdict, providing no separate credit at the criterion-choice tokens and ignoring the rich language feedback (e.g., preference rationales) that naturally accompanies preference labels. Self-Distillation (SD) is one natural way to use this language feedback: the same model, conditioned on this feedback, acts as a teacher providing dense, position-level supervision. However, not all positions carry equally useful signal. Using the per-position entropy shift between teacher and student, we identify two regimes: context sharpening, where the teacher concentrates probability on a particular feedback-aligned criterion expression, and context spreading, where the teacher distributes probability across multiple feedback-aligned alternatives. We interpret these patterns as follows: sharpening encourages memorization of a particular criterion expression, whereas spreading promotes semantic understanding by preserving these alternatives. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce position masking based on the entropy shift that retains the lower tail of the entropy-shift distribution. Experiments show that masking higher-entropy-shift positions improves out-of-distribution generalization over naive SD. The resulting self-distilled judges outperform judges trained with outcome-supervised RL by 2-9 percentage points on the evaluated subjective subcategories, while remaining competitive on objective ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何利用自然语言反馈训练LLM评判器，提出基于熵偏移的位置掩码自蒸馏方法，在主观任务上显著优于结果监督RL。
AI.motivation: 主观任务的评判结果高度依赖所采用的评估标准及其权重，而主流的监督式RL（如GRPO）仅用最终判定准确率的单一标量奖励回传至所有token，既未对标准选择token单独分配信用，也忽略了偏好标签自然附带的丰富语言反馈（如偏好理由）。
AI.method: 采用自蒸馏（SD）利用语言反馈：同一模型在反馈条件下作为教师，提供稠密的、位置级监督。通过教师与学生之间的逐位置熵偏移识别两种模式——语境锐化（教师将概率集中于某一反馈对齐的标准表述）与语境扩散（教师在多个反馈对齐的备选方案间分配概率）。基于此不对称性，提出依据熵偏移的位置掩码，仅保留熵偏移分布的下尾部分进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，掩蔽高熵偏移位置可提升相对朴素SD的分布外泛化能力；所得自蒸馏评判器在主观子类别上比结果监督RL训练的评判器高出2–9个百分点，同时在客观任务上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 熵偏移可区分“记忆特定标准表述”与“保持多备选语义理解”两类监督信号，通过掩码高熵偏移位置可保留促进语义理解的监督，从而提升主观任务评判器的分布外泛化性能。

title: Recovering Off-Policy Supervision for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters for speculative decoding are commonly trained on corpora written by external models, where a single off-policy token invalidates supervision for all subsequent slots in a block. Existing approaches discard these divergent slots, resulting in severe supervision loss. To resolve this problem while preserving the training corpus, we propose a rollout-based training framework that recovers full supervision through two complementary components. The first component, Anchor-Label Relabelling (ALR), replaces corpus labels with distributions from greedy target rollouts, restoring valid supervision across all predicted slots. The second component, In-Rollout Anchors (IRA), places draft blocks directly inside these rollouts to expose the drafter to target-generated context, reusing precomputed rollout features at no additional target cost. Across fixed vision-language and text corpora, our framework increases greedy accepted length by up to 36.5% over DFlash and consistently outperforms erasing baselines. Notably, a single epoch of our method surpasses the best erase schedules. After three epochs, it matches the acceptance length of training on target-regenerated responses. These results show that our framework provides an effective and compute-efficient approach for training speculative drafters on fixed corpora without modifying the original text. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ALR-IRA.

AI.tldr: 提出基于rollout的投机解码草稿模型训练框架，用锚点重标注(ALR)和rollout内锚点(IRA)恢复被丢弃slot的监督信号。
AI.motivation: 现有块式草稿模型用外部模型语料训练时，单个off-policy token会导致块内后续所有slot监督失效，而丢弃这些分歧slot会造成严重监督损失。
AI.method: 框架含两部分：ALR用贪婪目标rollout的分布替换语料标签，恢复所有预测slot的有效监督；IRA将草稿块直接置于这些rollout中，使草稿模型接触目标生成上下文，并复用预计算的rollout特征，不增加目标侧额外开销。
AI.result: 在固定视觉-语言和文本语料上，贪婪接受长度较DFlash提升最高36.5%，持续优于擦除基线；单轮训练即超过最佳擦除调度，三轮后接受长度匹配在目标重生成响应上训练的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为在不修改原文的固定语料上训练投机草稿模型提供了有效且计算高效的方案。

title: Evaluating Persistent Calibration under Evolving Model Knowledge
summary: As AI systems move from static repositories to agents that are capable of continual adaptation and learning, maintaining their trustworthiness means equipping the models backing them with the ability to produce confidence estimates that dynamically reflect their changing skills and knowledge. We introduce the problem of persistent calibration, which requires a confidence estimator to faithfully reflect the knowledge contained in a model as that knowledge changes, without recurring supervision. We operationalize this by examining persistent calibration across checkpoints of open models, asking whether confidence estimators trained on earlier checkpoints can generalize to later ones. Specifically, we aim to shed light on whether confidence is dependent on knowledge, a question with implications for the reliability of confidence estimates. To measure this relationship, we define and evaluate calibration on knowledge contrast sets: subsets containing questions that one checkpoint answers correctly and another checkpoint answers incorrectly, reflecting a change in knowledge. We show that both inference-time and fine-tuning methods fall short on contrast-set calibration compared to oracle methods trained on future checkpoints, even for methods that are well-calibrated on the full dataset. We provide evidence for the hypothesis that persistent calibration is challenging because there is a vast space of possible confidence functions that are well-calibrated on a given checkpoint, out of which only some rely on meta-knowledge features that would generalize to other checkpoints. Towards improving contrast-set calibration, we show that multi-checkpoint training helps, suggesting an avenue for identifying confidence features that remain robust across changing knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"持续校准"问题：模型知识变化时，置信度估计需在无重复监督下持续反映其知识状态；通过知识对比集评测发现现有推断时与微调方法均不足，而多检查点训练可改善。
AI.motivation: AI系统正从静态仓库转向具备持续适应与学习能力的智能体，其可信赖性要求模型置信度估计能动态反映不断变化的技能与知识，而现有校准方法多在固定模型上评估，缺乏对知识变化场景下校准持续性的研究。
AI.method: 定义持续校准问题，并在开源模型的多个检查点上进行评估：考察在早期检查点训练的置信度估计器能否泛化到后期检查点；构造"知识对比集"（一个检查点答对而另一检查点答错的题目子集）来度量校准与知识的关系；对比推断时方法、微调方法与在后期检查点上训练的oracle方法；并尝试多检查点训练。
AI.result: 推断时与微调方法在对比集校准上均逊于oracle方法，即使这些方法在完整数据集上校准良好；证据表明持续校准困难源于在给定检查点上良好校准的置信度函数空间庞大，其中仅部分依赖可泛化到其他检查点的元知识特征；多检查点训练有助于改善对比集校准。
AI.conclusion: 持续校准是持续学习智能体可信赖性的关键挑战，置信度与知识存在依赖关系；多检查点训练为识别跨知识变化稳健的置信度特征提供了可行方向。

title: Overlap, Unique and Conflict: Can LLMs Extract What They Can Recognize?
summary: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Existing work on cross-text relations largely focuses on categorizing relations between predefined text pairs, such as entailment or contradiction, rather than directly extracting such information from full narratives. To address this gap, we introduce Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) extraction, a cross-narrative task that extracts all overlapping, conflicting, and unique clauses from two narratives. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of approximately 22K narrative pairs and 140K OUC instances spanning factual, argumentative, and political discourse. Evaluating 14 open-source LLMs (0.6B-35B), we find that unique information is far easier to extract than overlap and conflict: the strongest model, Gemma-4-31B, reaches only 61.13% F1-score on overlap and 48.58% on conflict, against more than 75% on unique. Further diagnostic analysis reveals that this difficulty does not stem from relation recognition alone, but rather from a failure to pair and extract the corresponding clauses from full narratives, especially in smaller models. Nevertheless, learning these extractions with task-specific supervision narrows the gap considerably: a fine-tuned Qwen-3-8B gains 15-28% absolute over its baseline and surpasses models roughly four times its size (e.g., Qwen-3.6-35B) on several tasks. Even so, overlap and conflict remain well below satisfactory, leaving cross-narrative clause extraction an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"重叠-独有-冲突"(OUC)抽取任务，构建约22K叙事对、140K实例的基准，评测14个开源LLM并做诊断分析，发现独有信息最易抽取，重叠与冲突困难，且困难源于从句配对与抽取而非关系识别；任务专用微调可显著缩小差距。
AI.motivation: 理解多视角替代叙事需要识别不同来源信息之间的一致、冲突与差异。然而现有跨文本关系研究多聚焦于对预定义文本对进行关系分类（如蕴含、矛盾），而非从完整叙事中直接抽取此类信息，二者之间存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出跨叙事任务"重叠-独有-冲突抽取"(OUC extraction)，从两段叙事中抽取所有重叠、冲突与独有从句；构建约22K叙事对、140K个OUC实例的基准，覆盖事实性、论证性与政治性语料；评测14个开源LLM（0.6B–35B），并进行诊断分析，同时开展任务专用监督微调实验。
AI.result: 独有信息远易于重叠与冲突：最强模型Gemma-4-31B在重叠上仅61.13% F1、冲突48.58%，而独有超过75%。诊断显示困难并非仅源于关系识别，而是未能从完整叙事中配对并抽取对应从句，小模型尤甚。任务专用监督可显著缩小差距：微调后的Qwen-3-8B较基线绝对提升15–28%，并在多项任务上超越约四倍规模模型（如Qwen-3.6-35B）。
AI.conclusion: 重叠与冲突抽取性能仍远未令人满意，跨叙事从句抽取仍是一个开放挑战；但任务专用监督学习是有效的改进路径。

title: Uncovering Uncontrolled Repetition through Residual Stream Dynamics
summary: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Prior analyses of repetitive generation have identified strongly activated features in intermediate and late layers. However, how uncontrolled repetition activity emerges and develops before becoming prominent in these layers remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate this question primarily in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which support a richer set of uncontrolled repetitions through both visual and textual inputs. We propose Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC), a method that identifies and localizes anomalies associated with repetition from residual dynamics during generation. TRC compares attention and multilayer perceptron writes to the residual stream across generated tokens to identify patterns associated with repetition. It then selectively suppresses coordinates in the residual stream at the identified layer. Experiments show that TRC effectively mitigates uncontrolled repetition, reducing loop rates by 57\% on average. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. TRC also generalizes to large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs), where it consistently captures analogous repetition dynamics and achieves effective mitigation. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tokenwise Residual Comparison (TRC) 方法,通过比较残差流中的注意力与前馈写入,定位并抑制重复生成相关的异常坐标,平均降低 57% 的循环率。
AI.motivation: 不受控重复会延长大模型自回归生成,并可能被用于资源消耗攻击。已有分析多聚焦于中后层中被强激活的特征,但对这些层中重复活动在凸显之前如何产生与演变仍缺乏理解,也缺乏更早的干预机会。
AI.method: 提出 TRC(Tokenwise Residual Comparison):在生成过程中跨生成 token 比较注意力(attention)与多层感知机(MLP)对残差流(residual stream)的写入,以识别与重复相关的异常模式,并在所定位层选择性地抑制残差流中的相应坐标。研究主要在大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)上展开,因其视觉与文本输入支持更丰富的重复形式。
AI.result: TRC 有效缓解不受控重复,平均将循环率降低 57%;分析显示重复语义在浅层出现,并沿残差流传播,扰乱正常表征;TRC 可泛化到 LLMs 与大型推理模型(LRMs),一致地捕捉类似重复动态并实现有效缓解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将重复生成研究从显著的内部表征拓展到更早的可干预时机,为缓解资源消耗攻击提供了新视角与实用方法。

title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems
summary: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"黑板智能"(Blackboard Intelligence)推理范式：让扩散语言模型在可修改的固定画布上任意顺序预测并搜索候选解状态，利用掩码扩散目标中的平均置信度作为全局连贯性代理来引导推理时搜索与修正，在约束类任务上显著优于同规模自回归模型乃至更大规模前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 下一个词元预测(next-token prediction)虽推动了大语言模型的发展，但在受复杂全局约束支配的问题上表现不佳。作者关注这一局限是否部分源于下一个词元预测所诱导的推理接口(causal, left-to-right trajectory)，即自回归的因果从左到右生成方式难以适应需要整体约束满足的任务。
AI.method: 提出"黑板智能"推理时视角：模型在固定的、可修订的画布上工作，搜索候选解状态而非锁定在因果从左到右轨迹上。用扩散语言模型实例化该思想，其任意顺序预测接口(any-order prediction)天然暴露部分填充解状态上的预测。关键观察是"平均置信度"(mean confidence)——由标准掩码扩散目标即可获得的模型内部量——可作全局连贯性的代理指标，并用于引导推理时的搜索与修订。实验中固定微调后的LLaDA-8B-Instruct检查点不变，仅改进推理。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogic、Nurse Rostering、Job-Shop Scheduling三个基准上，Blackboard持续提升推理性能，并显著优于同规模自回归基线：ZebraLogic-Hard达90.4%准确率，Nurse Rostering达76.4%精确可行率，JSSP达80.2%最优率。更强的自回归搜索与精炼方法在ZebraLogic-Hard上仍无法弥合差距；Blackboard在该任务及JSSP上还超越了所测试的前沿LLM，尽管后者规模更大且具备强推理时推理能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 部分复杂全局约束任务的困难源于下一个词元预测的推理接口本身。可修订画布+任意顺序扩散预测+平均置信度引导的搜索，是一种有效且无需更换模型权重即可提升约束求解能力的推理时范式，并展现出优于更大规模自回归与前沿模型的潜力。

title: StateTree: Enhancing Long-Term Dialogue Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models deployed as personalized assistants must reason over long, evolving interaction histories. However, in long-term dialogue reasoning, relevant evidence is scattered across sessions, preferences may be revised over time, and standard long-context training fails to address these challenges under data scarcity and prohibitive computational costs. We propose StateTree, a data-driven RL method that constructs a challenging auxiliary task from scarce dialogues with verifiable ground truth. StateTree augments multi-session dialogues with a tree-structured path-tracing task: key-value records are embedded across sessions to form a binary tree. Solving the task requires the model to traverse from root to leaf by retrieving records across sessions and comparing timestamps to resolve branches, then recover the hidden target question among distractor leaves. We apply curriculum RL training progressively increasing tree depth and introduce a compositional variant whose edges carry step-level reasoning fragments, training the model to compose partial cues into coherent queries. Trained on 10K-token contexts, StateTree generalizes to 128K tokens without full-length RL costs and exhibits capabilities including cross-session retrieval, temporal reasoning, knowledge update, and compositional multi-hop reasoning. StateTree outperforms both SFT and RL-based baselines while preserving short-context general reasoning. StateTree-7B achieves gains up to +23.60% on LongMemEval (128k), and StateTree-14B reaches 59.00% accuracy on LongMemEval, surpassing QwenLong-L1-32B (45.20%).

AI.tldr: StateTree：用树结构路径追踪任务和课程强化学习训练长时对话推理，10K训练泛化到128K，LongMemEval显著提升。
AI.motivation: 个性化助手需在长期、演化的交互历史中推理，但证据跨会话分散、偏好随时间修订；标准长上下文训练面临数据稀缺和算力代价高的问题。直接长上下文RL训练代价大且难获得可验证监督。
AI.method: 提出数据驱动的RL方法StateTree：从稀缺对话中构造可验证真值的辅助任务。将多轮会话增强为树结构路径追踪：跨会话嵌入键值记录构成二叉树，模型需跨会话检索记录、比较时间戳以选择分支，从根遍历到叶，并在干扰叶中恢复隐藏目标问题。采用课程RL逐步增加树深度，并引入组合变体（边携带步骤级推理片段），训练模型将部分线索组合为连贯查询。
AI.result: 10K token上下文训练即可泛化到128K且无需全长RL成本；具备跨会话检索、时间推理、知识更新、组合多跳推理能力。优于SFT和RL基线，同时保持短上下文通用推理。StateTree-7B在LongMemEval(128k)提升最多+23.60%，StateTree-14B达59.00%准确率，超过QwenLong-L1-32B(45.20%)。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造可验证的树结构路径追踪辅助任务并结合课程RL，可在低成本下获得强长时对话推理与长上下文泛化能力，且不损害短上下文通用能力。

title: CRAFT: Causal Responsibility and Failure Tracing in Medical Vision Language Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Spotlight, Medical VLM Failure Analysis
summary: As vision language models are increasingly deployed in clinical diagnosis, under standing how they internally resolve competing visual and textual signals becomes a safety imperative. Existing mechanistic analyses remain confined to unimodal text and offer no explanation for why a single misleading sentence can override a correct image based diagnosis, or why a model commits to a confident answer despite insufficient visual evidence. We find that these two safety risks, arbitra tion failure where textual context overrides visual grounding and brake failure where the model commits without adequate evidence, are mediated by spatially disjoint attention head populations: arbitration heads form a mid-to-deep wideband reflecting cross-layer evidence competition, while brake heads concentrate in a narrow middle-to-late layer band that regulates evidence sufficiency and abstention behavior. To ground these observations in causal circuitry, we introduce CRAFT, which localizes each failure mode to a minimal causal head set via dual criteria and verifies necessity and sufficiency through temporal probes and Tuned Lens trajectory analysis. Excising arbitration heads sharply reduces conflict following with negligible degradation on clean inputs, while excising brake heads restores ap propriate abstention under degraded visual evidence. The two interventions target spatially disjoint head sets and produce distinct corrective effects, underscoring the mechanistic separability of the failure modes. Experiments across multiple medical VQA benchmarks and VLM architectures validate both the localization and inter ventions, demonstrating that the identified heads causally drive each failure mode and that targeted modulation generalises without retraining. The code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/CRAFT.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示视觉语言模型在医学诊断中的两类安全失效（仲裁失效与制动失效）由空间上分离的注意力头群体调控，并提出CRAFT定位因果头集合并进行干预。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型日益用于临床诊断，但已有机制分析局限于单模态文本，无法解释为何一句误导性文本能压倒正确的图像诊断，或模型在视觉证据不足时仍给出高置信答案，这构成紧迫的安全问题。
AI.method: 发现两类风险对应空间分离的注意力头：仲裁头（arbitration heads）形成中层至深层的宽带，反映跨层证据竞争；制动头（brake heads）集中于中后层窄带，调控证据充分性与弃答行为。进而提出CRAFT，通过双重准则将每种失效模式定位到最小因果头集合，并用时间探针与Tuned Lens轨迹分析验证其必要性与充分性。
AI.result: 切除仲裁头显著降低对冲突文本的跟随，且在干净输入上退化可忽略；切除制动头可在视觉证据退化时恢复适当弃答。两类干预针对空间分离的头集合并产生不同纠正效果，证明失效模式的机制可分离性。多个医学VQA基准与VLM架构上验证了定位与干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 识别出的注意力头因果驱动各失效模式，针对性调制无需重训练即可泛化，代码已开源。

title: DCM-SAM: Defect-Conditioned Mixture of LoRA Experts for NPU-Deployed AM Defect Segmentation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI)
summary: Metal additive manufacturing parts are inspected by X-ray computed tomography, where labelled data is scarce, the pores and inclusions that matter span a few pixels, and inspection must happen at the machine. We present DCM-SAM, a defect-conditioned adaptive mixture of LoRA experts: one frozen Segment Anything backbone carries a separate Conv-LoRA expert bank and mask decoder per defect class, each trained in its own pass, without prompts, on synthetic slices alone, updating only 4.4% of the parameters. On benchmarks that XCT-SAM reports, DCM-SAM improves on every baseline for both classes from a ViT-B backbone against their ViT-H, and reaches 64.2% pore IoU on real NIST scans having seen no real images during training. Deployment then exposes what adaptation work rarely measures: on a Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, ViT-H and ViT-L compile yet cannot allocate at 1024x1024 image resolution, since activations rather than weights exceed the device ceiling, and quantizing weights does not help. ViT-B alone runs, but the adapted encoder then fails to allocate where the stock one succeeds, until a numerically identical rewrite of the attention lets the complete DCM-SAM run in FP16 at 1024x1024, with no operator falling back to the CPU, masks within 0.01% of pixels of the FP32 reference. Code: https://github.com/MushfiqShovon/DCM-SAM.

AI.tldr: 提出DCM-SAM：缺陷条件自适应的LoRA专家混合模型，仅训练4.4%参数、仅用合成切片训练，在XCT-SAM基准上以ViT-B超越其ViT-H，实机NIST扫描孔隙IoU达64.2%；并揭示NPU部署中激活值（而非权重）导致的1024×1024内存瓶颈，通过数值等价的注意力重写实现FP16全算子片上运行。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造零件的X射线CT检测面临三重约束：标注数据稀缺、关键孔隙与夹杂仅占几个像素、且检测必须在设备端（机旁）完成。既有分割方法（如XCT-SAM）依赖大骨干与真实标注，难以满足小目标、少标注与边缘部署的需求。
AI.method: DCM-SAM采用缺陷条件自适应的LoRA专家混合：单一冻结的SAM骨干，为每个缺陷类别配备独立的Conv-LoRA专家库与掩码解码器；各类别分轮训练、无需提示、仅用合成切片，仅更新4.4%参数。部署侧在Qualcomm Hexagon NPU上评测，并针对注意力算子做数值等价的改写以支持FP16在1024×1024分辨率下的完整运行。
AI.result: 在XCT-SAM报告的基准上，ViT-B骨干的DCM-SAM对两类缺陷均优于所有基线（对比其ViT-H），在从未见过真实图像的条件下于真实NIST扫描上取得64.2%孔隙IoU。部署方面：ViT-H与ViT-L虽可编译但在1024×1024下无法分配内存（激活值超限、权重量化无效）；ViT-B可运行但适配后编码器分配失败而原版成功；经数值等价的注意力重写后，完整DCM-SAM可在1024×1024以FP16运行，无算子回退CPU，掩码与FP32参考差异在0.01%像素以内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明参数高效、合成数据驱动的专家混合适配可在小骨干上超越大骨干的分割性能，并将"可部署性"作为一等评测维度：边缘NPU的限制由激活内存而非权重主导，数值等价的算子重写是解锁高分辨率FP16全片上推理的关键。

title: Can Terminal Agents Trust Their Own Verification? Diagnosing and Improving Self-Verification
summary: Terminal agents rely on self-verification to assess and correct their solutions as they solve tasks through interaction with command-line environments. Yet how trustworthy such self-verification is remains poorly understood. To investigate this question systematically, we introduce a diagnostic framework that identifies the first complete solution in each trajectory, determines whether it is objectively correct, and uses this ground truth to quantify the agent's subsequent verification and recovery behavior. Applying it to ten terminal agents on TerminalBench2.1, we find that verification is nearly universal after a complete candidate is formed, yet only 61.43\% of incorrect candidates are detected and only 49.36\% of detected errors are successfully repaired. These results show that the main weakness in self-verification lies not in initiating verification, but in detecting and repairing errors. Motivated by these findings, we propose Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD), which lets the student first produce a candidate solution and distills a stronger teacher's subsequent verification and recovery from the same interaction context. Across three Qwen3.5 backbones, SCVD improves \textsc{Pass@1} on TerminalBench2.1 by 9.74--16.85 percentage points over the corresponding base models and by 4.49--8.61 points over the standard full-trajectory distillation, while avoiding the pronounced out-of-distribution degradation of full-trajectory distillation on SWE-bench Verified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出诊断框架研究终端智能体的自验证可信度，发现其弱点在于错误检测与修复而非验证启动，并据此提出SCVD蒸馏方法显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 终端智能体依赖自验证来评估和纠正其解，但自验证的可信度尚不明确，需要系统性研究其验证与恢复行为的真实表现。
AI.method: 提出诊断框架：定位每条轨迹中首个完整解，判定其客观正确性，并以此为基准量化智能体随后的验证与恢复行为；在TerminalBench2.1上评估十个终端智能体。基于发现提出Student-Conditioned Verification Distillation (SCVD)：让学生先产出一个候选解，再蒸馏更强教师在相同交互上下文下的后续验证与恢复过程。
AI.result: 完整候选解形成后，验证几乎普遍发生，但仅61.43%的错误候选被检测出，检出的错误中仅49.36%被成功修复。在三个Qwen3.5骨干模型上，SCVD使TerminalBench2.1的Pass@1相对基座模型提升9.74–16.85个百分点，相对标准全轨迹蒸馏提升4.49–8.61个百分点，同时在SWE-bench Verified上避免了全轨迹蒸馏明显的分布外性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 自验证的主要瓶颈不在于是否启动验证，而在于错误检测与修复能力；针对该环节的SCVD蒸馏策略能有效提升终端智能体的任务成功率，并保持更好的分布外泛化性。

title: You're Hired: Strategic Model Selection for LLM Collaboration
summary: While multi-agent and model collaboration algorithms gain traction to combine the strengths of diverse Large Language Models (LLMs), existing systems remain bottlenecked on pre-defined and hand-crafted model pools. In this work, we investigate the problem of model selection in multi-LLM systems. We propose and systematically evaluate a taxonomy of 9 selection algorithms ranging from diversity of model descriptions, capability-aware behavioral diversity, and LLM-based recruiters. We conduct extensive experiments across two candidate pools of 10 and 32 models, deployed in four model collaboration algorithms, and evaluated across tasks spanning math, coding, QA, and reasoning. Results demonstrate that successful selection algorithms greatly outperform random or heuristics-based teams such as merely selecting the models with top individual performance, by up to 36.1% across settings. Specifically, capability- and training-based selection strategies alleviate selection variance and achieve the best performance, which we recommend to employ before deploying real-world multi-LLM systems. Further analysis reveals that larger candidate pools pose greater challenges to shallow selection heuristics, while algorithms grounded in interacting with candidate models and understanding model capability robustly filter out misaligned, unsafe models, as well as generalizing to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. Together, we establish that principled and informed team selection is critical and present strong model selection algorithms for assembling effective multi-LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多LLM系统中的模型选择问题，提出并评估了9种选择算法的分类体系，实验表明能力感知与基于训练的选择策略优于随机或启发式团队，提升最高达36.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体与模型协作算法依赖预定义、人工构造的模型池，成为系统瓶颈，缺乏对“如何选择模型”这一关键问题的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出并系统评估9种选择算法的分类体系，涵盖模型描述的多样性、能力感知的行为多样性以及基于LLM的招募者；在10和32个模型的两个候选池、4种模型协作算法、以及数学/编程/问答/推理等任务上进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 成功的选择算法大幅优于随机或启发式团队（如仅选个体性能最优模型），最高提升36.1%；能力与训练相关的选择策略能缓解选择方差并获得最佳性能；更大的候选池对浅层启发式更具挑战，而基于与候选模型交互、理解模型能力的算法能稳健过滤不匹配、不安全模型，并可泛化到分布外新任务。
AI.conclusion: 有原则且基于信息的团队选择对构建有效多LLM系统至关重要，推荐在部署实际多LLM系统前采用能力与训练相关的选择策略。

title: When Reasoning Goes Astray: Attention Dynamics of Uncontrolled Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve performance on complex tasks through extended reasoning, yet the same process can degenerate into redundant verification and persistent generation loops. Such uncontrolled reasoning increases inference cost and creates risks of resource exhaustion and service degradation. However, existing mitigations largely truncate long outputs or react to surface repetition, and thus fail to distinguish normal thinking from uncontrolled reasoning or explain how benign reasoning degenerates into harmful behavior. In this paper, we operationalize LRM generation as four states and further introduce Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses (RADAR), which identifies the current reasoning state in real time and characterizes how effective reflection can develop into uncontrolled generation. Guided by RADAR's analysis, we further realign abnormal attention distributions toward patterns observed in normal requests and examine how this correction affects excessive reflection and persistent looping. Temporal analyses show that uncontrolled reasoning is characterized by attention distributions that deviate from normal generation, with abnormal trends becoming detectable before repetition begins. Correcting these deviations through Attention Realignment consistently reduces looping while largely preserving benign performance. Together, RADAR provide a mechanistic account of how reasoning becomes uncontrolled, offering actionable guidance for identifying critical failure stages and designing targeted runtime interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文将大推理模型（LRM）的生成过程操作化为四种状态，提出基于动态注意力响应的推理状态分析框架RADAR，实时识别推理状态并刻画有效反思如何退化为失控生成；据此通过注意力重对齐（Attention Realignment）纠正异常注意力分布，可一致性地减少循环并基本保持良性性能。
AI.motivation: LRM通过扩展推理提升复杂任务表现，但推理过程可能退化为冗余验证与持续生成循环，导致推理成本上升、资源耗尽与服务降级风险。现有缓解方法多依赖截断长输出或对表层重复做出反应，无法区分正常思考与失控推理，也难以解释良性推理如何退化为有害行为。
AI.method: 1) 将LRM生成操作化为四种状态；2) 提出Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses（RADAR），实时识别当前推理状态并刻画有效反思向失控生成的演化；3) 在RADAR分析指导下，将异常注意力分布重对齐至正常请求中观察到的模式，并考察该纠正对过度反思与持续循环的影响；4) 进行时序分析。
AI.result: 时序分析表明，失控推理以偏离正常生成的注意力分布为特征，且异常趋势在重复出现之前即可被检测到。通过注意力重对齐纠正这些偏差，能够一致性地减少循环，同时基本保持良性性能。
AI.conclusion: RADAR为推理如何变得失控提供了机制性解释，为识别关键失效阶段与设计针对性运行时干预提供了可操作指导。

title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
summary: Organizations increasingly route employee feedback to leaders through large language model (LLM) summaries, an unaudited layer that silences already-spoken voice. We introduce a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric for representational bias in summarization and apply it to a bilingual (English/German) corpus of 2,586 free-text responses from a global professional service company. First, employees supply criticism more reliably than praise (withholding praise is 82 times more common). Second, across 45 leader-summaries the pipeline filters by popularity, not sentiment: criticism survives, yet a concern voiced once is dropped 86% of the time, with short and German-only content lost on the same axis (theme retention 0.14 vs 0.74; German directional). Controlling for frequency, sentiment has no independent effect; the harm is prevalence-driven, which sentiment-only audits miss. A targeted prompt recovers only named themes. We contribute the metric, field evidence, and a disaggregated voice-retention card.

AI.tldr: 组织用大语言模型（LLM）摘要向领导者转达员工反馈，形成未经审计的"消音层"。作者提出"声音保留/代表性比率"指标，并基于某全球专业服务公司2,586条英/德双语自由文本及45份领导摘要进行实证分析，发现摘要管线按"流行度"而非情感过滤：批评更常被主动表达（不表达赞扬的可能性高82倍），但仅被提及一次的关切有86%被丢弃，短文本与纯德语内容损失最重（主题保留率0.14 vs 0.74）。
AI.motivation: 员工反馈一旦进入LLM摘要环节，就出现了一个缺乏审计的中间层，可能系统性地删削已表达的声音（"silencing already-spoken voice"）。现有审计多聚焦情感倾向，忽略了代表性偏差（哪些声音被保留、哪些被抹去）。作者希望量化这种代表性偏差，并揭示其真实机制。
AI.method: 1）提出"声音保留/代表性比率"（Voice Retention / Representation Ratio）指标，用于衡量摘要中的代表性偏差；2）构建英/德双语语料：某全球专业服务公司2,586条自由文本反馈；3）收集45份领导摘要，计算主题保留率；4）分析频率、情感、语言、文本长度等变量对保留的影响，并做频率控制的回归；5）测试针对性的提示（prompt）干预能否恢复丢失内容；6）输出分项（disaggregated）的"声音保留卡"。
AI.result: 员工表达批评比表达赞扬更稳定（不表达赞扬比不表达批评高82倍）。在45份领导摘要中，管线按流行度而非情感过滤：批评本身能幸存，但仅被一位员工提及的关切有86%被丢弃。短文本与纯德语内容在同一维度上损失（主题保留率0.14，对比高频主题0.74；德语呈方向性损失）。控制频率后，情感无独立效应——伤害由"普及度/出现频次"驱动，这正是仅做情感审计会漏掉的。针对性的提示干预只能恢复被明确命名的主题。
AI.conclusion: LLM摘要层的偏差本质是"频率驱动"的，而非情感驱动，因此仅基于情感的审计不足以发现问题。作者贡献了三项成果：可复用的声音保留指标、来自真实企业的实证证据，以及分项披露的声音保留卡，用于让被摘要层削弱的员工声音变得可审计、可追责。

title: Future Video Generation Better Aligns with the Human Visual Cortex than Observed Video
summary: Studying the alignment between the internal representations of vision models and the responses of the visual cortex to the same observed visual stimuli has enabled us to better understand human visual processing. However, studies so far have largely overlooked the fact that the human brain not only processes observed visual stimuli, but also predicts upcoming stimuli based on what has been observed. Accordingly, we hypothesize that internal representations for generating future video frames are better aligned with the predictive nature of human visual processing than representations of the observed video itself. To this end, we compare the alignment between human video-watching fMRI responses in the visual cortex and the internal representations from two types of video diffusion models, an autoregressive (AR) model and its non-AR base model. We first conduct a within-model analysis of the AR video diffusion model and show that the representations for future video generation align better with the visual cortex than the representations of the observed video. We then compare the internal representations of the AR model with those of its non-AR base model and again show that the representations for future video generation align better with the visual cortex than the representations for observed video reconstruction by the base model. Specifically, the alignment of observed video reconstruction is concentrated in lower-order visual cortex, whereas that of future video generation is concentrated in higher-order visual cortex. Finally, we show in a human behavioral experiment that humans prefer videos generated by amplifying the contributions of individual layers that align better with the visual cortex.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比人类观看视频时的fMRI视觉皮层响应与视频扩散模型内部表征，发现用于生成未来帧的表征比观测视频本身的表征更契合人类视觉处理，且该对齐集中于高级视觉皮层，并获行为实验支持。
AI.motivation: 以往关于视觉模型内部表征与视觉皮层响应对齐的研究，大多忽视了人脑不仅处理当前观测刺激，还会基于已观测内容预测未来刺激这一预测性本质。因此作者提出假设：用于生成未来视频帧的内部表征，比观测视频本身的表征更符合人类视觉处理的预测特性。
AI.method: ① 使用人类观看视频的fMRI视觉皮层响应数据，与两类视频扩散模型（自回归AR模型及其非AR基础模型）的内部表征进行对齐比较；② 对AR视频扩散模型进行模型内分析，比较未来视频生成表征与观测视频表征的对齐程度；③ 将AR模型内部表征与其非AR基础模型对比，比较未来生成表征与基础模型观测视频重建表征的对齐差异，并分析其对应的视觉皮层层级分布；④ 开展人类行为实验，验证放大与视觉皮层对齐更好的单层贡献后生成的视频是否更受偏好。
AI.result: AR视频扩散模型中对未来视频生成的表征比观测视频表征与视觉皮层对齐更好；AR模型的未来生成表征也优于其非AR基础模型的观测视频重建表征。观测视频重建的对齐主要集中于低阶视觉皮层，而未来视频生成的对齐则集中于高阶视觉皮层。行为实验中，人类偏好通过放大与视觉皮层对齐更好的各层贡献所生成的视频。
AI.conclusion: 生成未来视频帧的内部表征比观测视频表征更契合人类视觉皮层的预测性处理机制，且这种对齐在高级视觉皮层尤为突出，并能预测人类对生成视频的行为偏好，表明视频生成模型可作为研究人脑预测性视觉处理的有效计算框架。

title: BARRAC: Adaptation of an English Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis Approach for Classification Tasks in Arabic Dialects
summary: With the rapid growth of Arabic NLP, several models, datasets and benchmarks have been reported. This paper asks whether approaches developed for majority languages like English can be adapted to Arabic tasks. We adapt an English aspect-based sentiment analysis framework to Arabic classification tasks and present the adaptation as BARRAC: Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks. BARRAC replaces consumer-review attribute pools with Arabic linguistic devices and markers for dialectal sentiment, sarcasm, and dialect identification, and replaces noisy self-training with two-stage training. Evaluated on five Arabic dialect datasets, BARRAC achieves a mean macro-F1 of 63.93\%, outperforming the best few-label SOTA by 3\%, and outperforming GPT-4o on four out of five tasks. Error analysis provides insights into remaining challenges. These results demonstrate that adapting task-specific approaches is a promising direction for Arabic NLP alongside adapting models, datasets and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BARRAC 框架，将英语方面级情感分析方法迁移至阿拉伯语分类任务，通过替换属性池与两阶段训练，在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上取得平均 macro-F1 63.93%，优于最优少样本 SOTA 3%，并在四项任务上超过 GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语 NLP 快速发展，已有诸多模型、数据集与基准，但多数工作聚焦于模型、数据与基准的迁移。本文关注一个被忽视的问题：针对英语等主流语言开发的任务方法能否迁移至阿拉伯语任务，从而探索除模型迁移之外的方法迁移路径。
AI.method: 将英语方面级情感分析框架迁移至阿拉伯语分类任务，提出 BARRAC（Brainstorming Alignment and Replaced Representation learning for ArabiC tasks）。具体做法是用阿拉伯语语言手段与标记替换消费者评论属性池，以适配方言情感、讽刺与方言识别任务；并用两阶段训练替换原有的噪声自训练。
AI.result: 在五个阿拉伯语方言数据集上评估，BARRAC 平均 macro-F1 达 63.93%，比最优少样本 SOTA 高 3%，并在五项任务中的四项上超过 GPT-4o。误差分析进一步揭示了仍存在的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，与迁移模型、数据集和基准一样，迁移任务特定方法也是阿拉伯语 NLP 的一条有前景的方向。

title: DecoMoE: Decoupling Visual Propagation and Expert Computation for Efficient Multimodal MoE Inference
summary: Multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) models combine sparse expert activation with visual-language capabilities, yet their inference remains costly because long visual-token sequences repeatedly incur attention, routing, dispatch, and expert-MLP computation. Existing methods typically compress either the token or expert dimension, leaving redundancy along the other. Our analysis reveals two complementary regularities: the depth required for visual propagation varies across inputs, while text-token routing exhibits concentrated and recurrent expert-importance patterns. Based on these observations, we propose DecoMoE, a two-dimensional structured compression framework that decouples visual propagation from expert computation. The Sample-Adaptive Visual Boundary (SAVB) predicts an input-dependent visual-exit layer at which the visual-token block is removed. The Routing-Calibrated Expert Prefix (RCEP) reorders experts offline using text-token routed mass and, from this predicted exit layer onward, retains at each MoE layer the shortest contiguous prefix covering a target routed-mass fraction. We evaluate DecoMoE on Qwen3-VL-MoE and InternVL3.5-30B-A3B across six benchmarks. On Qwen3-VL-MoE, DecoMoE retains 97.91% of dense-baseline performance while reducing computation from 27.06 to 16.73 TFLOPs and latency from 0.44 to 0.26 seconds, yielding a 1.69x speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/ShawnTan86/DecoMoE.

AI.tldr: 提出DecoMoE，一种二维结构化压缩框架，通过样本自适应视觉边界（SAVB）与路由校准专家前缀（RCEP）解耦视觉传播与专家计算，在保持性能的同时降低多模态MoE推理成本。
AI.motivation: 多模态MoE模型虽结合稀疏专家激活与视觉-语言能力，但长视觉token序列反复触发注意力、路由、分发与专家MLP计算，推理成本高。现有方法通常只压缩token或专家单一维度，另一维度冗余仍存。
AI.method: 基于两项规律：视觉传播所需深度因输入而异；文本token路由呈现集中且循环的专家重要性模式。据此设计：SAVB预测输入相关的视觉退出层，在该层移除视觉token块；RCEP离线按文本token路由质量重排专家，并从预测退出层起，在每层MoE保留覆盖目标路由质量比例的最短连续专家前缀。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-MoE与InternVL3.5-30B-A3B及六个基准上评估。Qwen3-VL-MoE上保留稠密基线97.91%性能，计算从27.06降至16.73 TFLOPs，延迟从0.44降至0.26秒，取得1.69倍加速。
AI.conclusion: DecoMoE通过解耦视觉传播与专家计算，在token与专家两个维度上协同压缩，实现多模态MoE推理的高效加速且性能损失极小。

title: Forging LLM Authorship Fingerprints with Targeted Rewriting
summary: Model-attribution classifiers can often identify which language model produced a text, making model-specific writing patterns a signal of provenance. Accurate attribution on unmodified text, however, does not show whether the prediction still identifies the original source after deliberate rewriting. We formulate this problem as targeted fingerprint transfer: rewriting one model's output so that attribution classifiers assign it to a chosen target model. We study summarization, where different models receive the same document and express the same underlying content, providing a controlled setting for conditional generation. We introduce ForgePrint, a search-then-distil framework that first searches for rewrites that move attribution toward a target fingerprint, then distils the selected rewrites into a one-pass 4B Student model. On CNN/DM, the Student reaches 70.2% target success rate, outperforming both its Teacher (54.1%) and the strongest of six published rewriting baselines (39.3%), against held-out classifiers that are never queried by the attack. It also reaches 68.3% target success when transferring summaries from an open model toward chosen commercial models. These results show that fingerprint detectability should not be conflated with source authenticity, and that text-only attribution can provide misleading evidence of model identity under targeted rewriting, even when it is accurate on unmodified text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"定向指纹迁移"问题：将某模型生成的文本改写后，使归因分类器将来源误判为指定的目标模型。为此提出 ForgePrint（先搜索后蒸馏）框架，在摘要任务上用 4B 学生模型实现 70.2% 的目标成功率，远超教师模型（54.1%）与最强基线（39.3%）。
AI.motivation: 模型归因分类器能通过特定的写作模式识别文本来源模型，但仅在未修改文本上准确并不足以证明其可靠性。作者关注：当文本被刻意改写后，归因预测是否仍能识别原始来源，即归因可检测性是否等同于来源真实性。
AI.method: 形式化"定向指纹迁移"任务：改写某模型输出，使其被归因分类器判定为选定的目标模型。选用摘要任务作为条件生成的可控场景（不同模型接收同一文档、表达相同内容）。提出 ForgePrint 框架，采用"先搜索后蒸馏"策略：先搜索能将归因指向目标指纹的改写，再将筛选出的改写蒸馏进一次前向的 4B Student 模型。
AI.result: 在 CNN/DM 上，Student 达到 70.2% 的目标成功率，优于其 Teacher（54.1%）以及六个已发表改写基线中最强者（39.3%），且对抗的是攻击从未查询过的留出分类器。在将开源模型摘要迁移至选定商业模型时，目标成功率也达到 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 指纹可检测性不应与来源真实性混为一谈；在定向改写下，即使文本归因在未修改文本上准确，也可能给出具有误导性的模型身份证据。

title: Scaling Parameter and Context in Attention: Native Sparse Attention from Mixture-of-Head
summary: Scaling attention parameters can improve language model quality, but retaining full token histories makes additional heads costly at long contexts. Furthermore, since attention retrieves and combines contextual information, parameter scaling should also support longer contexts. We therefore ask whether attention parameter scaling can directly enable efficient and effective context scaling. We introduce NAMOH, an architecture-native sparse attention mechanism that activates $K$ of $H$ heads per token. Each head retains only its assigned tokens and performs causal attention within this subsequence. Head selection thus jointly determines active parameters and available context without scanning the full history. Under balanced assignments, increasing $H$ at fixed $K$ shortens head histories and reduces per-token key-value (KV) access without increasing total KV storage. We further support head-relative rotary position embeddings to shorten positional spans within routed subsequences, aiming to mitigate position-induced attention noise. Experiments show that NAMOH can outperform fully activated models with the same total parameters, while enabling more efficient long-context inference than smaller dense models with matched active parameter counts. It remains compatible with GQA and existing sparse attention mechanisms. We hope this work offers a new path for scaling attention, with parameter scaling directly enabling context scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出NAMOH，一种架构原生的稀疏注意力机制，通过对每个token激活H个头中的K个并仅在其分配的子序列内做因果注意力，使注意力参数缩放直接转化为高效的上下文缩放，兼顾质量与长上下文推理效率。
AI.motivation: 缩放注意力参数能提升语言模型质量，但保留完整token历史会使多头在长上下文下代价高昂；同时注意力需要检索与组合上下文信息，因此参数缩放也应支持更长上下文。作者据此探究：注意力参数缩放能否直接实现高效且有效的上下文缩放。
AI.method: 提出NAMOH：每个token仅激活H个头中的K个，每个头只保留其分配到的token并在该子序列内进行因果注意力；头选择同时决定活跃参数与可用上下文，无需扫描完整历史。在均衡分配下，固定K增大H可缩短头历史、减少每token的KV访问且不增加总KV存储。并引入头相对旋转位置编码，缩短路由子序列内的位置跨度以缓解位置引起的注意力噪声。兼容GQA及现有稀疏注意力机制。
AI.result: 实验表明，NAMOH在同总参数下可超越全激活模型，并且在匹配活跃参数量时，长上下文推理效率优于更小的稠密模型。
AI.conclusion: NAMOH为注意力缩放提供了新路径：参数缩放可直接带来上下文缩放，兼具质量提升与长上下文效率，且与GQA及现有稀疏注意力机制兼容。

title: FrameMorrow: Future-guided Frame Selection with Prospective Tokens for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation requires models to effectively leverage an increasingly long generation history. As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs.
