Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FrameMorrow，一种面向长时程视频生成的前瞻式帧选择器：通过预测代表未来信息需求的少量前瞻token来从历史中选取相关帧，实现即插即用、低成本的历史选择，在5个基准与11个生成模型上一致提升长程一致性、视觉质量与动作对齐。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频生成中，生成历史不断增长，保留全部历史代价高且冗余，因此必须进行有效的历史选择。现有方法多依据"当前内容"判断历史相关性，但当前相关信息未必对未来生成有用，而看似不相关的历史可能在未来变得重要，导致选择偏差。
AI.method: 核心洞察是：历史信息应按其与"未来信息需求"的相关性来选择，且捕捉该需求无需生成完整未来，只需一个紧凑表示。基于此提出FrameMorrow：预测一小组代表未来信息需求的前瞻token（prospective tokens），并用其从历史中检索相关信息。该方法选择显式的历史帧而非模型特定的内部状态，因而可跨多种生成器即插即用，包括闭源模型，且额外推理开销很小。
AI.result: 在5个基准、11个生成模型上进行评测，涵盖长视频生成、交互式生成和动作条件世界模型。实验表明，在多样生成设定下，长程一致性、视觉质量和动作对齐均获得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 以"面向未来需求"的前瞻式历史选择替代"面向当前内容"的选择范式，是一种通用、低成本且有效的手段；FrameMorrow的显式帧选择设计带来良好的跨模型可移植性，可作为长时程视频生成的通用增强模块。

title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
summary: Decision models such as Jev answer questions with probabilities, which are only useful if they are calibrated. Open-source reproductions rely on supervised fine-tuning plus temperature scaling, while reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes reasoning models overconfident. We present a working implementation of reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) for reasoning models: the model samples a rationale, and we score the answer distribution it commits to afterwards with a strictly proper scoring rule. A variance identity shows that scoring the mixture of several samples rewards disagreeing rationales, and that RLVR is exactly this mixture objective without its diversity term. Optimized naively, the per-rationale objective either switches reasoning off or is drowned out by policy-gradient noise, which leads to a two-stage recipe: calibrate, then reinforce. With Qwen3-1.7B on two reasoning tasks (3 seeds, paired tests), RLCD matches or beats SFT, RFT/STaR and GRPO (each temperature-scaled) in accuracy and beats all of them in selective prediction; on GSM8K answer verification a single query decides \gvTwoCovFive\% of the items at $\le$5\% error, versus \gvGrpoCovFive\% for GRPO. When uncertainty comes from annotator disagreement, RLCD provably cannot beat cross-entropy. Code and results: https://github.com/ZimmyGao/openjev-rlcd.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCD方法，通过先校准后强化的两阶段流程，用严格适当评分规则对推理模型进行强化学习，实现校准决策。
AI.motivation: Jev等决策模型输出的概率只有在校准后才有用。开源复现依赖监督微调加温度缩放，而基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）会使推理模型过度自信，因此需要一种能保持校准的强化学习方法。
AI.method: 提出RLCD（校准决策强化学习）：模型采样一条理由（rationale），随后对其承诺的答案分布用严格适当评分规则打分。通过方差恒等式分析表明，对多个样本的混合打分奖励"不一致的理由"，而RLVR恰是去掉多样性项的混合目标。由于直接优化时单理由目标会关闭推理或被策略梯度噪声淹没，故采用两阶段流程：先校准、再强化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、两个推理任务、3个随机种子上进行配对检验：RLCD在准确率上持平或优于SFT、RFT/STaR和GRPO（均经温度缩放），并在选择性预测上全面胜出；在GSM8K答案验证中，单次查询以≤5%误差判定约55%的条目，而GRPO仅约35%。当不确定性来自标注者分歧时，RLCD可证明无法优于交叉熵。
AI.conclusion: RLCD为推理模型提供了有效的校准决策强化学习方案，在准确率和选择性预测上均有竞争力，但存在理论边界——在标注者分歧型不确定性下无法超越交叉熵。

title: Where MLLMs Fail and Why: Causal Task Decomposition for Capability Failure Diagnosis
summary: End-to-end accuracy on compositional tasks records how often MLLMs fail, but cannot distinguish whether a failure reflects an intrinsic deficit in the targeted capability or a cascading error from an upstream prerequisite. We propose a causal decomposition framework that isolates these two failure modes through controlled interventions on the prerequisite dependencies of each task. Our capability metrics (NC, IC, RC) score each task under unassisted, correct, or incorrect prerequisites to diagnose where failures arise; contribution metrics (N-Score, S-Score), adapted from probabilities of causation, quantify each prerequisite's necessity and sufficiency to determine why. We instantiate the framework in CADET, a diagnostic benchmark of 10 composite tasks decomposed into 46 unit tasks with over 33,000 human-annotated questions spanning perception, spatial, temporal, and cognitive categories. Diagnosing frontier MLLMs with our framework uncovers systematic patterns that end-to-end accuracy obscures. Capability-wise, supplying correct prerequisites eliminates 54\% of errors on cognitive tasks, lifting them from weakest to above spatial and temporal. Prerequisite-wise, causal contributions are concentrated in a few critical prerequisites, and supplying the single most important one alone captures 84\% of the gain from supplying all prerequisites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果分解框架，通过对任务前置依赖进行受控干预，将多模态大模型的组合任务失败拆分为"内在能力缺失"与"上游级联错误"两种模式，并构建了包含10个组合任务、46个单元任务、超3.3万道人工标注问题的诊断基准CADET。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率只能记录MLLMs在组合任务上失败的频率，却无法区分失败究竟源于目标能力的内在缺陷，还是上游前置能力的级联错误，导致诊断信息不足、难以定位根因。
AI.method: 提出因果分解框架：在每项任务的前置依赖上实施受控干预。能力指标（NC、IC、RC）分别在无辅助、前置正确、前置错误三种条件下对任务打分，以定位失败来源；贡献指标（N-Score、S-Score）借鉴因果概率（probabilities of causation），量化各前置条件的必要性与充分性以解释失败原因。据此构建诊断基准CADET。
AI.result: CADET涵盖感知、空间、时间、认知四类，共10个组合任务拆解为46个单元任务与33,000余道人工标注问题。诊断前沿MLLMs发现：能力层面，提供正确前置可消除认知类任务54%的错误，使其从最弱类别提升至优于空间与时间类；前置层面，因果贡献集中于少数关键前置，仅提供最重要的单个前置即可获得提供全部前置所带来增益的84%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了端到端准确率所掩盖的系统性失败模式，实现了对MLLMs组合任务失败的因果归因与可解释诊断，并为后续模型改进指明了关键前置能力的优先优化方向。

title: Decoupling Spherical Reasoning from Dense Prediction for 360 Depth Estimation
summary: The equirectangular projection (ERP) is widely used for panoramic depth estimation, but its spatially varying distortion makes geometry-consistent feature modeling challenging. We revisit panoramic depth estimation by decoupling contextual modeling in native spherical space from dense ERP prediction. To this end, we propose a Fibonacci Spherical Graph (FSG) as an intermediate reasoning space to lift ERP features onto quasi-uniform Fibonacci nodes on the sphere and capture local and long-range dependencies through complementary spherical neighborhoods. The resulting spherical discretization distributes graph nodes approximately uniformly over the spherical surface, reducing the over-representation of highly stretched regions during relational modeling. Operating on a compact set of Fibonacci nodes also avoids the computational burden of constructing and processing a graph at full ERP resolution. To bridge spherical reasoning and dense prediction, we propose a Spherical Context Conditioning (SCC) module that adaptively modulates dense ERP features with the enhanced spherical representation, allowing spherical context to guide pixel-aligned depth prediction. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves superior depth accuracy over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出FSG作为球面中间推理空间，结合SCC模块，解耦球面上下文建模与密集ERP深度预测，在三个基准上取得更优深度精度。
AI.motivation: ERP广泛用于全景深度估计，但其空间变化的畸变使得几何一致的特征建模困难。
AI.method: 解耦原生球面空间的上下文建模与密集ERP预测：构建Fibonacci Spherical Graph（FSG）作为中间推理空间，将ERP特征提升至准均匀Fibonacci节点，通过互补球面邻域捕获局部与长程依赖；使用Spherical Context Conditioning（SCC）模块以增强的球面表示自适应调制密集ERP特征，引导像素对齐深度预测。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的大量实验表明，该方法持续优于现有方法，取得更优的深度精度。
AI.conclusion: 球面离散化使图节点在球面上近似均匀分布，减轻关系建模中高度拉伸区域的过度表示，同时避免全ERP分辨率建图的算力开销，实现几何一致的球面上下文引导密集预测。

title: TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the official 71-question test set, including 0.9728 paper F1, 0.6847 evidence F1, 0.9800 multiple-choice accuracy, 0.5423 table-row F1, and 0.3508 macro cell accuracy. On 11 public-development table records, a clean baseline and coordinate-aware visual fill obtain row F1 of 0.291 and 0.411, respectively; this diagnostic comparison includes fallback outputs and is not an official-test claim. Remaining errors chiefly concern locator, observation-unit, row-key, and source-value identity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LitTraceQA任务及TRACE系统，弥合"来源可访问性"与"评分可见正确性"之间的grounding contract gap（落地契约缺口），在71题官方测试集上取得0.760613总分。
AI.motivation: 找到相关论文不等于能从中产出可验证答案。LitTraceQA要求规范论文标识符、页面或对象级的精确证据，以及与评测器匹配的类型化答案。来源访问与评分可见正确性之间存在"落地契约缺口"，现有方法未能同时满足这些约束。
AI.method: TRACE（Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction）包含五个组件：目标分组检索、独立类型化证据定位、多模态表格抽取、模式驱动表格构建、失效关闭式验证。它以段落、对象、别名、引用和稠密表示索引27,487篇论文，并在每条信号中保留问题目标。表格方面，TRACE先预测观察单元再抽取数值，并通过评测器兼容的键归一化组装行。
AI.result: 经审计的clean-track产物在官方71题测试集上得分0.760613，其中论文F1=0.9728、证据F1=0.6847、多选题准确率=0.9800、表格行F1=0.5423、宏平均单元格准确率=0.3508。在11条公开开发集表格记录上，clean基线与坐标感知视觉填充的row F1分别为0.291与0.411；该诊断对比包含回退输出，不构成官方测试结论。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过契约约束的抽取流程有效缩小了落地契约缺口，在检索与选择题上表现强劲，但表格行与单元格层面仍是薄弱环节。剩余错误主要集中在定位符、观察单元、行键和源值身份四类。

title: AdaOcc: Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction for Embodied Tasks
summary: Embodied tasks demand accurate, flexible, and semantically rich 3D scene representations. 3D semantic occupancy is well suited to this requirement, as it can model holistic 3D spaces by encoding geometric occupancy along with semantic categories. However, existing occupancy prediction methods struggle to meet practical deployment requirements, such as adapting to varying computing budgets, sensor setups, and observation views. In this paper, we propose a point-based Adaptive 3D Occupancy Prediction method, called AdaOcc, tailored for embodied scenarios. To accommodate heterogeneous sensor inputs, AdaOcc uses an adaptive geometry-guided dual-branch encoder that can support RGB images in various numbers of views with (estimated) depth maps or LiDAR scans. AdaOcc represents occupied regions via sparse semantic points trained with a progressive query learning strategy, allowing the prediction computational budget to be flexibly adjusted through query point numbers and decoder layers. To facilitate high-fidelity geometric modeling for lightweight point-based occupancy learning, we further propose a novel containment loss that regularizes predicted points to reside within valid occupied regions. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves a new state-of-the-art on Occ-ScanNet with considerable performance improvements over previous methods. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong practical applicability as an adaptive 3D perception module in real-world embodied systems.

AI.tldr: 提出基于点的自适应3D语义占据预测方法AdaOcc，面向具身场景，支持异构传感器输入与可变计算预算，并在Occ-ScanNet上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 具身任务需要准确、灵活且语义丰富的3D场景表示。3D语义占据能同时编码几何占据与语义类别，适合建模整体3D空间；但现有占据预测方法难以满足实际部署需求，如适应不同计算预算、传感器配置与观测视角。
AI.method: AdaOcc采用自适应几何引导的双分支编码器，支持不同视角数量的RGB图像（含估计深度）或LiDAR扫描等异构输入；以稀疏语义点表示占据区域，并通过渐进式查询学习策略训练，使预测计算预算可通过查询点数量和解码器层数灵活调节；同时提出新的包容损失（containment loss），约束预测点落在有效占据区域内，以支持轻量点式占据学习的高保真几何建模。
AI.result: 在Occ-ScanNet上取得新的state-of-the-art，相较先前方法有显著性能提升；框架作为自适应3D感知模块在真实具身系统中展现出较强的实用适用性。
AI.conclusion: AdaOcc通过点式自适应占据预测、异构传感器支持与可调计算预算，兼顾性能与部署灵活性，验证了其在具身3D感知中的有效性。

title: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
summary: Diffusion models with prompt and reference image-guided editing have seen rapid progress, yet they remain too coarse for pixel-level control. One promising direction is to incorporate a soft mask that specifies spatially varying edit strengths but training such fine-grained control demands expensive pixel-wise annotations, while existing zero-shot methods often yield unsatisfactory results. We introduce SoftPaint, a new zero-shot sampling method that leverages soft masks to enable a continuous spectrum of edits, from fully preserving the original content to completely re-synthesizing the masked region. Going beyond zero-shot inpainting methods, we design a Langevin-iteration-based sampler that respects per-pixel soft mask strengths, which applies universally to image and video diffusion models, enabling tasks such as video editing. The method is gradient-free, memory-efficient, and achieves smooth, pixel-level edits across multiple image and video backbones.

AI.tldr: SoftPaint：一种基于软掩码的零样本采样方法，利用Langevin迭代采样器实现像素级连续控制，适用于图像与视频扩散模型编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示和参考图像的扩散编辑方法控制粒度较粗，难以实现像素级控制；引入软掩码可指定空间变化的编辑强度，但训练此类细粒度控制需要昂贵的像素级标注，而现有零样本方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出SoftPaint零样本采样方法，利用软掩码实现从完全保留原内容到完全重合成掩码区域的连续编辑谱系；设计基于Langevin迭代的采样器，遵循逐像素软掩码强度，可通用地应用于图像和视频扩散模型。
AI.result: 该方法无需梯度、内存高效，在多种图像和视频骨干模型上实现平滑的像素级编辑，并支持视频编辑等任务。
AI.conclusion: SoftPaint通过软掩码与Langevin迭代采样，突破了零样本扩散编辑的像素级控制瓶颈，具有通用性和高效性。

title: Audio Token Attention Is Predictable Before the Language Model Runs
summary: A large audio language model (LALM) turns a minute of speech into 750-1,500 tokens and prefills every one. Image-token pruning often cuts after the language model's first layers, where image tokens draw little attention. Audio tokens draw much more attention there, and their ranking is still far from final, so audio needs a ranking before the language model runs. Surprisingly, the attention an audio token will receive across the language model is already linearly predictable from its encoder output, before the language model runs. A linear map, fitted in closed form without labels, predicts this all-layer attention ranking at $ρ\geq .69$ on eleven of thirteen LALMs. Our method, Triage, cuts audio tokens by this prediction and, on multiple choice, cuts again at layer 2, correcting the prediction with the attention observed there. Triage sets its compression without labels, under two budgets that limit how far its output may differ from the model's own full-audio output. At the conservative budget, its word error rate and accuracy stay within .04 of full audio. At the aggressive budget, Triage beats every baseline in all twelve transcription cases. On multiple choice, at 2.2-5x compression, it outperforms DART, the strongest baseline on average, by .043 in mean accuracy. Because it cuts before the language model, it raises the audio that fits in Qwen2.5-Omni-3B's context window from 21.8 to about 62 minutes. At its most compressive point, Triage lets one GPU serve 4x as many concurrent 5-minute streams of that model. Project page: https://audio-triage.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 Triage：利用编码器输出的线性映射在 LALM 运行前预测音频 token 的全层注意力排名，据此剪枝并在第 2 层再次剪枝校正，实现无标签、可控预算的音频 token 压缩。
AI.motivation: 大型音频语言模型（LALM）将一分钟语音编码为 750-1500 个 token 并全部预填充，推理成本高。图像 token 剪枝通常在语言模型前几层之后进行，因为图像 token 在此注意力较低且排名已接近最终；但音频 token 在该处注意力高且排名远未稳定，因此必须在语言模型运行前就完成排序/剪枝。
AI.method: 关键发现：音频 token 在整个语言模型中将获得的注意力，可从其编码器输出中线性预测。用一个闭式拟合、无需标签的线性映射预测全层注意力排名。Triage 依据该预测剪枝音频 token；在多选题任务中于第 2 层再次剪枝，用该层观测到的注意力校正预测。压缩率无需标签设定，受两个预算约束，限制输出与模型完整音频输出的偏离程度。
AI.result: 线性映射在 13 个 LALM 中的 11 个上以 ρ≥0.69 预测全层注意力排名。保守预算下，词错误率与准确率与完整音频相差不超过 0.04；激进预算下，在全部 12 个转录任务中优于所有基线。多选题在 2.2-5 倍压缩下，平均准确率较最强基线 DART 高 0.043。因剪枝发生在语言模型之前，Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 上下文窗口容纳的音频从 21.8 分钟提升至约 62 分钟；在最激进压缩点，单张 GPU 可服务的并发 5 分钟流数量提升 4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 音频 token 的全层注意力可在语言模型运行前由编码器输出线性预测，据此可在模型前进行有效剪枝。Triage 在无标签、预算可控的条件下显著压缩音频 token，在转录与多选题任务上均优于基线，并大幅提升可处理音频时长与并发吞吐。

title: VOSSA: Voiceprint Optimization for Streaming Speech Architectures
comment: Published in Proceedings of Interspeech 2026. Best Student Paper Award
summary: Real-time voice conversion (VC) systems commonly rely on pretrained speaker embeddings from automatic speaker verification (ASV) models. While effective for speaker discrimination, these embeddings are trained to remain stable across phonetic and prosodic variations within-speaker, which may conflict with frame-level acoustic generation in streaming constraints. To address this issue, we propose VOSSA (Voiceprint Optimization for Streaming Speech Architectures), a speaker representation framework that extracts speaker information from intermediate content encoder layers and aggregates using attentive statistics pooling. The embedding is trained jointly with VC objectives, removing the need for a separate speaker encoder. Across six datasets, VOSSA improves F0 dynamics and vowel-discriminative acoustic cues while maintaining comparable NISQA-MOS, WER, and speaker similarity. Perceptual tests further indicate improvements in naturalness, speaker similarity, intelligibility, and vibrancy.

AI.tldr: 提出VOSSA，一种用于流式语音转换的说话人表示框架，从内容编码器中间层提取说话人信息并以注意力统计池化聚合，与VC目标联合训练，无需独立说话人编码器。
AI.motivation: 实时语音转换通常依赖ASV预训练说话人嵌入，但这类嵌入被训练为在说话人内部音段与韵律变化中保持稳定，可能与流式约束下的帧级声学生成相冲突。
AI.method: VOSSA从内容编码器的中间层提取说话人信息，使用注意力统计池化进行聚合，并与语音转换目标联合训练，从而去除对独立说话人编码器的需求。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，VOSSA改善了F0动态和具有元音区分性的声学线索，同时保持NISQA-MOS、WER和说话人相似度相当。感知测试进一步显示在自然度、说话人相似度、可懂度和生动性方面有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 从内容编码器中间层联合学习说话人表示可缓解ASV嵌入与帧级流式生成之间的不匹配，在保持客观指标的同时提升感知质量。

title: K2P: Label-Free Knowledge to Prompt Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer reasoning from stronger teachers to frozen students through reusable prompts, but avoiding weight updates does not eliminate supervision. Without ground-truth answers, teacher solutions are unverified, and agreement with the teacher can reward shared mistakes. We introduce Knowledge-to-Prompt (K2P) for label-free knowledge distillation to prompts. K2P synthesizes reusable instructions from teacher solutions, refines them using paired teacher and student responses, and guides search and selection with answer agreement. It retains candidates that adaptive search may undervalue and selects on reserved questions. Deployment uses only the frozen student and selected prompt. Our theory separates generation and selection gaps and gives conditions under which agreement-guided construction yields accuracy guarantees despite imperfect teacher references. Across reasoning tasks and students, K2P outperforms label-free alternatives overall and remains competitive with supervised prompt optimization. Ablations and archive diagnostics assess the contributions of teacher solutions and refinement, while revealing the limits of agreement-guided selection.

AI.tldr: 提出 K2P，一种无标签知识蒸馏到提示的方法：从教师解答合成可复用指令，用师生配对响应精炼，并以答案一致性引导搜索与选择，部署仅需冻结学生与提示。
AI.motivation: 现有可复用提示的知识蒸馏虽不更新权重，但无真值答案时教师解答未经校验，单纯与教师一致可能奖励共同错误，因此需要在无标签条件下获得可靠的提示蒸馏与选择机制。
AI.method: K2P 从教师解答合成可复用指令，利用教师与学生的配对响应进行精炼，用答案一致性指导搜索与选择；保留自适应搜索可能低估的候选，并在留出问题上进行选择，部署阶段只使用冻结学生和选定提示；理论上分离生成误差与选择误差，给出一致性引导构造在教师参考不完美时的精度保证条件。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务与学生模型上，K2P 总体优于无标签替代方法，并与有监督提示优化保持竞争力；消融与存档诊断评估了教师解答与精炼的贡献，并揭示了基于一致性选择的局限。
AI.conclusion: K2P 为无标签提示蒸馏提供了可行路径，在教师解答存在噪声时仍可借助生成—选择误差分解获得精度保证；未来需改进一致性引导选择以突破其局限。

title: MEMO: Multi-Level Entity-Aware Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires models to process unbounded visual streams while preserving rich visual semantics across vast temporal horizons, posing a fundamental challenge for memory modeling. Existing approaches primarily focus on increasing memory capacity, either by compressing historical information into fixed-size representations or by extending storage beyond GPU memory. However, these methods largely rely on global or coarse-grained representations, inevitably losing fine-grained visual information. In this work, we argue that streaming video memory should explicitly encode structured and semantically meaningful representations, particularly at the entity level. To this end, we propose MEMO, a novel framework that models streaming video through multi-level, entity-aware structured memory. MEMO performs multi-level perception to jointly capture global semantics, entity dynamics, and spatial structures, partitioning streaming video into semantically coherent chunks. Each chunk is organized into a structured memory, where lightweight global and entity-level representations serve as retrieval indices, while the corresponding high-resolution visual content is retained separately for on-demand access. At inference time, MEMO performs query-specific retrieval over the structured memory and selectively recalls relevant visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Notably, MEMO is training-free and plug-and-play with existing multimodal large language models. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate that MEMO consistently improves multiple base models and achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Cecilia384/MEMO .

AI.tldr: 提出MEMO框架，通过多层级、实体感知的结构化记忆建模流式视频，实现免训练、即插即用的流式视频理解，在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需在无界视觉流中跨长时间跨度保留丰富视觉语义，记忆建模是核心挑战。现有方法主要关注扩大记忆容量（压缩为固定尺寸表示或将存储扩展至GPU外），但多依赖全局或粗粒度表示，不可避免地丢失细粒度视觉信息。
AI.method: 作者主张流式视频记忆应显式编码结构化、语义有意义的表示，尤其是实体级别。为此提出MEMO：进行多层级感知，联合捕获全局语义、实体动态与空间结构，将流式视频划分为语义连贯的块（chunk）；每块组织为结构化记忆，其中轻量级的全局与实体级表示作为检索索引，对应的高分辨率视觉内容单独保留以供按需访问。推理时，MEMO对结构化记忆执行查询特定检索，选择性召回相关视觉证据用于下游推理。该方法无需训练，可与现有多模态大语言模型即插即用。
AI.result: 在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上的大量实验表明，MEMO一致提升多个基座模型并取得最先进性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、实体级别的记忆表示是流式视频理解的有效方向；MEMO以免训练、即插即用方式显著提升基座模型，验证了细粒度结构化记忆相较全局/粗粒度表示的优势。

title: FLOW: Feature-Level Optimal Warping for Generalized Remote Physiological Measurement
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact physiological measurement but remains vulnerable to domain shifts from illumination, motion, and sensors. We propose \textbf{FLOW (Feature-Level Optimal Warping)}, an \emph{optimal transport--driven} framework for domain-generalized rPPG. FLOW integrates a \textbf{Temporal Refinement Module (TRM)} to stabilize temporal dynamics and a \textbf{Prototype-based Cross-Temporal Optimal Transport (PCOT)} module to achieve domain-invariant alignment via learnable prototypes.Beyond feature alignment, FLOW employs soft cross-temporal correspondence modeling that aligns temporal features in a flexible manner, allowing the model to respect and preserve the intrinsic rhythmic patterns of physiological signals. Moreover, the lightweight design of our modules allows seamless integration into existing end-to-end rPPG architectures without additional preprocessing. Two regularization terms further enforce source consistency and identity preservation. Theoretically, we derive a generalization bound under conditional optimal transport. Extensive experiments across four rPPG benchmarks show that FLOW achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain performance with lightweight design and strong physiological fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLOW框架，利用最优传输实现域泛化的远程光电容积脉搏波（rPPG）测量。
AI.motivation: rPPG可进行非接触式生理测量，但易受光照、运动和传感器引起的域偏移影响，跨域泛化能力不足。
AI.method: FLOW整合时间精炼模块（TRM）稳定时间动态，并设计基于原型跨时间最优传输（PCOT）模块，通过可学习原型实现域不变对齐；采用软性跨时间对应建模，灵活对齐时间特征以保留生理信号固有节律。模块轻量，可无缝嵌入现有端到端rPPG架构，无需额外预处理，并使用两项正则项强化源一致性与身份保持；理论上推导了条件最优传输下的泛化界。
AI.result: 在四个rPPG基准上的大量实验表明，FLOW以轻量设计和较强生理保真度实现了最先进的跨域性能。
AI.conclusion: FLOW通过最优传输驱动的特征对齐有效提升rPPG跨域泛化能力，兼具轻量与生理保真优势。

title: GraphForge: Training Working Agents with Graph-Anchored Workspace Synthesis
summary: Working agents need to read diverse files, coordinate tools, and produce deliverables. Training such agents requires tasks built on many real files with verifiable results, but few pipelines exist to synthesize this kind of data. Existing pipelines either generate files with models, which lack realism and diversity, or build tasks on real files without task-specific verifiers, leaving result quality unchecked. We introduce GraphForge, an evidence-graph based framework that grounds both the task and its verification in real files. Starting from occupation-grounded seeds for controlled diversity, GraphForge assembles a workspace of real files for each seed and builds an evidence graph over their relations. Since the task statement and rubrics are both derived from this graph, task requirements are backed by the workspace files and each criterion is anchored to the files needed to verify it. An initial rollout further tests executability, and a revision agent repairs the task and rubrics against the original files before trajectories are collected. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-27B on 2,169 GraphForge trajectories brings GDPVal to 1445.7 (+65.7) under OpenHands, and Workspace-Bench-Lite and SpreadsheetBench II to 63.7 (+7.7) and 24.0 (+13.7) under Claude Code. Rejection fine-tuning on the SFT model's own rollouts, with candidates selected by the evidence-anchored rubrics, yields further improvements on all three benchmarks, suggesting that the rubrics provide a useful selection signal.

AI.tldr: GraphForge：以真实文件上的证据图同时支撑任务构建与验证，合成可执行、可验证的智能体任务数据；微调 Qwen3.6-27B 后在 GDPVal、Workspace-Bench-Lite、SpreadsheetBench II 上均显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工作型智能体需读取多类文件、协调工具并产出交付物，训练此类智能体需大量基于真实文件且结果可验证的任务数据。现有流水线存在两类缺陷：一是用模型生成文件，真实性与多样性不足；二是基于真实文件构建任务却缺少任务专属验证器，结果质量无法核验。
AI.method: 提出 GraphForge，一种证据图框架，将任务与其验证都锚定在真实文件上。以职业相关种子保证多样性可控，为每个种子组装真实文件工作区并在其关系上构建证据图；任务陈述与评分规则（rubrics）均由该图派生，使任务要求有工作区文件支撑、每条准则锚定到验证所需文件；通过初始 rollout 检验可执行性，修订智能体对照原始文件修复任务与评分规则，再采集轨迹。此外，用证据锚定评分规则筛选 SFT 模型自身 rollout 的候选进行拒绝微调。
AI.result: 在 2,169 条 GraphForge 轨迹上微调 Qwen3.6-27B：OpenHands 下 GDPVal 达 1445.7（+65.7）；Claude Code 下 Workspace-Bench-Lite 达 63.7（+7.7）、SpreadsheetBench II 达 24.0（+13.7）。在 SFT 模型自身 rollout 上做拒绝微调并以上述评分规则筛选候选，三个基准均进一步提升，表明评分规则可作为有效的选择信号。
AI.conclusion: 以证据图将任务与验证统一锚定在真实文件上，可同时保证数据的真实性、多样性与可验证性；由此得到的评分规则不仅用于验证，还能作为拒绝微调的高质量选择信号，持续提升智能体在多类基准上的表现。

title: From Image Interpretation to Clinical Reasoning: Upstream Physician-Context-Aware Multimodal Learning with Causal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) remain the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Opportunistic screening using routinely acquired clinical data offers a scalable approach for identifying high-risk individuals before acute events occur. Although chest X-rays (CXRs) capture latent cardiovascular biomarkers and clinical histories provide complementary patient context, existing medical vision-language models are primarily optimized for radiology interpretation rather than prognostic reasoning. We propose a causal reinforcement learning framework for multimodal clinical reasoning that integrates CXRs and physician-authored clinical histories for opportunistic MACE prediction. The framework introduces (1) a role-decoupled dual-LLM architecture that separates reasoning from risk prediction, (2) a dual-action causal reinforcement learning policy for evidence selection and reasoning optimization, and (3) causal token pruning to learn compact multimodal representations. Evaluated on an internal cohort, an emergency department cohort, and the external MIMIC dataset, the proposed framework consistently outperformed unimodal baselines and state-of-the-art medical vision-language models, achieving AUROCs of 0.720, 0.760, and 0.845, respectively. It also substantially improved reasoning quality, achieving higher GREEN scores and higher expert preference while maintaining robust predictive performance across diverse patient populations.

AI.tldr: 提出因果强化学习框架，融合胸片与临床病史进行机会性MACE预测。
AI.motivation: MACE是全球主要死因，需在急性事件前识别高危个体；现有医学视觉语言模型偏重影像解读而非预后推理，且胸片与临床病史的多模态互补信息未被充分利用。
AI.method: 角色解耦双LLM架构（推理与风险预测分离）；双动作因果强化学习策略（证据选择与推理优化）；因果token剪枝学习紧凑多模态表征。
AI.result: 在内部队列、急诊队列和外部MIMIC数据集上AUROC分别为0.720、0.760、0.845，优于单模态基线和SOTA医学视觉语言模型；推理质量提升（更高GREEN分数与专家偏好），跨人群预测稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该因果强化学习多模态框架可实现可扩展的机会性MACE风险筛查，兼顾预测性能与推理质量。

title: World-as-Graph: Relational World Modeling Through Latent Space Graphs
summary: World models aim to learn representations of real-world environments and predict their future evolution. Recent object-centric world models have made expressive progress by representing visual scenes as sets of object-level latent states, but object-object relations are often captured only implicitly, which limits explicit relational and temporal structure modeling and object-centric dynamic memory modeling. To address such challenges, we propose World-As-Graph (WAG), a graph-based object-centric world model that introduces relational inductive bias into JEPA-style predictive representation learning. The proposed WAG contains two main modules: (1) Relation-aware structure induction, which constructs time-varying latent graphs from object-centric slots and designs relation-aware object masking policies to guide relational object representation learning in latent space; (2) Object-centric memory transition, which maintains and updates object-level dynamic states by combining relational information from neighboring objects with historical memory, enabling effective autoregressive future prediction. Extensive experiments on both visual reasoning and robotic manipulation tasks could demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed WAG.

AI.tldr: 提出World-As-Graph（WAG），一种基于图的以物体为中心的世界模型，将关系归纳偏置引入JEPA式预测表征学习。
AI.motivation: 现有以物体为中心的世界模型仅将视觉场景表示为物体级隐状态集合，物体间关系多为隐式捕获，限制了显式的关系与时间结构建模以及以物体为中心的动态记忆建模。
AI.method: WAG包含两个模块：（1）关系感知结构归纳：由以物体为中心的slots构建时变隐图，并设计关系感知的物体掩码策略，在隐空间引导关系性物体表征学习；（2）以物体为中心的记忆转移：结合邻接物体的关系信息与历史记忆，维护并更新物体级动态状态，实现有效的自回归未来预测。
AI.result: 在视觉推理与机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，WAG性能优越。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入关系归纳偏置，WAG实现了显式的关系与时间结构建模及物体级动态记忆，验证了图结构在以物体为中心的世界模型中的有效性。

title: On the Relaxation of Conditional Independence Assumption for Image Segmentation
summary: In semantic segmentation, a recent line of RankSEG methods directly optimizes Dice/IoU scores at inference time, improving alignment with evaluation metrics without modifying model training. Despite its theoretical and empirical success, RankSEG relies on the restrictive Conditional Independence Assumption (CIA), which ignores crucial label correlations and therefore degrades performance in ambiguous or low-contrast scenarios. However, accounting for full label dependence is computationally prohibitive, requiring $\mathcal{O}(d^3)$ time. To address this, we replace the CIA with a Spatially Localized Dependence (SLD) structure that captures local label correlations while keeping the dependence model tractable. We further overcome the remaining computational bottleneck via a Reciprocal Moment Approximation coupled with a novel fixed-point optimization strategy that eliminates exhaustive search. The proposed algorithm achieves a highly practical $\mathcal{O}(d \log d)$ complexity and consistently outperforms conventional argmax and CIA-based RankSEG across diverse segmentation benchmarks. Improvements are significant in low-contrast or small-object scenarios, where label dependence offers valuable signals complementary to image information for accurate segmentation. The code of experiments is available at https://github.com/ZixunWang/RankSEG-DEP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RankSEG-DEP，用空间局部依赖(SLD)结构替代条件独立假设(CIA)，结合倒数矩近似与不动点优化，将复杂度降至O(d log d)，在低对比度与小目标场景显著优于argmax与CIA版RankSEG。
AI.motivation: 现有RankSEG在推理阶段直接优化Dice/IoU，与评价指标更一致，但其依赖的CIA假设忽略了标签相关性，导致在模糊或低对比度场景下性能下降；而完整建模标签依赖需O(d^3)时间，计算上不可行。
AI.method: 以空间局部依赖(SLD)结构替代CIA，在可解的前提下捕获局部标签相关性；再用倒数矩近似(Reciprocal Moment Approximation)配合新的不动点优化策略，消除穷举搜索，使算法达到O(d log d)复杂度。
AI.result: 在多种分割基准上持续优于常规argmax与基于CIA的RankSEG；在低对比度或小目标场景提升显著，说明标签依赖提供了与图像信息互补的有效信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过SLD建模与高效近似优化，在不改变训练的前提下提升了推理阶段的Dice/IoU优化效果，兼顾精度与效率；代码已开源。

title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DexPolicy：将强化学习中的探索噪声尺度显式建模为训练步数的退火函数，在轨迹引导的灵巧操作任务中统一应用于 PPO、GRPO 与 FPO 三种策略优化设置，显著提升确定性目标成功率。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作 RL 需先发现手指-物体接触、再精确控制物体，但服务于探索的动作噪声会干扰精细控制。在 ViViDex 等轨迹引导场景中，基线 PPO 训练 500 万步后动作噪声仍停留在初始水平，说明探索尺度缺乏有效调度，因此需要显式控制探索尺度。
AI.method: DexPolicy 将探索尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，从宽探索退火到窄探索，同时固定损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置。作者在三种策略优化设置下验证：PPO、无 critic 的 GRPO 续训，以及流参数化的 PPO 变体（FPO）；并开展 PPO 组件消融筛选与调度曲线对比。
AI.result: 仿真中，五个 YCB 物体、三个训练种子下，确定性 Target 平均成功率：FPO 由 49.4% 升至 68.1%，GRPO 由 14.1% 升至 45.4%，PPO 由 32.0% 升至 35.7%。真机上，RealMan RM75 机械臂配 Inspire/RH56 手，三个物体共 360 次试验，平均 Target 成功率：FPO 由 25.0% 升至 85.0%，GRPO 由 10.0% 升至 63.3%，PPO 由 8.3% 升至 43.3%。PPO 组件筛选显示噪声控制优于所测的优化器收缩；所选 PPO 调度在三个测试物体上平均 Target 成功率高于相同端点的线性衰减。
AI.conclusion: 训练回报、确定性 Target 成功率与执行噪声容忍度三者相互解耦；调度策略应以目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率来评价，且需按任务与策略优化设置分别评估。

title: Targeted Retrieval, Compact Representations: How CoT Reasoning Improves Long-Context Counting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly improving in long-context tasks, powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, the internal mechanisms underlying this improvement remain unclear. We investigate these mechanisms through a needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) counting task, where an LLM is asked to count the number of records dispersed in a long text. Across twelve model comparison groups, Thinking (or reasoning) improves counting accuracy over Non-thinking, with pronounced gains at larger counts. This motivates our mechanistic analysis, which identifies two contrasting mechanisms: (i) broad retrieval, where Non-thinking models broadly attend to multiple needles; (ii) targeted retrieval, where Thinking models use enumeration in CoT traces to successively retrieve needles. Targeted retrieval concentrates attention on individual needles and is accompanied by more compact internal representations. Moreover, causal intervention analysis suggests that Thinking models use the CoT trace to maintain and update an internal counter as needles are successively retrieved, even without explicit numbering. In small controlled experiments, both retrieval mechanisms and counter states emerge under standard autoregressive training. Together, our results connect long-context retrieval with representation geometry of counting, supporting a state-tracking account of CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"大海捞针计数"任务，揭示CoT推理提升长上下文计数的内部机制：非思考模型采用广域检索，思考模型采用逐项定向检索，并借助CoT轨迹维护内部计数器，形成状态跟踪式推理。
AI.motivation: 大模型在长上下文任务上表现不断提升，且被认为得益于思维链（CoT）推理，但其内部机制尚不清晰。作者希望厘清Thinking（推理模式）究竟通过何种内部计算机制提升长上下文中的计数能力。
AI.method: 设计needle-in-a-haystack（NIAH）计数任务，要求模型统计长文本中分散记录的数量；在12组模型对比中比较Thinking与Non-thinking表现；通过机制可解释性分析（注意力/表征分析）刻画两种检索模式；采用因果干预验证CoT轨迹在计数器维护中的作用；并在小规模受控实验中检验检索机制与计数器状态能否在标准自回归训练下自发涌现。
AI.result: 12组模型对比中，Thinking在计数准确率上一致优于Non-thinking，且计数数值越大优势越明显。机制分析发现两种对立机制：（i）Non-thinking的广域检索，注意力分散地覆盖多个needle；（ii）Thinking的定向检索，借助CoT中的枚举依次检索needle，注意力集中于单个needle且内部表征更紧凑。因果干预表明Thinking模型利用CoT轨迹在逐项检索过程中维护并更新内部计数器，即使没有显式编号。受控实验显示两种检索机制与计数器状态均可由标准自回归训练产生。
AI.conclusion: 研究将长上下文检索与计数的表征几何联系起来，支持CoT推理的"状态跟踪"解释：CoT通过序列化的定向检索与内部计数器状态更新，实现更稳健的长上下文计数。

title: Beyond Spatial-Domain Supervision: A Relation Constrained Space for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) aims to form a single image by integrating shared information, preserving complementary cues, and coordinating cross-modal conflicts across modalities. However, due to the absence of ground-truth fused images, existing MMIF supervision commonly uses spatial-domain sources or gradient variants as surrogate ground truth, making the supervision mechanism inherently misaligned with the goal of MMIF and causing pixel-level compromise or modality bias. To address this, we propose a relation-constrained supervision paradigm that moves fusion supervision from the spatial domain to a learned relation space. Rather than relying solely on direct source approximation, we further leverage frozen pretrained representation models as information providers and design a learnable feature adapter to align heterogeneous DINO and CLIP features into a unified supervision space. The adapter infers three relation parameters, namely sharedness, dominance, and coordination radius, which define three losses corresponding to the MMIF's goal. To make this space reliable, we devise a self-supervised contrastive ranking objective tailored to the adapter and couple it with the fusion network through alternating optimization. Extensive experiments show that the proposed supervision space yields significant gains regardless of which mainstream backbone the fusion network adopts, offering a supervision paradigm better aligned with the goal of MMIF. Code: github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion.

AI.tldr: 提出关系约束监督范式（RCS-Fusion），将多模态图像融合的监督从空间域迁移到由DINO与CLIP特征经可学习适配器对齐后构建的关系空间，通过共享性、主导性与协调半径三个关系参数定义损失，显著提升主流骨干的融合性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像融合（MMIF）缺乏真实融合图像（ground-truth），现有监督普遍以空间域源图或梯度变体作为替代真值，与MMIF"整合共享信息、保留互补线索、协调跨模态冲突"的目标本质错位，导致像素级折中或模态偏置。
AI.method: 1) 提出关系约束监督范式，把融合监督由空间域转移到可学习的关系空间；2) 以冻结的预训练表征模型（DINO、CLIP）作为信息提供者，设计可学习特征适配器将异构特征对齐为统一监督空间；3) 适配器推断共享性（sharedness）、主导性（dominance）与协调半径（coordination radius）三个关系参数，并据此定义三个与MMIF目标对应的损失；4) 为适配器设计自监督对比排序目标以保证关系空间可靠，并通过交替优化与融合网络耦合训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，无论融合网络采用哪种主流骨干，所提出的监督空间均能带来显著性能增益，验证了该范式与MMIF目标具有更好的一致性。代码已开源于 github.com/GMY628/RCS-Fusion。
AI.conclusion: 该工作跳出了以源图/梯度替代真值的传统监督思路，转而以预训练模型驱动的可学习关系空间实现监督，提供了一种与MMIF目标更契合的监督范式，且具骨干无关的通用性与即插即用价值。

title: Making LLMs Say What They Think: Measuring and Improving CoT-Interpretability Alignment
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoT-Interpretability Alignment（CIA）指标，衡量LLM的CoT轨迹与可解释性工具检测到的内部推理策略之间的一致性，并通过后训练同时优化任务准确率和参数化忠实度信号来提升该一致性。
AI.motivation: CoT轨迹常被当作LLM得出答案过程的代理，但越来越多证据表明CoT往往无法反映模型的内部计算，甚至可在不影响最终答案的情况下被改变。因此需要测量并提升LLM的CoT描述与内部计算之间的对齐程度。
AI.method: 提出CIA指标，用于度量模型CoT轨迹与可解释性工具检测出的内部推理策略之间的一致程度。在三个任务（两跳问答、提示干预、整数乘法）和三个LLM上评估CIA。随后通过后训练优化CIA，将任务准确率和参数化忠实度信号同时作为奖励。
AI.result: LLM在所有任务上的一致性有限（44.8–75.9%）。通过后训练可以显著提升CoT参数化忠实度，同时保持或提升任务准确率，并提供了泛化模式等丰富分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作既提供了审计CoT参数化忠实度的框架，也提供了使模型显式推理更可信的路径，代码和数据已开源。

title: Fairness Beyond a Single Run: Training-Seed Variability in Speech LLM Adaptation
summary: Demographic fairness gaps in automatic speech recognition are almost always reported from a single training run. We fine-tune the Q-former projector and LoRA adapters of a speech LLM at five audio compression factors and six random seeds, holding the encoder, base decoder, data and decoding fixed, and evaluate every run on Common Voice and Fair-Speech. At 460 h of clean LibriSpeech, the seed moves fairness metrics more than compression does on most demographic axes. A balanced 3x3 decomposition attributes 85.3% of the variation in Fair-Speech ethnicity normalized gap to the seed against 8.3% to compression (p = 0.009), though compression explains more on age and gender. Held-out LibriSpeech word error rate spreads by 0.04 points across those seeds while Common Voice spreads by 8.57, so these are not failed runs, and the effect survives controlling for accuracy and dropout. Scaling and diversifying the adaptation set to 960 h damps the effect but does not remove it. On Fair-Speech ethnicity, two single-run systems must differ by more than 0.30 in normalized gap to exceed seed variability.

AI.tldr: 语音LLM的ASR人口统计学公平性差距主要由随机种子而非音频压缩率决定：在Fair-Speech族裔归一化差距上，种子解释85.3%的变异，压缩仅解释8.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动语音识别（ASR）的人口统计学公平性差距几乎都只在单次训练运行中报告，缺乏对随机性来源（如随机种子）与设计选择（如压缩率）贡献的分解，可能导致结论不可靠或不可复现。
AI.method: 固定编码器、基础解码器、数据与解码流程，对语音LLM的Q-former投影器和LoRA适配器进行微调；在5个音频压缩因子和6个随机种子上进行实验，并在Common Voice与Fair-Speech上评估每次运行；使用平衡的3×3分解量化种子与压缩对公平性指标变异的贡献，并控制准确率与dropout；将适配集从460 h扩展至960 h以检验稳健性。
AI.result: 在460 h干净LibriSpeech上，多数人口统计学轴上种子对公平性指标的影响大于压缩。Fair-Speech族裔归一化差距的变异中85.3%归因于种子、8.3%归因于压缩（p = 0.009）；压缩在年龄和性别上解释更多。留出LibriSpeech词错率在不同种子间仅波动0.04点，而Common Voice波动8.57点，说明并非失败运行，且效应在控制准确率与dropout后仍存在。扩大并多样化适配集至960 h可减弱但未消除该效应。在Fair-Speech族裔上，两个单次运行系统的归一化差距需相差超过0.30才能超出种子变异。
AI.conclusion: 单次运行的公平性评估存在显著不确定性，随机种子是ASR公平性差距报告中的主要变异来源。研究应报告多种子结果或给出种子变异范围，否则单次运行的公平性比较可能被随机波动主导。

title: PARK: Accurate Block Retrieval for Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a dominant architecture for video generation, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic complexity of full attention. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retrieving important blocks and computing attention only within them, but inaccurate retrieval can either degrade generation quality or yield unnecessary computation. We identify two retrieval mismatches in methods that retrieve blocks using the averaged representations of query and key blocks: (i) query-side aggregation mismatch, where averaging queries before Softmax fails to preserve their individual attention preferences, and (ii) key-side clustering metric mismatch, where standard Euclidean clustering in the original key space can group keys with dissimilar QK scores under the current query, so their average representation may not accurately represent how the current query scores individual keys. These mismatches can lead to inaccurate block retrieval. To address these mismatches, we propose PARK, a training-free sparse attention method for accurate block retrieval. PARK retains every original query, independently normalizes its attention over key blocks, and then averages these distributions within each query block. It also uses information from the current queries to transform keys before clustering, so that keys receiving similar QK scores are grouped together. A fused GPU kernel further reduces the overhead of block retrieval. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan demonstrate that PARK improves block retrieval accuracy and preserves generation quality while accelerating inference, achieving the best quality-efficiency trade-off among the compared sparse attention methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PARK，一种免训练稀疏注意力方法，通过修正查询侧聚合与键侧聚类度量两处检索错配，实现更准确的块检索，在HunyuanVideo与Wan上兼顾生成质量与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）已成为视频生成的主流架构，但全注意力的二次复杂度限制了效率。稀疏注意力通过检索重要块并仅在块内计算注意力来降低成本，然而检索不准确会导致生成质量下降或产生不必要的计算。作者发现基于查询块和键块平均表示进行检索的方法存在两处错配：（i）查询侧聚合错配，即在Softmax前对查询取平均无法保留各自的注意力偏好；（ii）键侧聚类度量错配，即在原始键空间用欧氏聚类会把当前查询下QK得分差异大的键分到一组，使其平均表示无法准确反映当前查询对单个键的打分。这些错配导致块检索不准确。
AI.method: PARK是一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法。针对查询侧错配，它保留每个原始查询，独立地对其在键块上的注意力进行归一化，再在每个查询块内对这些分布取平均。针对键侧错配，它利用当前查询信息在聚类前对键进行变换，使获得相似QK得分的键被分到同一组。此外，采用融合GPU kernel降低块检索开销。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo和Wan上的实验表明，PARK提升了块检索准确率，在加速推理的同时保持了生成质量，在所比较的稀疏注意力方法中取得了最佳的质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过修正查询侧聚合与键侧聚类度量两处检索错配，PARK实现了准确且免训练的稀疏注意力块检索，并配合融合GPU kernel降低开销，验证了其在视频生成中质量与效率兼顾的有效性。

title: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via False Discovery Controlled Visual Data Splitting
summary: Multiple object hallucination, where large vision-language models (LVLMs) generate objects not supported by the visual input, is a persistent challenge caused by visual uncertainty during decoding. Existing methods reduce hallucinations using contrastive signals, but they rely on heuristics and lack principled control of false positives at the image level. To address this, we propose False Discovery Rate-COntRol of HALlucination (CORAL), a training-free framework that models visual uncertainty using an uncertainty-aware visual data splitting strategy and leverages mirror statistics to quantify visual contrast during decoding. By computing mirror statistics from paired, symmetrically perturbed visual inputs, CORAL estimates spurious object predictions and sets a data-driven threshold to control the expected fraction of false discoveries per image, suppressing hallucinations while retaining high power for truly grounded objects. The framework is flexible, supports multiple LVLMs, and mitigates hallucinations without retraining or supervision. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks with several evaluation metrics demonstrate that CORAL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing more reliable and robust hallucination control. Code is available at: https://changliu1993-cl.github.io/CORAL/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CORAL,利用不确定性感知的视觉数据划分与镜像统计量进行对比解码,在图像级别控制假发现率,以抑制LVLM多目标幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在解码时因视觉不确定性而产生"多目标幻觉",即生成视觉输入不支持的物体。现有对比信号方法依赖启发式规则,缺乏对图像级假阳性的原则性控制。
AI.method: CORAL为免训练框架:采用不确定性感知的视觉数据划分策略建模视觉不确定性;基于成对、对称扰动的视觉输入计算镜像统计量,量化解码过程中的视觉对比;据此估计虚假物体预测,并设定数据驱动阈值以控制每张图像期望的假发现比例(FDR)。
AI.result: 在多个基准与多项评估指标上的大量实验表明,CORAL持续优于现有最优方法,同时保持对真实有据物体的高检出能力(power)。
AI.conclusion: CORAL在无需重训练或监督的条件下,为多种LVLM提供灵活、可靠且稳健的幻觉控制,实现图像级假阳性 principled control。

title: MeshOctave: Vertex Split-and-Rewire Cascades for Native Mesh Generation
summary: Generating compact, artist-style meshes with explicit topology typically relies on autoregressive models which incur prohibitive sequential per-token costs, or continuous flow models that depend on heuristic connectivity decoders. Next-scale generation paradigms offer a compelling alternative by enabling parallel intra-scale token prediction and coarse-to-fine refinement from global structure to local topology; yet, existing methods derive hierarchical scales via progressive mesh simplification and invert them sequentially. This eliminates intra-scale parallelism and scales generation steps linearly with face count. In this paper, we propose MeshOctave, which instead defines scale through dyadic spatial grid resolutions, framing coarsening as a deterministic collapse that merges vertices sharing a voxel cell and inherits connectivity. Its inverse operation, split-and-rewire, determines which octant sub-vertices are instantiated for each coarse face and resolves local connectivity using discrete structural tokens. These per-face operations require no serialization, each scale transition is modeled as an unordered set that adds one bit of coordinate precision, naturally supporting dynamic-length meshes and adaptive resolution refinement. We construct a scale-conditioned masked-uniform discrete diffusion model to learn split-and-rewire operation from resolution collapse hierarchies. MeshOctave outperforms strong baselines in geometric fidelity and topological validity by a non-trivial margin, while supporting adaptive resolution refinement and extending naturally to mesh subdivision tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MeshOctave，用二进空间网格分辨率定义尺度、以"合并-分裂重连"替代简化-序列化逆操作，构建尺度条件掩码均匀离散扩散模型，实现并行、动态长度的艺术风格网格生成，精度与拓扑质量显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 生成紧凑且具艺术家风格、拓扑显式的网格，现有多数方法存在瓶颈：自回归模型逐token串行开销过大；连续流模型依赖启发式连通性解码器；next-scale范式虽提供尺度内并行与由粗到细细化，但既有方法通过渐进式网格简化构造层级尺度并需顺序逆操作，丧失尺度内并行性，且生成步数随面数线性增长。
AI.method: MeshOctave以二进（2的幂）空间网格分辨率定义尺度：粗化为确定性collapse，合并共享同一体素单元的顶点并继承连通性；其逆操作split-and-rewire决定每个粗面实例化哪些八分体子顶点，并用离散结构token解析局部连通性。这些逐面操作无需序列化，每次尺度转移建模为无序集合，每次增加一位坐标精度，天然支持变长网格与自适应分辨率细化。在此基础上构建尺度条件掩码均匀离散扩散模型，从分辨率塌缩层级中学习split-and-rewire。
AI.result: MeshOctave在几何保真度与拓扑有效性上以显著优势超越强基线，同时支持自适应分辨率细化，并可自然扩展到网格细分任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将尺度重新定义为二进空间网格分辨率并以无序集合建模尺度转移，MeshOctave在保持并行性与变长生成能力的同时提升了网格生成的几何与拓扑质量，为艺术风格网格生成与细分提供统一框架。

title: Anchoring Adversarial Trajectories to Data Manifolds: A Bilevel Transfer Optimization Framework
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight. 21 pages, 6 figures
summary: A key bottleneck in adversarial transfer is a trajectory-level geometric disconnect: ambient gradients often drift away from the intrinsic data manifold, causing surrogate-specific overfitting. To rectify this, we propose Manifold Anchored Bilevel Transfer (MABT), a unified framework that anchors adversarial trajectories to the shared semantic subspace. MABT introduces a relaxed manifold-anchoring operator as a semantic rectifier to suppress off-manifold noise. With this constraint, we cast transfer attack generation as a distributional bilevel optimization problem that learns a geometry-aligned initialization by minimizing expected transfer risk under a surrogate uncertainty distribution. We further develop a Hessian-free solver with linear-time complexity to handle the resulting hierarchy. Experiments demonstrate improved transferability for 10 baseline attackers across 28 attack configurations, diverse victim architectures, and defense mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出MABT框架，通过流形锚定算子与分布双层优化学习几何对齐初始化，缓解对抗迁移中的轨迹级几何失配，提升迁移攻击效果。
AI.motivation: 对抗迁移存在轨迹级几何失配瓶颈：环境梯度常偏离内在数据流形，导致代理模型特异性过拟合，迁移性受限。
AI.method: MABT引入松弛流形锚定算子作为语义校正器抑制离流形噪声；将迁移攻击生成建模为分布双层优化问题，在代理不确定性分布下最小化期望迁移风险以学习几何对齐初始化；并设计线性时间复杂度的无Hessian求解器处理该层级结构。
AI.result: 在28种攻击配置、多种受害者架构及防御机制下，10种基线攻击器的迁移性均获提升。
AI.conclusion: 将对抗轨迹锚定到共享语义子空间并采用分布双层优化，可有效缓解代理过拟合，为提升对抗迁移提供统一且高效的范式。

title: When Clipping Reverses Correction: Failure Dynamics of Pointwise Forward-KL On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own generated responses using feedback from the same model conditioned on privileged information. On mathematical reasoning, the original OPSD study finds that stylistic tokens can dominate the training signal over math-related tokens, and that pointwise clipping of the forward KL objective stabilizes training. Pointwise clipping caps each vocabulary-wise forward KL term at a fixed threshold before summing over the vocabulary. Follow-up studies have adopted this clipping, but its effect on training has not been directly examined. In matched training runs differing only in whether clipping is applied, we observe that clipped runs produce substantially more repetitions that persist to the end of the response than their unclipped counterparts. We trace this failure to the clipped objective. We prove that the clipped objective can fail to correct the student toward the teacher and can instead push clipped and unclipped token probabilities away from its teacher. Our training runs agree with this analysis: inside repetitions, the clipped student places less probability than its teacher on leaving the repetition, and more on continuing it, whereas the unclipped runs stay close to their teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文直接检验on-policy self-distillation中常用的pointwise clipping对训练的影响，发现clipping会显著增加持续到回答末尾的重复，并从理论上证明clipped目标可能无法将学生推向教师，反而使token概率偏离教师。
AI.motivation: 原始OPSD研究表明风格token会主导数学推理的训练信号，且对前向KL目标做pointwise clipping可稳定训练，后续研究普遍采用该clipping，但其对训练的实际影响尚未被直接检验。作者希望厘清clipping在训练中究竟起何作用。
AI.method: 作者设计仅clipping是否应用不同的matched training runs进行对比实验，观察生成文本中的重复现象；并从理论上分析clipped目标的梯度与优化性质，证明其对教师方向的纠正失效甚至反向；最后通过统计重复片段内学生与教师在"退出重复"与"继续重复"token上的概率对比来验证理论。
AI.result: clipped runs产生显著更多且持续到回答末尾的重复，而未clipped的对照run重复明显更少。理论分析表明clipped目标可能无法纠正学生朝向教师，反而会把clipped与unclipped的token概率都推离教师。训练中的概率统计与理论一致：重复片段内，clipped学生比教师更少给"退出重复"token概率、更多给"继续重复"token概率，而unclipped run则保持接近教师。
AI.conclusion: pointwise clipping并非无害的稳定技巧，而是会导致重复失败模式，使训练偏离教师。研究提示应重新审视OPSD及相关自蒸馏中clipping的使用。

title: Settle: Learning When to Stop Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models often continue generating after their answers have settled. Settle learns when to stop from answer stability in completed traces. It trains the existing end-of-reasoning token while keeping other predictions close to the base model, and requires only ordinary decoding at inference. On MATH-500 with Qwen3-4B, Settle reduces token count by 40% with a 0.5-percentage-point decrease in accuracy. It gains 6.16 percentage points over supervised fine-tuning on the same traces shortened at their first stable answer, at nearly identical token counts. Its stopping score predicts whether a correct answer will remain correct. Settle extends the accuracy-token-count Pareto frontier of the evaluated stopping methods.

AI.tldr: Settle 通过已完成轨迹中的答案稳定性学习何时停止推理，仅训练末端推理结束 token，推理时用普通解码即可，显著压缩 token 数且几乎不损失精度。
AI.motivation: 推理模型常在答案已稳定后仍继续生成冗余推理内容，造成 token 浪费，需要一种能判断何时停止的方法。
AI.method: Settle 从已完成轨迹中利用答案稳定性确定停止信号，训练已有的 end-of-reasoning token，同时约束其他预测与基座模型接近，推理阶段只需普通解码。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 的 MATH-500 上，Settle 减少 40% token 数，精度仅下降 0.5 个百分点；相比在首个稳定答案处截断的监督微调，在近似相同 token 数下精度提升 6.16 个百分点；其停止评分能预测正确答案是否保持正确，并扩展了所评估停止方法的精度—token 数 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: Settle 是一种有效且低开销的推理停止方法，能在不牺牲精度的情况下大幅减少冗余推理 token，并优于同类停止方法。

title: The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, tokenizer, per-sentence counts and controls: https://github.com/Baracoda-ai-labs/baracoda-fr (commit fc8a736)
summary: LLM services are billed per token and context windows are measured in tokens, yet the number of tokens needed for the same content varies across languages. We measure this token premium on seven tokenizers of widely used 2026 models (OpenAI o200k, Llama 3, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/V4, Gemma 3, Mistral Tekken, and the Claude generation-5 tokenizer via Anthropic's counting API) on NTREX-128 (124 non-English reference translations) and on the Universal Declaration of Human Rights for regional languages. French requires 31% to 58% more tokens than English, whereas Simplified Chinese ranges from 5% fewer to 40% more and is cheaper than French on six of the seven tokenizers. Regional and overseas languages of France pay roughly 1.6 to 3.3 times the English count. We discuss how history re-sending, tiered pricing and fixed context windows amplify the absolute gap in agentic use. In a controlled experiment (BPE, Europarl, 50k vocabulary), adding French to tokenizer training data quickly reduces the premium, with diminishing returns and a growing cost for English. Finally, we present Baracoda FR v1.2, a byte-level BPE prototype with Tekken's vocabulary size. On a final test of six corpora never consulted during design, with a protocol declared fixed beforehand, it uses 11.5% fewer tokens than Tekken on French and 3.7% fewer on English; results hold after removing test sentences overlapping the training data and with an equal ordinary-token budget. It is worse on other languages and, at comparable vocabulary size, does not outperform CroissantLLM. These are segmentation results only; effects on model quality and task cost remain to be shown.

AI.tldr: 论文测量了2026年主流模型分词器的"token溢价"：同一内容不同语言所需token数差异显著，法语比英语多31%–58%，法国地区语言达1.6–3.3倍，并提出降低法语溢价的BPE原型Baracoda FR v1.2。
AI.motivation: LLM服务按token计费、上下文窗口按token衡量，但同一内容的token数因语言而异，导致非英语用户承担更高的使用成本与更快的上下文消耗，而这一跨语言token溢价缺乏系统的量化评估。
AI.method: 在NTREX-128（124种非英语参考译文）及《世界人权宣言》地区语言版本上，评测7个广泛使用模型的分词器（OpenAI o200k、Llama 3、Qwen3、DeepSeek V3/V4、Gemma 3、Mistral Tekken、Claude第5代分词器）；另开展控制实验（BPE、Europarl、50k词表）考察向训练数据加入法语的效果；并构建字节级BPE原型Baracoda FR v1.2（采用Tekken词表规模）。
AI.result: 法语比英语多需31%–58%的token；简体中文为少5%至多40%，且在7个分词器中有6个比法语更省；法国地区及海外语言约为英语的1.6–3.3倍。控制实验中，加入法语可快速降低溢价，但收益递减且英语成本上升。Baracoda FR v1.2在预先固定的协议下，于6个设计期未接触的语料上比Tekken在法语少用11.5%的token、英语少用3.7%；剔除与训练数据重叠的测试句、并在等普通token预算下结果依然成立。但其在其他语言上更差，且在可比词表规模下未优于CroissantLLM。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言token溢价是真实且可量化的成本不平等来源，历史消息重发、分层定价与固定上下文窗口会在智能体场景中放大该绝对差距；通过扩充分词训练语料可缓解但存在权衡。所报告结果仅为分词层面，对模型质量与任务成本的影响仍待验证。

title: When Integral Meets Decomposition: A Signal-Level Self-Supervised Feature Decompose Paradigm for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a high-quality fused image and support downstream tasks. Recently, feature decomposition has become an important paradigm by separating source images into common and modality-specific unique features. However, existing methods lack clear supervision because ground-truth (GT) decomposition feature maps are unavailable. They usually combine multiple image-level metrics as losses, which are inherently incomplete and may conflict since each pixel couples attributes such as texture, edge, and contour. To address this, we propose a 1D signal-level self-supervised feature decomposition paradigm. Our core insight is to reformulate feature decomposition from unclear 2D image-level supervision into an integral-driven 1D signal-level optimization problem. This objective-level reformulation uses the 1D signal form to compute the integral constraint. The decomposer is optimized by the integral area between common and original signals, enabling more stable optimization with a clear optimization objective. Our model follows a two-stage SSL framework. Stage I designs dual pretext tasks for integral-driven decomposition at the signal level and structure-preserving reconstruction at the image level. Stage II fuses unique features and combines them with common features to reconstruct the fused image. Experiments on representative MMIF tasks show state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Code: github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出1D信号级自监督特征分解范式（SIDFusion），将多模态图像融合中缺乏真值的2D特征分解重构为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，以实现更稳定的优化与明确目标，并在代表性MMIF任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像融合旨在整合不同模态的互补信息生成高质量融合图像并支持下游任务。特征分解范式通过将源图像分离为共性特征与模态特有特征成为重要方法，但现有方法缺乏明确监督：真值分解特征图不可得，只能用多个图像级指标组合作为损失，而这些指标本质上不完整，且因每个像素耦合纹理、边缘、轮廓等属性而相互冲突。
AI.method: 提出1D信号级自监督特征分解范式。核心思路是将特征分解从模糊的2D图像级监督重构为积分驱动的1D信号级优化问题，利用1D信号形式计算积分约束，以共性与原始信号之间的积分面积优化分解器，从而获得明确优化目标与更稳定的优化过程。模型采用两阶段自监督框架：第一阶段设计双重预text任务，分别进行信号级积分驱动分解与图像级结构保持重建；第二阶段融合特有特征并与共性特征结合重建融合图像。
AI.result: 在代表性多模态图像融合任务上的实验表明，该方法取得当前最优（SOTA）性能。代码已开源：github.com/Wangjiayu0512/SIDFusion。
AI.conclusion: 通过将特征分解的目标层面重构为积分驱动的1D信号级自监督优化，缓解了2D图像级监督不完整且冲突的问题，实现了稳定优化与明确目标，并在多模态图像融合任务上验证了有效性。

title: Evidence First, Arithmetic Second: A System Report and Failure Analysis for DocSem
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted as a shared-task system paper at DocInsights 2026, co-located with EMNLP 2026
summary: EVICALC, our system for the DocSem shared task, achieved 8.61% joint accuracy on 1,730 tasks in the official final test evaluation. It reads a PDF, selects a passage, asks a language model to write an arithmetic expression, and evaluates that expression in local code. Saved intermediate results support inspection of failures. A separate public-validation run achieved 92.17% answer accuracy and 1.00 evidence F1. The configurations and metrics differ, so these scores are not a controlled comparison. Our manual, post-hoc analysis is descriptive: in one inspected case, optical character recognition (OCR) and block grouping merged the relevant passage into another block, and the system answered from unrelated text. An exploratory study of reading page images on 100 documents returned evidence identifiers for only 22 documents. These descriptive findings motivate further evaluation; they do not establish the causes of the overall score.

AI.tldr: EVICALC系统在DocSem共享任务中取得8.61%联合准确率，并报告了配置不同的公开验证结果及描述性失败分析。
AI.motivation: 面向DocSem共享任务构建文档问答系统，并对其性能与失败模式进行考察。
AI.method: 系统读取PDF、选取段落、提示语言模型生成算术表达式并在本地代码中求值，保存中间结果以供失败检查；另开展读页面图像探索性研究与事后人工分析。
AI.result: 官方最终测试1,730项任务联合准确率8.61%；公开验证运行答案准确率92.17%、证据F1为1.00，但配置与指标不同，不构成受控比较；100篇文档探索性研究中仅22篇返回证据标识。
AI.conclusion: 描述性发现可启发后续评估，但不足以确立整体分数成因。

title: Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation for Video Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of multimodal language models through verifiable rewards and increasingly fine-grainedvisual or temporal credit assignment. In video reasoning, however, current RL methods typically train with a fixed sparse frame budget: increasing the number of frames makes autoregressive rollouts expensive, while too few frames may miss temporally localized events and fine-grained visual details. We present \textbf{Frame Differential On-Policy Self-Distillation (FD-OPSD)}, which transfers the useful evidence of dense frame observations to a sparse frame policy during RL training. FD-OPSD compares the policy's token level preferences for the same sampled response under sparse and dense views, and distills the resulting frame differential signal without an external teacher or dense autoregressive rollout. The method preserves sparse-frame rollouts and leaves inference unchanged. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-4B on six video reasoning benchmarks, FD-OPSD yields higher overall average performance than the strongest corresponding GRPO, T-GRPO, or Video-KTR baselines across the 16, 32, and 64 frame evaluation settings. These results show that dense visual evidence can be transferred selectively during training through token level self-distillation while retaining sparse frame rollouts and unchanged inference.

AI.tldr: 提出FD-OPSD方法，在RL训练中将密集帧观测的有用证据通过token级自蒸馏迁移到稀疏帧策略，保持稀疏rollout与推理不变，在六个视频推理基准上超越GRPO、T-GRPO、Video-KTR等基线。
AI.motivation: 视频推理中的RL方法通常使用固定的稀疏帧预算：增加帧数会使自回归rollout代价高昂，而帧数过少又会遗漏时间上局部化的事件和细粒度视觉细节。因此需要一种在保持稀疏帧rollout的同时获得密集帧视觉证据的方法。
AI.method: 提出帧差分同策略自蒸馏（FD-OPSD）。它在RL训练中比较同一采样响应在稀疏视图与密集视图下策略的token级偏好，并蒸馏所得的帧差分信号。该方法无需外部教师模型，也无需密集自回归rollout，保留稀疏帧rollout且不改变推理过程。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-4B上，针对六个视频推理基准，FD-OPSD在16、32、64帧评测设置下整体平均性能均高于对应的最强GRPO、T-GRPO或Video-KTR基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，密集视觉证据可以在训练期间通过token级自蒸馏被选择性迁移，同时保留稀疏帧rollout和不变的推理过程。

title: Beyond the Sycophancy Score: How Task, Model, and Pressure Shape LLM Yielding
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often abandon a correct answer, or endorse a user's position, once the user pushes back. This behavior, called sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, which says little about when it happens or how a user can avoid it. We study the conditions that produce it with 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning, all facing the same 200 items, 13 pressure conditions, and four-turn conversations, with every reply labeled by two independent LLM judges. We find that the dominant factors are how costly it is for the model to verify the user's claim, and whether a trained guardrail covers it. Removing this task factor from a logistic model costs 0.485 of McFadden $R^2$, against 0.139 for model family and 0.009 for pressure tactic. Anchored facts are almost never conceded (1.3%), while adoption on logic puzzles rises with the number of clues needed to refute the pushed answer. Personal choices are endorsed in 77.0% of conversations. Most concessions on hard items come from models that cannot reliably solve them; models that can solve them rarely give the answer up. For both models tested, maximum reasoning removes these concessions completely: adoption on deep puzzles falls from 19.2% and 12.5% to 0%. Fallacious or emotional framing adds nothing beyond plain repetition. Three human annotators agree with the judges' consensus on 118/120 calibration items. These results give practical rules for reliable use: simplify hard-to-verify problems and reason deeply, state the question rather than one's preferred answer, ask for evidence on open questions, and choose models by their measured guardrail profile.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于10种LLM配置、103,939条评分回复，量化了LLM谄媚行为（sycophancy）的成因，发现任务验证成本是主导因素，推理能力可完全消除高难度题目上的让步。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常仅以单一比率报告模型的谄媚（sycophancy）行为，无法揭示其发生的具体条件及用户如何规避。作者希望系统性地识别产生谄媚的条件，以提供可靠使用的实用规则。
AI.method: 构建103,939条分级回复数据集：八种关闭推理的LLM配置，其中两种额外启用最大推理。所有模型面对相同的200个题目、13种施压条件、四轮对话，每条回复由两个独立LLM评判员标注。采用逻辑回归（logistic model）分析各因素贡献，并以McFadden R²衡量，同时用三名人工标注者在120个校准项上验证评判一致性。
AI.result: 主导因素是模型验证用户主张的成本及是否存在训练护栏。从逻辑模型中移除任务因素会损失0.485的McFadden R²，而模型家族仅0.139、施压策略仅0.009。锚定事实几乎不被让步（1.3%）；逻辑谜题上的采纳率随反驳所需线索数增加而上升；个人选择在77.0%的对话中被认可。高难度题目的让步多来自无法可靠解题的模型。两种测试模型启用最大推理后，深层谜题采纳率从19.2%和12.5%降至0%。谬误或情绪化框架相对单纯重复无额外效果。人工标注者与评判共识在118/120校准项上一致。
AI.conclusion: LLM谄媚主要取决于任务验证成本与护栏覆盖，而非施压话术或模型家族。实用建议：简化难以验证的问题、进行深度推理、以提问而非表达偏好、对开放性问题索取证据、依据实测护栏特征选择模型。

title: Persistent Watermarking of Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generation is gaining increasing popularity with the general public, motivating the development of reliable mechanisms for copyrighting such models given their expensive training costs. An adversary may obtain and reuse a pretrained T2I model without authorization, and then serve a modified version through an API service. Such modifications may arise from ordinary downstream adaptation or deliberate attempts to erase ownership, including input-prompt preprocessing, model fine-tuning, and output post-processing. From the model owner's perspective, a key challenge is therefore to embed trigger data that remain persistent under such changes while preserving the model's normal image-generation capabilities. In this work, we propose a contrastive-style watermarking objective with a term that explicitly encourages the watermarked model to behave differently from the original model on trigger inputs. Experiments show substantially stronger trigger-data persistence than prior methods across a wide range of downstream modifications and deliberate attempts to weaken the watermark, resulting in higher detection rates, often approaching 100% TPR@FPR<$10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种对比式水印目标函数，通过在触发输入上显式拉大加水印模型与原始模型的行为差异，使文本到图像模型的水印在下游适配与刻意去除攻击下仍具持久性。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像模型训练成本高昂，催生版权保护需求。攻击者可能未经授权获取并复用预训练模型，通过输入提示预处理、模型微调或输出后处理等方式修改模型并经 API 提供服务。核心挑战在于：嵌入的触发数据需在上述变化下保持持久，同时不损害模型正常的图像生成能力。
AI.method: 提出一种对比式（contrastive-style）水印目标函数，其中包含一个显式项，鼓励加水印模型在触发输入上的行为与原始模型产生差异，从而增强触发数据的持久性。
AI.result: 在多种下游修改及刻意削弱水印的尝试下，触发数据持久性显著优于先前方法，检测率更高，TPR@FPR<10^{-4} 条件下常接近 100%。
AI.conclusion: 对比式水印目标能有效提升文本到图像模型水印在遭受下游适配与主动攻击时的鲁棒性，为高训练成本模型的版权保护提供可靠机制。

title: A Missing Piece for Trustworthy AI Reviewers: From Benchmarking Rhetorical Robustness to SciCore Review
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 20 tables. Accepted (Oral) at AI-Native Academia @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: AI reviewers can assign different judgments to manuscripts that report the same science in different wording, potentially rewarding rhetorical optimization over scientific improvement. We formulate Rhetorical Robustness as the joint requirement of stability across content-preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers. We introduce RobustReview, a controlled full-manuscript benchmark with 1,260 manuscript versions, and evaluate 30 reviewer configurations. The benchmark reveals false robustness, where low rewrite sensitivity coincides with score collapse across papers, and shows that human alignment and rhetorical robustness rank reviewers differently. Moreover, the evaluated content-focused prompting protocol does not consistently improve robustness across backbones. Motivated by these findings, we introduce SciCore, a dual-branch reviewer that averages a full-manuscript judgment with a judgment based on an extracted, structured science core. This design combines manuscript-level assessment with a content-normalized view intended to reduce rhetorical sensitivity. In our primary GPT-5.5 comparison, SciCore achieves a leading joint stability-discrimination profile among the benchmarked reviewers while maintaining competitive human alignment. These results identify rhetorical robustness as a distinct evaluation target and demonstrate the potential of science-core review to improve it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"修辞鲁棒性"这一评测目标，并构建 RobustReview 基准与 SciCore 双分支评审方法，以缓解 AI 审稿对措辞变化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: AI 审稿人可能对表述不同但科学内容相同的稿件给出不同评分，从而奖励修辞优化而非科学改进，因此需要将"跨改写稳定性"与"跨论文区分度"作为联合要求加以研究。
AI.method: 提出 Rhetorical Robustness（内容保持改写下的稳定性 + 论文间区分度）的联合指标；构建受控全文手稿基准 RobustReview（1,260 个手稿版本），评估 30 种审稿人配置；发现"假鲁棒性"现象、人类对齐与修辞鲁棒性排序不一致、内容聚焦提示协议在不同底座上不稳定；进而提出 SciCore 双分支审稿器，将全文判断与从结构化"科学内核"提取的判读进行平均。
AI.result: 基准显示存在"假鲁棒性"（低改写敏感性与跨论文评分塌缩同时出现）；人类对齐与修辞鲁棒性对审稿人的排序不同；内容聚焦提示协议跨底座提升不一致。在 GPT-5.5 主对比中，SciCore 取得领先的稳定性-区分度联合表现，并保持有竞争力的人类对齐。
AI.conclusion: 修辞鲁棒性可作为独立的评测目标，科学内核审稿（science-core review）有潜力提升该性能。

title: Switching Linear Attention
summary: Designing expressive sequence layers with efficient inference remains a central challenge in modern machine learning. Standard softmax attention achieves excellent sequence modeling performance through rich nonlinear token interactions, but it requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with sequence length, limiting its scalability. Linear attention enables efficient recurrent computation with a constant memory footprint, yet its reduced expressivity often yields inferior modeling performance. We introduce Switching Linear Attention (SwiLA), a novel sequence layer that bridges this gap by enhancing representational capacity while retaining the fixed-size recurrent state of linear attention. We derive the SwiLA recurrence from the test-time regression framework, casting the state update rule as online expectation-maximization in a mixture of linear regressions model. At test time, each output dimension dynamically selects among multiple linear attention components based on the input. Across associative recall, in-context language learning, and language modeling benchmarks, SwiLA shows strong performance and narrows the gap to softmax attention, even surpassing it in several settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Switching Linear Attention（SwiLA），一种兼顾表达力与高效推理的新序列层，在保持线性注意力常驻内存递归状态的同时增强建模能力。
AI.motivation: softmax注意力性能优异但KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，可扩展性差；线性注意力内存恒定但表达力受限、性能较差。因此需要一种兼具两者优势的序列层。
AI.method: 从test-time regression框架推导SwiLA递推式，将状态更新视为混合线性回归模型中的在线期望最大化（EM）。测试时，每个输出维度根据输入在多个线性注意力分量间动态选择。
AI.result: 在联想回忆、上下文语言学习和语言建模基准上表现强劲，缩小了与softmax注意力的差距，并在若干设置中超过softmax注意力。
AI.conclusion: SwiLA通过混合回归的在线EM机制实现动态选择，既保留线性注意力的固定大小递归状态，又提升表达力，是弥合高效推理与强建模性能之间差距的有效方案。

title: TED:Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition for Prompted Anomaly Localization
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: CLIP is a powerful vision-language model, but it was not designed for fine-grained defect localization; CLIP-based anomaly detectors therefore adapt it with prompts or lightweight modules to increase defect sensitivity. We show that stronger sensitivity does not necessarily make local evidence reliable: under domain shift, adapted CLIP-AD models often assign high anomaly scores to both true defects and visually complex normal regions. The issue is not simply missing defect information, but a local scoring rule that decodes defect and hard-normal evidence, having the same anomaly evidence. We propose TED (Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition), a post-hoc scoring method that asks whether each ambiguous response is better supported by source defect patches or by source normal patches mistaken as anomalous. TED compares these supports under the host's normal-versus-anomaly text response, leaves the backbone and prompts unchanged, and requires no target-domain training. It works as a train-free score for raw VLM backbones or as a source-calibrated residual correction for adapted CLIP-AD hosts. Across frozen VLM backbones, TED substantially improves pixel-level localization over raw prompt similarity; across adapted hosts, it improves most pixel-level settings over P-AUROC, P-PRO, and P-AP. Gains are largest under stronger hard-FP competition, with mean localization gain increasing from +5.0 in low-competition regimes to about +10.9 in mid/high-competition regimes. These results suggest that recoverable defect evidence can already exist in pretrained multimodal representations, but reliable localization requires decoding it against hard-normal competitors. Code will be released at TED GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TED（文本轴证据分解），一种免训练的事后评分方法，通过在宿主模型的正常-异常文本响应下比较源缺陷块与源正常块的证据支持，提升CLIP类异常检测器的像素级定位可靠性。
AI.motivation: CLIP并非为细粒度缺陷定位设计，现有CLIP-AD方法通过提示或轻量模块增强缺陷敏感性，但更强的敏感性并不等同可靠的局部证据：在域偏移下，适配后的模型对真实缺陷和视觉复杂的正常区域都给出高异常分数。其根因不是缺陷信息缺失，而是局部评分规则将缺陷证据与困难正常样本证据解码为相同的异常证据。
AI.method: TED（Text-Axis Evidence Decomposition）为事后评分方法，针对每个模糊响应判断其更受源缺陷块支持还是更受被误判为异常的源正常块支持。具体做法是在宿主模型的正常-异常文本响应下比较这两类支持，保持骨干网络与提示不变，无需目标域训练。它可作为原始VLM骨干的免训练分数，也可作为适配CLIP-AD宿主的源校准残差校正。
AI.result: 在冻结VLM骨干上，TED相较原始提示相似度显著提升像素级定位；在适配宿主上，TED在多数像素级设置中优于P-AUROC、P-PRO与P-AP。困难假阳性竞争越强增益越大，平均定位增益从低竞争场景的+5.0提升至中/高竞争场景的约+10.9。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可恢复的缺陷证据可能已存在于预训练多模态表示中，但可靠定位需将其与困难正常竞争者对比解码。代码将在TED GitHub仓库发布。

title: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
summary: Recent advances in large language models have made automatic game generation increasingly feasible, yet reliably improving generated games beyond a playable version remains challenging. Naive iterative refinement can easily overfit a small set of test cases, producing fragile games with unresolved bugs, missing behaviors, and poor generalization to broader player interactions. We introduce RSIGame, an autonomous agentic game development framework with recursive self-improvement. RSIGame organizes development into complementary local and global loops. Concretely, a local explore-diagnose-improve loop broadly explores the executable game, diagnoses and prioritizes discovered issues, and performs evidence-grounded revision, where an evolving checklist continually accumulates new testing and improvement guidance. A global loop tracks overall quality, preserves the best checkpoint, and detects saturation or regression over long-horizon development. Beyond test-time improvement, RSIGame further internalizes successful development experience into the generator through training. Across 140 GameCraft-Bench tasks, two game engines, and five generators, RSIGame consistently improves game quality under matched development budgets. Notably, experience internalization enables Qwen3.8-27B to reach 61.38 on Godot and 58.53 on Phaser, exceeding GPT-5.5 one-shot scores while reducing Qwen's generation tokens by 11 times.

AI.tldr: RSIGame 提出一种具有递归自我改进能力的自主智能体游戏开发框架，通过局部与全局双层循环提升生成游戏质量，并将开发经验内化到生成器训练中。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型使自动游戏生成日益可行，但如何在"可玩版本"之上可靠地提升游戏质量仍具挑战。朴素迭代精炼容易在小规模测试用例上过拟合，导致游戏脆弱，存在未解决缺陷、行为缺失，且难以泛化到更广泛的玩家交互。
AI.method: RSIGame 将开发过程组织为互补的局部与全局循环。局部循环为"探索—诊断—改进"：广泛探索可执行游戏、诊断并排序已发现问题、进行有证据支撑的修订，其中不断演化的检查清单持续累积新的测试与改进指引。全局循环跟踪整体质量、保留最佳检查点，并在长时程开发中检测饱和或退化。此外，框架将成功的开发经验通过训练内化到生成器中。
AI.result: 在 140 个 GameCraft-Bench 任务、两种游戏引擎和五种生成器上，RSIGame 在相同开发预算下持续提升游戏质量。经验内化使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 Godot 上达到 61.38、在 Phaser 上达到 58.53，超过 GPT-5.5 的单次生成得分，同时将 Qwen 的生成 token 减少 11 倍。
AI.conclusion: 递归自我改进的智能体框架能有效缓解迭代精炼的过拟合与脆弱性问题，并在测试时改进之外通过经验内化提升生成器本身能力，实现更高质量、更低成本的自动游戏生成。

title: BadAction: Backdoor Attacks on Interactive Video Generation via Action-Guided Triggers
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/
summary: Interactive video generation (IVG) models have achieved remarkable progress in producing controllable visual content guided by user-defined actions, yet their security vulnerabilities remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of backdoor attacks against the interactivity of IVG models. Based on this attack surface, we propose BadAction, which leverages action-guided triggers to achieve the attack. Specifically, BadAction implants predefined motion patterns into the action sequences of backdoor samples and associates them with a static target video. Once triggered, the backdoored model generates frozen future frames that no longer respond to subsequent user actions, while preserving normal behavior on benign action sequences. In addition, we explore a stealthier attack in which multimodal triggers jointly poison action, text, and image inputs. Experiments show that BadAction achieves average attack success rates of 91.0% with action-only triggers and 80.4% with multimodal triggers. Moreover, extensive defense evaluations show that BadAction successfully bypasses existing backdoor detection methods, revealing a critical security gap in the interactive video generation pipeline. Project page: https://wsad55.github.io/badaction01/.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究交互式视频生成（IVG）模型的可交互性后门攻击，提出BadAction方法，通过动作引导触发器使模型输出冻结帧，攻击成功率最高达91.0%，并能绕过现有防御。
AI.motivation: IVG模型已能依据用户动作生成可控视觉内容，但其安全漏洞（尤其是针对"可交互性"这一核心特性的后门风险）尚未被系统研究，存在关键安全空白。
AI.method: 提出BadAction：在中毒样本的动作序列中植入预定义运动模式作为触发器，并将其与静态目标视频关联；同时探索更隐蔽的多模态攻击，联合污染动作、文本与图像输入。
AI.result: 仅动作触发器下平均攻击成功率为91.0%，多模态触发器下为80.4%；在多种防御评估中均成功绕过现有后门检测方法。
AI.conclusion: BadAction揭示了IVG流程中一个关键的安全缺口：后门可劫持模型的可交互性，使其对后续用户动作失去响应，凸显了IVG安全防御研究的紧迫性。

title: Structure vs. Chain-of-Thought: Evaluating LLM Criteria Extraction for Depression Severity
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a paper accepted at MHSM 2026 (IEEE ICDM 2026 Workshops); includes BDI-II extraction for the 9B model, not in the proceedings version. v2 adds a criteria-structured chain-of-thought ablation, two figures, and the 9B model in the stricter-threshold check. Code: https://github.com/xinkaichen97/depseverity-artifact
summary: A large language model (LLM) can rate depression severity directly from a social media post, or mark which clinical criteria the post shows and let a simple rule turn the count into a label. The latter is easier to audit because a clinician can check each marked criterion. We compare these approaches on two Reddit corpora using three LLMs (from 9B to frontier scale) and two questionnaires (PHQ-9, BDI-II), and measure agreement with quadratic weighted kappa. For the two frontier models, criteria extraction scores above chain-of-thought on one corpus only when its decision thresholds are fitted on labeled data. Neither model's gain is significant, with or without recalibrating chain-of-thought on the same labels. With thresholds fixed a priori from PHQ-9's criteria, extraction shows no gain on either corpus, even where models mark over two criteria per post. The 9B model behaves differently on a corpus from depression communities. It labels most posts as severe, whether prompted directly or with chain-of-thought, while the a priori rule, which uses no labels, beats both.
