title: Fiber-Resolved Microstructure Quantification from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI using Detection Transformers
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 1 table; Accepted at MICCAI 2026 Workshop CDMRI; Code: https://github.com/Marcus02W/Diffusion-DETR
summary: Fiber orientation and compartmental microstructure are central to the characterization of white matter tissue in diffusion MRI, yet existing methods either resolve fiber orientations without quantifying microstructure, or quantify microstructure while assuming a fixed number of compartments and a single fiber direction. Nonparametric approaches that recover both require tensor-valued diffusion encoding and computationally expensive Monte-Carlo inversion of an ill-posed inverse Laplace transform. We propose to reframe this problem as an object detection-like task, adopting the Detection Transformer (DETR) architecture to jointly predict mean diffusivity (MD), fractional anisotropy (FA), main fiber direction, and signal fraction for a variable number of compartments per voxel from standard multi-shell diffusion MRI with linear encoding. Hungarian matching during training resolves permutation invariance across compartments. We introduce mean Average Precision as a reproducible benchmark metric. Evaluated on synthetic test data with up to five compartments per voxel, our model achieves $R^2=0.95$ for MD, $R^2=0.88$ for FA, and a median angular error of 4.2°, with performance scaling naturally with compartmental signal fraction.

AI.tldr: 提出将白质纤维取向与区室微结构联合估计重构为类目标检测任务，采用DETR架构从标准多壳扩散MRI中直接预测每体素可变数量区室的MD、FA、主纤维方向与信号分数，并用匈牙利匹配解决排列不变性，引入mAP作为可复现评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散MRI方法存在割裂：或仅解析纤维方向而不量化微结构，或量化微结构但假设固定区室数与单一纤维方向；能同时恢复二者的非参数方法依赖张量值扩散编码与计算昂贵的蒙特卡洛反演，且需处理病态逆拉普拉斯变换。因此需要一种能从常规线性编码多壳数据中高效、联合估计可变数量区室方向与微结构参数的方法。
AI.method: 将问题重构为目标检测式任务，采用Detection Transformer（DETR）架构，对每个体素的可变数量区室联合预测平均弥散率（MD）、分数各向异性（FA）、主纤维方向与信号分数；训练时使用匈牙利匹配处理区室间的排列不变性；输入为标准多壳线性编码扩散MRI；并引入平均精度均值（mAP）作为可复现的基准评测指标。
AI.result: 在每体素最多五个区室的合成测试数据上评估，模型达到MD的R²=0.95、FA的R²=0.88、中位角度误差4.2°，且性能随区室信号分数自然缩放。
AI.conclusion: 该方法表明，将扩散MRI微结构与方向联合估计建模为类目标检测问题具备可行性，DETR能够从标准多壳线性编码数据中直接输出可变数量区室的方向与微结构参数，避免张量值编码与昂贵蒙特卡洛反演，并提供mAP这一可复现的评测范式。

title: ViLegalExpert: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Retrieval and Question Answering from Real-World Consultations
summary: Trustworthy Legal AI requires systems that can answer legal questions while grounding their responses in authoritative sources. However, existing Vietnamese legal benchmarks provide limited coverage of real-world legal consultations. We introduce \textbf{ViLegalExpert}, a large-scale benchmark constructed from authentic citizen--lawyer consultations, containing over \textbf{172K} questions across \textbf{34 legal domains}, together with professional answers and expert-verified legal evidence. ViLegalExpert supports legal information retrieval, extractive QA, and abstractive QA. Experiments with representative retrieval methods and language models reveal substantial challenges in evidence retrieval and grounded answer generation. While pretrained models perform strongly on QA, hybrid retrieval achieves the best retrieval performance. These results demonstrate the difficulty of mapping naturally expressed legal questions to authoritative provisions and establish ViLegalExpert as a challenging benchmark for reliable Vietnamese Legal AI.

AI.tldr: ViLegalExpert：一个源自真实公民-律师咨询的大规模越南法律基准，含17.2万+问题、34个法律领域，支持检索、抽取式与生成式问答，揭示证据检索与接地答案生成的显著挑战。
AI.motivation: 可信法律AI需将回答锚定于权威来源，但现有越南法律基准对真实法律咨询场景覆盖有限，难以评估系统在自然表述问题与权威法条之间建立映射的能力。
AI.method: 构建ViLegalExpert基准：采集真实公民-律师咨询，整理超过172K问题，覆盖34个法律领域，配备专业答案与专家核验的法律证据；支持法律信息检索、抽取式问答和生成式问答三类任务；并使用代表性检索方法与语言模型进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示证据检索与接地答案生成均存在显著挑战；预训练模型在问答上表现较强，而混合检索在检索任务中取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 将自然表达的法律问题映射到权威条款具有较高难度，ViLegalExpert可作为可靠的越南法律AI的挑战性基准。

title: Uruqi: Learning Spatial Cognition from Visual Experience
summary: Spatial intelligence requires maintaining a coherent understanding of the world as the embodied agent moves. Like humans, the agent must use its own motion to interpret changes across observations and update object locations and spatial relations accordingly. Despite spatial post-training having substantially broadened the spatial intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs), they still struggle with two atomic spatial capabilities: tracking self-motion and mapping the surrounding world during motion. To address this gap, we provide dense multi-turn supervision over interleaved atomic capabilities within each training episode, mimicking the visual experience of a continuously moving agent that reasons as it observes. To scale this up, we synthesize 11,738 motif-driven camera trajectories over a broad range of 3D scenes, supporting self-motion tracking, persistent object mapping, and rich spatial operations within each visual experience. By training models to reason over these atomic questions, our URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B improves accuracy from 15.84% to 47.73% on our Uruqi benchmark comprising 52k questions across 2.7k episodes. URUQI-SI-Mix-8B further reaches 50.41%, comparable to the 50.08% achieved by GPT-6 Astra. Trained solely on our synthesized data, URUQI$_{\mathrm{Syn}}$-8B achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of 17.13% over its InternVL3-8B backbone across three external spatial benchmarks. These results highlight continuous visual experience as a scalable source of supervision for developing spatial cognition in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过合成1万余条相机运动轨迹并构建密集多轮交错的原子空间能力监督，训练出URUQI系列模型，显著提升了VLM的自运动跟踪与持续物体映射能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）虽经空间后训练扩展了空间智能，但仍难以掌握两项原子空间能力：跟踪自运动（self-motion tracking）和运动中映射周围世界（persistent object mapping）。
AI.method: 在每个训练回合中对交错的原子能力提供密集多轮监督，模拟持续移动智能体的视觉体验；合成11,738条motif驱动的相机轨迹，覆盖广泛3D场景，支持自运动跟踪、持续物体映射及丰富空间操作；让模型对这些原子问题进行推理训练。
AI.result: URUQI_Syn-8B在Uruqi基准（52k问题、2.7k回目）上准确率从15.84%提升至47.73%；URUQI-SI-Mix-8B达50.41%，与GPT-6 Astra的50.08%相当；仅用合成数据训练的URUQI_Syn-8B在三个外部空间基准上平均相对准确率较InternVL3-8B骨干提升17.13%。
AI.conclusion: 连续视觉体验是发展VLM空间认知的可扩展监督来源。

title: DC-SAE: Deep Compression Semantic Autoencoder for Faster Diffusion Convergence
summary: High-compression tokenizers are essential for scaling latent image generative models. However, aggressive compression creates a fundamental tradeoff between reconstruction fidelity and generation efficiency: high compression image encoder always increases the learning difficulty of diffusion training, resulting in slow model convergence. Recent representation autoencoders speed up the diffusion training by improving the latent feature's expressive capability by replacing VAE encoders with pretrained semantic encoders, yet they are typically limited to moderate compression and lose pixel-level details necessary for faithful reconstruction. To achieve both high compression and fast diffusion training, we propose DC-SAE, a Decoupled Compact Semantic Autoencoder designed for high-compression image generation with accelerated diffusion model convergence. DC-SAE consists of two key components: (1) a macro-level architecture design that leverages semantic encoders to enable higher compression ratios, and (2) a pixel-level encoder that preserves low-level details, ensuring high-fidelity image reconstruction. We empirically demonstrate that DC-SAE performs strongly on image generation tasks, achieving both compact latent representations and efficient training dynamics. Specifically, on the ImageNet dataset with $512 \times 512$ resolution, DC-SAE achieves $32\times$ spatial compression, with 29.79 PSNR and 3.37 gFID, substantially outperforming the previous state-of-the-art high-compression tokenizer baselines DC-AE by 13.5% and 54.9% on PSNR and gFID, respectively, maintaining comparable throughput and faster diffusion model training convergence. Beyond class-conditional generation, a $1.6$B-parameter DiT using DC-SAE achieves 0.84 on GenEval and 86.007 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation at $1024\times1024$ resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出DC-SAE解耦式紧凑语义自编码器，同时实现高压缩比与快速扩散训练收敛，在ImageNet 512分辨率下达到32倍空间压缩、29.79 PSNR与3.37 gFID。
AI.motivation: 高压缩tokenizer对扩展潜在图像生成模型至关重要，但激进压缩带来重建保真度与生成效率的根本性权衡：高压缩图像编码器会加大扩散训练难度，导致收敛缓慢。现有表征自编码器通过用预训练语义编码器替换VAE编码器来提升潜在特征表达能力、加速扩散训练，但通常局限于中等压缩比，且丢失了忠实重建所需的像素级细节。因此需要同时实现高压缩与快速扩散训练。
AI.method: 提出DC-SAE（Decoupled Compact Semantic Autoencoder），包含两个关键组件：(1) 宏架构设计，利用语义编码器支持更高压缩比；(2) 像素级编码器，保留低级细节以保障高保真图像重建。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 512×512分辨率下，DC-SAE实现32倍空间压缩，达到29.79 PSNR与3.37 gFID，在PSNR和gFID上分别超越此前最优高压缩tokenizer基线DC-AE 13.5%和54.9%，同时保持相当吞吐量并加快扩散模型训练收敛。在文生图任务中，使用DC-SAE的1.6B参数DiT在1024×1024分辨率下取得GenEval 0.84和DPG-Bench 86.007。
AI.conclusion: DC-SAE通过解耦语义编码与像素级编码，有效兼顾紧凑潜在表示与高效训练动态，在高压缩图像生成及文本到图像生成任务上均表现优异。

title: Argument Structure Prediction in Online Conversations: A Comparative Study of Modeling Paradigms and Task Architectures
comment: CMNA'26: 26th International Workshop on Computational Models of Natural Argument
summary: Argument structure prediction (ASP) constructs complete argument structures from discourse by identifying argumentative units and their relations. While recent work has explored diverse approaches---including unified neural models, multi-step pipelines, and prompt-based large language models (LLMs)---their relative trade-offs remain under-explored, particularly in dialogical settings. We present a systematic evaluation of ASP under strict schema constraints, comparing supervised fine-tuning and prompt-based LLMs across single- and multi-step task architectures, generating complete argument structures from dialogical input end-to-end. We benchmark them on three diverse dialogical corpora adapted from Inference Anchoring Theory into bipolar argument structures. Under a shared evaluation framework, we assess predictive performance, cross-domain generalization, schema compliance, and computational efficiency. Our results show that ASP remains a challenging task, with identifying argumentative relations emerging as the primary bottleneck, largely due to the implicit and context-dependent nature of dialogical argumentation. To facilitate future research, we release our data processing pipeline and end-to-end modeling framework for computational ASP on dialogical corpora.

AI.tldr: 本文在严格模式约束下系统评测对话式论辩结构预测（ASP），比较微调与提示式LLM在单步/多步架构下的表现，发现论辩关系识别是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有ASP研究探索了统一神经模型、多步流水线和提示式LLM等多样方法，但它们之间的相对取舍仍缺乏系统探讨，尤其在对话场景中。
AI.method: 在严格schema约束下评测ASP，对比有监督微调与提示式LLM，覆盖单步与多步任务架构，从对话输入端到端生成完整论辩结构；基于三个由Inference Anchoring Theory改编为双极论辩结构的对话语料，在统一评测框架下评估预测性能、跨域泛化、schema合规性与计算效率。
AI.result: ASP仍是具挑战性的任务，论辩关系识别成为主要瓶颈，根源在于对话论辩的隐式与依赖上下文特性。
AI.conclusion: 发布了面向对话语料计算ASP的数据处理流水线与端到端建模框架，以促进后续研究。

title: Emergent Multi-View Geometry Through Self-Distillation
summary: Over a century ago, Henri Poincaré argued that a motionless observer cannot acquire the notion of space. Yet, most visual representation learning methods operate on individual images, while those that leverage multiple views rely on RGB reconstruction, entangling geometry with appearance. We propose Poincar3, a self-supervised method that learns representations from multiple views through self-distillation instead of RGB reconstruction. We combine masked patch and image-level distillation with a teacher that observes additional views, enabling training from scratch without explicit 3D supervision. Poincar3 outperforms both previous single and multi-view self-supervised approaches such as DINOv3, MuM, and Muskie on correspondence estimation, camera pose estimation, and 3D reconstruction. Using a lightweight Poincaré adapter, we also find that our learned features encode camera motion more accurately than existing self-supervised representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Poincar3，一种基于多视图自蒸馏（而非 RGB 重建）的自监督表征学习方法，通过掩码块级与图像级蒸馏结合观察额外视图的教师网络，从零训练且无需显式 3D 监督，在对应估计、相机位姿估计与 3D 重建上超越 DINOv3、MuM、Muskie 等方法。
AI.motivation: 受 Henri Poincaré 关于"静止观察者无法获得空间概念"的论断启发：空间/几何概念需通过运动（多视图）获得。然而现有视觉表征学习方法大多仅处理单张图像，少数利用多视图的方法又依赖 RGB 重建，导致几何与外观被纠缠在一起，无法学到纯粹的几何结构表征。
AI.method: 提出 Poincar3 自监督方法：以自蒸馏替代 RGB 重建，从多视图中学习表征。具体做法是结合掩码块级蒸馏（masked patch distillation）与图像级蒸馏，并使用一个可观察额外视图的教师网络进行蒸馏。该方法支持从零开始训练，且不需要显式的 3D 监督。此外引入一个轻量级 Poincaré 适配器用于分析所学特征。
AI.result: 在对应估计、相机位姿估计和 3D 重建三项任务上，Poincar3 均优于此前的单视图与多视图自监督方法（如 DINOv3、MuM、Muskie）。借助轻量级 Poincaré 适配器，发现所学特征比现有自监督表征更准确地编码相机运动信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过自蒸馏解耦几何与外观，Poincar3 证明多视图自监督可用于学习高质量几何表征，且无需显式 3D 监督即可从零训练，在几何相关下游任务上取得领先性能，其特征对相机运动的编码能力更强。

title: RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection
comment: 49 pages, 23 tables, 10 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/eOnofri04/raim-analysis and https://github.com/eOnofri04/raim-verdicts
summary: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $κ$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAIM，一种对成员相关性错误鲁棒的廉价开源模型评审聚合方案，通过交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归与可采性检验，用 4–9B 模型组成的评审团替代前沿专有模型进行忠实性自动评估。
AI.motivation: 忠实性自动评估日益依赖大模型作为评判者，但最可靠的评判者多为昂贵的专有前沿模型，不适合高吞吐量监测场景。作者希望探究：一组廉价开源模型（4–9B）的评审团能否聚合起来替代前沿模型、这种替代牺牲了什么、以及在何种条件下值得进行替代。
AI.method: 提出 RAIM 聚合方案，针对成员间相关性错误具有鲁棒性：将交叉拟合（cross-fitted）堆叠逻辑回归与一项可采性检验（admissibility test）相结合，该检验可从成员自身输出中读出，用于判定聚合是否优于最佳单成员、并是否接近前沿评判者。用来自不交叉家族的十个模型，在八个忠实性基准上实例化 RAIM。
AI.result: 相对 Claude Sonnet，评审团保留了其中位数 93% 的 Cohen's κ，平衡准确率平均仅损失 2.9 个百分点；按配对差异看，在一个基准上明显提升、三个基准上明显下降（其中仅两个差距不可忽略），四个基准无定论。推理成本仅为前沿模型定价的六十四分之一，主要代价是 50–100 条标注记录上的一次性域内校准。评审团在其原生基准上与专用检测器相当（与 GPT-4o 相差 1.3 个准确率点、与 LLM-AggreFact 榜首相差 1.9 点），并在自建 grounded 集上比复现的最强检测器高 6 点。
AI.conclusion: 聚合是否值得取决于成员本身：当多个有能力的成员在不同样本上出错时，评审团优于最佳单成员并接近前沿；当某一成员占主导时，堆叠器退化为该领先者，此时前沿模型才明显更优。两种条件均可从校准集零额外成本读出，因此只要该审计允许，廉价评审团即可替代前沿评审团。

title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
summary: World models offer a promising way to help robots understand how the physical world evolves and plan complex behaviours through imagination. Yet existing studies mainly demonstrate what these models can accomplish, leaving unclear when their predictions remain useful for planning and where they fail. We study this question using action-conditioned predictors built on five frozen self-supervised visual backbones: V-JEPA 2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAEv2, VideoPrism, and DINOv2. We use frozen backbones to test representations intended to transfer across environments. We evaluate these models on diverse Meta-World manipulation tasks and real-robot interactions from BridgeData V2. We find that a world model guides action selection reliably only when the goal lies within, or slightly beyond, the trajectory it imagines during planning. With five-step rollouts, the length the predictor was trained on, the world model ranks actions reliably only for targets five to ten control steps ahead, whereas task goals lie 16 to 53 steps away. Neither an 81-fold larger predictor nor longer-rollout training extends this range; the encoder affects both range and closed-loop success, with V-JEPA 2.1 performing most consistently. More fundamentally, the limit persists under perfect prediction: using the real simulator, success falls from 92% to 41% as the target moves from five to twenty steps ahead of a five-step rollout. Planning therefore requires either longer imagined trajectories or closer subgoals. For distant goals, pure imagination succeeds in 23% of episodes, planning with feedback (MPC) raises success to 30%, imagining as far as the goal to 47%, and nearby expert subgoals to 76%. Used within its plannable range, a world model can also improve a vision-language-action (VLA) policy: choosing among eight actions the VLA proposes raises its success from 65% to 77% across 16 different tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统检验了基于冻结自监督视觉骨干的动作条件世界模型在机器人规划中的可用范围与失效原因，发现其仅在目标落在想象轨迹内或稍远处时可靠，超出后即使预测完美也无法弥补。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型研究多展示能力，却未阐明其预测在何时对规划仍有用、何处会失效，缺乏对可规划范围与失效边界的系统理解。
AI.method: 采用五个冻结自监督视觉骨干（V-JEPA 2、V-JEPA 2.1、VideoMAEv2、VideoPrism、DINOv2）构建动作条件预测器，在Meta-World操作任务与BridgeData V2真实机器人交互上评估五步rollout；并对比更大预测器、更长rollout训练、真实模拟器完美预测、MPC、直接想象到目标及专家子目标等设置。
AI.result: 五步rollout仅在目标提前5–10控制步时可靠排序动作，而任务目标在16–53步外；81倍大预测器与更长rollout训练均未扩展该范围；完美预测下成功率随目标从5步到20步由92%降至41%；远目标时纯想象23%、MPC 30%、想象至目标47%、专家子目标76%；在可规划范围内用世界模型从VLA八个候选动作中挑选可将16任务成功率从65%提升至77%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的规划可靠性受其想象轨迹范围根本限制，需更长想象轨迹或更近子目标；在可规划范围内可作为VLA策略的动作筛选器提升成功率。

title: 4MT-VLM: How Coarse Is a VLMs Cognitive Map?
summary: An agent that moves must recognise a place from a viewpoint it has never seen. We introduce 4MT-VLM, a dataset of procedurally generated landscapes, each rendered across five stimulus modes that remove appearance cues while holding layout fixed: shape and colour, shape only, colour only, bare terrain peaks with no objects, and a valley viewpoint that puts the peaks on the horizon. The last condition is commonly used in clinics to probe hippocampal function in human patients. We test this benchmark across sixteen different open and closed-source models and report 4AFC performance, a measure which is also used to grade human participants. We observe that models identify a place from the studied viewpoint but lose it once the camera moves, dropping below the 25% chance level at 135° where a human observer scores 85%. Frontier models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-5.6) answer only 39% and 31% of rotated trials correctly, recovering to 85% and 55% only when distractors are moved more than 30 meters apart. Our benchmark demonstrates that while current VLMs possess rudimentary cognitive maps, their spatial resolution remains fundamentally too coarse to maintain a stable, 3D understanding of the world once the viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: 提出4MT-VLM基准：程序生成的景观在五种刺激模式下渲染（形状+颜色、仅形状、仅颜色、无物体的裸地形山峰、山谷视角），在16个开源与闭源模型上做4AFC测试。模型在研究过的视角能识别地点，但相机一移动就失败，135°时低于25%随机水平，而人类观察者得85%；前沿模型旋转试验正确率仅39%和31%。
AI.motivation: 移动的智能体必须能从从未见过的视角识别地点，这需要稳定的三维空间理解。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的地图能力尚不清楚，且缺少能剥离外观线索、只保留布局信息、并可与人类临床测量对齐的基准。
AI.method: 构建4MT-VLM数据集：程序化生成景观，每个场景在五种刺激模式下渲染，除去外观线索而保持布局固定——形状与颜色、仅形状、仅颜色、无物体的裸地形山峰、将山峰置于地平线的山谷视角（该条件常用于临床探测人类海马功能）。在十六个开源与闭源模型上进行4AFC评估，并与人类被试评分方式一致。
AI.result: 模型能从研究过的视角识别地点，但相机旋转后能力丧失：135°旋转时低于25%随机水平，而人类为85%。前沿模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash、GPT-5.6）旋转试次正确率仅39%和31%，只有当干扰项间距超过30米时才回升至85%和55%。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM具备初步的认知地图，但空间分辨率过于粗糙，视角改变后无法维持稳定、三维的世界理解。

title: Concept Subspaces Compute Beyond the Logit Lens: A Weights-Only Test for Locating Representations Upstream of Readout
comment: 54 pages. Substantially revised preprint: new title, expanded model coverage, readout-geometry controls, supplementary intervention and transfer experiments, revised interpretation, updated figures and author list
summary: A concept subspace's effect on model behavior does not establish how it relates to the output readout. We introduce a two-sided geometric diagnostic that measures an extracted subspace's overlap with the dominant right-singular directions of the unembedding matrix, evaluated against output-oriented positive controls. Given an extracted basis, the raw diagnostic requires only model weights. Our testbed is the Format-Agnostic Reasoning Subspace (FARS), a ten-dimensional basis extracted from eighteen reasoning concepts expressed in six surface forms. Across nine rank-matched estimators and twenty-six models, four activation-derived concept estimators carry only 0.38--0.80% mean energy in the top-ten readout span. Final-layer PCA carries 3.56%, exceeding FARS in 25 of 26 models. A same-layer next-token control, evaluated using a fitted linear translator for depth matching, carries approximately thirteen times more energy than FARS, with separation in all 25 tested models. Re-extracting FARS on ten disjoint concepts yields 62--100% cross-format retrieval across twenty-four generative models, demonstrating transfer of the extraction procedure rather than a fixed basis. A complementary four-model, three-seed intervention study finds model-dependent source-directed effects that remain well below full-vector replacement. Together, the geometry and intervention controls distinguish concept structure from dominant readout directions while limiting claims of causal sufficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双侧几何诊断方法，通过测量提取子空间与解嵌入矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠程度（并与输出导向阳性对照比较），检验概念子空间与输出读出之间的关系；以FARS为测试床，结果显示激活派生的概念估计器在top-10读出跨度中仅携带0.38–0.80%能量，明显低于末层PCA及同层下一token对照。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已表明概念子空间会影响模型行为，但无法确定该子空间与输出读出（readout）之间的具体关系；作者希望区分“概念结构”与“主导读出方向”，并避免过度声称因果充分性。
AI.method: 提出双侧几何诊断：在给定提取基的情况下，仅需模型权重，度量该子空间与解嵌入矩阵主导右奇异方向的重叠，并以输出导向阳性对照为参照，同时控制秩匹配。测试对象为FARS——从六种表层形式下的十八个推理概念中提取的十维基；比较九种秩匹配估计器与二十六种模型，并设置同层下一token对照（用拟合线性翻译器进行深度匹配）。此外，在十个不相交概念上重新提取FARS，并进行四模型三种子干预研究。
AI.result: 四个激活派生的概念估计器在top-10读出跨度中平均仅携带0.38–0.80%能量；末层PCA携带3.56%，在26个模型中的25个超过FARS；同层下一token对照携带约13倍于FARS的能量，在全部25个受测模型中均有分离。在10个不相交概念上重新提取FARS，在24个生成模型中实现62–100%的跨格式检索。干预研究显示依赖模型源的定向效应，但远低于全向量替换。
AI.conclusion: 几何与干预对照共同表明，概念结构与主导读出方向可被区分，同时限制了关于因果充分性的主张；FARS体现的是提取程序的可迁移性，而非固定基。

title: Universal Cross-Prompt Adversarial Attacks on Promptable Concept Segmentation
summary: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) achieves remarkable performance in visual segmentation. The latest SAM3 extends promptable segmentation to concept-level prediction, broadening the scope of segmentation foundation models. While recent works reveal that SAM and SAM2 are vulnerable to adversarial examples, the robustness of SAM3 under the concept segmentation paradigm remains unexplored. In addition, existing adversarial attacks on SAM-series models exhibit limited cross-prompt transferability. To this end, we propose AdvPCS, a universal cross-prompt adversarial attack for Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS), including a min-max prompt optimization strategy, a global-local perception deception attack, and a temporal transition deviation attack. Specifically, we first identify the hardest-to-attack prompts via min-max bilevel optimization. In the inner maximization, we enhance diversity over candidate point, box, and text prompts. In the outer minimization, we select prompts with the highest responses based on the confidence scores output by the detector. Given the selected prompts, we apply the perception deception attack to minimize both global and local existence probabilities under joint prompting and employ the temporal memory misalignment attack to maximize inter-frame semantic inconsistency and corrupt memory pointers. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that a single universal adversarial perturbation (UAP) generated by our method generalizes across frames from different videos and achieves strong attack performance under point, box, and text prompts. In particular, it reduces the average mIoU of various PCS models on the SA-CO dataset to below 5% under text prompts, demonstrating strong attack ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdvPCS，一种针对 Promptable Concept Segmentation（PCS）的通用跨提示对抗攻击方法，通过 min-max 提示优化、全局-局部感知欺骗攻击和时间过渡偏移攻击，生成单一通用对抗扰动，在四个数据集上实现对 SAM3 类模型跨帧、跨提示类型的强攻击效果。
AI.motivation: SAM3 将可提示分割扩展到概念级预测，但现有研究仅揭示 SAM/SAM2 对对抗样本脆弱，SAM3 在概念分割范式下的鲁棒性尚属空白；此外，已有针对 SAM 系列的攻击跨提示迁移能力有限，亟需研究更具通用性的攻击方法。
AI.method: 提出 AdvPCS，包含三部分：(1) min-max 提示优化策略，通过 min-max 双层优化识别最难攻击的提示：内层最大化在候选点、框、文本提示上增强多样性，外层最小化依据检测器置信度选择响应最高的提示；(2) 全局-局部感知欺骗攻击，在联合提示下最小化全局与局部存在概率；(3) 时间记忆错位攻击，最大化帧间语义不一致性并破坏记忆指针。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法生成的单一通用对抗扰动（UAP）可跨不同视频的帧泛化，并在点、框、文本提示下均取得强攻击性能。尤其在 SA-CO 数据集上，文本提示下将多种 PCS 模型的平均 mIoU 降至 5% 以下，展现出强大的攻击能力。
AI.conclusion: AdvPCS 首次系统研究了 SAM3 在概念分割范式下的对抗鲁棒性，验证了概念级可提示分割模型同样存在显著安全风险，且单一通用扰动即可实现跨帧、跨提示类型的强攻击，为后续鲁棒性防御研究提供了基准与方向。

title: PLRS-IC: A Dual-Calibration Framework for Chest X-Ray Vision-Language Alignment
summary: Fine-grained vision-language alignment in chest radiography enables zero-shot classification, grounding, and segmentation without task-specific annotations. However, this alignment is fundamentally hindered by two intertwined sources of ambiguity: projection-induced visual mismatch and patient-agnostic semantic overlap. First, at the local feature level, frontal and lateral radiographs exhibit distinct appearances for the same clinical finding, rendering a shared patch-text similarity geometry inherently suboptimal. Compounding this visual ambiguity is a semantic mismatch during global contrastive optimization, where instance-level objectives penalize cross-patient pairs as strict negatives even when they share identical positive clinical concepts. To address this dual ambiguity, we propose PLRS-IC, a unified dual-calibration framework for chest X-ray representation learning. At the local alignment stage, Projection-Conditioned Low-Rank Residual Similarity (PLRS) dynamically adapts patch-text matching to projection-specific manifolds using a bounded, parameter-efficient low-rank residual. At the global optimization stage, Information-Content-Calibrated Soft False-Negative Suppression (IC-SFNS) leverages a corpus-derived information-theoretic prior to soften the penalty of semantically overlapping negatives without altering original contrastive assignments. Extensive experiments across nine public zero-shot benchmark settings demonstrate that our framework yields consistent improvements in classification, grounding, and segmentation, validating the necessity of dual-calibration in medical vision-language pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PLRS-IC 双校准框架，分别从局部投影条件化相似度建模和全局信息论软负样本抑制两方面缓解胸部X线视觉-语言对齐中的双重歧义，在九个公开零样本基准上提升分类、定位和分割性能。
AI.motivation: 胸片细粒度视觉-语言对齐可实现零样本分类、定位和分割，但受两类相互交织的歧义阻碍：一是投影导致的视觉不匹配，同一临床表现在正位与侧位片中外观不同，共享的 patch-文本相似度几何并非最优；二是患者无关的语义重叠，实例级对比目标将共享相同阳性临床概念的跨患者样本对误判为严格负样本。
AI.method: 提出统一双校准框架 PLRS-IC。局部对齐阶段使用投影条件化低秩残差相似度（PLRS），通过有界、参数高效的低秩残差，将 patch-文本匹配动态适配到投影特定的流形上；全局优化阶段使用信息内容校准的软假阴性抑制（IC-SFNS），利用语料导出的信息论先验，在不改变原始对比分配的前提下，柔化语义重叠负样本的惩罚。
AI.result: 在九个公开零样本基准设置上的大量实验表明，该框架在分类、定位和分割任务上均取得一致改进，验证了医学视觉-语言预训练中双校准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部投影条件化相似度校准与全局软假阴性抑制的协同设计，可有效缓解胸片视觉-语言对齐中的投影视觉歧义与语义重叠歧义，从而提升零样本下游任务的泛化性能，说明双校准是医学视觉-语言预训练中的关键环节。

title: MegaAvatar: Controllable Talking Avatar Generation
summary: This report presents \textbf{MegaAvatar}, a controllable talking avatar generation framework built on top of the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B model. Compared with previous talking-avatar methods that mainly rely on audio or reference-image conditioning, we introduce additional SMPL-X-derived 3D guidance, enabling global control over body pose and head motion. Specifically, we render the driving SMPL-X sequence into dense mesh frames and encode them with a lightweight 3D convolutional encoder, whose outputs are injected into the latent tokens to provide overall motion control. Furthermore, we extend Wan2.2-TI2V-5B with additional audio and face cross-attention modules to enable fine-grained expression control and preserve the input identity, respectively. In addition, we implement an audio-to-SMPL-X model to predict an SMPL-X sequence conditioned on the reference image and input audio, allowing MegaAvatar to support audio-driven inference without user-provided SMPL-X frames. Experiments show that MegaAvatar achieves high-quality talking avatar generation with controllable body and head motion, speech-synchronized facial expressions, and consistent identity preservation. MegaAvatar also supports inference with flexible resolutions and video lengths. Codes, dataset, models will be avaliable in https://github.com/Jeoyal/MegaAvatar

AI.tldr: MegaAvatar：基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 的可控说话数字人框架，引入 SMPL-X 3D 引导实现身体与头部整体运动控制，并扩展音频/人脸交叉注意力模块，支持音频驱动推理、灵活分辨率与时长。
AI.motivation: 现有说话数字人方法主要依赖音频或参考图像条件，缺乏对身体姿态和头部运动的全局可控性，生成结果在整体运动控制与身份保持的精细程度上有局限。
AI.method: 在 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 上构建框架：1) 将驱动 SMPL-X 序列渲染为稠密网格帧，用轻量 3D 卷积编码器编码后注入 latent token 提供整体运动控制；2) 为基座模型扩展音频与人脸交叉注意力模块，分别实现细粒度表情控制与输入身份保持；3) 实现音频到 SMPL-X 的预测模型，以参考图像与输入音频为条件生成 SMPL-X 序列，免除用户手动提供 SMPL-X 帧。
AI.result: 实验表明 MegaAvatar 能生成高质量说话数字人，具备可控的身体与头部运动、语音同步的面部表情和一致的身份保持，并支持灵活的分辨率与视频长度推理。
AI.conclusion: MegaAvatar 通过显式 3D（SMPL-X）引导与多模态注意力扩展，在可控性与身份一致性上优于仅依赖音频/图像条件的方法；代码、数据集与模型将开源。

title: A Tilted Bowl Is Not a Slippery Slope: Compressing Looped Models
summary: Looped models reason by applying the same block of weights many times, so compressing that block saves memory traffic on every loop. Compressed looped models, however, often collapse, and the collapse is usually blamed on rounding error that accumulates from loop to loop. In this work we test that account on more than 30 models from five families and find, to our surprise, that it holds only for loops that never settle. When a loop settles, a fixed rounding error does not accumulate. It moves the point where the loop settles, much as tilting a bowl moves where a ball comes to rest, and the answer is lost only when the shift is larger than the readout tolerates. This picture lets us predict which models fail from a single label-free measurement, and it tells us why failed models recover: their loops still settle, so a few final loops with 8-bit weights bring the answer back. Motivated by these findings, we build a controller that stops when the model's halting head fires and then finishes with 8-bit loops. On Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard it beats fixed-depth inference by up to 15 points under a third of the weight traffic.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视循环模型压缩后崩溃的原因，发现崩溃并非来自逐圈累积的舍入误差，而是仅发生在循环不收敛（不settle）时；当循环收敛时，固定舍入误差只是平移收敛点。基于此提出无标签预测失效模型的测量方法，并构建控制器：在halt head触发后以8-bit环路收尾，在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Hard上以约1/3权重流量超越固定深度推理最多15个点。
AI.motivation: 循环模型通过重复应用同一权重块进行推理，压缩该权重块可在每次循环中节省内存流量，具有显著效率价值。但压缩后的循环模型常发生崩溃，现有解释普遍归因于逐圈累积的舍入误差。作者希望验证这一解释是否成立，并据此找到避免崩溃、恢复性能的方法。
AI.method: 在来自五个模型家族、超过30个模型上进行实验，检验舍入误差累积假说；区分循环"收敛（settle）"与"不收敛"两种情形，将收敛情形下的误差刻画为对收敛点的平移（类似倾斜碗使球静止位置移动），并指出仅当平移超过readout容忍度时答案才丢失。据此提出仅用单次无标签测量即可预测哪些模型会失败；并设计控制器：当模型halting head触发时停止，随后用8-bit权重的少数最终循环完成推理。
AI.result: 实验发现舍入误差累积假说仅在循环永不收敛时成立；收敛情形下固定舍入误差不累积，而是平移收敛点。该视角可仅凭单次无标签测量预测模型是否失败，并解释失败模型为何能恢复：其循环仍收敛，故最后若干8-bit循环即可恢复答案。在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Hard上，所提控制器以不到三分之一的权重流量，比固定深度推理最多提升15个点。
AI.conclusion: 压缩循环模型的崩溃并非源于逐圈累积的舍入误差，而是与循环是否收敛密切相关；收敛性视角提供了可预测失效并指导恢复方案的理论框架，基于halt head触发加8-bit收尾的控制器在保持低权重流量的同时显著提升推理性能。

title: Tree Navigation Without LLM Summaries: A Matched-Cost Study of Hierarchical Retrieval for Long-Document QA
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds language models in external context, but for long documents flat top-$k$ retrieval can cluster on a single region and miss complementary evidence. RAPTOR-style summary trees address this by recursively clustering chunks and using a language model to summarize each cluster at indexing time, then ranking summary nodes alongside raw chunks at query time. We show the main benefit of summary trees in long-document QA can come from navigation rather than the generated summary content. We introduce NavTree, a leaves-only retriever that builds a deterministic balanced segment tree over chunks (zero language-model calls at indexing) and uses the tree purely as a navigation scaffold: a hybrid lexical-and-dense frontier walk, anchored on top retrieved leaves, descends from the root and emits only leaf chunks to the reader. On a matched-cost evaluation against flat retrievers and an extractive re-implementation of RAPTOR, NavTree is the strongest matched-cost hierarchical retriever in our evaluated grid and ties the strongest flat baseline. On long-document multi-hop QA, it is the only hierarchical method that significantly beats BM25 on a class-vs-class basis, corroborated by a reader-free retrieval-recall check. A matched-reader replication of the published abstractive RAPTOR variant, given strong cluster summaries, still loses to NavTree at every multi-chunk budget, at zero indexing cost. The ranking carries across stronger and open-weight readers, a stronger encoder, and a full factorial that isolates leaves-only emission as the structural lever.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NavTree，一种"只用叶节点"的检索器：在语料块上构建确定性平衡分段树，索引阶段零 LLM 调用，仅把树当作导航脚手架，通过混合词法-稠密前沿游走从根下降并只向读者输出叶块。实验表明，长文档 QA 中摘要树的主要收益来自导航而非摘要内容。
AI.motivation: 长文档检索增强生成中，扁平 top-k 检索容易聚集在单一区域而遗漏互补证据；RAPTOR 式摘要树通过递归聚类与 LLM 摘要来缓解该问题，但索引成本高。作者希望验证摘要树在长文档 QA 中的主要收益是否来自"导航结构"而非 LLM 生成的摘要内容本身。
AI.method: NavTree 仅使用叶节点，构建确定性平衡分段树（索引阶段无任何 LLM 调用）；将树纯作为导航支架，采用词法+稠密混合的前沿游走，以检索到的 top 叶块为锚点，从根节点向下推进，最终只向阅读器输出叶块。在匹配成本设定下与扁平检索器、RAPTOR 的可抽取式复现进行对比，并进行匹配阅读器的抽象式 RAPTOR 复现实验。
AI.result: 在匹配成本评估网格中，NavTree 是最强的匹配成本层级检索器，并与最强扁平基线持平；在长文档多跳 QA 上，它是唯一在类对类比较中显著优于 BM25 的层级方法，检索召回检验亦支持该结论。匹配阅读器复现的抽象式 RAPTOR（给定强聚类摘要）在每个多块预算下仍落后于零索引成本的 NavTree。该排序在更强与开源权重阅读器、更强编码器及隔离"仅叶输出"这一结构杠杆的全因子实验下均保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 摘要树在长文档 QA 中的收益主要来自导航作用而非生成摘要内容。NavTree 以零 LLM 索引成本和仅叶输出的结构设计，在匹配成本与多跳设定下取得优于或持平主流基线的效果，且结论具有跨阅读器、编码器与因子实验的稳健性。

title: BMASH: Ball-Motion-Aware Soccer Header Spotting
summary: Recent advances in computer vision have made broadcast sports videos increasingly useful for event analysis, performance assessment, and player-safety applications. In soccer, however, header spotting remains a challenging problem due to the subtle and short-lived nature of header events. This paper focuses on soccer header spotting: identifying moments in broadcast videos where the ball contacts a player's head. We first adapt and evaluate Video Swin as a strong action-recognition baseline for this task, and then introduce BMASH, a ball-motion-aware fusion framework that integrates detector-derived ball features. BMASH combines Video Swin action representations with ball-presence and motion features from frame-level soccer-ball detection, integrating player-action context with ball dynamics to distinguish headers from visually similar events. We evaluate BMASH using game-level splits with separate test matches and rotating validation folds, considering both centered-window classification and continuous full-video spotting. Results show that Video Swin provides a strong baseline for header spotting, while BMASH improves clip-level AP and ROC-AUC over the corresponding Video Swin baseline. In continuous full-video spotting, BMASH achieves a comparable event-level F1-performance with a different precision--recall trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文针对足球广播视频中的头球事件检测问题，提出BMASH框架，将Video Swin动作表征与检测器导出的球在场与运动特征融合，在片段级分类和连续全视频检测两种设定下均验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 足球头球事件具有动作细微、持续时间短的特点，在广播视频中难以准确识别；同时头球与其它视觉相似动作（如胸部停球、头球争顶等）易混淆，现有动作识别方法缺乏对球的运动动态的显式建模，因此需要引入球运动信息来提升头球检测性能。
AI.method: 首先将Video Swin适配为头球检测的强动作识别基线；随后提出BMASH（ball-motion-aware fusion framework），融合帧级足球检测器导出的球在场特征与运动特征，与Video Swin的动作表征进行融合，将球员动作上下文与球的动态信息结合以区分头球与视觉相似事件。实验采用游戏级划分（game-level splits），使用独立测试比赛和轮换验证折，分别在中心窗口分类和连续全视频检测两种设定下评估。
AI.result: Video Swin为头球检测提供了强基线；BMASH在片段级AP和ROC-AUC指标上优于对应的Video Swin基线；在连续全视频检测设定下，BMASH达到与基线相当的事件级F1性能，但呈现不同的精确率-召回率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将球运动感知特征与动作识别表征融合可有效提升足球头球检测性能，BMASH在片段级分类上取得一致性提升，并在连续检测中提供可调节的精确率-召回率权衡，为广播体育视频的事件分析提供了可行方案。

title: Rethinking Generative Image Compression at Extremely Low Bitrates
summary: Generative image compression produces visually plausible reconstructions at low bitrates, yet their behavior as the rate approaches zero remains largely unexplored. When pushed below normal operating rates, representative codecs undergo semantic collapse: rather than gracefully losing source-specific detail, they produce malformed or unrecognizable content. Our analysis identifies two factors. As the bitrate decreases, reconstruction losses increasingly conflict with semantic objectives on gradients and visual results, while pixel-space and reconstruction-oriented VAE diffusion models become less efficient on semantic preservation. Guided by these findings, we introduce RAE-CoD, a compression-oriented diffusion (CoD) built in a representation autoencoder (RAE) space with direct alignment between compressed and source representations, preserving recognizable, naturally structured content for a $256\times256$ image with as few as 16 bits. We evaluate this framework using five vision foundation models (VFM) and a blinded vision-language model protocol. On MSCOCO-30K, RAE-CoD stands out from all evaluation. At 0.001-0.008 bpp, it reduces relative VFM feature MSE and Fréchet Distance ratio by at least 25.7% and 69.1% over the best competitors. Meanwhile, semantic recognizability and quality of the reconstructions remain nearly constant while source consistency falls smoothly, replacing abrupt semantic collapse with a graceful transition toward unconditional generation. Code will be released at https://github.com/LuizScarlet/RAE-CoD.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生成式图像压缩在极低比特率（接近零）下的行为，发现现有编解码器会出现"语义崩塌"，并提出在表征自编码器（RAE）空间构建的压缩导向扩散模型 RAE-CoD，实现从有源重建到无条件生成的平滑过渡。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像压缩虽能在低比特率下产生视觉上合理的重建，但当比特率逼近零时的行为尚未被探索。作者发现代表性编解码器在低于正常工作比特率时会发生语义崩塌——不是逐渐丢失源特定细节，而是产生畸变或无法识别的内容。因此需要分析其成因并提出改进方法。
AI.method: 分析指出两个原因：(1) 随比特率下降，重建损失与语义目标在梯度和视觉结果上日益冲突；(2) 面向像素空间和重建的 VAE 扩散模型在语义保持上效率降低。基于此提出 RAE-CoD：在表示自编码器（RAE）空间中构建压缩导向扩散（CoD），并在压缩表征与源表征之间进行直接对齐。评估使用五种视觉基础模型（VFM）及盲测视觉-语言模型协议。
AI.result: 在 MSCOCO-30K 上，RAE-CoD 在所有评估中表现突出。在 0.001–0.008 bpp 下，相较最优竞争者，VFM 特征 MSE 降低至少 25.7%，Fréchet 距离比率降低至少 69.1%。同时语义可识别性与重建质量几乎保持恒定，而源一致性平滑下降。
AI.conclusion: RAE-CoD 将突兀的语义崩塌替换为向无条件生成的平滑过渡，在极低比特率（256×256 图像仅需 16 比特）下仍能保持可识别且结构自然的内容。代码将于 https://github.com/LuizScarlet/RAE-CoD 发布。

title: MotionWeave: Learning Motion-Centered Future Dynamics for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 4 pages + 1 page references, 3 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently incorporated world models to provide richer dynamic supervision beyond sparse action labels. However, explicitly predicting future images or videos may include control-irrelevant appearance, while guidance derived from holistic future visual representations and shared global action features may fail to establish timestep-specific correspondence between actions and local visual changes. To address this issue, we propose MotionWeave, a motion-centric future-dynamics framework for action-chunk prediction with two modules: the Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG) and the Horizon Residual Composer (HRC). Specifically, AIMG conditions on action and proprioceptive representations to construct horizon-specific queries that localize interaction regions associated with each future action timestep from current visual tokens. HRC extracts differences between interaction representations at adjacent horizons, encodes them as temporal motion cues, and injects them into action tokens through a gated residual. During training, robot-arm masks rendered from future frames are used to construct KL-based motion-grounding supervision, while inference uses only the current observation. On six MetaWorld tasks, MotionWeave achieves a 75.3% average success rate, an absolute gain of 8.6% over π0 (66.7%), especially on sustained-interaction tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/autu-mn/MotionWeave.

AI.tldr: 提出MotionWeave，以运动为中心的VLA未来动态建模框架，通过动作诱导运动定位与时序残差组合提升动作块预测精度，在MetaWorld六任务上平均成功率75.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型引入世界模型提供动态监督，但显式预测未来图像/视频会包含与操控无关的外观信息；同时基于整体未来视觉表征与共享全局动作特征的引导，难以为动作与局部视觉变化建立分时间步的对应关系。
AI.method: MotionWeave包含两个模块：Action-Induced Motion Grounder (AIMG)以动作与本体感受表征为条件，构造针对各未来时间步的horizon-specific queries，从当前视觉token中定位与每步未来动作相关的交互区域；Horizon Residual Composer (HRC)提取相邻视界交互表征的差异，编码为时序运动线索，并通过门控残差注入动作token。训练时利用由未来帧渲染的机械臂掩码构建基于KL的运动定位监督，推理阶段仅需当前观测。
AI.result: 在六个MetaWorld任务上平均成功率达75.3%，较π0（66.7%）绝对提升8.6个百分点，在持续交互任务上优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以运动为中心的显式未来动态建模可在不依赖未来观测推理的前提下，有效增强动作块预测的时间步级动作-视觉对应，显著提升VLA操控成功率。

title: NarrativeSteward: Coordinating Delegation, Guidance, and Verification in Agent-Assisted Interactive Narrative Authoring
summary: Autonomous AI agents can turn authors' goals into interactive narratives by independently organizing and carrying out generation and revision. As agents generate and revise extensive content, authors struggle to grasp its overall structure, local details, and relationships, complicating continued guidance. We present NarrativeSteward, an authoring environment that organizes outlines, worldbuilding, and narrative graphs as linked artifacts for agent implementation and author guidance. Agent dialogue and project-wide structural review help authors understand the evolving work and guide local and cross-layer revisions, while change records and execution verification help authors assess the resulting work. Technical tests validated the system's change records, recovery mechanisms, and execution diagnostics. In a 12-participant within-subject study, NarrativeSteward supported easier formulation of revision requests and inspection of changes, and greater perceived understanding of changes and story structure, than general-purpose agents. Qualitative findings show how reviewing the work and feedback helps authors develop requirements and guide subsequent delegation. We open-source NarrativeSteward at https://github.com/Tencent/NarrativeSteward.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NarrativeSteward，一个将大纲、世界观设定与叙事图作为关联工件进行组织的写作环境，支持自主 AI 智能体的叙事生成与修订，并帮助作者理解与引导这些改动。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体可独立组织并执行生成与修订，将作者目标转化为互动叙事。但随着内容规模扩大，作者难以把握整体结构、局部细节及二者关系，导致后续引导困难。通用型智能体缺乏对项目结构与变更的支撑，因此需要面向作者引导的专门写作环境。
AI.method: 系统将大纲、世界构建与叙事图作为相互关联的工件，供智能体实现与作者引导；提供智能体对话与项目级结构审查，支持作者理解演进中的作品并引导局部与跨层修订；通过变更记录与执行验证帮助作者评估产出。评估包括技术测试（验证变更记录、恢复机制与执行诊断）以及 12 名参与者被试内研究。
AI.result: 技术测试验证了变更记录、恢复机制与执行诊断功能。在 12 人被试内研究中，相较于通用型智能体，NarrativeSteward 更易形成修订请求与检查变更，并提升作者对变更与故事结构的感知理解。定性结果揭示了审查作品与反馈如何帮助作者形成需求并引导后续委托。
AI.conclusion: NarrativeSteward 通过关联工件、结构审查、变更记录与执行验证，有效支撑作者对自主智能体叙事创作的引导与理解。系统已开源，代码见 https://github.com/Tencent/NarrativeSteward。

title: Taming Speculative Search for Test-Time Scaling in LLM Serving
summary: Test-time scaling has recently emerged as a powerful approach for improving LLM reasoning by allocating additional computation during inference, substantially enhancing accuracy on challenging tasks such as mathematics and coding. To accelerate the exploration of reasoning paths, recent studies proposed speculative execution. However, we show that supporting speculative execution poses two unique challenges for LLM serving systems: (1) an explosion in the search space of candidate paths and (2) frequent, fine-grained verification tasks for candidates. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SpecScale, a serving system for efficient speculative execution. We introduce three techniques to reconcile the trade-off between latency and computational overhead: (1) early pruning of low-quality candidate paths, (2) deduplicating computation across redundant candidate paths, and (3) deferring fine-grained verification tasks. We evaluate SpecScale on challenging reasoning benchmarks, including MATH and Olympiad. Our results show that SpecScale significantly outperforms both non-speculative and recent speculative approaches, delivering substantial improvements in throughput and latency while preserving answer quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpecScale，一种面向 LLM 推理的投机执行服务系统，通过三项技术解决候选路径搜索空间爆炸与细粒度验证频繁的问题，在 MATH、Olympiad 等基准上显著提升吞吐并降低延迟，同时保持答案质量。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放通过在推理阶段分配额外计算提升 LLM 在数学、编程等困难任务上的准确率。为加速推理路径探索，近期研究提出投机执行，但其在 LLM 服务系统中带来两个独特挑战：（1）候选路径搜索空间爆炸；（2）对候选项的频繁、细粒度验证任务。现有服务系统缺乏针对性支持。
AI.method: SpecScale 系统引入三项技术以权衡延迟与计算开销：（1）对低质量候选路径进行早期剪枝；（2）对冗余候选路径进行去重计算；（3）延迟执行细粒度验证任务。
AI.result: 在 MATH、Olympiad 等具有挑战性的推理基准上进行评估，SpecScale 显著优于非投机方法及近期投机方法，在吞吐量和延迟上取得大幅改善，同时保持答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 投机执行在 LLM 服务中面临搜索空间爆炸与细粒度验证频繁两大挑战，SpecScale 通过剪枝、去重与延迟验证三项技术有效缓解延迟与计算开销的权衡，验证了其在推理任务服务场景下的高效性与有效性。

title: TexTailor: Texture-Preserving Video Virtual Try-On via Adaptive Garment Conditioning
summary: Video virtual try-on has attracted increasing attention due to its broad potential in digital fashion and intelligent e-commerce. However, existing methods primarily focus on low-resolution settings and still face substantial challenges when extended to high-resolution scenarios. These limitations can be attributed to two main factors: (1) the insufficient utilization of rich garment reference information, and (2) the lack of explicit positional modeling between garment and video representations during cross-modal interaction, which weakens fine-grained local correspondence. To address these issues, we propose TexTailor, a high-fidelity video virtual try-on framework built upon a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer. Specifically, we introduce a timestep-adaptive modulation mechanism to dynamically adjust garment visual representations throughout denoising. We further develop a frame-aligned positional encoding strategy to strengthen garment-to-video correspondence, together with a multi-source injection design that reduces interference among heterogeneous conditions. Extensive experiments on multiple video virtual try-on benchmarks, including the high-resolution Eevee dataset, demonstrate that TexTailor achieves competitive performance in garment detail preservation, temporal consistency, and overall video quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 TexTailor，基于预训练视频 Diffusion Transformer 的高保真视频虚拟试穿框架，通过时序自适应调制、帧对齐位置编码与多源注入设计，解决高分辨率下参考信息利用不足与跨模态对应薄弱的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法多聚焦低分辨率场景，扩展到高分辨率时面临两大瓶颈：(1) 服装参考信息利用不充分；(2) 跨模态交互中缺乏服装与视频表示之间的显式位置建模，导致细粒度局部对应关系被削弱。
AI.method: 构建于预训练视频 Diffusion Transformer 之上，包含三个关键设计：1) timestep-adaptive modulation，在去噪全过程中动态调整服装视觉表示；2) frame-aligned positional encoding，加强服装到视频的对应关系；3) multi-source injection，减少异质条件之间的相互干扰。
AI.result: 在多个视频虚拟试穿基准（含高分辨率 Eevee 数据集）上的大量实验表明，TexTailor 在服装细节保持、时序一致性和整体视频质量方面取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: TexTailor 通过增强服装参考信息利用与显式跨模态位置建模，有效提升高分辨率视频虚拟试穿的保真度，验证了所提设计的有效性。

title: Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models
summary: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. To address this, we introduce Arbitr, a training framework where an adversarial trader penalizes the model for logical inconsistencies, paired with a calibration anchor to prevent uninformative collapse. Across five pre-registered experiments on Qwen2.5 and Phi-3.5 models, we demonstrate that standard models are highly exploitable across different phrasings. Arbitr reduces this exploitability by orders of magnitude without sacrificing task accuracy, and the effect successfully transfers to unseen logical patterns and new model families. Crucially, we uncover a scaling illusion: at 7B parameters, near-zero measured incoherence often coincides with extreme, unjustified confidence. We conclude that while Arbitr enforces rigorous logical consistency, coherence is a necessary condition for knowledge, but not a sufficient one

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"无套利"（Dutch book）为度量标准来定义语言模型的"理解"，理论证明标准下一词预测目标本身导致逻辑不一致，并据此提出对抗式训练框架Arbitr，将模型的逻辑可套利性降低数个数量级而不损失任务准确率，同时揭示7B规模下的"缩放幻觉"。
AI.motivation: 语言模型究竟只是预测token还是真正"理解"语义，这一问题长期缺乏可操作、可量化的定义。作者希望将"理解"从哲学争论转化为可测量指标，通过计算受限交易者能否利用模型概率在逻辑相关命题上构造"荷兰赌"（无风险套利）来刻画理解程度，从而为评估模型逻辑一致性提供严格框架。
AI.method: 方法包含理论与实证两部分。理论层面给出三条结论：逻辑完全一致在计算上不可行，故理解必然是分级的；标准下一词预测的最优解在不同提问格式间本质不一致，缺陷源于训练目标而非架构；推理链中不确定性可预测累积，过度自信本身构成套利机会。训练层面提出Arbitr框架：引入对抗性交易者，对模型逻辑不一致施加惩罚，并配合校准锚（calibration anchor）防止模型退化为无信息的保守输出。实验在Qwen2.5与Phi-3.5上进行五项预注册实验。
AI.result: 标准模型在不同措辞下高度可被套利利用；Arbitr将这种可利用性降低数个数量级，且不牺牲任务准确率，效果可迁移至未见逻辑模式与其他模型族系。此外发现"缩放幻觉"：在7B参数规模下，接近零的测量不一致性往往伴随极端且缺乏依据的过度自信。
AI.conclusion: Arbitr能够强制实现严格的逻辑一致性，但一致性只是知识的必要条件而非充分条件——模型可以逻辑自洽却仍不真正"理解"。研究同时表明，仅凭低不一致性指标评估模型理解会产生误导，需结合校准与置信度评估。

title: Offline Guidance, Online Reasoning: Reusing LLM Feedback for Small Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities but are often costly to access through commercial APIs, while small language models (SLMs) are easier to deploy locally yet remain weaker in reasoning. This capability-deployment gap has motivated LLM-SLM collaboration, which aims to improve SLM reasoning using LLM capabilities while preserving the deployment advantages of SLMs. Existing approaches mainly follow two paradigms. Knowledge distillation uses LLM-generated answers and reasoning trajectories to train SLMs offline, but requires parameter updates and additional training. Alternatively, online collaboration routes difficult problems to an LLM or leverages LLM-generated guidance and corrections when an SLM encounters difficulties. Although effective, online collaboration requires repeated LLM access. Moreover, the guidance produced for a particular problem is discarded after inference and cannot benefit subsequent problems involving similar reasoning states. In the paper, we focus on a more constrained setting in which the LLM is accessed only offline, the SLM parameters remain fixed, and online inference is performed solely by the SLM. To this end, we propose Reusable Latent Correction (RLC), which converts one-off natural-language guidance from a black-box LLM into persistent corrective experiences in the hidden space of an SLM. RLC stores these experiences in an external bank and retrieves them according to the SLM's current reasoning state, enabling the SLM to reuse LLM-derived corrections during inference without any online LLM calls. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and SLM scales show that RLC consistently improves SLM reasoning without parameter updates or online LLM calls. Code is available at https://github.com/ZBH031/reusable-latent-correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可复用隐空间纠正（RLC），将黑箱LLM一次性生成的自然语言引导转化为SLM隐空间中的持久纠错经验，存储于外部经验库并按当前推理状态检索复用，从而在SLM参数固定、无在线LLM调用的约束下持续提升SLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM推理能力强但商用API成本高，SLM便于本地部署但推理能力弱，二者存在能力—部署鸿沟。现有LLM-SLM协作分两类：知识蒸馏需离线训练与参数更新；在线协作需反复调用LLM，且针对单个问题生成的引导在推理后被丢弃，无法惠及后续相似推理状态的问题。论文聚焦更受限的设定：LLM仅离线访问、SLM参数冻结、在线推理完全由SLM完成。
AI.method: 提出可复用隐空间纠正（RLC）。将黑箱LLM输出的一次性自然语言引导转换为SLM隐空间中的持久纠错经验，存入外部经验库；推理时依据SLM当前推理状态检索相应经验，使SLM能够在无任何在线LLM调用的前提下复用LLM衍生的纠正信息。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准与不同规模的SLM上，RLC均能持续提升SLM推理性能，且无需参数更新，也无需在线LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: RLC验证了在LLM仅离线可用、SLM冻结的严格约束下，通过隐空间纠错经验的持久化存储与状态化检索，可实现可复用、低成本的LLM-SLM能力迁移，为本地化部署的SLM推理增强提供新范式。代码已开源。

title: Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost
summary: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify (arXiv:2507.07505). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on llama.cpp at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 Galahad 记忆层（含 Taliesin 与 Blaise 两个组件），将无状态 LLM 服务改为有状态推理，复用已读文本的 KV 状态并只传入必要片段，从而大幅降低计算、时延与能耗。
AI.motivation: Transformer 每 token 计算量有界，而现有服务在跨请求间是无状态的：模型回答关于同一文档的第二个问题时，需从第一个 token 重新计算该文档的注意力状态。实测七个真实数据集中，98.7% 的 prompt token 是模型已经读过的文本，造成大量重复计算。
AI.method: 提出 Galahad 记忆层，适配 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp。Taliesin 保存文本块的 KV 状态，在后续包含相同字节的请求中直接加载而非重算；Blaise 保留文档本身，仅把问题所需的片段传给模型。通过校验失败即重算的 fail-closed 机制保证正确性。
AI.result: 在 97,000 token 语料、隐藏 100 条事实的召回测试（Gemma 4 31B）中，仅 Taliesin 即可让模型关注全语料，llama.cpp 上答对 98/100，耗时 3.0 s、能耗 572 J；基线仅能容纳最后 12,000 token，答对 10/100，9.3 s、2,754 J。加入 Blaise 后，每题约读 668 token，三种运行时均答对 100/100，耗时 0.59–0.64 s、能耗 200–213 J；调优的 RAGFlow 流水线答对 77/100。存储语料为一次性成本约 100 s、28 kJ，13 个问题后即可回收能耗。恢复状态逐位一致：重启、再水化与热加载后全部 262,144 个输出 logits 完全匹配。在 vLLM 下测试的 30 个模型均可用。
AI.conclusion: Galahad 通过状态复用与按需片段注入，显著提升准确率并降低时延与能耗，且保持逐位一致的正确性与 fail-closed 安全，推动 LLM 服务从无状态推理转向有状态推理。

title: Rethinking Multi-Image Re-Representation in Multi-Image Understanding
summary: Multi-image understanding requires MLLMs not only to recognise the content of individual images, but also to organise visual evidence distributed across them. We study this problem through multi-image re-representation, viewing prompted Chain-of-Thought reasoning and agentic visual tool use as different ways of re-organising visual evidence during reasoning. We introduce Mosaic, a general-purpose multi-image visual harness that enables an MLLM to actively construct visual intermediates with ten composable image operations. We compare five re-representation settings on existing multi-image benchmarks and on MosaicBench, a new grounding-focused benchmark for fine-grained multi-image understanding. Our experiments show that the relative benefits of textual and visual re-representation are strongly task-dependent. Visual re-representation is particularly effective for tasks requiring precise visual evidence, including hypothesis testing, precision comparison, and orientation-sensitive reasoning, while tasks dominated by higher-level semantic content show smaller or less consistent gains. Building on this finding, we train MosaicAgent-8B to use Mosaic with reinforcement learning using only accuracy and format rewards. Without demonstration trajectories or rewards for specific tool-use, the agent learns to compose visual operations over multiple steps and exhibits diverse problem-solving patterns unpromptedly. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/gengyuanmax/Mosaic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mosaic——一个支持十种可组合图像操作的通用多图像视觉工具框架，系统比较了文本与视觉重表征在推理中的效果，并训练出MosaicAgent-8B。研究表明视觉重表征的收益强烈依赖任务类型，且仅用准确率与格式奖励的强化学习即可让智能体自主学会多步视觉操作组合。
AI.motivation: 多图像理解要求多模态大模型不仅要识别单张图像内容，还需组织分布在多张图像之间的视觉证据。作者希望通过"多图像重表征"这一视角，将提示式思维链推理与智能体式视觉工具使用统一理解为推理过程中对视觉证据的不同组织方式，从而探究文本与视觉重表征各自的适用条件。
AI.method: 引入Mosaic，一个通用多图像视觉工具框架，使多模态大模型能够用十种可组合的图像操作主动构建视觉中间产物。在现有多图像基准与新建的MosaicBench（面向细粒度多图像理解的定位型基准）上比较五种重表征设置。进一步用强化学习（仅使用准确率和格式奖励）训练MosaicAgent-8B。
AI.result: 文本与视觉重表征的相对收益强烈依赖任务。视觉重表征在需要精确视觉证据的任务上尤为有效，包括假设检验、精度比较和方向敏感推理；而在由高层语义内容主导的任务上收益较小或不稳定。MosaicAgent-8B在无演示轨迹、无特定工具使用奖励的情况下，学会了多步组合视觉操作，并自主展现出多样的问题解决模式。
AI.conclusion: 多图像理解中的重表征策略应因任务而异，视觉重表征在细粒度视觉证据任务中优势明显。轻量奖励的强化学习足以驱动智能体自主习得可组合的多步视觉推理行为，为构建通用多图像视觉智能体提供了可行路径。代码与数据将开源。

title: Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts
summary: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Its modular design further enables weighted personalization and order-free composition without retraining. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Ready2Blend 通过可组合的对齐提示（alignment prompt）实现持续对齐，在冻结主干的前提下达到接近后训练方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 持续对齐要求大语言模型适应新需求而不遗忘已有行为。自然语言指令灵活可组合但控制间接；后训练提供更强适应但需反复更新参数，代价高。作者希望结合两者优势。
AI.method: 提出 Ready2Blend：AlignFormer 将每个需求映射为定长对齐提示，存入模块化提示库，主干与既有提示保持冻结；通过可组合性正则化将文本需求的语义几何迁移到提示空间，支持推理时融合与重加权。
AI.result: 在两种持续对齐设定下，Ready2Blend 是唯一能匹配后训练对齐方法的冻结主干方案，达到联合训练参考的 93.1%–98.5%，保持性具竞争力，仅需少量提示 token 且训练时间最多减少 4.3 倍；模块化设计支持加权个性化与无序组合，无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: Ready2Blend 以冻结主干加模块化提示的方式，兼顾自然语言的灵活性与后训练的对齐强度，是持续对齐的高效替代方案。

title: COBICount: Separating Object and Background Responses for Remote Sensing Object Counting Without Training on Target Data
summary: Remote sensing object counting estimates how many buildings, vehicles, or ships appear in overhead images. Most supervised counters predict a density map, whose sum gives the object count, and assume similar categories, sizes, and backgrounds. Applying them across regions, sensors, or categories often requires target data or further training, which may be costly or unavailable. We study source-only counting. Training for the counting task and model selection use one group of images that shares an object category and similar imaging conditions, with one point marking each object. Target images and information remain unavailable until the model is fixed. This reduces data preparation but makes transfer harder. A model trained on one source may place high density values, called responses, on real objects and repeated background structures. Road edges, parking grids, roof boundaries, and water boundaries may then be counted as objects, creating candidate origin ambiguity. COBICount separates response generation, acceptance, and background suppression. Candidate Evidence (CE) generates possible responses. Candidate Acceptance (CA) keeps compact responses centered on objects. Bias Isolation (BI) reduces responses associated with repeated background structures. Their outputs form the final density map. Trained on RSOC Building and evaluated directly on DOTA Large Vehicle, Small Vehicle, and Ship, COBICount achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over the target domains among the compared methods, 174.132. It uses 5.07 million parameters and 17.41 billion floating point operations for a 512x512 input. COBICount improves transfer without target data or training for each target. The code will be available at: https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount.

AI.tldr: 提出COBICount，实现源域专有（source-only）遥感目标计数，通过候选证据、候选接受与背景偏置隔离抑制重复背景误检，在DOTA多目标域上取得最低MAE 174.132。
AI.motivation: 现有监督式遥感目标计数多预测密度图并假设类别、尺度、背景相似，跨区域/传感器/类别迁移需目标数据或再训练，成本高或不可得；因此研究仅用源域训练的source-only计数，但该设定下模型易在道路边缘、停车格、屋顶与水域边界等重复背景结构上产生高响应，造成候选来源歧义。
AI.method: COBICount将响应生成、接受与背景抑制解耦：候选证据（CE）生成潜在响应；候选接受（CA）保留以目标为中心、紧凑的响应；偏置隔离（BI）削弱与重复背景结构相关的响应；三者输出构成最终密度图。
AI.result: 在RSOC Building上训练，直接在DOTA Large Vehicle、Small Vehicle与Ship上评估，COBICount在对比方法中取得目标域平均最低MAE 174.132；参数量5.07M，512×512输入下计算量17.41 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: COBICount无需目标域数据或针对每个目标的训练即可提升跨域迁移计数性能，代码将开源于 https://github.com/yixuxi22/COBICount。

title: Making Grid Beam Search Less Greedy
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026
summary: A common formalism for constraining the output of autoregressive text generation models involves lexical constraints, words or phrases which are required to occur in the generated text. DFA-constrained beam search and grid beam search are two widely used paradigms for decoding from autoregressive models while enforcing lexical constraints. As the former approach requires a number of forward passes exponential in the number of constraint tokens, it is often dispreferred to the latter, which requires only linearly many forward calls. However, while grid beam search achieves an exponential speedup, it does so in a manner which does not treat all of the constraints equally. In this paper, we demonstrate that grid beam search is biased to incorporate easier-to-satisfy constraints first, leaving harder constraints to the end of the sequence. This contrasts with DFA-constrained beam search, which exhibits no such bias. To address this shortcoming, we propose fair grid beam search, a modification to grid beam search which avoids this bias while still requiring only linearly many forward passes. Experimentally, we confirm grid beam search's bias on two constrained generation tasks, finding significant differences in how it orders constraint tokens as compared to DFA-constrained beam search and fair grid beam search. Furthermore, we find that fair grid beam search not only fixes grid beam search's bias, but finds higher-probability strings in the process.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示网格束搜索在强制词汇约束解码时存在偏向优先满足简单约束的偏置，并提出公平网格束搜索（fair grid beam search）以消除该偏置，同时保持线性前向调用复杂度，并在两个约束生成任务上验证其能找到更高概率的序列。
AI.motivation: 自回归文本生成中，DFA约束束搜索需指数级前向调用，而网格束搜索仅需线性调用但可能对不同约束不平等。作者希望探究并解决网格束搜索的公平性问题。
AI.method: 本文首先理论分析并实验证伪网格束搜索的约束顺序偏置；随后提出公平网格束搜索，作为网格束搜索的修改版本，在保持仅线性前向调用的情况下消除偏置。
AI.result: 在两个约束生成任务上确认了网格束搜索的偏置，其约束词排序与DFA约束束搜索和公平网格束搜索存在显著差异；公平网格束搜索不仅修复偏置，还能找到更高概率的字符串。
AI.conclusion: 网格束搜索因优先纳入易满足约束而产生系统性偏置，公平网格束搜索在维持线性解码开销的同时实现了无偏且更优的约束生成。

title: Exploring Heterogeneous Model Merging Approach for Complex Knowledge Transfer
summary: Specialized models encode task-oriented behavior, but transferring that behavior to a general language model usually requires training, distillation, or representation alignment. We study whether such ability can instead be transferred directly at the parameter level. We apply two existing training-free heterogeneous merging methods, previously shown to transfer knowledge between general language models, to specialist-to-general transfer, projecting a specialist donor into the recipient's shape and interpolating backbone parameters without gradient updates or semantic alignment. Intersection-Merge (IM) injects a prefix-aligned donor slice matching the recipient shape, while Activate-Prune-Merge (APM) uses forward-pass activation statistics to select which donor dimensions to retain before injection. Across embedding, reranking, reward modeling, and MoE code-specialist transfer, both methods improve the general recipient, showing that simple heterogeneous merging can move capabilities across diverse specialist roles.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究是否可以在参数层面直接将专家模型的能力迁移到通用语言模型。作者将两种现有的免训练异构合并方法（Intersection-Merge 和 Activate-Prune-Merge）应用于专家到通用的迁移场景，通过形状投影与主干参数插值实现迁移。在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模以及 MoE 代码专家迁移任务上，两种方法均提升了通用接收模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 专用模型编码了面向任务的行为，但通常需要通过训练、蒸馏或表征对齐才能将这种行为迁移到通用语言模型，过程成本较高。作者希望探究能否绕过梯度更新与语义对齐，直接在参数层面完成这种能力迁移。
AI.method: 采用两种免训练的异构合并方法：Intersection-Merge（IM）注入与接收模型形状匹配的前缀对齐捐赠切片；Activate-Prune-Merge（APM）利用前向传播的激活统计来选择保留哪些捐赠维度后再注入。两者均将专家捐赠模型投影到接收模型的形状，并在无梯度更新、无语义对齐的条件下对主干参数进行插值。
AI.result: 在嵌入、重排序、奖励建模以及 MoE 代码专家迁移等多个任务上，IM 与 APM 两种方法都提升了通用接收模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 简单的异构合并在无需训练的情况下即可跨多种专家角色迁移能力，表明参数级迁移是专家到通用模型能力转移的一条可行路径。

title: Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection
summary: A robot that observes people interacting with objects should be able to carry out later requests that refer back to those interactions. Such requests may specify a grasp target by the role it played in a past event rather than by its name or appearance. Moreover, the target may no longer be visible when the robot is asked to act. We present BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system for this event-referential setting. Given the event history and the current scene, the system identifies the requested object or part and localizes it for grasping. If the target is occluded, it combines an event prior recovered from the history with current scene geometry to select camera viewpoints likely to reveal the target. The system uses pretrained models without additional task-specific training. In real-robot experiments with a single wrist-mounted RGB-D camera, it achieves grasp success rates of 76% and 77% for initially visible and occluded targets, respectively, compared with 40% and 55% for the strongest baseline in each condition. On four additional scenes with heavy occlusion, it increases grasp success rates from 75% to 95% while reducing the mean number of views from 3.35 to 2.20, compared with an active-perception baseline given the target's ground-truth 3D bounding box.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本机器人抓取系统BeyondSCe，面向事件指代场景：依据历史交互事件确定抓取目标并定位，目标被遮挡时结合事件先验与当前场景几何主动选取视角，无需任务特定训练。
AI.motivation: 人在与物体交互后，后续请求可能以该物体在过去事件中扮演的角色来指代它，而非用名称或外观；且机器人被要求执行时目标可能已不可见。现有抓取方法难以处理这种事件指代与遮挡情形。
AI.method: 构建零样本抓取系统BeyondSCe：输入事件历史与当前场景，识别被请求的物体或部件并定位以供抓取；若目标被遮挡，则从历史中恢复事件先验，并与当前场景几何结合，选择更可能揭示目标的相机视角；系统仅使用预训练模型，不做额外任务特定训练；在单腕部RGB-D相机的真机实验中验证。
AI.result: 真机实验中，初始可见与遮挡目标的抓取成功率分别为76%与77%，而最强基线分别为40%与55%；在四个重遮挡场景中，抓取成功率由75%提升至95%，平均视角数由3.35降至2.20（对比给定目标真值3D包围盒的主动感知基线）。
AI.conclusion: 利用事件历史先验与场景几何的视角选择，可有效支持事件指代下的零样本机器人抓取，并在遮挡条件下同时提升成功率与感知效率。

title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
summary: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoTools，首个面向第一视角工具使用理解的综合性套件，包含 100 小时工具中心的第一视角数据语料与覆盖感知、几何、流程、因果四个维度的 1000 题诊断基准，并验证其兼具评估与训练价值。
AI.motivation: 现实具身任务多为工具中介，需在物理约束下追踪物体与任务状态变化，涉及可供性、手—工具—物体几何、流程进展与因果效应等推理。现有多模态视频模型虽在感知类任务（如字幕生成、通用视频问答）表现良好，但在工具中心的具身推理上仍受限，主要瓶颈在于缺乏真实世界第一视角数据与诊断性基准。
AI.method: 构建 EgoTools 套件，由两个互补部分组成：EgoTools-Data（100 小时工具中心第一视角录制语料，含同步音频、密集字幕、重推理叙述及补充 3D 信息）与 EgoTools-Bench（1000 个问答对构成的诊断基准，分四条赛道，涵盖从感知与几何到流程与因果推理）。并以严格源视频分离设置做监督微调验证。
AI.result: 现有模型难以将工具使用落地于视觉证据：Gemini-3.1-Pro 总体准确率 66.9%，但在 Perception & Grounding 上仅 51.7%。在完整 1000 题基准上，全监督微调使 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 从 50.0% 提升至 60.9%（严格源视频分离）。
AI.conclusion: EgoTools 既是训练资源也是诊断评估资源，可作为统一平台推进真实世界第一视角工具使用理解的研究。

title: InfoAgent: Traceable Generation and Repair of Evidence-Grounded Infographics
summary: Reliable infographic generation requires facts, symbols, and visual relations to remain consistent through rendering and revision. Correcting one element also requires tracking its supporting evidence and the dependencies affected by the change. We present \textbf{InfoAgent}, a training-free framework for \emph{evidence-bound visual-symbolic program synthesis}. Its Infographic Visual Description (IVD) records factual payloads, evidence provenance, execution routes, and verification obligations in a typed dependency graph. Retrieved design priors guide compilation, and layered execution combines raster synthesis with editable symbolic and binding objects while retaining their traces. Dependency-aware repair localizes corrections, rechecks affected dependencies, and requires protected obligations to remain satisfied under the declared checkers. Unresolved obligations remain explicit. On IGenBench, InfoAgent achieves 93.0 Q-ACC and 59.0 I-ACC. We also introduce InfoGraphicBench-Evidence, where complete-checklist pass rates on 200 test requests increase from 21.5\% for Same-IVD Prompt to 23.5\% for the initial layered output and 28.5\% after repair, using the same evidence and initial IVD. On 120 audited repair cases, localized repair edits 12.4\% of the canvas on average, compared with 67.3\% for global regeneration.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 InfoAgent 框架，将信息图生成建模为"证据绑定"的视觉-符号程序合成，通过类型化依赖图记录事实、证据溯源与验证义务，实现分层生成与依赖感知修复。
AI.motivation: 可靠的信息图生成需保证事实、符号与视觉关系在渲染与修订过程中保持一致；修改任一元素时还需追踪其支撑证据及受影响的依赖关系。现有方法难以满足这种一致性与可追溯性要求。
AI.method: 1) 引入信息图视觉描述（IVD），在类型化依赖图中记录事实载荷、证据溯源、执行路径与验证义务；2) 利用检索到的设计先验指导编译；3) 分层执行，将栅格合成与可编辑的符号对象、绑定对象结合并保留其追踪轨迹；4) 依赖感知修复，定位修改点、复检受影响依赖，并要求受保护义务在声明的检查器下持续满足，未解决的义务显式保留。
AI.result: 在 IGenBench 上达到 93.0 Q-ACC 与 59.0 I-ACC。新提出的 InfoGraphicBench-Evidence 上，200 条测试请求的完整清单通过率由 Same-IVD Prompt 的 21.5% 提升至分层输出初版的 23.5%、修复后的 28.5%（使用相同证据与初始 IVD）。在 120 个审计修复案例中，局部修复平均仅编辑画布 12.4%，而全局重生成需编辑 67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将证据绑定与依赖感知机制显式引入视觉-符号程序合成，可在免训练条件下提升信息图生成的可靠性与修复效率，并显著降低修复的编辑代价。

title: TTLab at Daleel 2026: STAR-Ar, Sequence Tagging for Argument Recognition in Arabic
comment: Accepted at ArabicNLP 2026 Daleel-2026 shared task
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial texts.We jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{https://github.com/ENTAILab/daleel_2026_Arabic-Argumentative-Discourse-Mining}{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAR-Ar系统，采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，用于阿拉伯语论辩话语单元（ADU）的识别与分类，作为Daleel 2026阿拉伯语论辩挖掘共享任务的参赛系统，其在验证集上F1为72.69，测试集上F1为73.7。
AI.motivation: 论辩挖掘（AM）是重要的NLP任务，但在阿拉伯语中资源严重不足。Daleel 2026作为首个阿拉伯语论辩挖掘共享任务，需要针对辩论与社论文本进行论辩话语单元（ADU）的识别与分类。
AI.method: 将ADU识别与分类两个目标联合建模为词级序列标注任务，采用BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，结合上下文化Transformer嵌入与结构化转移约束，以实现准确的片段（span）检测。
AI.result: STAR-Ar在验证集上取得72.69的F1分数，在测试集上取得73.7的F1分数。领域特定分析表明，仅在社论数据上训练的模型表现不如在辩论数据上训练的模型，该差异主要归因于社论数据集规模较小。
AI.conclusion: STAR-Ar作为一种BERT-BiLSTM-CRF架构，可有效完成阿拉伯语论辩话语单元的识别与分类任务；数据集规模对跨领域（社论vs辩论）性能有显著影响，代码已开源。

title: RIQE: a NIQE-style reference model for Computed Tomography
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code and model: https://github.com/Metallogik/RIQE, archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23055559
summary: The Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores an image by its statistical distance from a model fitted on pristine images, and its distributed model is fitted on photographs. We release the Radiology Image Quality Evaluator (RIQE), a NIQE-style model fitted on 3,792 full-dose slices from 158 patients of the public LDCT-and-Projection-data collection, with a declared intensity mapping, a manifest of every slice and a script that reproduces the fit. On 40 held-out patients, RIQE ranks reduced-dose reconstructions, simulated by projection-domain noise insertion, worse than the full-dose reconstruction of the same slice in 240 of 240 chest and 230 of 240 abdominal pairs, and ranks images with 20% more noise worse than their source in 97.5-100% of cases. Its preferences among filtered images, however, do not follow lesion signal. With a 4 mm, +10 HU lesion inserted in noisy abdominal slices, RIQE prefers bilateral filtering to the unfiltered image in every image up to a 32 HU residual, at which 29% of the lesion's matched-filter signal remains and its detectability index falls from 0.51 to 0.33; it never prefers Gaussian smoothing, which at the same 32 HU residual leaves 70% of the signal and a detectability index of 0.48. Fitted on photographs with the parameters published for NIQE, the same code ranks every simulated reduced-dose abdominal image better than its full-dose counterpart. RIQE is suited to ranking a degraded image against its source; under the conditions tested it should not be the sole criterion for selecting, comparing or tuning denoisers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIQE（Radiology Image Quality Evaluator），一个基于NIQE范式、在3,792张全剂量CT切片上拟合的放射图像质量评价模型，并附带数据清单与可复现脚本。RIQE能可靠地判断降质图像劣于其源图像，但其对滤波图像的偏好不遵循病灶信号，因此不宜作为去噪器选择或调优的唯一标准。
AI.motivation: NIQE通过图像与在自然图像（照片）上拟合的统计模型之间的距离来评分。对于医学CT图像，使用在照片上拟合的模型存在域不匹配问题，因此需要一个在放射图像域拟合的、可复现的NIQE风格评价器。
AI.method: 在公开LDCT-and-Projection-data集合中158位患者的3,792张全剂量切片上拟合RIQE模型，明确声明强度映射，提供每张切片的清单及复现拟合的脚本。在40位留出患者上，通过投影域噪声插入模拟降剂量重建，测试RIQE的排序能力；并在含4 mm、+10 HU病灶的噪声腹部切片上比较RIQE对双边滤波与高斯平滑的偏好，同时用匹配滤波信号与检测指数（detectability index）量化病灶可检测性。
AI.result: 在留出患者上，RIQE将降剂量重建排在同切片全剂量重建之后：胸部240/240对、腹部230/240对；对噪声增加20%的图像，97.5%–100%被正确判为更差。但在滤波图像偏好上，RIQE不遵循病灶信号：对插入4 mm、+10 HU病灶的噪声腹部切片，RIQE在残余达32 HU之前始终偏好双边滤波而非未滤波图像，此时病灶匹配滤波信号仅剩29%，检测指数从0.51降至0.33；RIQE从不偏好高斯平滑，而高斯平滑在同样32 HU残余下保留70%信号、检测指数为0.48。此外，用发布的NIQE照片参数在同一代码上运行时，所有模拟降剂量腹部图像都被判优于其全剂量对应图像。
AI.conclusion: RIQE适用于将降质图像与其源图像进行排序，但在所测试条件下，不应作为选择、比较或调优去噪器的唯一标准。

title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
summary: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.

AI.tldr: UniWAM 是一种统一混合流世界-动作模型，通过分离的动作编码器与输出头、共享主干，实现导航与操作两阶段的联合表示学习，并借助自动构建的大规模 MAP-Data 与 Manipulation Anchor Pose 监督，在导航与移动操作任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 移动操作包含导航到可操作位姿与可靠物体交互两个阶段，两阶段在动作空间与视觉需求上存在差异，难以用统一策略学习；同时，带有明确“可操作位姿”监督的多样化真实世界导航数据采集成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 提出 UniWAM：统一混合流世界-动作模型，为导航与操作设置独立的动作编码器和输出头，共享共同主干，支持在独立采样的导航与操作数据上进行联合表示学习，并支持任一流的独立推理与双流批并行推理。进一步提出 Manipulation Anchor Pose（MAP）监督，用于确定停止位置与操作朝向。通过自动化流水线从大规模 3D 场景构建 MAP-Data，生成超过 150 万 episodes 与 7,500 小时数据，提供逐帧目标物体边界框与图像平面 MAP 坐标作为导航辅助监督，并结合投影后的末端执行器轨迹，为基于自我中心观测的动作学习提供流特定的图像平面监督。
AI.result: 在大规模 MAP-Data 支持下，UniWAM 在自建 MAP-Bench 上相较最强外部基线，位置误差降低 30.1%，朝向误差降低 44.0%。在 24 个真实机器人任务中，UniWAM 在 MAP 导航与移动操作上取得领先结果，操作性能具有竞争力。已发布代码、数据与 benchmark。
AI.conclusion: UniWAM 通过统一世界-动作模型架构与大规模自动构建的 MAP-Data 监督，有效缓解了移动操作中导航与操作阶段的统一学习难题及数据规模化问题，并在导航与移动操作任务上验证了其有效性。

title: FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training
summary: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates.
