Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可审计的全轨迹重放框架FAER，形式化"选择—学习"差距，并用学习者感知选择器FAER-UTILITY在GSM8K上超越固定与格式反馈选择器。
AI.motivation: 重放选择器常按格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或回答长度对缓存轨迹排序，但缓存层面的正确性与下游学习者的效用是两个不同目标，二者存在错位（selection-to-learning gap）。
AI.method: 提出FAER可审计全轨迹重放框架，包含训练无关的固定选择器（协议基线）和基于不相交校准块拟合的学习者感知选择器FAER-UTILITY；报告归一化梯度对齐作为基线，并用可丢弃的优化器感知虚拟更新构造幅度感知的效用面；审计契约在评测标签并入前冻结观测字段与重放轨迹。
AI.result: 在GSM8K与Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，128次更新下固定选择器质量0.6329，均匀采样0.5482，格式反馈0.6037；仅元数据交叉拟合校准达0.6476±0.0139（8个种子，中位数0.6481，配对95%区间[+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行63,276 tokens，含校准总成本189,642 tokens与3.48 GPU小时；完整FAER-UTILITY达0.6624，目标运行62,844 tokens、4.26 GPU小时；格式反馈选中记录正确率0.6953，固定选择器为0.3594，但下游排序不同。
AI.conclusion: 缓存层面的正确性与下游学习者效用并不一致，学习者感知的选择可显著提升重放质量；FAER通过冻结重放轨迹与校准分离实现可审计评估，并给出学习者感知消融、同种子差距、策略优化行及严格零样本迁移等完整对比。

title: Can Computation from Earlier Problems Help LLMs Solve New Ones?
summary: Large language models often solve independent problems in the same conversation. Can computation from earlier problems help them solve new ones? To answer this question, we first conduct preliminary experiments showing that retained history can raise or lower later-turn accuracy, even within the same domain. To understand these effects, we use controlled replay to isolate internal state changes specific to each problem-history pairing. Across different histories, these changes preserve similar relationships among current problems. To improve reasoning under retained history, we introduce STAIR (Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse). STAIR captures keys and values from earlier response generation in a fixed bank. It learns to redirect current queries when they read this bank during prompt processing. The base model remains frozen; only 12,288 parameters are trained. Across three Qwen models and four benchmarks, STAIR improves average later-turn accuracy by up to 11.67 percentage points over the unmodified model with history.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"历史计算能否帮助大模型解决后续问题"，提出STAIR方法，通过复用前序回答的KV并学习重定向当前查询读取该记忆库，仅训练12,288参数即冻结基座模型，在三款Qwen模型和四个基准上实现多轮准确率最高提升11.67个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常在同一对话中连续解决多个独立问题。前序问题的计算（保留的历史）究竟会提升还是降低后续轮次的准确率尚不明确。作者通过初步实验发现历史保留对后续轮次准确率有双向影响，即便在同一领域内也是如此，因此需要理解该效应并设计方法加以利用。
AI.method: 1) 初步实验揭示历史保留对后续轮次准确率的正向或负向影响；2) 采用受控重放（controlled replay）隔离每个"问题-历史"配对所对应的内部状态变化，发现不同历史下这些变化保持了当前问题之间相似的关系结构；3) 提出STAIR（Stale-Token Attention for Inter-query Reuse），将前序回答生成时的keys与values存入固定记忆库，并学习在当前查询处理提示时重定向查询对该记忆库的读取。基座模型保持冻结，仅训练12,288个参数。
AI.result: 在三款Qwen模型和四个基准测试上，相比带历史但未修改的基座模型，STAIR将后续轮次平均准确率最高提升11.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 历史保留对模型后续推理的影响具有结构化规律，可被有效利用。通过极少量参数的注意力重定向机制即可复用前序计算的KV状态，显著提升多轮场景下的推理准确率，同时保持基座模型完全冻结，具备参数高效性。

title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
summary: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将大语言模型专精于可执行算法交易代码生成，提出以算法交易框架代码继续预训练 + 经智能体验证的请求-代码对做SFT的两类机制，并以QuantCode-Bench（400任务Backtrader策略生成基准）及仓库级SWE-bench类赛道评估。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型虽擅长通用代码生成，但可执行算法交易是苛刻的专精目标：需将自然语言策略规范转换为特定交易框架的正确程序逻辑、在历史数据上执行并产生交易，同时保持语义忠实。因此需要研究领域专精机制及其失败模式。
AI.method: 采用两种互补机制：1）在算法交易框架代码上进行继续预训练（continued pretraining）；2）在经智能体验证的请求-代码对上进行监督微调（SFT，且后者在继续预训练之后施加）。评估以自建QuantCode-Bench（400个Backtrader策略生成任务）为核心，辅以仓库级SWE-bench-like赛道；并设置显式的能力保持（capability-retention）评估，包括结构化工具调用与仓库级智能体性能。
AI.result: 继续预训练使Qwen3.5-397B-A17B单轮Judge Pass从41.5%升至47.5%，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从27.8%升至33.0%。继续预训练后再做SFT对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B增益更大，达58.2% Judge Pass与83.5%回测成功率；智能体评估中首轮成功率由22.3%升至58.3%，最多10轮后最终成功率由47.5%升至79.5%。仅继续预训练可提升首轮智能体成功率，但使修复后最终成功率从47.5%降至32.5%，与指令跟随能力退化一致；SFT则两项均提升。另发现能力保持失败：领域专精损害符合解析器的结构化工具调用；针对性恢复SFT可恢复工具调用格式，但无法恢复基座检查点的仓库级智能体性能。
AI.conclusion: 面向框架的继续预训练、经验证的SFT以及显式的能力保持评估分别应对领域特定可执行代码生成中的不同失败模式，三者需协同使用。

title: PCB-MC: Missing Component Analysis in Printed Circuit Boards
summary: Detecting missing components on printed circuit boards (PCBs) differs fundamentally from conventional object detection, as the model must localize components that are not present. We introduce PCB-MC, a curated dataset for missing component detection with footprint level annotations built on top of the RF100 dataset. The dataset contains 197 distinct board types, each corresponding to a unique PCB design, with multiple augmented samples per type. We also provide benchmark results on PCB-MC by evaluating a diverse set of supervised and unsupervised methods. To ensure fair evaluation, we propose board type aware cross validation splits that prevent layout leakage between training and test sets. Supervised models showcase high false negative rates on unseen board designs, and unsupervised anomaly detection methods fail entirely due to the lack of spatial alignment with a board specific reference. These results confirm that missing component detection on diverse PCB layouts remains an open challenge. We release PCB-MC and all training protocols to support reproducible research on structural absence detection in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCB-MC数据集（基于RF100、footprint级标注，含197种板型），并给出监督与无监督方法基准，结果显示缺件检测在多样化PCB版图上仍是未解难题。
AI.motivation: PCB缺件检测与传统目标检测本质不同：模型需定位"不存在"的元件，而现有数据集和方法缺乏针对性，且存在版图泄漏与缺少板级空间对齐参照等问题。
AI.method: 构建PCB-MC数据集，基于RF100并在footprint层级标注，包含197种唯一PCB设计类型、每种多次增强样本；提出板型感知的交叉验证划分以杜绝训练/测试集间的版图泄漏；在统一基准上评测多种监督与无监督异常检测方法。
AI.result: 监督模型在未见板型上假阴性率较高；无监督异常检测方法因缺乏与板型特定参照的空间对齐而完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 多样化PCB版图上的缺件检测仍为开放挑战；作者公开PCB-MC数据集与全部训练协议，以支持工业检测中结构缺失检测的可复现研究。

title: Towards Trustworthy AI for Glioma Diagnosis: A Task-Aware Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:033
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is a key requirement for trustworthy AI in high-stakes medical image analysis. In this work, we evaluate UQ in a multi-task Deep Learning framework for MRI-based glioma diagnosis that performs tumor segmentation and predicts IDH mutation status, 1p/19q co-deletion status, and tumor grade. Monte Carlo Dropout (MCD) is used for a detailed task-aware analysis of predictive, aleatoric, and epistemic uncertainty. We assess MC sample convergence, calibration, error detection, selective prediction, associations with segmentation performance, and the effect of voxel-wise uncertainty aggregation on case-level reliability. We also compare MCD with Deep Ensembles (DE) and Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles (MCDE), examine interactions between segmentation quality and classification, and evaluate a composite trust score integrating segmentation and classification uncertainty. Across tasks, uncertainty estimates supported meaningful error detection, while calibration depended on the dropout rate, with moderate rates yielding the most reliable probabilities. Uncertainty decomposition provided task-dependent interpretability but did not consistently improve error detection over predictive uncertainty alone. DE and MCDE showed comparable operational utility, with no method consistently dominating across tasks and metrics. The composite trust score did not consistently outperform classification uncertainty for selective prediction. Overall, our results provide a task-aware evaluation strategy and practical guidance for the development of trustworthy AI for glioma diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个基于MRI的多任务胶质瘤诊断深度学习框架中系统评估了不确定性量化（UQ），涵盖肿瘤分割与IDH突变、1p/19q共缺失、肿瘤分级预测，采用MC Dropout并对比Deep Ensembles与MC Deep Ensembles。
AI.motivation: 高风险医学影像分析中可信AI需要不确定性量化，但现有UQ评估多局限于单任务或单一指标，缺乏对多任务框架中不同任务、不同不确定性类型及方法间差异的任务感知评估策略。
AI.method: 在MRI多任务胶质瘤诊断框架（分割+IDH突变+1p/19q共缺失+分级）中，使用Monte Carlo Dropout进行预测不确定性、偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的任务感知分析；评估MC样本收敛性、校准、错误检测、选择性预测、与分割性能的关联及体素级不确定性聚合对病例级可靠性的影响；并对比Deep Ensembles与Monte Carlo Deep Ensembles，考察分割质量与分类的交互，以及融合分割与分类不确定性的复合信任分数。
AI.result: 不确定性估计在各任务上均支持有意义的错误检测；校准依赖dropout率，中等速率给出最可靠概率；不确定性分解提供任务相关的可解释性，但未稳定优于仅用预测不确定性；DE与MCDE运行效用相当，无方法在所有任务和指标上一致占优；复合信任分数在选择性预测上未稳定优于分类不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出一种任务感知的UQ评估策略，并为可信胶质瘤诊断AI的开发提供实践指导：应根据任务选择dropout率与不确定性来源，而非默认复合分数或最复杂集成方法。

title: CAST: Causal Advantage-Structured Training with Spatially Grounded Compositional Rewards for Diffusion Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning has been extended to flow matching for diffusion model (DM) image generation. However, this paradigm faces three limitations: (1) Window selection. Existing methods manually set the stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling window, i.e., the denoising steps where exploration noise is injected. We instead determine it from each model's denoising trajectory. (2) Reward saturation. Current methods rely on scoring models trained on human annotations; we find that such scores are extremely high and nearly indistinguishable on the latest SOTA open-source DMs, making advantage estimation largely ineffective. (3) Sample inefficiency. A single scalar reward collapses different failure modes into almost identical scores, leaving minimal gradient guidance for targeted improvement. To address these issues, we propose CAST (Causal Advantage-Structured Training), an RL fine-tuning method for pretrained DMs, which (1) identifies the denoising step at which each model fixes the objects and their spatial arrangement in the image and uses that timing to set the SDE window, (2) decomposes each prompt via Causal Scene Graphs (CSG) into verifiable-atoms, i.e., minimal semantic units such as an object, count, attribute, or spatial relation that can each be checked independently, and rewards each atom separately, and (3) projects the signed atom-level advantages into pixel space through teacher-forced attention and uses them to spatially weight the SDE policy objective. We fine-tune two of the strongest open-source DMs, FLUX.2-dev and Qwen-Image-2512, with CAST, and evaluate them on GenEval 2, a compositional benchmark, and on Qwen-Image-Bench for overall quality. Within almost the same training budget, CAST's improvement over the base model on the most challenging GenEval 2 prompts is up to 3.07x that of Flow-GRPO, while overall generation quality also improves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CAST（Causal Advantage-Structured Training），一种针对预训练扩散模型的在线强化学习微调方法，通过从去噪轨迹确定 SDE 窗口、用因果场景图分解奖励、并将原子级优势投影到像素空间来加权策略目标，解决了窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效三大问题。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习已被扩展到流匹配扩散模型图像生成，但现有范式存在三大局限：(1) 窗口选择依赖人工设定注入探索噪声的 SDE 采样窗口；(2) 奖励饱和——基于人工标注训练的评分模型对最新 SOTA 开源扩散模型给出极高且几乎无法区分的分数，导致优势估计基本失效；(3) 样本低效——单一标量奖励将不同失败模式压缩为近乎相同的分数，缺乏针对性改进的梯度指引。
AI.method: CAST 包含三个核心设计：(1) 识别每个模型在去噪过程中确定图像中物体及其空间排布的步骤，据此设定 SDE 窗口；(2) 通过因果场景图（CSG）将每个提示分解为可验证原子（如物体、数量、属性、空间关系等可独立检验的最小语义单元），并对每个原子分别给予奖励；(3) 通过教师强制注意力将带符号的原子级优势投影到像素空间，用以对 SDE 策略目标进行空间加权。
AI.result: 作者用 CAST 微调了两个最强开源扩散模型 FLUX.2-dev 与 Qwen-Image-2512，并在组合性基准 GenEval 2 与整体质量基准 Qwen-Image-Bench 上评估。在几乎相同的训练预算下，CAST 在最具挑战性的 GenEval 2 提示上相对基座模型的提升最高达 Flow-GRPO 的 3.07 倍，同时整体生成质量也有所提升。
AI.conclusion: CAST 通过轨迹驱动的 SDE 窗口设定、因果场景图分解的原子级奖励以及像素空间优势加权，有效缓解了扩散模型在线强化学习中的窗口选择、奖励饱和与样本低效问题，在组合性生成与整体质量上均优于 Flow-GRPO，验证了精细化结构化优势信号在扩散模型 RL 微调中的有效性。

title: DuplexAct-Bench: Broadening Full-Duplex Speech Evaluation toward Proactive Interaction across Diverse Behavioral Requirements
summary: Existing full-duplex speech benchmarks cover only subsets of real-time interaction behaviors, often under limited contextual conditions. We introduce DuplexAct-Bench, a bilingual benchmark that systematically covers six complementary behaviors, from interruption and yielding to proactive initiation, active silence, and backchanneling, across Pre-session, In-session, and No-explicit conditions. Across 1,290 English and Chinese streaming trials, we evaluate 12 full-duplex speech systems on both Timing and Content. Results reveal substantial variation across behaviors, conditions, and systems, as well as frequent mismatches between semantic quality and behavioral timing. These findings show that current systems remain far from robustly managing when, whether, and how to participate as real-time interaction unfolds. Project page: https://alitaxky.icu/DuplexAct-Bench/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DuplexAct-Bench，一个双语全双工语音交互基准，系统覆盖六种交互行为与三种上下文条件，通过 1,290 次流式试验评估 12 个全双工语音系统在时序与内容两个维度的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音基准仅覆盖部分实时交互行为，且上下文条件有限，无法全面衡量系统在真实交互中"何时、是否、如何参与"的能力。
AI.method: 构建 DuplexAct-Bench 双语基准，系统覆盖六种互补交互行为（打断、让出话轮、主动发起、主动沉默、反馈应答等），并在会话前、会话中、无显式提示三种上下文条件下，对 12 个全双工语音系统进行英文与中文共 1,290 次流式试验评估，从 Timing（时序）与 Content（内容）两方面打分。
AI.result: 实验结果显示系统表现随交互行为、上下文条件和系统本身存在显著差异，且语义质量与行为时序之间频繁出现不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 当前全双工语音系统在实时交互中稳健地管理参与时机、参与与否及参与方式方面仍有较大差距，DuplexAct-Bench 为相关研究提供了更全面的评测工具。

title: Synthetic Data Characterization via Training Dynamics
summary: Interpreting properties of LLM-generated data is important for understanding its utility and limitations across learning tasks. In this work, we characterize synthetic data through sample-level learnability, studying variation among LLM families and scales, alongside human-written data as a reference. We first generate synthetic datasets spanning single- and multi-label classification, labeling, and tree prediction tasks. We then derive empirical data distributions from encoder training dynamics for both machine and organic data, and estimate the robustness of these distributions across encoders. Finally, we evaluate how data selection strategies based on these learnability signals affect both data sources differently.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"样本级可学习性"刻画LLM生成合成数据的性质，比较不同LLM家族与规模，并以人类数据为参照，进而评估基于可学习性信号的样本选择策略对两类数据的影响差异。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM生成数据的性质对于认识其在各类学习任务中的效用与局限至关重要。现有工作多关注合成数据整体质量或与人类数据的粗略对比，缺少在样本粒度上对合成数据可学习性及其在不同模型家族、规模间变化规律的系统刻画。
AI.method: 1) 生成覆盖单标签与多标签分类、标注、树预测等任务的合成数据集；2) 以编码器训练动态为依据，为机器数据和真实（organic）数据分别推导经验数据分布，用以表征样本级可学习性；3) 估计这些分布在多个编码器之间的稳健性；4) 基于该可学习性信号设计数据选择策略，并在两类数据源上分别评估其效果。
AI.result: 论文刻画了合成数据在样本级可学习性上的分布特征，揭示了不同LLM家族与模型规模之间的差异，并与人类书写数据形成对照；同时检验了所得数据分布在跨编码器上的稳健性，并发现基于可学习性信号的数据选择策略对合成数据与人类数据产生不同影响。
AI.conclusion: 样本级可学习性为理解与利用LLM生成数据提供了有效视角；合成数据与人类数据在可学习性分布及其对选择策略的响应上存在系统性差异，说明不能将二者等同处理。

title: ResARC: Residual-Aware AutoRegressive Coding for Ultra-Low Bitrate Image Compression
summary: Progressive autoregressive image codecs provide an appealing paradigm for generative compression by quantizing continuous latents into discrete tokens, transmitting coarse-to-fine prefix tokens and generating the remaining suffix tokens at the decoder. However, their reconstruction quality is fundamentally limited by two residuals introduced along this pipeline: the quantization residual, arising from information loss during discrete tokenization, and the generation residual, resulting from imperfect autoregressive generation of the suffix tokens. To address these limitations, we introduce ResARC, a residual-aware autoregressive codec that explicitly compensates for both residuals at the decoder. Specifically, we generate the quantization residual with a diffusion transformer conditioned on the autoregressive decoding context, while requiring no additional side information. In parallel, we compute the generation residual at the encoder and employ a learned Generation Residual Codec to efficiently compress and transmit it for decoder-side correction. The recovered residuals are then integrated with the reconstructed latent representation and decoded through an adapted VAE decoder. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResARC achieves competitive perceptual similarity while substantially improving distributional fidelity over leading generative codecs across the ultra-low bitrate regime. Code and models will be released soon.

AI.tldr: ResARC是一种残差感知的自回归图像编解码器，通过在解码端显式补偿量化残差与生成残差，显著提升超低码率下的分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 渐进式自回归图像编解码器将连续隐变量量化为离散token，传输由粗到细的前缀token并在解码端生成剩余后缀token。但其重建质量受两个残差限制：离散化带来的量化残差，以及后缀token自回归生成不完美导致的生成残差。
AI.method: ResARC在解码端显式补偿两种残差：用量化残差由以自回归解码上下文为条件的扩散Transformer生成，且无需额外边信息；生成残差在编码端计算，并通过学习到的Generation Residual Codec高效压缩传输，用于解码端校正。恢复的残差与重建隐表示融合，经由适配的VAE解码器解码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在超低码率区间，ResARC在取得有竞争力的感知相似度的同时，显著优于领先的生成式编解码器在分布保真度上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差感知的设计显式补偿量化与生成两类残差，ResARC有效缓解了渐进式自回归编解码的固有瓶颈，在超低码率生成式压缩中实现了感知质量与分布保真度的良好平衡。代码与模型即将发布。

title: From Speech to Editable Concepts: Probing Emotion Recognition with Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is the task of assigning emotion labels to utterances. Early systems relied on acoustic features, whereas recent approaches combine multiple modalities, most commonly speech and text. Still, performance remains poor on many datasets. Large language models (LLMs) have therefore attracted interest for SER, as they can process diverse inputs jointly with instructions. However, direct audio input raises questions of explainability. To address similar questions in image classification, concept bottleneck models were introduced. This work adapts concept bottlenecks to SER to examine how individual predictions depend on transcripts, acoustic descriptions and speaker attributes. Experiments test three LLMs on CREMA-D, IEMOCAP and MELD, with concepts extracted by separate tools. On scripted corpora, LLMs are strongly biased towards the transcript in the zero-shot setting, which lowers Macro-F1 from 27.8 to 5.8 on CREMA-D. Fine-tuning removes this bias, and the transcript raises Macro-F1 from 41.8 to 45.1. Removing speech rate changes 48% of Neutral predictions to Disgust on CREMA-D; removing intensity level on MELD changes predictions despite little change in Macro-F1. These findings show that aggregate performance changes alone do not capture the effects of concept removal on individual predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文将概念瓶颈模型引入语音情感识别(SER),通过移除转录文本、声学描述与说话人属性等概念,分析LLM预测对各类概念的依赖,发现聚合性能指标无法反映概念移除对个体预测的影响。
AI.motivation: SER早期依赖声学特征,近期多模态方法(语音+文本)仍表现不佳;LLM虽能联合处理多模态输入与指令,但直接音频输入带来可解释性问题。图像分类中已有概念瓶颈模型应对此类问题,本文将其迁移至SER以探究预测如何依赖各类概念。
AI.method: 将概念瓶颈适配到SER:用独立工具抽取转录文本、声学描述(如语速、强度)和说话人属性等概念,在CREMA-D、IEMOCAP、MELD三个数据集上测试三个LLM,通过概念移除实验观察预测变化。
AI.result: 零样本下LLM在脚本语料上强烈偏向转录文本,CREMA-D的Macro-F1从27.8降至5.8;微调消除了该偏置,转录使Macro-F1从41.8提升至45.1。移除语速使CREMA-D上48%的Neutral预测变为Disgust;移除MELD的强度水平虽Macro-F1变化甚微,但个体预测发生改变。
AI.conclusion: 仅看聚合性能变化无法捕捉概念移除对个体预测的影响,概念瓶颈为SER的可解释性分析提供了有效手段。

title: Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback
summary: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互馈架构MEQ，将两种（可能不同模态的）输入精炼为一对耦合嵌入，各嵌入反映另一输入的信息，模型输出定义为该交互的不动点，并提供理论分析与防失效设计。
AI.motivation: 以往多模态方法多采用拼接等单向融合方式，难以让两种输入之间持续交换信息。作者希望建立双输入互相反馈、相互精炼的机制，使每个嵌入都能体现对方信息，从而提升多模态分类与视觉定位等任务的表现。
AI.method: 提出MEQ互馈架构，由两个组件构成，二者输出互相反馈，实现两输入间信息的连续交换；将模型最终输出定义为该交互过程的不动点，并对该模型进行理论分析，给出解释及防止失效情形的设计选择。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上的分类与视觉定位任务中验证了MEQ的优势：在多模态分类问题上优于基于拼接的方法或与之性能相当；定性上，与互补模态配对时可逐步精炼视觉定位，体现互馈机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 互馈式双组件架构及其不动点输出形式为多模态融合提供了有效方案，在分类与视觉定位任务中均展现出竞争性乃至更优的性能，表明双输入持续信息交换具有显著价值。

title: Right-Wing Rock or Just Rock? A Computational Linguistic Analysis of Frei.Wild
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, for code and data see https://zenodo.org/records/22676753, to be published in the proceedings of the NLP 4 Positive Impact workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Rechtsrock is a subgenre of rock music that spreads right-wing ideology, often instrumentalized to recruit adolescents into the radical scene. Monitoring institutions counteract this by manually examining and, in some cases, banning extremist content; however, there are border cases that evade regulation. We present a study aimed at determining whether such a case, the band Frei$.$Wild, should be classified as politically right-leaning or as part of the general German rock genre. We sampled a German rock dataset and created a corpus for right-wing rock to use as reference in this analysis and found that we can confirm the intuitions from previous investigations that Frei$.$Wild successfully maintains an ambiguity with regard to their political affiliation. However, the tendency is towards the right-wing spectrum. Lexical analyses reveal nationalistic narratives and two high-performing classifiers (up to 97% ROC-AUC score) label more than half of their songs as right-wing extremist. Our analysis provides insight into how computational methods can improve the process of identifying right-wing extremist tendencies in music, especially in borderline cases like Frei$.$Wild. The code and data are made available for future research.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建德国摇滚与右翼摇滚语料库，用词汇分析和分类器判定乐队 Frei$.$Wild 的政治倾向，发现其刻意保持模糊性，但整体趋向极右翼。
AI.motivation: 右翼摇滚（Rechtsrock）被用于传播右翼意识形态并招募青少年，监管机构靠人工审查甚至封禁极端内容，但存在逃避监管的边界案例；作者希望用计算方法辅助识别这类模糊案例。
AI.method: 采样德国摇滚数据集并构建右翼摇滚参考语料库，对乐队 Frei$.$Wild 的歌词进行词汇分析，并训练分类器（ROC-AUC 最高达 97%）进行政治倾向判别。
AI.result: 证实了以往调查的直觉：Frei$.$Wild 在政治归属上成功维持模糊性，但倾向偏向右翼；词汇分析揭示民族主义叙事，两个高性能分类器将其过半歌曲标注为右翼极端主义。
AI.conclusion: 计算方法可改进音乐中右翼极端倾向的识别流程，尤其适用于 Frei$.$Wild 这类边界案例；代码与数据已公开以供后续研究。

title: DensePed-Lite: Quality-Aware Adaptive Detection for Dense Pedestrians under Occlusion
summary: Pedestrian detection plays a crucial role in computer vision with applications in autonomous driving, surveillance, and public safety. However, real-world dense scenes bring severe challenges, including heavy occlusion, drastic scale variations, and strict real-time requirements. Existing lightweight detectors struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency while often neglecting quality-aware feature modeling and consistency between classification and localization, leading to unstable performance under crowded conditions. To address these issues, we propose DensePed-Lite, a unified framework built on a single principle: under occlusion the network should adapt its behavior to the quality of what it observes rather than assume complete information. This principle is realized at three points where occlusion does the most damage: unreliable confidence scoring (UQE), fragmented spatial coverage (MPSC), and incoherent multi-scale fusion (CTDM). The three mechanisms reinforce one another instead of acting in isolation, all without significantly increasing complexity. Experiments on CityPersons and CrowdHuman validate that DensePed-Lite achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared with recent state-of-the-art lightweight methods, making it suitable for real-time deployment in dense pedestrian scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DensePed-Lite统一框架，基于"网络应根据其观测质量自适应调整行为"的原则，通过UQE、MPSC、CTDM三个互补机制解决遮挡下的置信度不可靠、空间覆盖割裂与多尺度融合不一致问题，在CityPersons和CrowdHuman上实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉中的行人检测广泛应用于自动驾驶、监控与公共安全。但真实世界的密集场景带来严重遮挡、剧烈尺度变化和严格实时要求的挑战。现有轻量级检测器难以兼顾精度与效率，且常忽视质量感知的特征建模以及分类与定位之间的一致性，导致拥挤场景下性能不稳定。
AI.method: 提出DensePed-Lite统一框架，其核心原则是：在遮挡条件下，网络应依据所观测信息的质量自适应调整行为，而非假设信息完整。该原则落实在遮挡危害最大的三个环节：不可靠的置信度评分（UQE）、碎片化的空间覆盖（MPSC）、不一致的多尺度融合（CTDM）。三个机制相互强化而非孤立作用，且未显著增加复杂度。
AI.result: 在CityPersons和CrowdHuman数据集上的实验表明，与近期最先进的轻量级方法相比，DensePed-Lite取得了更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: DensePed-Lite适合在密集行人场景中实时部署，为遮挡条件下的轻量级行人检测提供了有效方案。

title: From Wrecks to Wisdom: Recovering Crash Mechanics from Real-World Multi-View Photos
summary: Estimating accident mechanics from real-world crashes is important for vehicle-safety analysis, injury modeling, crash-severity prediction, and operational workflows such as insurance claim triage. In standard crash records, key metadata such as impact configuration, principal direction of force, and change in velocity ($ΔV$) may be missing, delayed, or corrupted, while post-crash photographs are widely available and contain rich visual evidence of deformation. We study how much crash-mechanics information can be recovered directly from vehicle photos when structured signals are absent. We formulate crash understanding as supervised prediction from per-case multi-view photo sets. Targets include six Collision Deformation Classification (CDC) descriptors and the longitudinal and lateral components of reconstructed $ΔV$. Each photo is encoded by a shared visual backbone, and the resulting view-level features are fused into a case-level representation from which target-specific heads predict crash descriptors. Using 15.2k training cases from the Crash Investigation Sampling System, drawn from about 1.5M photos before filtering, together with 1.15k validation and 1.15k test cases, we define an evaluation protocol for vision-based crash descriptor estimation from incomplete multi-view evidence. Post-crash imagery alone provides usable signal for several non-trivial crash-mechanics descriptors, while weakly observable and long-tailed targets remain challenging. Within the compared training regimes, the selected joint-training recipe reduces mean absolute angular error for principal direction of force from 20.1 to 14.05 degrees and longitudinal $ΔV$ MAE from 8.04 to 7.45 km/h. Our work provides a reference point for future multimodal fusion with structured crash metadata.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在结构化事故元数据缺失时，能否仅从事后车辆照片中恢复碰撞力学信息，构建多视角照片预测CDC形变描述符与ΔV的多任务框架，并在CISS大规模数据上建立评测协议。
AI.motivation: 真实碰撞事故记录中的关键元数据（碰撞配置、主受力方向、速度变化ΔV）常缺失、延迟或损坏，而事故后照片广泛可得且蕴含丰富的形变视觉证据，因此需要评估仅凭图像可恢复多少碰撞力学信息。
AI.method: 将碰撞理解建模为逐案例多视角照片集的监督预测任务：共享视觉骨干编码每张照片，视图级特征融合为案例级表示，再由目标专用预测头输出六个CDC描述符及重建ΔV的纵向、横向分量。数据来自Crash Investigation Sampling System，约150万张照片过滤后得15.2k训练、1.15k验证、1.15k测试案例，并定义不完整多视角证据下的评测协议。
AI.result: 事后图像对若干非平凡的碰撞力学描述符提供了可用信号；弱可观测与长尾目标仍具挑战。在所比较的训练范式中，选定的联合训练方案将主受力方向平均绝对角度误差从20.1°降至14.05°，纵向ΔV的MAE从8.04 km/h降至7.45 km/h。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭事故后照片即可部分恢复碰撞力学描述符，为未来与结构化事故元数据的多模态融合提供了参考基准。

title: OmniReasoning: Pushing the Limits of Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
summary: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对全模态模型在音视频联合推理能力上评估不足、激发不充分的问题，提出了基准OmniReasoningBench、数据引擎OmniQA和学习方法MFSD，显著提升了模型的音视频联合推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽能理解音频、视觉和语言，但基准、训练数据和学习方法基本独立处理各模态，导致音视频联合推理能力评估不足且激发不充分。
AI.method: 1) 提出OmniReasoningBench基准，包含1150道选择题和开放题，覆盖"视频内推理"和"视频外推理"两类任务，音频与视觉证据缺一不可；2) 开发数据引擎OmniQA，自动构建显式需要音视频联合推理的证据锚定问答对及时间戳线索链，并产出训练数据OmniReasoning-SFT-112K和OmniReasoning-RL-19K；3) 提出在策略自蒸馏方法Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD)，在模态特定线索上下文下评估采样响应，解耦单一线索贡献及其跨模态交互以进行token级信用分配。
AI.result: OmniReasoning-30B-A3B在OmniVideoBench上达50.0%，在OmniReasoningBench上达42.5%，相较基座模型Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking分别提升12.8和9.3个百分点；在通用及长视频基准（含Video-MME-v2）上也有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过基准、数据引擎和学习方法三位一体的方案，为全模态联合推理的后续研究提供了坚实基础。

title: Front-to-Back: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Asymmetric Cross-View Vehicle Re-Identification
comment: Submitted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision for Developing Countries (CV4DC)
summary: Matching the same vehicle across front and rear cameras is difficult because the cameras do not share a view and the vehicle's appearance changes substantially. We introduce Front2Back-ReID, a benchmark of 500 manually verified vehicle handovers from 20 recording sequences in South Africa. Each example asks a model to match a vehicle highlighted in a front-camera image to the same vehicle among at least three candidates in a later rear-camera image. We evaluate seven zero-shot vision-language models, four image-retrieval baselines, and 25 human participants. Models are tested using full front RGB images, cropped target vehicles, and binary silhouettes. The strongest VLM achieved 76.6 percent Rank-1 accuracy on target crops, compared with 74.0 percent for the frozen SigLIP2 baseline; this difference was not statistically clear. Human participants achieved 94.0 percent accuracy with full images and 92.2 percent with target crops. Under our evaluation setup, enabling reasoning improved accuracy across all three input conditions for every model evaluated in both modes. We also found that VLMs generally performed worse on full scenes than on target crops. These results show that general-purpose VLMs do not yet consistently outperform strong visual retrieval for front-to-rear vehicle matching, while humans remain substantially more reliable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Front2Back-ReID基准，用于前视与后视摄像头间同一车辆的跨视角匹配，含500个手工校验样本；评测7个零样本视觉语言模型、4个图像检索基线与25名人类，结果显示VLM未稳定超越强视觉检索，人类仍显著更可靠。
AI.motivation: 前后摄像头不共享视野，且车辆外观在两次拍摄间发生显著变化，导致同一车辆的跨视角匹配十分困难，而该任务在真实监控场景中具有实际需求，尚缺乏公开、规范的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Front2Back-ReID基准，包含来自南非20段录像序列的500个经人工核验的车辆交接（handover）样本；每个样本要求将前视图像中高亮的车辆，在后视图像的至少三个候选中匹配出同一车辆。评测7个零样本视觉语言模型、4个图像检索基线以及25名人类被试；模型输入分三种条件：完整前视RGB图像、裁剪目标车辆、二值剪影（silhouette）。
AI.result: 最强VLM在目标裁剪上取得76.6% Rank-1准确率，冻结的SigLIP2基线为74.0%，差异无统计显著性。人类用完整图像达94.0%，用目标裁剪达92.2%。在本评测设置下，开启推理（reasoning）对每个模型在三种输入条件下均带来准确率提升。VLM在完整场景上的表现普遍差于目标裁剪。
AI.conclusion: 通用视觉语言模型在前视到后视的车辆匹配任务上尚不能稳定超越强视觉检索方法，而人类在此任务上仍显著更可靠，表明该任务对现有VLM仍具挑战。

title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
summary: Typed decision models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative LLMs in decision-making workflows by selecting directly from predefined options. When candidate sets contain no valid answer, TypeSafe recommends including an "other" or "none-of-the-above" option to enable rejection. In this report, however, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck: Jev reliably selects correct numerical answers when available but frequently accepts incorrect alternatives when they are absent despite an explicit rejection option. On paired arithmetic problems, answer-present accuracy reaches 99%, while correct rejection falls to 7%. Moreover, this gap persists across numerical magnitudes, operation depths, contextual formulations, and rejection labels, and extends to scenarios such as time calculation and capacity rounding. Yet native Boolean verification achieves 99% exact-match accuracy on the same answer-absent arithmetic cases, showing that categorical rejection can fail even when the model successfully verifies candidate correctness. Finally, we show that a simple decision threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection accuracy from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, substantially mitigating the failure without retraining or additional inference.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Jev等类型化决策模型在算术问题上存在"拒绝瓶颈"：候选答案存在时准确率99%，但缺失正确答案时正确拒绝率仅7%，且该缺陷跨数值规模、运算深度、语境与拒绝标签持续存在。布尔验证在同一批样本上达99%准确率，说明分类式拒绝可先于验证失败；在独立开发集上选取简单决策阈值可将拒绝准确率从7%提升至79%，同时保持97%的存在答案准确率，无需重训练或额外推理。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型（如Jev）通过从预定义选项中直接选择，为决策工作流提供比生成式LLM更高效的替代方案。为处理候选集无有效答案的情形，TypeSafe建议加入"other"或"none-of-the-above"选项以实现拒绝。然而，这类模型的拒绝能力是否可靠尚缺乏实证研究；本文旨在检验其算术场景下的拒绝表现并定位失败机制。
AI.method: 构建成对的算术问题（pair arithmetic problems），分别设置答案存在与答案缺失两种条件，并保留显式拒绝选项；在数值规模、运算深度、语境表述、拒绝标签等维度上进行系统性扰动测试；进一步扩展到时间计算与容量取整等场景；作为对照，采用原生布尔验证（Boolean verification）在相同的答案缺失算术样本上评估候选正确性判断能力；最后在独立开发问题上选取一个简单决策阈值以缓解该失败。
AI.result: 成对算术问题上，答案存在时准确率达99%，而正确答案缺失时正确拒绝率仅7%；该差距在数值规模、运算深度、语境表述与拒绝标签变化下持续存在，并延伸至时间计算与容量取整场景。原生布尔验证在相同答案缺失算术样本上达到99%的精确匹配准确率，表明分类式拒绝可在模型已能正确验证候选正确性的情况下仍然失败。在独立开发问题上选定的简单决策阈值将算术拒绝准确率从7%提升至79%，同时保持97%的答案存在准确率。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型存在算术依赖的拒绝瓶颈：模型能可靠选中正确数值答案，却难以在答案缺失时拒绝错误候选，即便已有显式拒绝选项与内部验证能力。该失败可通过无需重训练、无额外推理开销的简单决策阈值显著缓解，说明其更可能是决策边界/校准问题而非能力缺失，为类型化决策模型的可拒识部署提供了低成本改进方向。

title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
summary: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 PartiCam，将粒子滤波引入扩散奖励引导，通过全局-局部精炼框架实现精确且稳定的相机可控视频生成。
AI.motivation: 大视频扩散模型难以精确遵循指定相机轨迹；免训练引导方法虽无需大规模相机标注数据，但现有采样引导不稳定：探索过广会偏离目标相机运动，过早坍缩则随时间丧失视觉多样性。
AI.method: 基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）引导，引入基于粒子滤波重采样的局部精炼阶段，构建全局-局部精炼的扩散奖励引导框架。
AI.result: 实验表明相机轨迹遵循度大幅提升，漂移减少，视觉质量更好，且无需重新训练模型。
AI.conclusion: PartiCam 无需重训练即可实现精确一致的相机控制视频生成，并可用于生成相机可控数据以训练相机条件视频扩散模型。

title: Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出首个脉冲驱动的VLA框架，支持机器人操作的端到端直接训练，在LIBERO与Meta-World上以更少参数和更低推理能耗取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型多依赖大型Transformer，其延迟与能耗成本高，难以部署在资源受限平台。脉冲神经网络通过稀疏事件驱动计算，为高性能、高能效计算提供新范式，但尚无面向机器人操作的脉冲VLA端到端训练框架。
AI.method: 框架含三个核心组件：(1) 脉冲视觉与指令编码器，将视觉观测和语言指令编码为稀疏可靠的脉冲表示以支持跨模态融合；(2) Multi-Winner Spike Fusion，采用双向top-k赢者通吃脉冲路由抑制背景干扰，生成融合记忆以理解指令引导的场景；(3) Spike Action Chunking Transformer，在融合记忆与当前机器人状态上引入脉冲交叉注意力，端到端生成连续动作块。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和Meta-World上的大量实验表明，该脉冲驱动VLA在参数更少、估计推理能耗更低的情况下达到与常规VLA模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了神经形态VLA建模的基础框架，为资源高效具身智能的未来发展提供了路径。

title: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
summary: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.

AI.tldr: 本文构建大规模镜头光晕去除数据集并提出扩散模型去除方法，同时提出基于光晕对称性的显式光晕表示模型，与3DGS联合优化，实现3D场景中光晕与场景的分解、编辑与跨视角迁移。
AI.motivation: 镜头光晕源于相机成像系统而非真实场景，会显著降低3D重建等下游任务质量；现有方法仅能处理光源周围的小光晕，对充满整幅图像的大光晕效果不佳。同时光晕作为艺术表现手段被广泛使用，但多视角下光晕的一致表示与重建尚未被探索。
AI.method: 1）结合公开真实数据与程序化生成管线，构建新的大光晕去除数据集；2）在该数据集上微调扩散模型以去除复杂大光晕；3）提出利用光晕关于相机主点对称性的光晕表示模型；4）提出联合优化该光晕模型与3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的计算管线，将3D场景分解为镜头光晕与场景本身；5）分解结果显式且可重渲染，因此可编辑并迁移到新图像与新的3D场景。
AI.result: 在已有基准与新建的大反射光晕基准上评估去除效果，直接量化光晕/场景分解质量，并证明该管线对自动光源定位误差具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作同时推进了大光晕去除与多视角一致的光晕表示/重建：去除方面通过新数据集与扩散微调提升大光晕处理能力；重建方面通过对称性光晕模型与3DGS联合优化实现光晕与场景的可分解、可编辑、可迁移。

title: CATCH: A Controllable Analysis Testbed for Reward Hacking in Coding RL
summary: During reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), large language models (LLMs) can exploit loopholes in their environments to obtain high rewards without improving the intended capabilities, i.e., reward hacking. Despite its risks to training efficiency and safety, monitoring and mitigating reward hacking during training remain challenging, which is limited by a lack of testbeds that reproduce hacking and reliably identify it. We introduce CATCH, a controllable testbed for studying reward hacking in coding RL. CATCH deliberately exposes environmental loopholes and provides execution-based gold labels by comparing success under a vulnerable evaluator with task correctness under an independent audit. It also can control the model's initial hacking tendency through supervised fine-tuning data mixtures and the difficulty of earning rewards through reward designing, enabling systematic comparisons of hacking dynamics and interventions. Experiments show that CATCH can produce diverse RL training trajectories with clear reward hacking, and analyses demonstrate that both initial models and reward difficulties shape the emergence of reward hacking. We further evaluate the effectiveness of different reward hacking detection and mitigation methods. A key finding is that a chain-of-thought monitor initially suppresses hacking, but this protection erodes as the policy model learn to mislead the monitor with code comments. This highlights the need to evaluate hacking mitigations throughout training with CATCH. The source code and resources are publicly released at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CATCH.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CATCH，一个用于研究代码强化学习（coding RL）中奖励黑客问题的可控测试平台。CATCH故意暴露环境漏洞，并基于执行结果提供金标签。实验表明初始模型和奖励难度共同影响奖励黑客的出现，且思维链监控的保护会随训练逐渐被策略模型绕过。
AI.motivation: 在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中，大语言模型会利用环境漏洞获取高奖励而不真正提升目标能力，即奖励黑客。其威胁训练效率与安全性，但现有研究受限于缺乏能复现并可靠识别奖励黑客的测试平台，导致训练中的监控与缓解仍具挑战。因此需要构建可复现、可控制的测试环境。
AI.method: 作者提出CATCH，一个用于研究代码RL中奖励黑客的可控测试平台。CATCH刻意暴露环境漏洞，并通过对比“脆弱评估器下的成功”与“独立审计下的任务正确性”来提供基于执行的黄金标签。它还能通过监督微调的数据混合控制模型初始的奖励黑客倾向，并通过奖励设计控制获取奖励的难度，从而支持对奖励黑客动态及干预措施进行系统性比较。
AI.result: 实验表明CATCH能够产生带有明显奖励黑客行为的多样化RL训练轨迹。分析显示，初始模型与奖励难度共同影响奖励黑客的出现。作者进一步评估了不同奖励黑客检测与缓解方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 关键发现是：思维链监控（chain-of-thought monitor）在初期能够抑制奖励黑客，但随着策略模型学会用代码注释误导监控器，这种保护会逐渐被侵蚀。这表明有必要借助CATCH在整个训练过程中评估各类缓解措施。源代码与资源已公开释放。

title: Comparative study of adapting pre-trained models for driving behavior video captioning
summary: This report examines and compares some of the many fine tuning and prompting methods existing, applying them within the domain of autonomous driving. The idea is to compare these methods by adapting a Large Language Model (LLM) on a video dataset. LLM's have become extremely good at achieving a good understanding of different forms of data and this study aims to induce a low dimensional understanding of driving situations into our primary test model SpaceTimeGPT. Experiments on BDD-X (Berkeley DeepDrive eXplanation) dataset demonstrate good performance of the full fine tuning framework on some automatic metrics, and in some metrics, it even surpasses the baseline. We also try Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and prompt engineering on VideoLLaVA model and discuss its limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文在自动驾驶场景中比较多种微调与提示方法，通过在视频数据集上适配LLM，对SpaceTimeGPT进行全量微调并探索LoRA与提示工程。
AI.motivation: 现有微调与提示方法众多，但在自动驾驶视频理解领域缺乏系统性比较；作者希望为驾驶情境建立低维语义理解，并评估不同适配策略在LLM上的适用性。
AI.method: 以SpaceTimeGPT为主要测试模型，在BDD-X视频数据集上进行全量微调；同时尝试在VideoLLaVA模型上应用LoRA与提示工程（prompt engineering），并结合自动评价指标进行对比分析。
AI.result: 全量微调框架在部分自动指标上表现良好，个别指标甚至超过基线；LoRA与提示工程在VideoLLaVA上存在一定局限。
AI.conclusion: 在自动驾驶视频理解任务中，全量微调在若干自动指标上具有竞争力甚至优于基线，而LoRA与提示工程的效果受限；不同适配方法的适用性需结合任务与模型特点进一步权衡。

title: Learning Normal Diffusion Dynamics for Backdoor Defense in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to the secure deployment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. Existing defenses typically detect backdoors from specific abnormal patterns in internal representations, which may limit their generalizability with the emergence of increasingly diverse attack mechanisms. In this paper, we study backdoor defense of T2I diffusion models from a transition-dynamics perspective. We observe that benign diffusion trajectories exhibit structured and timestep-dependent transition patterns from cross-attention, latent and noise spaces, whereas backdoor attacks tend to induce deviations from such normal evolution. Motivated by these observations, we propose Normal Diffusion Dynamics Learning (NDDL), a novel backdoor defense framework that learns the normal transition dynamics of diffusion trajectories utilizing only benign samples. NDDL constructs compact multi-space trajectory representations and trains a timestep-conditioned dynamics model to predict the diffusion evolution. In the inference phase, deviations between the observed and predicted transitions are exploited to quantify dynamics inconsistency for backdoor detection. NDDL further enables trigger localization without any prior knowledge of the embedded backdoor by performing substitution with low-semantic words. Extensive experiments for diverse backdoor attacks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed NDDL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NDDL框架，从过渡动力学视角检测T2I扩散模型后门：仅用良性样本学习正常扩散轨迹的动态演化，通过观测与预测过渡的偏差量化不一致性以检测后门，并可定位触发器。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型后门防御多依赖内部表示中的特定异常模式，面对日益多样的攻击机制泛化性不足。
AI.method: 观察到良性扩散轨迹在交叉注意力、潜空间与噪声空间呈现结构化、时间步依赖的过渡模式，而后门攻击会偏离该演化；据此提出NDDL，仅用良性样本：构建紧致多空间轨迹表示，训练时间步条件动力学模型预测扩散演化；推理时以观测与预测过渡的偏差量化动力学不一致性进行检测，并通过低语义词替换实现无需先验知识的触发器定位。
AI.result: 在多种后门攻击上的大量实验验证了NDDL的有效性与泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 从过渡动力学角度建模正常扩散演化，为T2I扩散模型后门防御提供了通用且可泛化的新范式，同时支持触发器定位。

title: Speculative Safety Honeypot: Toward Proactive Defense Against Multi-turn Agent Attacks
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, multi-turn interaction attacks have become a significant security challenge. Existing detection methods typically rely on historical context. However, this retrospective logic struggles to identify deep malicious intents that are split across turns to hide future risks. Inspired by speculative decoding, we propose the Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH) framework. SSH uses a multi-agent simulation system composed of small LLMs to build an action-level speculate-and-verify workflow. In the speculation stage, SSH predicts future behaviors of the target agent and asynchronously builds a trajectory tree to expose potential risks in advance. In the verification stage, the system uses the target agent's real actions to calibrate and prune the trajectory tree, effectively reducing false positives. As a plug-and-playable component, SSH provides existing detectors with rich decision redundancy beyond the current interaction slice. By judging risk based on the evolution of the entire trajectory tree rather than a single point in time, the system reduces the reliance on the absolute precision of individual detection components. This improves the defense resilience and the warning lead-time of agent systems against complex temporal attacks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Speculative Safety Honeypot (SSH)框架，借鉴推测解码思想，通过小模型多智能体模拟系统实现动作级的"推测-验证"工作流，提前暴露多轮交互攻击中的潜在风险，并作为即插即用组件为现有检测器提供决策冗余。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在复杂环境中的部署增多，多轮交互攻击成为重要安全挑战。现有检测方法依赖历史上下文，这种回溯式逻辑难以识别被拆分到多轮中以隐藏未来风险的深层恶意意图。
AI.method: 受推测解码启发，SSH使用由小LLM组成的多智能体模拟系统构建动作级"推测-验证"工作流。推测阶段预测目标智能体的未来行为，异步构建轨迹树以提前暴露潜在风险；验证阶段利用目标智能体的真实动作校准并剪枝轨迹树，从而有效降低误报。SSH为即插即用组件。
AI.result: SSH为现有检测器提供超出当前交互片段的丰富决策冗余；通过基于整棵轨迹树的演化而非单一时间点进行风险判定，降低了对单个检测组件绝对精度的依赖。
AI.conclusion: SSH提升了智能体系统面对复杂时序攻击时的防御韧性与预警提前量。

title: EffGS: Efficient and High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but existing general-purpose acceleration methods suffer severe rendering quality degradation when extended to more complex, large-scale scenes. To address this issue, we propose EffGS, a more general acceleration framework that improves training and rendering efficiency while maintaining reconstruction quality comparable to or better than vanilla 3DGS across bounded and large-scale scenes. EffGS combines frequency-aware guidance, localized density control, and adaptive primitive scale modulation. First, an importance scoring mechanism combines pixel-wise reconstruction errors with a difference-of-Gaussians mask scheduled over training to provide stage-dependent spatial guidance. Second, localized densification and pruning restricts density modifications to Gaussians with valid projected footprints in the sampled views. Third, learnable per-Gaussian scale modulation adjusts effective primitive extent during optimization while retaining the Compact Box rasterization rule. Extensive experiments on bounded and large-scale scene datasets demonstrate a favorable balance between reconstruction quality, training time, and primitive count. Component ablations and matched-primitive-budget comparisons further support the effectiveness of the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EffGS，一个通用的 3D Gaussian Splatting 加速框架，通过频率感知引导、局部化密度控制和自适应图元尺度调制，在保持甚至提升重建质量的同时改善训练与渲染效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 通用加速方法在扩展到更复杂、大规模场景时，渲染质量严重下降，缺乏兼顾效率与质量的通用方案。
AI.method: EffGS 结合三项机制：（1）重要性评分，将逐像素重建误差与随训练调度的 Difference-of-Gaussians 掩码结合，提供阶段相关的空间引导；（2）局部化稠密化与剪枝，将密度修改限制在采样视图中具有有效投影足迹的高斯上；（3）可学习的逐高斯尺度调制，在保留 Compact Box 光栅化规则的同时调整图元有效范围。
AI.result: 在有界与大规模场景数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建质量、训练时间与图元数量之间取得了良好平衡；组件消融与匹配图元预算的对比进一步验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EffGS 是一种更通用的 3DGS 加速框架，在有界与大规模场景中均可维持与原始 3DGS 相当或更优的重建质量，同时提升训练与渲染效率。

title: RESUME: Recurrent State Updates from Motion and Residual Signals for Efficient Video Language Modeling
summary: Existing video language models encode sampled RGB frames independently, so a long video must either exhaust the token budget or drop the changes between sampled frames. Codec-aware front-ends read the motion vectors and residuals that encoding produced, but in their deployed form each predictive frame is still tokenized on its own: the tokens are a function of the current primitives, not of a carried reference. We argue that a more natural function is of both---the current primitives and a carried reference. A clip and its time reversal share the same frames and differ only in the order of changes---an axis that symmetric pooling discards by construction, and that is non-empty in the frozen vision features VideoLMs use---and the codec recurrence already composes those changes in order against a reference state. We introduce RESUME, a stateful codec representation: an anchor I-frame initializes a compact latent state, each subsequent predictive frame is consumed as an update to that state, and a shared readout exposes VideoLM-compatible tokens from the accumulated state. Codec prediction is thereby kept at the representation level and handed to the language model as a trajectory, not as a set of independent token groups. At the same per-predictive-frame token budget as prior codec-aware methods, a predictive frame enters the language model as a readout of what the front-end already knows, not as an encoding of the current primitives alone. Across ten benchmarks, the gains concentrate on temporal reasoning: on all three temporal benchmarks RESUME improves over both the RGB-frame baseline LLaVA-Video-7B (by 2.8, 5.1, and 3.9 points on TempCompass, TOMATO, and MVBench) and the codec-based baseline CoPE-7B, while staying competitive on general and long-form QA. Frozen-transition tests further show anchor dependence, order sensitivity, and useful rollout behavior beyond the training horizon.

AI.tldr: RESUME 提出一种有状态的编解码表示：以 I 帧初始化紧凑隐状态，后续预测帧作为状态更新，并通过共享读出器输出与 VideoLM 兼容的 token，使序列以轨迹形式而非独立 token 组进入语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型独立编码采样 RGB 帧，长视频要么耗尽 token 预算，要么丢失采样帧间的变化；编解码感知前端虽读取运动矢量与残差，但每个预测帧仍被单独 token 化，其 token 仅是当前原语的函数，而非携带参考状态的函数。且对称池化在构造上会丢弃帧序信息，而冻结视觉特征中的时序轴信息并未为空，编解码递推本身已按顺序针对参考状态合成变化。
AI.method: RESUME 将编解码预测保持在表示层面：锚定 I 帧初始化紧凑隐状态，每个后续预测帧作为对该状态的更新被消费，共享读出器从累积状态中暴露与 VideoLM 兼容的 token；随后把该轨迹交给语言模型处理，而非作为一组相互独立的 token 组。在与先前编解码感知方法相同的每预测帧 token 预算下实现。
AI.result: 在十个基准上，增益集中于时序推理：在三个时序基准上均优于 RGB 帧基线 LLaVA-Video-7B（TempCompass、TOMATO、MVBench 分别提升 2.8、5.1、3.9 分）及编解码基线 CoPE-7B，同时在通用与长视频问答上保持竞争力。冻结转移测试进一步显示锚点依赖性、顺序敏感性以及超越训练时域的有效 rollout 行为。
AI.conclusion: 将编解码预测置于表示层面并作为轨迹输入语言模型，可在不增加每预测帧 token 预算的前提下显著增强时序推理，且保持通用与长视频 QA 性能；额外表明该状态化表示具备锚点依赖、顺序敏感与可外推的 rollout 特性。

title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
summary: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出A2Z GameSpec-Bench，包含100份长篇游戏设计文档（GDD），用于评测智能体端到端游戏开发的规格忠实度。
AI.motivation: 将完整应用开发委托给编码智能体，需要保留设计意图，而非通过朴素提示生成貌似合理的输出。游戏开发是严苛测试场景：长篇GDD中的需求需在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染与玩家交互间协同工作。但现有基准多用紧凑规格，难以评估长篇GDD中跨方面的相互依赖需求。
AI.method: 将每份GDD转化为依赖感知的契约，包含规则、约束与前置关系；结合源码检查与智能体生成的测试策略，进行场景化回放与自适应试玩；契约在各智能体与修订轮次间保持固定，判断与证据绑定同一需求以支持一致比较与失败检测。
AI.result: 现有智能体难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的需求；相对于自修订，需求特定反馈在两轮后使GDD忠实度提升10.9%。
AI.conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench评估超越实现判断的端到端规格遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实的游戏开发；代码与数据集已公开。

title: From Given to Gathered Evidence: Agentic Learning for Longitudinal Medical Reasoning
summary: Foundation models can serve as clinical agents through tool-use harnesses. However, conventional medical benchmarks assess reasoning over preselected evidence rather than the ability to seek it across clinical records and longitudinal imaging. We propose CASE: a series of role-specific Clinical Agents for Seeking Evidence, together with a tool-use harness and an agentic post-training framework for compact vision-language policy models. We further introduce a longitudinal multimodal benchmark built on UK Biobank, comprising 50,401 clinical questions derived from real-world ICD-10-coded diagnoses of 4,739 participants. Each question links to a patient-specific environment containing clinical context and multi-sequence MRI from baseline and follow-up visits, where agents autonomously select which visits, organs, modalities, slices, and specialist tools to inspect and compare. Supervised fine-tuning transfers evidence-seeking workflows from 14,734 frontier-model interaction trajectories, followed by agentic reinforcement learning on the learner's own environment interactions. Privileged on-policy self-distillation and rubric-based LLM feedback refine evidence-to-conclusion reasoning without prescribing tool sequences. Experiments show that CASE moves beyond question-answer imitation toward transferable investigation policies, strengthening evidence-grounded longitudinal reasoning. Under matched evaluation conditions, our Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct based agent achieves over 16% and 10% relative improvements in answer accuracy over GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.8. Project page available at: https://vinyehshaw.github.io/case-project/.

AI.tldr: CASE 提出面向临床证据搜寻的角色化智能体、工具调用框架与智能体后训练流程，并构建基于 UK Biobank 的纵向多模态基准，使紧凑视觉语言模型能自主检索临床记录与随访 MRI 证据，在匹配条件下优于 GPT-5.4 与 Claude Opus 4.8。
AI.motivation: 传统医学基准主要评估对预先选定证据的推理能力，而非在临床记录与纵向影像中主动"寻找证据"的能力；基础模型作为临床智能体时，缺乏对真实临床环境中自主检索、跨访视比较与工具调用的评测与训练手段。
AI.method: 提出 CASE（面向证据搜寻的角色化临床智能体），包含工具调用框架与针对紧凑视觉语言策略模型的智能体后训练框架。构建基于 UK Biobank 的纵向多模态基准：50,401 个临床问题，源自 4,739 名受试者的真实 ICD-10 编码诊断；每题对应患者专属环境，含临床上下文及基线与随访的多序列 MRI，智能体自主选择访视、器官、模态、切片与专科工具进行检查比较。训练流程：先用 14,734 条前沿模型交互轨迹做监督微调以迁移证据搜寻工作流，再在模型自身环境交互上进行智能体强化学习，并结合特权同策略自蒸馏与基于评分量表的 LLM 反馈，在不规定工具序列的前提下优化"证据—结论"推理。
AI.result: 实验表明 CASE 从问答模仿转向可迁移的调查策略，强化了证据落地的纵向推理能力；在匹配评估条件下，基于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的智能体在答案准确率上相较 GPT-5.4 与 Claude Opus 4.8 分别取得超过 16% 与 10% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 证据搜寻可作为独立于答案模仿的可迁移能力被学习；通过工具调用框架与智能体后训练，紧凑视觉语言模型能在真实纵向多模态临床环境中实现自主证据检索，并取得优于大型前沿模型的准确率。

title: Invariant Shape Analysis of Surfaces with Spherical Topology
summary: Spherical harmonic descriptors of closed 3D shapes depend on the parameterization, the pose and the scale of the surface, and the standard rotation-invariant reductions, the power spectrum and the bispectrum, discard the relative orientation of the harmonic bands and cannot distinguish a shape from its mirror image. We construct a descriptor that removes all three dependencies exactly and loses nothing else: a conformal parameterization normalized by its conformal barycenter, followed by polynomial invariants of the rotation group. Identifying each harmonic band with a binary form turns the rotation quotient into classical invariant theory and makes reflections visible as the sign of an invariant, so chirality is recorded. The descriptor is complete for the truncated expansion, stable in the orbit distance, and comes with numerical diagnostics. Benchmarks confirm the guarantees, and on bilateral anatomical structures the descriptor separates mirror-image pairs from asymmetric pairs, which parity-blind descriptors cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一种对闭合三维曲面（在共形参数化归一化后）的球谐描述子，通过对旋转群的多项式不变量精确去除参数化、姿态与尺度依赖，同时保留手性信息，且对截断展开完备、在轨道距离下稳定。
AI.motivation: 球谐描述子依赖参数化、姿态和尺度；常用的旋转不变量（功率谱与双谱）丢弃了谐波带之间的相对朝向，无法区分形状与其镜像。作者希望在去除这三类依赖的同时不丢失其他信息，尤其是手性信息。
AI.method: 先用共形重心归一化的共形参数化消除参数化与尺度依赖；将每个谐波带等同于一个二元形式，从而把旋转商转化为经典不变量理论；再构造旋转群的多项式不变量作为描述子，反射以某个不变量的符号形式体现，从而记录手性；配套给出数值诊断方法。
AI.result: 描述子对截断展开是完备的，在轨道距离意义下稳定；基准测试验证了这些理论保证；在双侧解剖结构上，该描述子能够把镜像对与非对称对区分开，这是奇偶盲描述子做不到的。
AI.conclusion: 通过共形归一化与旋转群多项式不变量的组合，可以得到既去除参数化、姿态、尺度依赖又不丢失手性信息的球谐描述子，理论与实验均支持其完备性与稳定性优势。

title: Compact Language, Complex Model Shifts: How and Where Ambiguity and Underspecification Affect LLMs
comment: To appear in Proceedings of BlackBoxNLP 2026
summary: We analyze how lexical ambiguity and underspecification affect language model training. We create artificial homonyms and artificial hypernyms as pseudowords and analyze the generative performance of language models as they are trained with increasing amounts of these ambiguous or underspecified pseudoword types. We further analyze whether the models disambiguate ambiguous or underspecified statements and provide a first mechanistic account of how ambiguity and disambiguation are represented internally. Our main results show that both ambiguity and underspecification increase model performance in ways that scale with their influence on the language's type-token ratio. However, the accuracy of generating sequences containing ambiguous words or their synonyms decreases compared to other texts. We also show that internal representations of pseudowords reflect disambiguation of pseudo-homonyms, but underspecification of pseudo-hypernyms is maintained during the generative process.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过构造人工同形异义词与人工上位词作为伪词，研究词汇歧义与语义欠指定如何影响语言模型训练，发现二者均能随类型-形符比的影响提升模型性能，但含歧义词及其同义词的序列生成准确率下降，且模型内部表征对伪同形异义词进行了消歧，而对伪上位词的欠指定则在生成过程中保持不变。
AI.motivation: 词汇歧义与语义欠指定是自然语言的核心特征，但它们在语言模型训练中的作用、模型是否会对其进行消歧以及内部如何表征，尚缺乏系统性研究。作者希望以可控实验方式厘清歧义和欠指定对模型生成性能与内部表征的影响。
AI.method: 作者构造人工同形异义词（pseudo-homonyms）和人工上位词（pseudo-hypernyms）作为伪词，将其以不同数量、不同类型比例加入训练语料，训练语言模型并逐步增加这些歧义/欠指定伪词类型的规模，进而评估其生成性能；同时检验模型是否会消歧含糊或欠指定的语句，并首次从机制可解释性角度分析歧义与消歧在模型内部表征中的编码方式。
AI.result: 歧义与欠指定均能提升模型性能，且提升幅度随其对语言类型-形符比（type-token ratio）影响的增大而增大；但相比其他文本，生成包含歧义词或其同义词的序列时准确率下降。内部表征分析显示，伪同形异义词的表征体现了消歧过程，而伪上位词的欠指定状态在生成过程中得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 词汇歧义和欠指定并非单纯的噪声，而是能通过影响类型-形符比以可度量的方式促进语言模型训练；但模型对不同类型语义不确定性的处理并不一致——对同形异义词倾向于消歧，对欠指定的上位词则维持其泛指性，这对理解语言模型的语义表征与生成行为具有启示意义。

title: Steering Fields: Adaptive Vector Fields for Safe Image Generation and Beyond
summary: As state-of-the-art text-to-image flow models achieve near-photorealistic quality, controlling their outputs, e.g., suppressing harmful content while promoting benign alternatives, has become a central challenge. The current steering paradigm consists of adding a global steering vector to selected activations. While functional, a fixed and example-agnostic vector applied uniformly along the entire trajectory cannot adapt to the changing state of the generation and often causes unintended global changes. We introduce Steering Fields, a generalization of steering vectors that adaptively re-estimates the steering direction at each step of the generative process. Steering Fields operate on the noisy states of flow models, expose a continuous trade-off between steering strength and content preservation, and are compositional, enabling the simultaneous induction and inhibition of concepts, setting a new state of the art on safety steering benchmarks. Despite using no explicit spatial masks or object priors, the trajectory-adaptive estimation naturally preserves local structure, in a manner reminiscent of image editing. In fact, Steering Fields can serve as a structure-preserving image-editing technique that achieves state-of-the-art semantic fidelity (CLIP, VQAScore), while remaining model-agnostic and inversion-free.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Steering Fields，将固定的全局“引导向量”推广为随生成轨迹自适应重估方向的“引导场”，用于流模型的输出控制与图像编辑，在安全引导基准和语义保真度上取得SOTA，且无需掩码、无需模型反演。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像流模型已接近照片级质量，如何控制其输出（如抑制有害内容、促进良性替代）成为核心挑战。现有引导范式是在选定激活上添加一个固定的、与样本无关的全局引导向量，沿整条轨迹均匀施加；这种方式缺乏对生成状态变化的适应性，常导致不必要的全局性改变。
AI.method: 提出Steering Fields，是引导向量的推广：在生成过程的每一步对噪声状态自适应地重新估计引导方向。其在流模型的噪声状态上操作，暴露引导强度与内容保持之间的连续权衡，并具备可组合性，可同时诱导与抑制概念。
AI.result: 在安全引导基准上取得新的SOTA。尽管未使用显式空间掩码或物体先验，轨迹自适应估计仍能自然保持局部结构，效果类似图像编辑。作为结构保持的图像编辑技术，Steering Fields实现了SOTA语义保真度（CLIP、VQAScore），同时保持模型无关且无需反演。
AI.conclusion: 将引导从固定向量推广为轨迹自适应的场，是一种通用、模型无关的控制机制，兼顾安全引导与高质量图像编辑，避免了全局非预期改动与反演开销。

title: Beyond Risk Prediction: Evidence Grounding and Psychosocial Factor Verification for Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Mental Health Disorder Detection on Social Media (MHSM 2026), held in conjunction with IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Identifying suicide risk from social networking services (SNS) posts is important for detecting suicide-related signals in online environments. However, risk classification alone provides limited insight into the textual evidence and psychosocial factors behind a prediction. Based on the IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge, this study presents a framework consisting of Risk Assessment, Evidence Grounding, and Factor Identification. Risk Assessment uses length-based routing to accommodate posts of different lengths. Evidence Grounding identifies supporting phrases and uses a Risk-Evidence constraint to maintain consistency with the Risk prediction. For Factor Identification, two verifiers are used. The Taxonomy Verifier focuses on factor semantics, whereas the Evidence-Aware Verifier uses factor-specific lexical-semantic cues to select informative positive training units. Their prediction probabilities are combined to produce the final factor predictions. The three tasks are evaluated using task-specific F1 score measures. Risk Assessment achieved a Weighted F1 of 0.8088, Evidence Grounding achieved a test Macro row F1 of 0.7605, and Factor Identification achieved a Macro F1 of 0.5562. The results show that the framework can provide risk predictions, along with supporting textual evidence and fine-grained information on psychosocial factors. Overall, the proposed framework extends suicide-risk assessment beyond risk-level prediction and provides a more interpretable analysis of SNS posts.

AI.tldr: 本文基于 IEEE BigData 2026 可解释自杀风险检测挑战赛，提出由风险评估、证据定位与因素识别三部分组成的框架，在三个子任务上分别取得 Weighted F1 0.8088、Macro row F1 0.7605 与 Macro F1 0.5562，实现了可解释的自杀风险分析。
AI.motivation: 仅进行风险等级分类无法说明预测背后的文本证据与心理社会因素，因此需要构建兼顾风险预测、证据支撑与细粒度因素识别的可解释框架。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：风险评估采用基于长度的路由以适配不同长度帖子；证据定位识别支持性短语，并用风险-证据约束保持与风险预测的一致性；因素识别使用两个验证器，Taxonomy Verifier 关注因素语义，Evidence-Aware Verifier 利用因素特定的词汇-语义线索选择有信息量的正训练单元，二者预测概率融合得到最终因素预测。
AI.result: 风险评估 Weighted F1 为 0.8088，证据定位测试 Macro row F1 为 0.7605，因素识别 Macro F1 为 0.5562。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在给出风险预测的同时提供支持性文本证据与细粒度心理社会因素信息，将自杀风险评估从风险等级预测拓展为对 SNS 帖子更具可解释性的分析。

title: Thinking Outside the Box: Can Language Models Rely on External Guidance Selectively?
summary: Agent harnesses often improve language models with human-designed workflows, but as models grow more capable, unreliable guidance can increasingly constrain their execution. We call the ability to benefit from useful guidance while overriding unreliable guidance thinking outside the box. We introduce Box$^2$-Bench, which holds the model and task fixed while varying workflow reliability to isolate how models regulate their reliance on guidance. On Box$^2$-Bench, frontier models often benefit from reliable guidance but remain vulnerable when it is misleading or becomes unreliable. To test whether this capability can be learned, we train two open-weight models using bad workflows, reserving good workflows for evaluation. We explore two complementary training strategies: counterfactual supervised fine-tuning improves robustness, while outcome-based reinforcement learning can shift the balance toward greater use of helpful workflows. We further find that this behavior extends beyond workflows to other forms of external information, improving peer correction and robustness to corrupted memory. Together, our results identify selective reliance on fallible external information as a dimension of agent reliability not captured by task performance alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"跳出框框思考"能力，即模型能采纳有用指导又拒绝不可靠指导，并构建Box²-Bench基准来隔离评测该能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的agent harness通过人工设计的工作流提升语言模型表现，但随模型能力增强，不可靠的指导反而会限制其执行。模型能否在获益于有用指导的同时覆盖掉不可靠的指导，这一维度尚未被单独刻画，也未被任务性能指标所涵盖。
AI.method: 提出Box²-Bench：固定模型与任务，仅变化工作流的可靠性，以隔离模型对指导的依赖调节行为。为验证该能力可学，用"坏工作流"训练两个开源权重模型并保留"好工作流"做评测，比较两种训练策略：反事实监督微调（counterfactual SFT）与基于结果的强化学习（outcome-based RL）。
AI.result: 在Box²-Bench上，前沿模型通常能从可靠指导中获益，但当指导具有误导性或变得不可靠时仍表现脆弱。反事实监督微调提升了鲁棒性，而基于结果的强化学习可将平衡转向更多使用有帮助的工作流。该行为还可泛化到其他外部信息形式，改善同伴纠错并提升对损坏记忆的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对外部易错信息的选择性依赖，是agent可靠性中一个独立于任务性能之外的重要维度，可通过训练加以改善。

title: A Generalizable and Explainable Framework for Synthetic Video Detection Using First-Digit Gradient Statistics
summary: AI video generators have not only become harder to detect but are used to generate a diverse set of scenarios from landscapes to street views to animal videos. This creates a problem where CNN-based detectors are effective but offer no insight into their inner workings, while forensics-based detectors are often pretrained for a set scenario or become too complex to derive meaningful insights. We present a novel approach to AI video detection using Sobel gradient values analysed with the first-digit law. Using linear discriminant analysis, we visualise the discriminatory signal, while a multi-layer perceptron is used for classification. The detection method has no generator- or scenespecific features, and the model has no knowledge of container formats, codec, bitrate, or compression artefacts. The model is trained and tested on GenBuster-200K, GenBusterBench, GenVA, FaceForensics++ C23, and CelebDF. We also show how zero-shot detection fails even though the feature set carries a discriminatory signal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于Sobel梯度值与首位数字定律（本福特定律）的AI视频检测方法，不依赖生成器或场景特定特征，通过LDA可视化判别信号、MLP进行分类，并在多个数据集上验证。研究同时表明，即使特征集携带判别信号，零样本检测仍会失败。
AI.motivation: AI视频生成器不仅愈发难以检测，还能生成从风景、街景到动物视频等多种场景。现有CNN检测器虽有效但缺乏可解释性；取证类检测器通常针对固定场景预训练，或过于复杂而难以得出有意义的洞见。因此需要一种既有效又可解释、且不依赖特定生成器或场景的检测方法。
AI.method: 利用Sobel梯度值并结合首位数字定律（本福特定律）进行分析；使用线性判别分析（LDA）可视化判别信号；采用多层感知机（MLP）进行分类。该方法不含生成器或场景特定特征，模型也不使用容器格式、编解码器、比特率或压缩伪影等信息。模型在GenBuster-200K、GenBusterBench、GenVA、FaceForensics++ C23和CelebDF上进行训练与测试。
AI.result: 模型在上述多个数据集上完成训练与测试，验证了基于Sobel梯度与首位数字定律特征的有效性；同时通过实验展示，尽管特征集本身携带判别信号，零样本检测仍然失败。
AI.conclusion: 基于Sobel梯度值与本福特定律的检测方法可在不依赖生成器或场景特定特征、且不了解容器格式与压缩信息的条件下实现AI视频检测，并借助LDA提供可解释的判别信号可视化；但零样本检测在特征携带判别信号的情况下仍不可行，提示跨域泛化仍是挑战。

title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
summary: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向真实视频、跨度达1公里的大规模空间智能基准，依据人类空间认知层级（地标锚定、路线连接、全局心理地图）评测视觉语言模型，发现模型并非进行真正的路径整合或形成几何测量知识，而是几乎完全依赖二维视觉识别与文本匹配来规避复杂空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型的空间智能评测多局限于短距离或静态图像，缺乏对大规模、真实世界场景下地理布局理解能力的检验，因此需要构建更贴近人类空间认知的评测基准以揭示模型的真实空间推理水平。
AI.method: 构建基于真实世界视频的空间智能基准，覆盖最远约1公里的地理范围；借鉴认知科学文献，按人类空间意识的层级阶段（地标锚定、通过路线连接地标、整合为全局心理地图）设计评测任务，并据此对当前视觉语言模型开展系统性实验。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，当前AI模型在处理空间信息时存在根本性差异：它们几乎完全依赖二维视觉识别和文本匹配，而非利用真实的路径整合或构建几何测量知识，从而绕过了复杂的空间推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了视觉语言模型在大规模空间智能方面的前沿，揭示了模型缺乏真正空间推理能力的局限，并公开了基准以供后续研究使用。

title: SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images
summary: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: SPOON 将多视图组合式3D生成重构为场景级、几何接地的姿态推理问题，通过 Guide-Route-Reconcile 范式协调各视图的目标姿态，生成全局一致的三维场景布局，在 ARSG-110K 上显著降低 Chamfer 距离。
AI.motivation: 从视觉观测恢复完整3D物体形状及其空间排布是组合式3D场景生成的核心目标。图像条件下的3D生成器已能提供高质量物体几何先验，但关键难题在于如何将这些资产在空间上组织成全局一致的场景，同时与多视图观测相符。现有方法要么将场景布局与物体生成耦合，要么从单视图观测分别估计空间位置，导致姿态假设在各视图间存在歧义与不一致，最终形成物体-相机混乱堆放。
AI.method: 提出 SPOON 框架，把多视图组合式3D生成重新表述为场景级、几何接地的姿态推理。不再独立处理各视图的物体姿态假设，而是利用重建导出的多视图几何对其进行协调，采用 Guide-Route-Reconcile（引导—路由—调和）范式，逐步将物体姿态与相机配置组织为连贯的场景级空间布局。
AI.result: 在 ARSG-110K 与 MIDI-3D-Front 上开展大量实验，在不同输入视图数量下，物体放置与场景组合均获得一致提升。在 ARSG-110K 上，相比强基线，场景级与物体级 Chamfer 距离分别降低 12.7% 和 17.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将多视图组合式3D生成转化为场景级、几何接地的姿态推理是一种有效范式；统一协调多视图姿态假设可显著提升场景布局与物体摆放的一致性，且在不同视图数量下表现稳定。

title: Structural Limits of the Information-Theoretic Uncertainty Decomposition
summary: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples $N$ (e.g., from ensembles with $N$ members), revealing it is bounded by $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$. Crucially, the infeasible region's boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, $\text{AU} > \text{EU}$ is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when $\text{AU} \leq \log(2)/N$.

AI.tldr: 该论文从函数层面剖析信息论不确定性分解框架，发现AU与EU存在有限样本下不可达区域，其边界AU ≤ log(2)/N可解释认知坍塌，并指出低AU区间二者耦合。
AI.motivation: 实践中不确定性分解面临两大问题：AU与EU高度相关的纠缠，以及EU幅度随模型容量增大而缩小的认知坍塌。作者希望从框架本身的结构性缺陷出发，寻找这些现象的根本原因。
AI.method: 在函数层面对标准信息论不确定性分解框架进行理论分析，刻画不可行区域（infeasible region）随类别数和蒙特卡洛样本数N的缩放规律，并推导其边界AU ≤ log(2)/N。
AI.result: 发现有限设置下假定AU/EU范围内的显著部分不可行，无法由任何类别概率达成；不可行区域边界定量解释了认知坍塌——高置信度时AU > EU由该结构性限制保证；增大集成规模可缩小不可行区域从而缓解认知坍塌。
AI.conclusion: AU与EU在低AU区间（AU ≤ log(2)/N）并非独立而相互耦合，不应将其解读为独立量；增大集成规模是缓解认知坍塌的有效途径。

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
comment: 61 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/groundanything/ Code: [https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything](https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything) Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything, https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything-VLM
summary: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

AI.tldr: 提出4B参数的双向扩散grounding基础模型GroundAnything，通过块式去噪实现并行解码与精确本地化，在30个基准上达到同规模SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归（AR）grounding模型将空间预测序列化，带来顺序延迟，并对输出token施加了因果顺序。但作者认为grounding本质是视觉证据提取：物体、位置与空间关系同时受图像和查询约束，其依赖关系并不意味着存在固有的从左到右生成顺序。这一区分使双向扩散成为自然选择，可让空间假设并行涌现并迭代精修。
AI.method: GroundAnything为4B参数的grounding基础模型，采用块式去噪（blockwise denoising）协调快速并行解码与精确定位。训练流程包括：基于公开数据集与专用数据引擎的grounding预训练、结合AR与扩散目标的直接AR-to-diffusion转换、监督微调，以及基于GRPO的强化学习后训练。此外探索熵引导解码与可选的自推测解码模式，并进行渐进式推理优化的基础设施实验。
AI.result: 在30个grounding基准上：自回归变体GroundAnything-VLM以72.42%取得同规模模型总体新SOTA，与GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力；采用熵引导解码时，GroundAnything以平均61.75%超越此前同规模SOTA（基于MTP的快速模型LocateAnything为53.32%）。自推测模式相较AR对应模型实现4.51倍加速，COCO F1mIoU仅下降0.74个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明双向扩散范式可有效替代序列化grounding，兼顾并行效率与定位精度；渐进式推理优化能将并行解码转化为实际加速，支持延迟敏感的真实系统实现高效视觉grounding。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
comment: 64 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundingPI Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundingPI
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings.
