Under matched interaction or rollout budgets, OPTS-TTPO improves MuJoCo tail returns over PPO by up to 28.6%, achieves a 34-22-1 win-loss-tie record against PPO on Atari-57 under the last-100-log mean-return metric, and improves micro-averaged avg@32 and pass@32 over PPO across all four Qwen3 models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于on-policy树轨迹的OPTS与TTPO/TTPG方法，在固定预算下利用树搜索提升稀有高回报轨迹覆盖，同时控制梯度偏差，并在链式基准、MuJoCo、Atari-57及Qwen3模型上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 策略梯度定理给出当前策略下的精确梯度，但有限on-policy样本可能遗漏稀有高回报轨迹。作者研究在固定预算下树搜索能否在控制梯度偏差的同时改善轨迹覆盖。
AI.method: 提出On-Policy Parallel Tree Search（OPTS）与Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization（TTPO），在访问状态处从当前策略采样新后缀构成on-policy树轨迹，无需动作分布校正。通过Branch Aggregation Lemma证明固定分支选择与权重时，分支加权树统计可恢复链式期望；OPTS用估计性能差选择扩展状态，并在确定性动力学、精确值与max-backup优势下给出单调改进，并界定自适应扩展带来的梯度偏差。
AI.result: 在有限链式参考上，TTPG测得偏差接近无分支水平，而NaivePG偏差从0.1251增至0.4884。匹配预算下，reward-与value-guided OPTS在正确答案覆盖率与多数投票准确率上优于独立采样；匹配分支数时OPTS+TTPG以适度偏差增加换取覆盖率提升。在匹配交互或rollout预算下，OPTS-TTPO在MuJoCo尾部回报较PPO最高提升28.6%，在Atari-57上以last-100-log平均回报取得34-22-1胜负平战绩，并在四个Qwen3模型上提升micro-averaged avg@32与pass@32。
AI.conclusion: 在固定预算下，on-policy树搜索可在保持梯度偏差可控的同时有效提升高回报轨迹覆盖与任务表现，优于PPO与独立采样基线。

title: Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian, a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 to 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features.

AI.tldr: Radian：在冻结VFM表征空间引入对抗蒸馏，弥补DMD缺乏解码视频感知监督的缺陷，实现高效少步自回归视频生成。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频生成可实现高效流式合成，但早期时域块的误差会作为上下文被复用并在后续rollout中传播，导致细节退化、结构漂移与运动不稳定。现有DMD仅在扩散隐空间对齐师生分布，缺乏对解码视频感知质量的直接监督。
AI.method: 提出Radian表征空间对抗蒸馏框架：在on-policy DMD基础上，于冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）定义的特征空间加入真实数据对抗监督。训练时稀疏解码自回归学生rollout的帧，提取多层视觉表征，用轻量判别头区分生成与真实视频帧。DMD目标将学生锚定到预训练教师，表征空间对抗目标提供互补的感知与语义梯度。训练后丢弃附加组件，生成器架构与推理去噪预算不变。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-1.3B上覆盖四步chunk-wise、一步frame-wise及分钟级自回归生成。四步生成下VBench Total达0.8444、VideoAlign Total达0.8033；相比Rolling Forcing将VBench-Long从0.7805提升至0.8041且去噪步数更少。图像、视频与扩散表征的对照实验表明，表征空间选择会产生不同对抗信号，外部VFM梯度比扩散内部特征的对抗监督更有效地补充DMD。
AI.conclusion: 在表征空间引入真实数据对抗监督可有效补充DMD，缓解自回归误差传播，提升少步自回归视频生成的感知与语义质量，且不增加推理开销。

title: MGhana-ST: A Low-Resource Speech Translation Dataset for Ghanaian Languages and an Analysis of Multilingual Training Trade-offs
summary: We present MGhana-ST, a speech translation dataset for four low-resource Ghanaian language varieties: Ga, Twi (Akuapem and Asante), Ewe, and Fante. MGhana-ST is an ongoing annotation effort; the experiments here use a fixed subset of about 16.1 hours of paired speech and English translations. The audio is curated from two existing Ghanaian speech resources. Unlike in those resources, the English translations are produced directly from audio by 37 native-speaker annotators and include verbal and non-verbal event annotations. Using Whisper-small, we compare monolingual and multilingual training under severe data scarcity, reporting means over three seeds. Flat multilingual training benefits no variety in this regime. Ga and Twi are unchanged within seed variance (+0.51 and +0.06 BLEU against monolingual standard deviations of 1.63 and 2.20), while Ewe declines by 6.99 BLEU and Fante by 5.11. The degrading varieties are Ewe, which is linguistically distinct and drawn from a different source corpus, and Fante, the least-resourced. Comparing empirical cross-lingual transfer with typology-based similarity, we find that transfer BLEU identifies closely interacting language pairs better than URIEL similarity, though neither predicts which varieties benefit from joint training. We also report a methodological finding. An earlier single-run analysis found positive transfer for three of four varieties; this did not survive replication across seeds. For Ga and Twi, monolingual baselines trained on 1.6 to 6.2 hours of audio have seed standard deviations roughly five and thirty times those of the multilingual models (0.35 and 0.07 BLEU). When the monolingual condition is noisier, a single-run comparison can show apparent transfer of this size from seed variation alone. We release MGhana-ST to support research on African language speech technology and low-resource speech translation.

AI.tldr: MGhana-ST：四种加纳低资源语言变体的语音翻译数据集，约16.1小时配对语音与英语译文。用Whisper-small比较单语与多语训练，发现扁平多语训练在严重数据稀缺下无益，Ewe与Fante显著下降，且此前的正迁移结论无法复现。
AI.motivation: 针对加纳低资源语言（Ga、Twi、Ewe、Fante）缺乏语音翻译资源的问题，构建带英语译文与言语/非言语事件标注的数据集，并探究在严重数据稀缺条件下单语与多语训练的相对表现及跨语言迁移规律。
AI.method: 从两个现有加纳语音资源中筛选音频，由37名母语标注员直接依据音频产出英语译文，并加入言语与非言语事件标注；构建约16.1小时配对子集。以Whisper-small为骨干，在三种随机种子下比较单语训练与扁平多语训练，并用BLEU评估；同时对比经验性跨语言迁移（迁移BLEU）与基于类型学的URIEL相似度。
AI.result: 扁平多语训练在此稀缺条件下未使任何语言变体获益：Ga（+0.51）与Twi（+0.06）在种子方差内（单语标准差分别为1.63与2.20）基本不变；Ewe下降6.99 BLEU，Fante下降5.11 BLEU。迁移BLEU比URIEL相似度更能识别交互密切的语言对，但两者均无法预测哪些变体可从联合训练中获益。早期单次运行的“四分之三变体正迁移”结论在多种子复现中不成立；Ga与Twi单语基线（1.6–6.2小时音频）的种子标准差约为多语模型的5倍与30倍（0.35与0.07 BLEU），说明单语条件噪声更大时，单次比较可因种子波动而显现虚假迁移。
AI.conclusion: 在严重数据稀缺的低资源语音翻译场景下，扁平多语训练不一定带来收益，甚至可能损害部分语言变体；跨语言迁移的预测指标（迁移BLEU、URIEL）均不充分。研究强调必须进行多种子复现以避免由种子方差导致的虚假正迁移结论。MGhana-ST已公开，以支持非洲语言语音技术与低资源语音翻译研究。

title: MAGiDiff: Sampling the Photospheric Vector Field from UV/EUV Filtergrams
summary: Photospheric vector magnetic fields are foundational to modeling, understanding, and forecasting solar activity. These data are usually produced by inverting and disambiguating the full Stokes vector at multiple passbands, which is demanding. Here, we investigate how well we can estimate photospheric vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. This problem is challenging and intrinsically ambiguous without polarization information, as the mapping from UV/EUV intensity to the magnetic field is indirect and ill-posed. We introduce MAGiDiff, a machine-learning-based method that uses denoising diffusion models to estimate vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. As input, MAGiDiff takes a stack of filtergrams from the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) / Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA); as output, it is trained to estimate the disambiguated vector magnetogram as seen by Hinode / Solar Optical Telescope-Spectro-Polarimeter (SOT-SP). We show that MAGiDiff can accurately mimic the Hinode ground-truth. Additionally, we probe MAGiDiff's understanding of the physical structure and magnetic connectivity. On full-disk, we show that it produces plausible structures for active regions. MAGiDiff generalizes across solar cycles despite hemispheric polarity reversal, and can be fine-tuned to other EUV instruments including STEREO/EUVI and GOES-R/SUVI. While clearly not a substitute for a dedicated instrument, MAGiDiff opens the door to new capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGiDiff，用扩散模型从SDO/AIA的UV/EUV滤光图估计光球矢量磁图，逼近Hinode/SOT-SP去歧义结果，并具备物理结构理解与跨仪器泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 光球矢量磁场对太阳活动建模、理解与预报至关重要，但通常需对多个波段的全Stokes矢量做反演与去歧义，代价高昂。本文探索能否仅从UV/EUV滤光图估计矢量磁图，以降低对偏振观测的依赖、拓展观测手段受限时的能力。
AI.method: MAGiDiff：基于去噪扩散模型的机器学习方法。输入为SDO/AIA的一叠UV/EUV滤光图，输出为经训练估计的、以Hinode/SOT-SP为参照的去歧义矢量磁图。任务本身欠定且不适定，因UV/EUV强度到磁场的映射缺乏偏振信息。
AI.result: MAGiDiff可较准确模拟Hinode真值；在全日面上能生成合理的活动区结构；在半球极性反转下仍可跨太阳周泛化；并可微调迁移至STEREO/EUVI与GOES-R/SUVI等其他EUV仪器。对物理结构与磁连接性的探针测试表明其具备一定的物理理解。
AI.conclusion: MAGiDiff虽不能替代专用矢量磁强计，但为无偏振数据条件下的矢量磁图估计开辟了新能力与可能性。

title: CoEvoWhen: Policy-Tool Coevolution for Ultra-Long Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Ultra-long video temporal grounding requires balancing long-range evidence search with fine-grained event understanding under a limited visual budget, yet existing agentic methods still rely largely on predefined policies and tool capabilities. Motivated by this, we propose a novel policy-tool coevolution framework that jointly evolves high-level policies and executable media tools from the agentic reasoning trajectories of a VLM, forming a reusable skill without updating model parameters. During evolution, an external skill updater distills transferable task experience in long-video temporal grounding, accordingly refining the orchestration of long-range image-based and fine-grained video-based observations. Alongside these policy updates, the updater employs its coding capabilities to upgrade existing tools or create new ones, adapting the tools to long-video evidence acquisition. Equipped with the evolved skill, the VLM autonomously orchestrates tools under the guidance of the evolved policy, coordinating image and video observations for agentic inference without relying on a separate, stronger planning model. Extensive experiments spanning five benchmarks and three VLMs show that policy-tool coevolution consistently improves temporal grounding accuracy in ultra-long videos while reducing visual token cost at inference, and that the evolved skill yields substantial performance gains on general long-video QA without additional task-specific evolution, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“策略-工具协同演化”框架，通过从VLM的智能体推理轨迹中联合演化高层策略与可执行媒体工具，形成可复用技能而无需更新模型参数，在超长视频时序定位中提升精度并降低视觉Token开销。
AI.motivation: 超长视频时序定位需在有限视觉预算下平衡长程证据搜索与细粒度事件理解，但现有智能体方法大多依赖预定义的策略与工具能力，缺乏自适应演化能力。
AI.method: 提出策略-工具协同演化框架：外部技能更新器从VLM的智能体推理轨迹中蒸馏可迁移的长视频时序定位任务经验，优化基于图像的长程观察与基于视频的细粒度观察的编排策略；同时利用其编码能力升级现有工具或创建新工具以适配长视频证据获取。VLM在演化策略指导下自主编排工具完成智能体推理，无需依赖独立的更强规划模型。
AI.result: 在五个基准和三种VLM上的大量实验表明，策略-工具协同演化持续提升超长视频时序定位精度，同时降低推理阶段视觉Token成本；演化所得技能在通用长视频QA上无需额外任务特定演化即可取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 策略-工具协同演化框架对长视频理解具有有效性与泛化性，可在不更新模型参数的前提下形成可复用技能并迁移至其他长视频任务。

title: Less Data, Better Timing: Student-Curriculum Coupling for VLM On-Policy Distillation in Temporal Video Grounding
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student's current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. Supervision can therefore be activated, suspended, or reactivated as competence changes, concentrating teacher computation and optimization on current task-level deficits. Across three TVG benchmarks, SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD on its original curriculum, while using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%. Ablations support the complementary roles of capability-structured curriculum design and student-dependent supervision in achieving these gains. Together, these results establish SCC as a data- and compute-efficient framework for TVG post-training, delivering stronger temporal grounding by aligning trustworthy supervision with the student's evolving learning needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出学生-课程耦合（SCC）闭环框架，用于视频时序定位（TVG）的在线策略蒸馏，通过让动态变化的学生模型决定当前激活的监督子集，实现数据与算力高效的后训练。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏（OPD）流程通常基于固定教师和初始学生状态构建固定训练课程，隐含假设所选样本在整个优化过程中始终具有正向监督价值。作者指出监督可信度（目标是否可信）与监督必要性（随学生当前任务能力变化）是两个不同但耦合的维度，二者共同决定监督价值，因此固定课程无法适应学生能力演进。
AI.method: 提出学生-课程耦合（SCC）闭环框架：用紧凑的锚点-前沿（Anchor-Frontier）课程定义候选监督空间，由不断演进的学生模型动态决定其激活子集；监督可根据能力变化被激活、暂停或重新激活，从而将教师计算与优化集中于当前任务层面的能力缺口。
AI.result: 在三个TVG基准上，SCC在其原始课程上相较Video-OPD平均召回率提升5.1%（相对），同时训练样本减少60.0%、训练时间减少50.4%。消融实验验证了能力结构化课程设计与学生依赖监督的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: SCC是一种数据与算力高效的TVG后训练框架，通过将可信监督与学生演进的学习需求对齐，实现更强的时间定位性能。

title: LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Technical report of MMLA. The authors contributed equally
summary: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) give a frozen model a compact numerical state that can learn from feedback. The map $h+BAh$ adds a low-rank correction to a hidden representation. A slow state $ρ$ learns starting factors across tasks; a private fast state $Φ$ copies them, changes with feedback, and resets to the trained initialization. This report specifies an input-side realization of the numerical policy carrier in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture and examines its factor-space dynamics and learning lifetime. We study a rank-4 input residual with 12,288 trainable parameters on a frozen MiniCPM5-1B-SFT substrate. In a four-candidate program-selection task, two feedback-gradient steps reduce expected query execution error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points relative to resetting to the respective trained static and post-adaptation initializations. These development results cover 16 parameter groups and three paired training seeds. A direct support-loss selection rule is much more accurate, reaching 0.78125% error. In a repository-balanced chronological replay of public continuous-integration jobs, retaining online updates raises half-Brier loss from 0.1274 to 0.1808. A fixed follow-up intervention records same-batch non-descent and inconsistent future benefit from shrinking updates. Together, the algebra and measurements distinguish residual capacity, adaptation relative to a starting point, and usefulness on later decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LARC（低秩自适应残差连接）在冻结模型上的输入侧实现，分析其因子空间动力学与学习生命周期。在冻结的MiniCPM5-1B-SFT上，用12,288参数、秩4的输入残差，两步反馈梯度使查询执行误差相对重置到静态/自适应初始化分别降低24.65和36.65个百分点；但在线CI任务回放中保留在线更新反而使半Brier损失从0.1274升至0.1808。
AI.motivation: 为冻结模型赋予一个紧凑的数值状态，使其能够从反馈中学习。通过低秩修正h+BAh，并引入慢状态ρ（跨任务学习起始因子）和私有快状态Φ（随反馈变化并可重置到训练初始化），以规范化"记忆介导学习架构"中数值策略载体，并厘清残差容量、相对于起点的适应性与后续决策有用性之间的区别。
AI.method: 在冻结的MiniCPM5-1B-SFT基座上，采用秩4的输入侧残差，含12,288个可训练参数。对比四候选程序选择任务，使用两步反馈梯度；评估覆盖16个参数组与3个配对训练种子；另设直接support-loss选择规则；并做仓库均衡的时序CI作业回放及固定后续干预实验。
AI.result: 两步反馈梯度使期望查询执行误差相对重置到训练静态初始化和自适应后初始化分别降低24.65和36.65个百分点。直接support-loss选择规则更准确，误差仅0.78125%。在线CI回放中，保留在线更新使半Brier损失从0.1274恶化到0.1808。后续干预记录到同批次非下降以及缩减更新带来的一致未来收益。
AI.conclusion: 代数和测量结果共同区分了残差容量、相对于起点的适应性与后续决策有用性三者。LARC能有效实现紧凑的反馈学习状态，但在线更新的保持并不必然带来收益，甚至可能损害性能，说明适应性与长期有用性需分别评估。

title: From Tweets to Trades: Analyzing the Influence of Public Mood over Stock Market Performance in Turkiye
summary: Purpose: This study examines whether domain-specific public mood is associated with stock-market dynamics and whether these relationships vary across communication domains and market conditions. It distinguishes public mood from investor sentiment and investigates whether heterogeneous sources of public communication exhibit different relationships with market behaviour. Design: The study analyses 610,422 posts published by 176 curated X accounts between January 2022 and December 2023, covering Politics and Government, Economy and Finance, and Media and Society. Posts are classified using fine-tuned Turkish transformer models under three domain-specific and one pooled regime. Public mood measures are constructed at daily, weekly, and monthly frequencies and examined alongside BIST100 and BIST30 market measures using correlation, Granger causality, vector autoregression, and impulse response analyses across the full period and selected market conditions. Findings: Public mood is not associated with the direction of stock-market returns but is associated with the magnitude of price movements, particularly for Media and Society and pooled communication. These relationships become stronger at longer aggregation frequencies. Predictive relationships are concentrated in Economy and Finance communication, while their magnitude and direction vary across market conditions, particularly during the 2023 election period. The pooled measure largely reflects the most active communication domain. Originality: The study contributes to behavioral-finance research by incorporating communication - domain heterogeneity into the analysis of public mood and market dynamics. It also demonstrates how aggregating heterogeneous sources can obscure domain-specific relationships between public communication and financial markets.

AI.tldr: 研究基于176个X账号在2022年1月至2023年12月发布的610,422条帖文，用土耳其语Transformer模型按政治与政府、经济与金融、媒体与社会三个领域分类并构建公共情绪指标，考察其与BIST100/BIST30的动态关系。结果发现公共情绪与收益率方向无关，但与价格波动幅度相关，且在更长聚合频率下更强；预测关系集中于经济与金融领域，并随市场状况（尤其2023年选举期）变化；汇总指标主要反映最活跃的沟通领域。
AI.motivation: 既有行为金融研究多将公共情绪与投资者情绪混同，且常把异质性的公共沟通来源合并处理，可能掩盖领域间的差异关系。本文旨在区分公共情绪与投资者情绪，并将沟通领域异质性纳入公共情绪与股市动态的分析框架。
AI.method: 采集176个精选X账号2022年1月至2023年12月的610,422条帖文，覆盖政治与政府、经济与金融、媒体与社会三个领域；在三个领域专属及一个汇总（pooled）设定下，用微调的土耳其语Transformer模型对帖文分类；在日、周、月三个频率构建公共情绪指标，与BIST100、BIST30市场指标进行相关分析、Granger因果检验、向量自回归（VAR）及脉冲响应分析，并在全样本期与特定市场状况下分别检验。
AI.result: 公共情绪与股票收益率方向无显著关联，但与价格波动幅度相关，媒体与社会领域及汇总沟通的效应尤为明显；该关系在更长聚合频率（周、月）下增强。预测性关系集中于经济与金融沟通，其强度与方向随市场状况变化，在2023年选举期间尤为突出。汇总情绪指标在很大程度上反映最活跃的沟通领域。
AI.conclusion: 研究将沟通领域异质性引入公共情绪与市场动态分析，拓展了行为金融研究。结果表明，将异质性来源简单汇总会掩盖公共沟通与金融市场之间领域特异的关联，提示后续研究应区分沟通领域并关注聚合频率与市场状况的调节作用。

title: LongEmo: Towards Emotion Understanding and Reasoning in Long Videos
summary: While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in affective computing, their reasoning capabilities are largely confined to short video clips with limited interactions. However, real-world emotions are not merely isolated instantaneous reactions but dynamic and cumulative processes deeply shaped by past experiences and ongoing events. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongEmoBench, a benchmark dedicated to emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. It assesses progressive capabilities scaling from continuous scene interactions to complex episodic developments. Furthermore, we propose LongEmo, a novel memory-augmented agentic framework designed to tackle the immense challenges of long-range affective reasoning. LongEmo processes continuous video streams to construct an Event Memory Graph, explicitly modeling long-range dependencies and capturing emotional dynamics across discrete events. Given a question, the agent retrieves a query-relevant event stream from the graph, iteratively integrating multimodal memories and relational dependencies to deduce the final answer. Extensive evaluations of 17 representative methods reveal that they struggle significantly with emotion understanding and reasoning in long videos. In contrast, LongEmo achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the efficacy of its event-centric memory architecture.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对长视频情感理解与推理的空白，提出了LongEmoBench基准与LongEmo记忆增强智能体框架，通过事件记忆图建模长程依赖，取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在情感计算中多局限于短视频片段与有限交互，而真实情感是受过往经验与持续事件影响、动态且累积的过程。为弥补这一差距，作者希望推动从连续场景交互到复杂情节发展的渐进式情感理解与推理能力评估与研究。
AI.method: 提出LongEmoBench基准，用于长视频中的情感理解与推理，覆盖从连续场景交互到复杂情节发展的渐进能力评估；并提出LongEmo记忆增强智能体框架：处理连续视频流构建事件记忆图，显式建模长程依赖并捕捉离散事件间的情感动态；给定问题后，从图中检索与查询相关的事件流，迭代整合多模态记忆与关系依赖，最终推理出答案。
AI.result: 对17种代表性方法的广泛评估显示，这些方法在长视频情感理解与推理上表现明显不足；相比之下，LongEmo取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明以事件为中心的记忆架构在长视频情感推理任务中具有显著有效性，LongEmo验证了该架构的优越性，为长程情感计算提供了新思路。

title: The Effect of Tissue Detection on False Positives of Diffusion-Based Artifact Detection in Histopathology
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, including supplementary material. Code, data and models: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23016733
summary: One-class artifact detectors for whole-slide images learn normal tissue from a clean training pool and flag departures from it. The pool is built by a preprocessing pipeline whose tissue-detection step is usually treated as neutral. We tested whether it is. On 16 annotated slides from The Cancer Genome Atlas, we rebuilt the clean pool of a diffusion-based detector with different tissue detection methods and compared the resulting models in a four-fold cross-validation. Per-slide saturation-Otsu detection excluded normal tissue, chiefly tissue with large clear spaces such as adipose tissue and alveolar parenchyma, and on slides with thick marker ink kept the ink while excluding ordinary tissue. Replacing it with entropy-based detection reduced the false-positive fraction on held-out clean slides from 0.102 to 0.016, in every fold and with a second training seed, without loss of sensitivity; the gain came from the composition of the pool, not its size. Across three tissue detection methods, false positives followed the fraction of such clear-space tissue in the pool, a statistic that needs no labels or training (0.103, 0.016 and 0.009). The effect did not carry over at the same size to a nearest-neighbour detector on foundation-model features. On an external cohort, the curated pool lowered clean-control false positives by about 20%, far less than on the development slides, and the remaining cross-center loss was not explained by stain differences. For one-class quality control, tissue detection decides what the model learns as normal and should be chosen and reported accordingly.

AI.tldr: 组织检测步骤并非中性：饱和-Otsu法会剔除含大透明腔隙的正常组织（脂肪、肺泡实质），污染"干净"训练池，使扩散型单类伪影检测器的假阳性升高；改用熵检测法可将留出干净切片上的假阳性比例由0.102降至0.016，且不损失敏感性。
AI.motivation: 单类伪影检测器需从"干净训练池"学习正常组织分布，而该池由预处理流水线构建，其中的组织检测步骤通常被视为中性、不被关注。作者要检验这一假设是否成立，即组织检测方法的选择是否决定了模型"何为正常"。
AI.method: 在TCGA的16张标注全切片图像上，用不同组织检测方法重建基于扩散模型的检测器的干净池，进行四折交叉验证；对比饱和-Otsu与熵检测，并更换第二个训练种子；另测试三种组织检测方法下的假阳性与池中"透明腔隙组织"比例的关系；在基础模型特征上训练最近邻检测器作为对照；并在外部队列上评估清洗后池的效果。
AI.result: 饱和-Otsu检测会排除正常组织（尤其是脂肪、肺泡实质等含大透明腔隙的组织），在有厚标记墨迹的切片上还会保留墨迹而排除普通组织。改用熵检测后，留出干净切片上的假阳性比例从0.102降至0.016，在所有折与第二个种子下均成立，敏感性无损失；增益来自池的组成而非大小。三种方法下假阳性分别为0.103、0.016、0.009，与池中透明腔隙组织比例一致，该统计量无需标签或训练。该效应在同等规模下未迁移至基础模型特征的最近邻检测器。外部队列中，清洗池使干净对照假阳性下降约20%，远小于开发切片上的效果，残余跨中心损失不能用染色差异解释。
AI.conclusion: 对于单类质量控制，组织检测决定了模型学习到的"正常"含义，应作为设计变量审慎选择并明确报告，而非当作中性预处理。假阳性由训练池中透明腔隙组织的占比驱动，该占比可作为无需标注的诊断指标。

title: GateSPINE: Gated Cross-View Fusion for Lumbar Spine MRI Report Generation
summary: Automated report generation can ease the burden radiolo gists face when interpreting multi-sequence MRI studies. Unlike CT, MRI examinations comprise multiple sequences and imaging planes, each con tributing complementary diagnostic information. Existing methods en code a study as a single volume and combine multiple acquisitions by fixed rules. Findings visible in only one plane are thus diluted and of ten missed, lowering recall on clinical efficacy metrics, where a missed abnormality is most costly. We propose GateSPINE, a vision-language framework that fuses sagittal T1 and T2 volumes with a training-free operator, encodes the fused sagittal and axial volumes with two parallel 3D encoders, and decodes their combined representation into a report. Its core mechanism is a gated cross view fusion module that predicts, per feature channel and token, how much of each view to admit, so the more informative view dominates at each spatial location. We evaluate GateSPINE on three lumbar MRI datasets, comprising two public bench marks and a private cohort collected from Phenikaa University Hospital, using both natural language generation (NLG) and clinical efficacy (CE) metrics. GateSPINE achieves the highest CE F1 through improved re call on all three datasets; on SPIDER, which lacks an axial sequence, this reflects the sagittal fusion component rather than the gated cross-view mechanism, which is validated on the two cohorts with both imaging planes. GateSPINE also remains competitive on standard NLG metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出 GateSPINE 视觉-语言框架，融合腰椎 MRI 的矢状位 T1/T2 与轴位多序列多平面信息，通过门控跨视角融合模块按通道与 token 自适应分配各视角权重，生成放射报告，在三个腰椎 MRI 数据集上取得最高临床效能 F1。
AI.motivation: MRI 检查包含多序列、多成像平面，各提供互补诊断信息；现有方法将检查编码为单一体积并用固定规则组合多次采集，导致仅在某平面可见的病灶被稀释而漏检，在"漏诊代价最高"的临床效能指标上召回率偏低。自动化报告生成可减轻放射科医师解读多序列 MRI 的负担。
AI.method: GateSPINE 采用视觉-语言框架：以无训练（training-free）算子融合矢状位 T1 与 T2 体积；用两个并行 3D 编码器分别编码融合后的矢状位与轴位体积；将联合表示解码为报告。核心机制为门控跨视角融合（gated cross-view fusion）模块，逐特征通道、逐 token 预测每个视角的接纳程度，使信息量更大的视角在对应空间位置占主导。
AI.result: 在三个腰椎 MRI 数据集（两个公开基准与 Phenikaa 大学医院收集的私有队列）上，以自然语言生成（NLG）指标和临床效能（CE）指标评估。GateSPINE 在三个数据集上均通过提升召回率取得最高 CE F1；在缺少轴位序列的 SPIDER 上，该提升来自矢状位融合组件而非门控跨视角机制，后者在同时具备两种成像平面的两个队列上得到验证；在标准 NLG 指标上亦保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 门控跨视角融合可有效保留特定平面独有的诊断信息、提升临床效能召回与 F1；但需区分矢状位融合与门控跨视角机制的各自贡献，后者的有效性需在兼具矢状位和轴位平面的数据上验证。

title: AutoDataBench: A Data-centric Testbed for Accelerating Auto Research
summary: Existing auto-research benchmarks often entangle multiple sources of improvement, including training frameworks, hyperparameters, compute budgets, and data, making it difficult to attribute why one frontier agent outperforms another to specific research capabilities. In this work, we isolate and systematically evaluate Data Intelligence: an agent's ability to understand, manipulate, and improve the data that shapes model capabilities. We introduce AutoDataBench, a controlled testbed built on a conceptual framework of data intelligence spanning data diagnosis, data organization, and data construction, instantiated through three highly curated optimization tasks while holding non-data factors fixed. Across tool use, retrieval, and knowledge injection, we evaluate frontier LLMs' ability to improve training data through iterative experimentation under task-specific resource budgets. Beyond optimization performance, we ask: do LLMs understand what their data interventions do? We compare predictions made before training with observed outcomes to seek evidence of data-effect reasoning beyond trial and error, and explore whether iterative feedback helps LLMs better understand how changes to training data affect model performance. Finally, we show that reusing AutoDataBench trajectories for mid-training improves downstream coding performance, highlighting its value in both evaluating data intelligence and generating high-quality training data. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoDataBench，在固定非数据因素的前提下，将"数据智能"（理解、操纵、改进训练数据的能力）从多种改进来源中隔离出来，系统评估前沿LLM的数据诊断、组织与构造能力。
AI.motivation: 现有自动研究（auto-research）基准将训练框架、超参数、算力预算和数据等多种改进来源混杂在一起，难以归因某个前沿智能体优于另一个究竟源于何种研究能力。作者希望单独、系统地评估其中与数据相关的核心能力。
AI.method: 提出概念框架，将数据智能划分为数据诊断、数据组织、数据构造三个维度；据此构建受控测试平台AutoDataBench，实例化为三个精心设计的优化任务，并固定非数据因素。在工具使用、检索、知识注入三类场景下，评估前沿LLM在任务特定资源预算内通过迭代实验改进训练数据的能力；同时对比"训练前的预测"与"实际观测结果"，检验其是否具备超越试错的数据效应推理能力，并探究迭代反馈能否帮助LLM更好理解数据改动对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 在受控设置下完成了对前沿LLM数据智能的评估，并获得了其优化表现与数据效应推理（预测-观测一致性）的证据；此外，复用AutoDataBench的轨迹进行mid-training可提升下游编码性能。
AI.conclusion: AutoDataBench既能用于评估LLM的数据智能，又能生成高质量训练数据，具备双重价值。代码与资源已开源（https://github.com/AutoDataBench/AutoDataBench）。

title: JuryFlow: Disagreement-Guided Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Evaluation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. To appear in Proceedings of the 14th International Conference on Human-Agent Interaction (HAI '26), November 16-19, 2026, Osaka, Japan
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated judges for AI-generated content, yet a single judge is unreliable and even a panel of judges leaves a hard residue: when judges disagree, majority voting discards the conflict instead of resolving it. We present JuryFlow, a disagreement-guided, human-in-the-loop multi-agent evaluation framework that treats inter-judge disagreement not as noise to be averaged away, but as a precise, claim-level signal indicating where an evaluation is uncertain. JuryFlow decomposes each candidate response into atomic claims, has a panel of heterogeneous judges assign per-claim verdicts, and builds a disagreement graph whose nodes are scored by verdict entropy and whose edges encode structural similarity between claims. A human acts as a structural guide, selecting which disagreement to resolve through a single, minimal intervention rather than re-labeling the response, after which the focal claim is re-evaluated, the correction propagates along graph edges and to historically similar cases, and is crystallized into reusable rubric entries that all judges inherit, making the evaluator progressively self-refining. To enable large-scale, reproducible benchmarking without human studies, we evaluate JuryFlow in an automatic configuration in which focal selection is made by entropy ranking. On MT-Bench and LLMBar, JuryFlow improves agreement with gold labels over single-judge and majority-vote panel baselines, and ablations isolate the contributions of disagreement-targeted re-evaluation, propagation, and rubric induction. We contribute (1) a human-in-the-loop paradigm that recasts the human from labeler to structural guide, (2) the JuryFlow framework operationalizing it through a disagreement graph, focal re-evaluation, and closed-loop rubric induction, and (3) an evaluation protocol with ablations that isolate where the gains originate.

AI.tldr: 提出JuryFlow——一种以分歧为引导、人在回路的多智能体评估框架，将评委间分歧视为claim级的精确不确定性信号而非待平均的噪声，通过分歧图、焦点重评与闭环规则归纳实现自精炼评估。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作AI生成内容的自动评委，但单一评委不可靠，多评委面板亦存在"硬残留"问题：当评委产生分歧时，多数投票直接丢弃冲突而非解决冲突，导致评估不确定性无法被有效消解。
AI.method: JuryFlow将候选回答分解为原子claim，由异构评委面板给出逐claim裁决；构建分歧图，节点以裁决熵评分、边编码claim间结构相似性。人类作为"结构引导者"，通过单次最小干预选择需解决的分歧（而非重新标注），随后焦点claim被重评，修正沿图边传播并扩散至历史相似案例，最终固化为所有评委共享的可复用评分规则，使评估器渐进自精炼。为支持大规模可复现基准测试，论文采用由熵排序进行焦点选择的自动配置进行评估。
AI.result: 在MT-Bench与LLMBar上，JuryFlow相较单评委与多数投票面板基线，提升了与金标标签的一致性；消融实验分离出分歧靶向重评、传播与规则归纳各自的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献三点：(1)人在回路新范式，将人类从标注者转变为结构引导者；(2)通过分歧图、焦点重评与闭环规则归纳实现该范式的JuryFlow框架；(3)含消融实验的评估协议，可定位增益来源。

title: OverdoseMoE: A Multi-Expert Framework for Opioid Overdose Risk Prediction
summary: Opioid overdose remains a major clinical and public health burden, highlighting the need for scalable approaches to identify patients at high risk. Here, we investigate diagnosis-specific adaptation for 180-day opioid overdose risk prediction from patients' preceding one-year longitudinal ICD histories. We develop OODMAMBA and OODQWEN through continued pretraining on longitudinal diagnostic sequences followed by task-specific fine-tuning. Building on the stronger Qwen-based predictors, we further propose OVERDOSEMOE, a multi-expert framework that integrates models of different scales using complementary expert-weighting strategies. Diagnosis-specific adaptation consistently improved predictive performance over general-purpose language-model baselines, with OODQWEN achieving an AUPRC of 24.47 and an AUROC of 68.56. OVERDOSEMOE further improved discrimination and precision, achieving an AUPRC of 25.17 and an AUROC of 69.49 while outperforming the strongest single-model baselines. Among patients ranked in the top 5% of predicted risk, OVERDOSEMOE identified substantially enriched overdose risk, achieving a PPV of 25.38% while retaining meaningful recall. Evaluation on an independent MIMIC-IV cohort further demonstrated cross-cohort robustness, with complementary weighting strategies showing advantages across different performance measures. These findings demonstrate that diagnosis-specific language-model adaptation combined with multi-expert integration can improve opioid overdose risk stratification and support more robust prediction across heterogeneous electronic health record populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于纵向ICD历史进行180天阿片类药物过量风险预测，提出诊断特异性的语言模型适配方法（OODMAMBA、OODQWEN）及多专家集成框架（OVERDOSEMOE），在预测性能与跨队列稳健性上优于通用语言模型基线。
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物过量仍是重大临床与公共卫生负担，亟需可扩展的高风险患者识别方法。现有通用语言模型在利用患者纵向诊断序列进行特定任务风险预测时可能存在适配不足的问题。
AI.method: 基于患者前一年的纵向ICD诊断序列，采用继续预训练加任务特异性微调的方式，构建OODMAMBA与OODQWEN两个诊断特异性预测模型；在性能较强的Qwen基模型之上，提出OVERDOSEMOE多专家框架，通过互补的专家加权策略整合不同规模的模型。
AI.result: 诊断特异性适配一致优于通用语言模型基线。OODQWEN达到AUPRC 24.47、AUROC 68.56；OVERDOSEMOE进一步提升至AUPRC 25.17、AUROC 69.49，优于最强单模型基线。在预测风险排名前5%的患者中，OVERDOSEMOE的PPV达25.38%，风险显著富集且保持有意义的召回率。在独立MIMIC-IV队列上验证了跨队列稳健性，不同加权策略在各性能指标上各有优势。
AI.conclusion: 诊断特异性语言模型适配结合多专家集成可改善阿片类药物过量风险分层，并在异构电子健康记录人群中实现更稳健的预测。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出智能体错误数据集（AED）与五阶段"智能体错误到训练"（AET）流程，将失败轨迹转化为可复用的诊断与修正监督信号，并在诊断与行动恢复训练上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 失败的LLM智能体rollout中包含大量未被最终奖励反映的信息——观测、动作与环境响应。要利用这些经验学习，必须定位需要修正的决策并验证具体的替代方案，而现有工作缺乏系统化的错误诊断数据与训练转换方法。
AI.method: 构建AED数据集，含来自33个环境、19个harness家族、23个策略模型、9,961个源任务的50,228个错误-诊断对，并保留源轨迹与执行元数据。提出五阶段AET流水线：收集自然失败、生成诊断与修正提案、依据记录证据核验、在支持replay时与同检查点原始动作重试在匹配执行设置下比较，最后为诊断与actor恢复构建独立训练视图。在3,062个匹配replay对上评估，并用冻结诊断发布对Qwen3-8B进行全诊断微调。
AI.result: 3,062个匹配replay对中，首次提案修正将验证器通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7个百分点）。在943例holdout上，全诊断微调使Qwen3-8B与内部教师标注的精确步一致率从47.2%升至63.6%（三个随机种子平均），超过最强提示参考的54.7%，且在四种递增训练集规模下均提升。单种子actor训练对比中，仅动作修复训练在WebShop-lite上比仅成功训练高6.67个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 失败rollout经系统化诊断与修正核验后可转化为有效监督信号；诊断训练显著提升模型对错误步的定位能力，动作修复训练优于仅用成功轨迹训练，AED与AET为跨设置失败分析与免重复rollout的再诊断提供了基础设施。

title: Persistent Context Graphs for Efficient Memory Compaction in LLM Agents
summary: As LLM capabilities advance, agents are tackling increasingly complex tasks over longer horizons. Their growing interaction histories make memory compaction essential for staying within context windows and reducing prefill cost. Existing methods summarize the history or compress its KV cache, often adding model computation to preserve information for future requests. A new user request can change which history matters, but reassessing that history with the model requires re-encoding it if the KV cache has expired. Past attention provides signals of historical importance and dependencies between messages, while relevance to the current task must be assessed using the new user request. We introduce ReCAP, a memory compaction method that stores attention-derived importance scores and dependency links in a lightweight, persistent context graph. For each new request, ReCAP combines stored importance with relevance cues from the request and follows dependency links to select messages and their supporting context, without additional model calls for selection. Compared with Codex's default summarization-based compaction, ReCAP reduces estimated latency for compaction and cold restoration by approximately 95% on both Qwen3-Coder and gpt-oss. It also roughly halves the historical context per call on SWE-Together at comparable task quality and improves accuracy on the code tasks of Lost-in-Conversation over full history by 19.8 and 41.2 points.

AI.tldr: ReCAP 提出一种基于注意力派生重要性分数与依赖链接的轻量持久上下文图的记忆压缩方法，在新请求到来时结合存储重要性与请求相关性线索选择消息，无需额外模型调用，显著降低压缩与冷恢复延迟并提升代码任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 能力提升，智能体面临更长时程、更复杂的任务，交互历史不断增长，使得记忆压缩成为维持在上下文窗口内并降低 prefill 成本的关键。现有方法通过摘要历史或压缩 KV cache 来实现，但往往需要额外模型计算以保留未来请求所需信息。新用户请求会改变哪些历史重要，而若 KV cache 已过期，用模型重新评估历史就必须重新编码。因此需要一种无需额外模型调用即可动态评估历史重要性的压缩方法。
AI.method: ReCAP 存储由注意力导出的重要性分数与依赖链接，构建轻量、持久的上下文图（context graph）。对每个新请求，ReCAP 将存储的重要性与来自请求的相关性线索相结合，并沿依赖链接选择消息及其支撑上下文，选择过程不产生额外模型调用。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Coder 与 gpt-oss 上，相比 Codex 默认的基于摘要的压缩，ReCAP 将压缩与冷恢复的估计延迟降低约 95%。在 SWE-Together 上，在任务质量相当的情况下将每次调用的历史上下文大致减半。在 Lost-in-Conversation 的代码任务上，相比完整历史，准确率分别提升 19.8 和 41.2 个点。
AI.conclusion: ReCAP 通过注意力派生的重要性与依赖图实现高效记忆压缩，在不牺牲任务质量的前提下大幅降低延迟与上下文开销，并在代码任务上显著优于全历史基线。

title: On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables, accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了AMR增强提升LLM下游性能的工作，发现在统一超参协议下纯文本基线不劣于AMR增强模型，并通过困惑度探针证明AMR未提供额外关系知识。
AI.motivation: AMR在历史上提升了多种NLP任务表现，但对现代LLM而言AMR增强是否有益尚不明确。近期工作报告了显著的下游增益，作者希望验证其可靠性并厘清增益来源。
AI.method: 采用统一、一致的超参数选择协议复现已有AMR增强实验；提出基于困惑度（perplexity）的探针，量化AMR为LLM提供的补充关系知识程度。
AI.result: 在统一协议下，纯文本基线持续匹配或超过AMR增强模型；困惑度探针显示AMR增强并未帮助LLM更好地理解句中的关系性内容。
AI.conclusion: 此前报告的AMR增强下游增益很可能源于实验设置中的特定选择，而非AMR本身的贡献；用AMR增强LLM在下游任务上并无明显收益。

title: Debias It Yourself: Teaching LLMs Cognitive Bias Mitigation Interventions
summary: Bias has long been studied in social psychology and cognitive science, where decades of research have produced a body of validated interventions that reduce stereotypical thinking and prejudiced responses in humans. We propose Debias It Yourself (DIY), a cognitively grounded framework that translates five such interventions into debiasing procedures for large language models and delivers them through three established paradigms: Show (in-context examples), Train (instruction tuning), and Revise (guided self-revision). Across three models, five bias benchmarks, eleven debiasing baselines, and three reasoning benchmarks, Train+Revise and Revise alone attain the top two average ranks, lead the bias-reasoning tradeoff (mean bias as low as 2% at 90% reasoning accuracy), and reduce bias on unseen dimensions by up to 14.8%. Our code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Debias It Yourself（DIY）框架，将社会心理学与认知科学中经过验证的五种去偏干预方法转化为大语言模型的去偏流程，并通过Show（上下文示例）、Train（指令微调）、Revise（引导式自我修正）三种范式实现。
AI.motivation: 社会心理学和认知科学领域数十年研究已积累了大量可降低人类刻板印象思维与偏见反应的有效干预方法，但如何将这些认知科学成果迁移到大语言模型去偏中仍缺乏系统框架。作者希望弥合这一空白，以认知理论为基础构建可操作的模型去偏方案。
AI.method: 作者提出DIY（Debias It Yourself）框架，将五种认知科学去偏干预方法转译为针对大语言模型的处理流程，并通过三种成熟范式实现：Show（在上下文示例中展示）、Train（指令微调）和Revise（引导式自我修正）。实验在三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线和三个推理基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 在三个模型、五个偏见基准、十一个去偏基线和三个推理基准上，Train+Revise与单独Revise取得了最高的两个平均排名，在偏见—推理权衡中处于领先（平均偏见低至2%，同时保持90%的推理准确率），并将未见维度上的偏见最多降低14.8%。
AI.conclusion: DIY框架表明，源自认知科学的去偏干预可有效迁移至大语言模型，其中Train+Revise与Revise范式在降低偏见与保持推理能力之间取得最佳平衡，并能泛化到未见偏见维度。代码与数据已公开。

title: Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression
summary: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses. We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end. Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector. All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen. Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved. After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor. In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values. Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases. At -70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline. The factorized model decodes up to 1.6x faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5x at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5x for untied baseline factorizations.

AI.tldr: 提出可学习子空间投影（LSP），端到端学习各线性层（或共享激活的绑定层组）应丢弃的子空间，将投影器合并为标准低秩因子，在LLM与ViT上大幅压缩时性能优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩权重分解方法采用局部闭式准则（激活能量、逐层重构误差、损失的二次近似）选择舍弃子空间，忽略误差在网络中的传播，高压缩率下误差随深度累积导致性能崩溃。
AI.method: 为每个线性层或读取相同激活的绑定层组分配正交投影器，预训练权重冻结，所有投影器针对全局目标（对稠密模型输出分布的KL散度或原训练损失）联合优化；投影器以白化SVD截断初始化，秩按"每个投影器单位节省参数所诱导的输出KL"分配；训练后将投影器合并为标准低秩因子，绑定组共享一个因子；注意力中可缓存单一窄潜向量替代完整K、V。
AI.result: 在OPT-125M/1.3B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-2-7B及ViT-B/16上均优于基线，压缩率越高优势越明显。压缩-70%时Llama-2-7B达10.9 WikiText-2困惑度、42.2%平均零样本准确率（最强基线为13.3与36.0%）。小批量下解码最高快1.6倍；缓存共享潜向量使128k上下文下权重与KV缓存总内存降低13.5倍（非绑定基线分解至多6.5倍）。
AI.conclusion: 端到端学习低秩子空间可有效缓解高压缩下的误差累积，兼顾性能与推理效率，并在注意力KV缓存压缩上有额外收益。

title: VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning
summary: Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains. Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an $11.33\%$ relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VR-JEPA框架，通过局部对比状态学习和技能专家适配V-JEPA预测器，用其潜在轨迹引导视频生成，提升视觉推理的逻辑一致性与物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型缺乏对视觉状态应如何演化的显式引导，导致生成轨迹易出现物理与结构不一致，损害推理可靠性；而V-JEPA虽提供丰富的时空先验，却难以自然适配复杂视觉任务所需的逻辑推理能力。
AI.method: 提出VR-JEPA：(i)在相同输入条件下配对成功轨迹与生成替代轨迹，利用二者V-JEPA表示的差异识别信息量高的状态与token，进行局部对比监督；(ii)为V-JEPA预测器配备在锚任务数据上训练的技能专属专家，使其共享时空先验能跨认知域自适应特化；二者结合使预测轨迹为视频生成提供任务特定逻辑引导。
AI.result: 在大型VBVR-Pro-Bench数据集上，VR-JEPA相较前沿的基于生成的推理基线取得11.33%的相对提升，显著减少物理伪影并增强逻辑一致性。
AI.conclusion: 对齐V-JEPA预测器与任务特定推理逻辑可有效引导视频生成，为视觉推理提供可靠的潜在轨迹级逻辑指导。

title: Toward Controlling Biology with Language:Offline Learning of Prompt-Conditioned Interventions for Cells, Organoids, and Biobots
summary: Artificial intelligence increasingly serves as a natural-language interface to complex technical systems, letting people accomplish sophisticated tasks by describing what they want rather than specifying how to do it. Extending this interface to living systems is harder: unlike code or images, a biological intervention has no closed-form linguistic meaning, and the paired language-intervention-outcome data needed to learn such a mapping is expensive to collect, since each example requires its own wet-lab experiment. One way around this is to treat an existing archive of interventions and their already-observed outcomes as a fixed, offline dataset, and use a vision-language model to judge, without any new experiments, whether an archived outcome matches a natural-language description. But whether that judgment is reliable enough to train a language-to-intervention mapping on -- without new experiments and without human validation -- has remained unclear. Here we show that a natural-language interface for a living organism -- a xenobot, a synthetic multicellular construct with no nervous system -- can be learned entirely offline this way, using a vision-language model's own judgment as the sole training reward: an instruction is mapped to the intervention already on record as producing the described behavior. This mapping generalizes to entirely new instructions, evaluated against archive data withheld from training (80.0% held-out accuracy vs a $66.7% chance baseline, matching a network trained directly on ground-truth labels).

AI.tldr: 该研究证明：以视觉-语言模型对已归档干预-结果数据的"判断"作为唯一训练奖励，可在完全离线、无需新实验和人工验证的条件下，为无神经系统的合成生物体（xenobot）学得自然语言到生物干预的映射，并泛化到新指令（留出准确率80.0%，随机基线66.7%）。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言界面扩展到生命系统面临双重困难：一是生物干预缺乏像代码或图像那样的封闭式语言语义；二是学习"语言-干预-结果"映射所需配对数据必须依靠湿实验逐例采集，成本高昂。因此需要一种无需新实验、无需人工标注即可获得训练信号的替代路径。
AI.method: 将已有干预及其已观测结果的档案视为固定的离线数据集；使用视觉-语言模型对"归档结果是否匹配自然语言描述"进行判断，并以该判断作为唯一的训练奖励，训练语言到干预的映射（即将指令映射到记录中已被证明产生所描述行为的干预）。
AI.result: 该映射可泛化到全新指令；在训练时留出的档案数据上评估，留出准确率为80.0%，随机基线为66.7%，与直接用真值标签训练的网络表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 即使判断未经人工验证，视觉-语言模型的自动判断也足以作为可靠训练奖励，从而在完全离线条件下为活体系统（xenobot）建立自然语言接口。

title: Prototype-Rule Neurosymbolic Regularization for Rank-Constrained Tensor Neural Networks under Label Scarcity
summary: Rank-constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high-order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype-rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit arises from training-time regularization, whereas inference fusion is small and dataset dependent.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Rank-R张量网络中引入可微原型规则作为互补归纳偏置，通过训练期正则化与可选的推理期证据融合，提升有限监督下的高光谱分类性能。
AI.motivation: Rank-R张量神经网络虽能降低高阶输入的参数化规模，但并未在学习到的表示中显式约束类几何结构；作者希望探究可微原型规则能否为有限监督下的Rank-R张量学习提供互补的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 在Rank-R目标函数中加入基于原型的正则化，并在推理阶段可选地将原型证据与神经网络的logits进行融合。在四个高光谱基准数据集上，使用四种Rank-R配置，分别在七折分层划分与缓解泄漏的空间分离折下评估；另设空间实验将类支持预算从2变化到20个样本。
AI.result: 在空间评估下，完整神经符号推理使Macro-F1在Botswana上提升+8.82个百分点，Indian Pines上+5.49，Pavia University上+1.59，Salinas上-0.62。大部分收益来自训练期正则化，推理融合带来的提升较小且依赖具体数据集。
AI.conclusion: 可微原型规则能为Rank-R张量学习提供有效的互补归纳偏置，其中训练期正则化是主要收益来源；推理期融合效果有限且具数据集依赖性，说明原型约束的价值主要体现在表示学习阶段。

title: Index-Translate: A Multilingual Translation Model Family -- Text, Speech, Controlled Dubbing, and Long-Document Translation
comment: 29 pages. Project: https://index-translate.bilibili.com ; Code and models: https://github.com/bilibili/Index-Translate
summary: We introduce Index-Translate, a multilingual translation model family that combines a shared multilingual foundation with specialized training for general translation, instruction following, speech translation, controlled dubbing, and long-document translation. It includes three model sizes, 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B, and supports translation in 150 languages, with multilingual instruction following. Evaluations on general translation and complex translation instructions show that Index-Translate outperforms translation models of comparable size and achieves performance comparable to 100B-scale translation models and frontier models. Image-text evaluation shows that translation remains possible without image examples in Index-Translate-specific training, although results vary by model size. Index-Echo provides end-to-end speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, outperforming existing end-to-end models and achieving performance comparable to frontier omni models. Index-Homura extends the family to syllable-controlled dubbing. Index-NativeLong introduces native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These capabilities support diverse translation tasks, including multilingual content production.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Index-Translate 多语言翻译模型家族，包含 2B、9B、35B-A3B 三种规模，支持 150 种语言，并扩展出语音翻译（Index-Echo）、音节可控配音（Index-Homura）和长文档翻译（Index-NativeLong）等专门能力。
AI.motivation: 构建一个统一的多语言翻译基础，并在此基础上针对通用翻译、指令遵循、语音翻译、配音控制和长文档翻译等多样化任务进行专门训练，以满足多语言内容生产等实际翻译需求。
AI.method: 以共享多语言基座结合专用训练，形成 Index-Translate 模型家族；分三种参数规模（2B、9B、35B-A3B）；支持 150 种语言与多语言指令遵循；并分别通过 Index-Echo 实现端到端语音到文本及语音到语音翻译，Index-Homura 实现音节可控配音，Index-NativeLong 提出长文档翻译的任务定义与评测基准。
AI.result: 通用翻译与复杂翻译指令评测中，Index-Translate 优于同规模翻译模型，性能可与 100B 级翻译模型及前沿模型相比；图文评测显示，即使训练中不含图像样例，翻译仍然可行，但结果随模型规模变化；Index-Echo 优于现有端到端模型，性能可比前沿全能模型。
AI.conclusion: 该模型家族覆盖通用翻译、语音翻译、配音和长文档翻译等能力，可支持包括多语言内容生产在内的多样化翻译任务。

title: Provably Tractable NFA-Constrained Language Generation via HMMs
summary: Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length-$n$ sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that #NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NFA-LM，一个在温和假设下具有理论保证的多项式时间 NFA 约束生成引擎，可高效生成高质量且近似误差有界的输出。
AI.motivation: 现有针对非确定性有限自动机（NFA）约束的受约束生成技术要么扭曲分布，要么牺牲效率；同时该任务理论上可归约为 #NFA 计数问题，而精确 #NFA 是 #P-完全的，因此需要兼顾分布正确性与效率的新方法。
AI.method: 受 #NFA 存在全多项式随机近似方案（FPRAS）这一结果的启发，作者设计了 NFA-LM，一个多项式时间的 NFA 约束生成引擎，并给出在温和假设下的理论保证。
AI.result: 实验表明，NFA-LM 能高效生成高质量输出，且近似误差具有理论界。
AI.conclusion: NFA-LM 通过近似计数的方式，在效率与分布保真度之间取得平衡，为 NFA 约束生成提供了具有理论保证的可行方案。

title: Cheap to Draw, Expensive to Trust: Certifying Test-Time Scaling Curves
summary: Sampling several answers and keeping the one a verifier scores highest is one of the simplest ways to buy accuracy at test time. Its effect is reported as a scaling curve: accuracy against the number $k$ of sampled answers. The curve is cheap to draw and expensive to trust. A budget read off it is chosen after looking at every point, so only a band that covers all budgets at once protects the choice, and on a 100-question benchmark a fixed exact-binomial design needs 192,000 generated answers to certify 64 budgets to within $\pm1/32$ at 95%. Most of that cost pays for the wrong uncertainty. A benchmark is a fixed list of questions; at budget 64, about three quarters of the variance of a selected answer's correctness lies between questions, and an audit that revisits every question need not pay for it. We derive the minimax cost of certifying the whole curve, up to logarithmic factors. It has three parts: calibrating the tail of the score distribution, telling the questions apart, and within-question noise summed along the curve. At a single benchmark the last part sharpens to the variance of one answer's influence under the best allocation of answers to questions, which every valid audit pays and an audit that learns the allocation attains, up to a logarithm, as the precision grows. A paired audit built on an exponential inequality for two independent draws at the same question needs no pilot. On 185 held-out score pools it uses 0.74 times the answers of the cheapest competing certified audit at 64 budgets and 0.53 times at 1,024, and on a newly generated MMLU-Pro study it certified the curve with 79,133 answers, within 0.6% of what a cost law fitted beforehand predicted from the study's within-question variance. The same paths certify pass@$k$ and majority voting, and the bands extend to populations of questions and to answers that depend on earlier ones.

AI.tldr: 本文将「采样k个答案并由验证器选最优」的测试时缩放曲线认证问题形式化，推导出认证整条曲线所需的最小最大（minimax）成本，并给出一种只需两次同题独立采样即可实现的无试点配对审计方法。
AI.motivation: 缩放曲线（准确率 vs 采样数k）虽然绘制便宜，但要在看完所有点后再选定预算，就必须用能同时覆盖所有预算的置信带才能保证选择有效。传统固定精确二项设计在100题基准上认证64个预算需生成192,000个答案，大部分开销花在了错误的不确定性来源上：基准是固定问题列表，预算64时约四分之三的方差来自问题之间，逐题审计（paired audit）无需为此付费。
AI.method: 作者推导认证整条曲线的最小最大成本（忽略对数因子），分解为三部分：分数分布尾部校准、问题间区分、以及沿曲线的题内噪声求和。在单一基准下，第三部分精化为「最优答案-问题分配下单个答案影响力的方差」，这是任何有效审计都必须支付的代价，而学习到该分配的审计（至多差一个对数因子）可达到该下界。据此提出基于两次同题独立采样指数不等式的配对审计，无需试点。
AI.result: 在185个留出分数池上，该方法在64个预算时仅用最便宜的竞争认证审计所需答案数的0.74倍，在1,024个预算时为0.53倍；在一个新生成的MMLU-Pro研究中，以79,133个答案认证了曲线，与事先基于题内方差拟合的成本定律预测值相差在0.6%以内。相同路径还可认证pass@k和多数投票，置信带可扩展至问题总体以及依赖先前答案的答案。
AI.conclusion: 配对审计通过利用问题间方差可被复用消除的结构，显著降低了认证测试时缩放曲线的采样成本，并达到（至多对数因子的）minimax最优。该方法统一适用于贪心采样、pass@k与多数投票等场景，并可扩展至更一般的答案依赖设定。

title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
summary: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, and retrievable memories. MemOpt consistently improves MemLife by 2.7--5.0% across different video and question distributions, with gains that generalize across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemLife多模态记忆系统及MemOpt强化学习优化框架，通过构建实体锚定的第一人称文本情节并用时间索引智能体检索器定位，实现高效长时程自我中心视频记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 长时程自我中心视频可支撑个性化AI助手进行日常生活推理，但当视频历史累积至数百小时、跨越数月甚至数年时，对每条查询重新处理原始片段在计算上难以承受。已有记忆系统虽以文本压缩视频实现可扩展性，但在实际基准上表现不佳：要么记忆未保留关键证据，要么因不断增长的检索空间中存在检索竞争而导致检索器无法定位相关条目。
AI.method: MemLife是一种多模态记忆系统，构建实体锚定、第一人称的文本情节，并通过时间索引的智能体式阅读器进行检索，无需训练、也无需查询时访问视频。在此基础上提出MemOpt强化学习框架，优化记忆写入器，使其产生忠实、信息丰富且可检索的记忆。
AI.result: MemLife在四个长时程基准上相比最强免训练基线提升4.6%–12.0%；MemOpt在不同视频与问题分布上稳定提升MemLife 2.7%–5.0%，且增益可跨写入器、阅读器骨干及记忆系统泛化。
AI.conclusion: 通过实体锚定的文本情节记忆与时间索引智能体检索，并借助强化学习优化记忆写入质量，可有效缓解长时程自我中心视频记忆中的证据保留与检索竞争问题，且具备良好的泛化性与实用性。

title: SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models
comment: Conducted during a 2024 internship at SCBX R&D
summary: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpeechConversationBench (SCB)，基于 103 个分片 GSM8K 数学题，评估语音对话系统在多轮增量披露条件下的口语数学推理能力，并比较四种商用语音系统与自研 LEGO 流水线。
AI.motivation: 语音到语音系统的任务需求往往在多轮对话中逐步显现，而现有评测多集中于单轮或一次性输入，难以区分"问题改写敏感性"与"增量口语交互带来的额外困难"。
AI.method: 构建 SCB 框架，对 GSM8K 问题进行分片（sharding），设置三种条件：full（单轮完整呈现原题）、concat（分片信息合并后一次性呈现）、sharded（跨轮次增量口语披露）。以最终答案准确率为指标，评测四种商用语音系统及内部自研 LEGO 语音流水线（含显式对话上下文管理）。
AI.result: 相较于 concat，四种商用系统在 sharded 条件下准确率下降 5.0–25.3 个百分点。LEGO 在三种条件下均达到 77.5% 准确率，GPT-4o Realtime 在 sharded 条件下为 76.6%。
AI.conclusion: 增量口语交互本身构成独立挑战，并非仅由问题改写引起；显式对话上下文管理可有效缓解该性能衰减。

title: Recognition of Urbanized Areas in UAV-Derived Very-High-Resolution Visible-Light Imagery
summary: This study compared classifiers that differentiate between urbanized and non-urbanized areas based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-acquired RGB imagery. The tested solutions in-cluded numerous vegetation indices (VIs) thresholding and neural networks (NNs). The analysis was conducted for two study areas for which surveys were carried out using different UAVs and cameras. The ground sampling distances for the study areas were 10 mm and 15 mm, respectively. Reference classification was performed manually, obtaining approximately 24 million classified pix-els for the first area and approximately 3.8 million for the second. This research study included an analysis of the impact of the season on the threshold values for the tested VIs and the impact of image patch size provided as inputs for the NNs on classification accuracy. The results of the con-ducted research study indicate a higher classification accuracy using NNs (about 96%) compared with the best of the tested VIs, i.e., Excess Blue (about 87%). Due to the highly imbalanced nature of the used datasets (non-urbanized areas constitute approximately 87% of the total datasets), the Mat-thews correlation coefficient was also used to assess the correctness of the classification. The analysis based on statistical measures was supplemented with a qualitative assessment of the classification results, which allowed the identification of the most important sources of differences in classification between VIs thresholding and NNs.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于无人机RGB影像，比较了植被指数阈值法与神经网络在城市与非城市化区域分类中的表现，NNs精度约96%，优于最佳VI（Excess Blue，约87%）。
AI.motivation: 评估并比较植被指数阈值法与神经网络在无人机RGB影像中区分城市化与非城市化区域的适用性与精度，并考察季节和影像块大小等因素的影响。
AI.method: 在两个研究区使用不同无人机与相机采集RGB影像，地面采样距离分别为10 mm和15 mm；测试多种植被指数阈值化方法与神经网络，人工标注参考分类（第一区约2400万像素，第二区约380万像素），分析季节对VI阈值的影响及输入影像块大小对NN精度的影响。
AI.result: 神经网络分类精度约96%，高于最佳植被指数Excess Blue约87%；由于数据集高度不平衡（非城市化区域约占87%），同时采用马修斯相关系数评估；并结合定性分析识别两类方法分类差异的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络在城市与非城市化区域分类中优于植被指数阈值法，且统计指标与定性评估相结合可更全面揭示方法间差异来源。

title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The project code is available at https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED .

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作经验字典（AED），将历史动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入，以支持跨任务技能复用与语义关系建模，并引入运动感知转移损失抑制背景干扰，在仿真与真实跨本体设定中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）虽耦合视觉动态预测与动作生成，但未显式支持动作经验在多种操作任务间的复用；同时冗余背景元素干扰关键视觉信息提取，导致难以建模可指导目标动作预测的跨任务语义关系。
AI.method: 构建动作经验字典（AED），将历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享动作嵌入。先用预训练动作分词器聚合历史动作并与视觉观测对齐，从AED中检索动作嵌入；再通过交叉注意力对池化嵌入进行视觉条件化，并将其前置到含噪动作token，为预测提供交互上下文与动作意图。同时提出运动感知转移损失，在随机时间间隔上监督视觉特征变化预测。
AI.result: 在仿真基准与真实世界跨本体（cross-embodiment）设置上的实验验证了AED的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AED通过共享动作嵌入实现跨任务动作经验复用与语义关系建模，结合运动感知监督降低对无关背景线索的依赖，为世界动作模型的可复用动作预测提供可行方案。

title: PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds
summary: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 使用纯规则生成、零边际成本的虚拟世界环境（PhantomEnvironments）对 LLM 智能体进行多轮强化学习训练，所得搜索智能体可迁移到真实世界多跳搜索基准，甚至优于真实数据训练，并展现随问题难度线性扩展搜索预算的涌现能力。
AI.motivation: 训练 LLM 智能体的强化学习受制于环境：环境需提供可验证奖励、支持长程交互并能低成本扩展。现有方案依赖昂贵的人工标注数据，或依赖 LLM 生成环境，后者存在幻觉与基准污染风险。因此需要一个无需 LLM、零边际成本且可验证的替代环境来源。
AI.method: 构建 PhantomEnvironments：基于虚构世界的多轮 RL 环境，由纯规则生成、不涉及任何 LLM，零边际成本。智能体需在模板化文章语料中检索，以回答多跳问题。并通过对环境复杂度做消融（跳跃数、约束、比较等）分析迁移来源。
AI.result: 尽管与真实世界无任何事实共享，这些极简环境训练出的智能体可迁移到真实世界多跳搜索基准，在较新基准上常优于真实世界训练数据；可泛化到未见过的虚构宇宙；Qwen 模型学会让搜索预算随问题难度近似线性扩展，表明仅通过环境交互即可涌现搜索扩展能力。消融显示跳跃数对迁移的驱动作用大于约束或比较。
AI.conclusion: 规则生成的最简环境是一种意外有效且免费的资源，可用于训练具备可泛化搜索能力的 LLM 智能体；环境复杂度中跳数最关键。该范式规避了人工数据成本、LLM 生成环境的幻觉与污染问题。

title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://xiaji2021.github.io/LOCI/
summary: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LOCI，一种混合空间记忆架构，将键值缓存与递归线性注意力记忆结合，并引入投影相机几何作为读写条件，以在长视频世界中实现恒定内存下的高保真重访内容复现。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型在相机重访已观测区域时，应能复现已有的视觉内容，这要求模型既记住过去的观测，又能在当前视角下检索到正确的记忆。键值缓存能保留视觉细节但随视频长度增长；递归记忆虽紧凑，却将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，导致单个过去观测无法直接访问。因此需要一种同时保留两种表示的机制。
AI.method: LOCI 在部分 transformer 块中让主注意力保留过去观测的键值缓存；在其余块中将注意力限制在当前块，并由一个递归线性注意力记忆补充。该递归记忆的读写均以投影相机几何为条件，使视角同时参与记忆寻址与存储内容。递归读出结果流入后续缓存块，为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。
AI.result: 在公开 MIND 记忆基准和留存的录制轨迹上，LOCI 比代表性世界模型及同配方全 softmax 模型更忠实地复现重访内容；在完整历史下，同等长度时峰值内存较全 softmax 降低约 30%。在有限保留观测库下，它能以恒定内存流式处理长视频，并在同等预算下仍比全 softmax 更忠实。
AI.conclusion: LOCI 通过混合键值缓存与几何条件化的递归记忆，兼顾了视觉细节保留与紧凑历史压缩，在保持甚至提升重访复现质量的同时显著降低内存，并支持长视频的恒定内存流式处理。

title: EviRover: Reinforcing Agentic Perception Beyond a Glance
summary: Visual perception is conventionally formulated as a one-shot prediction from a single glance at the image, under the assumption that the image content and the model's parametric knowledge suffice to resolve the query. This assumption often fails in real-world scenarios that hinge on fine-grained visual details or require knowledge-intensive and up-to-date information. We term such cases \textit{perception under insufficient evidence} and formulate perception as an agentic process that can obtain information beyond a single glance. To address the absence of data for this setting, we design two dedicated data generation pipelines, yielding EviRover-SFT-5K and EviRover-RL-12K for training. We further construct EviLens, a human-verified benchmark comprising 688 instances across five perception categories. Building on these data, we present EviRover, to our knowledge the first perception agent explicitly trained to resolve perceptual queries through interaction, using supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning. Experiments show that the 4B EviRover outperforms its backbone by 30 points on average on EviLens, reaching performance comparable to advanced proprietary models. The gains transfer beyond EviLens to WebEyes, conventional perception benchmarks, and general multimodal benchmarks, including a 15-point improvement on BrowseComp-VL. All code, models, and data are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"证据不足下的感知"问题，将感知建模为可通过交互获取外部信息的智能体过程，构建数据管线与基准EviLens，并训练首个感知智能体EviRover。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉感知被设定为对图像的单次预测，假设图像内容与模型参数知识足以回答查询。但在依赖细粒度视觉细节或需要知识密集、时效性信息的真实场景中，该假设往往失效。
AI.method: 设计两条专用数据生成管线，产出EviRover-SFT-5K与EviRover-RL-12K；构建人工校验基准EviLens（688个实例，覆盖五类感知任务）；提出EviRover，通过监督微调与智能体强化学习显式训练以交互方式解决感知查询。
AI.result: 4B的EviRover在EviLens上平均超越其backbone 30分，性能接近先进闭源模型；增益可迁移至WebEyes、常规感知基准与通用多模态基准，其中BrowseComp-VL提升15分。
AI.conclusion: 将感知重构为主动获取证据的智能体过程可显著缓解单次预测范式的局限，且小规模模型经交互式训练即可达到接近闭源模型的感知表现，相关代码、模型与数据均已开源。

title: Distribution Matching Distillation for Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate all tokens in parallel, yet high-quality generation can still require hundreds of network evaluations (NFEs). We study how distributional distillation can reduce this cost by exploiting the student's probabilistic token outputs. Our unified formulation connects the student's output parameterization to the resulting gradient estimators and yields two methods with the same student architecture and reverse-KL matching objective: Simplex-DMD uses continuous token relaxations and pathwise gradients, while Reinforce-DMD uses categorical sampling and REINFORCE with a learned density ratio. We develop both methods for multi-step generation and investigate the training and sampling choices associated with each parameterization. On OpenWebText, for sequences of 1,024 tokens, Simplex-DMD achieves a generative perplexity of 45.6 at a unigram entropy of 5.44 nats in just 4 NFEs, a 49% reduction relative to the strongest evaluated diffusion baseline at matched entropy and sampling budget. Reinforce-DMD improves the frontier at larger budgets, reaching a generative perplexity of 14.9 at an entropy of 5.00 nats with 256 NFEs, a 20% reduction under the same comparison protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分布蒸馏降低连续扩散语言模型的推理成本，提出统一框架并导出两种方法：Simplex-DMD（连续松弛+路径梯度）和Reinforce-DMD（类别采样+REINFORCE）。在OpenWebText 1024 token任务上，Simplex-DMD仅4步NFE即达生成困惑度45.6（熵5.44），较最强基线降低49%；Reinforce-DMD在256步NFE下达14.9（熵5.00），降低20%。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型虽可并行生成全部token，但高质量生成仍需数百次网络评估（NFE），推理成本高昂。作者希望利用学生模型输出的概率分布信息，通过分布蒸馏在保持生成质量的同时大幅减少NFE。
AI.method: 提出统一公式：将学生输出的参数化方式与其对应的梯度估计器相联系，在相同学生架构和reverse-KL匹配目标下导出两种方法。Simplex-DMD采用连续token松弛与路径wise梯度；Reinforce-DMD采用类别采样与REINFORCE及学习到的密度比。两者均针对多步生成设计，并研究各自参数化相关的训练与采样选择。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText上，生成1024 token序列时，Simplex-DMD在仅4次NFE下达到生成困惑度45.6（unigram熵5.44 nats），在匹配熵与采样预算下相较最强扩散基线降低49%；Reinforce-DMD在更大预算下改进前沿，以256次NFE达到生成困惑度14.9（熵5.00 nats），在相同比较协议下降低20%。
AI.conclusion: 分布蒸馏可有效降低连续扩散语言模型的推理成本；两种基于同一架构与reverse-KL目标的方法在不同NFE预算下各有优势，Simplex-DMD适合极少步数场景，Reinforce-DMD在大预算下进一步改进性能前沿。

title: Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports
summary: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

AI.tldr: 在院内ICH影像报告多标签分级任务中，用真实GPT-4o标注报告蒸馏微调的开放权重模型（Gemma-3-12B, DIFT）可匹配GPT-4o（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850），决定性因素是训练数据来源（真实蒸馏 > 合成数据），而非微调方法；全流程可在单张24GB消费级GPU上完成。
AI.motivation: 将自由文本放射报告转为结构化标签对队列构建、质控和临床影像模型监测有价值，但最强抽取器为专有托管模型，存在隐私、成本与可复现性问题，因此需验证开放权重模型能否在窄域高价值任务上替代专有模型，并厘清关键要素。
AI.method: 2×2析因设计：适配策略（判别式分类头CH vs 生成式指令微调IFT）×训练数据来源（蒸馏真实GPT-4o标注报告 vs GPT-4o基于真实样例生成的合成报告），覆盖5种训练规模；以100份专家裁定报告为基准，对比GPT-4o与未微调开放权重基线，评测非增强头颅CT报告的多标签颅内出血（ICH）急迫度抽取。
AI.result: 蒸馏+指令微调模型（DIFT）匹配GPT-4o（macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850；p = 1.000），较基线提升0.178。训练数据来源为决定性因素：合成数据模型在任何训练规模下均未超过未微调基线，且在所有急迫度类别上均劣于蒸馏模型。微调与推理均可在单张24GB消费级GPU内存范围内完成。
AI.conclusion: 针对窄域、高价值的临床标签抽取任务，蒸馏真实报告（而非生成合成数据）才是弥合与托管模型差距的关键，可实现私有化、低成本、版本稳定的本地部署替代方案。

title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Its Promise and Limitations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important trade-off between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether decision-oriented systems provide a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of two decision-oriented systems, TypeSafe Jev and OpenAI Decisions, for recommendation reranking. Across three Amazon Reviews domains and four candidate-set sizes, we compare these systems against recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise LLM-based rerankers, systematically evaluating recommendation effectiveness, candidate-order robustness, and efficiency and scalability. Our results reveal that Jev frequently achieves a favorable quality--latency trade-off, offering competitive recommendation effectiveness at substantially lower observed latency than stronger LLM-based alternatives. Overall, our findings suggest that specialization for decision-making does not inherently guarantee superior recommendation quality or robustness. Instead, the practical value of decision-oriented inference depends on implementation-specific characteristics and application requirements. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented systems for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

AI.tldr: 论文对两种决策导向系统（TypeSafe Jev、OpenAI Decisions）在推荐重排序任务上进行受控实证研究，在三个Amazon Reviews领域和四种候选集规模下与推荐专用模型及pointwise/listwise LLM重排器对比，评估推荐效果、候选顺序鲁棒性与效率可扩展性。结果显示Jev常在质量-延迟权衡上表现良好，但决策专门化并不必然带来更优的推荐质量或鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM用于推荐重排序时存在推荐质量与服务效率之间的权衡。当重排任务本质上是预定义候选物品间的结构化选择时，决策导向系统可能是有用替代方案，但尚缺乏系统性验证。
AI.method: 针对推荐重排序开展受控实证研究，选取TypeSafe Jev与OpenAI Decisions两种决策导向系统，在三个Amazon Reviews领域、四种候选集规模下，与推荐专用模型以及pointwise、listwise的LLM重排器进行对比，系统评估推荐效果、候选顺序鲁棒性以及效率和可扩展性。
AI.result: Jev频繁实现较好的质量-延迟权衡，在显著更低的观测延迟下提供有竞争力的推荐效果，优于更强的LLM基线替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 面向决策的专门化并不天然保证更优的推荐质量或鲁棒性；决策导向推理的实际价值取决于具体实现特征与应用需求。该结论为在推荐及其他具结构化输出空间的排序任务中进一步研究决策导向系统提供了动机。

title: StreamRig: Exploiting Intra-Rig Geometry for Streaming Multi-Camera Odometry
summary: Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons. Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig.

AI.tldr: StreamRig 是一个在冻结多视角3D基础模型上构建标定多相机平台因果流式里程计的框架，仅训练 74.6M 参数并以相对位姿为监督，在四个数据集上实现更低的平移与旋转漂移且推理成本低。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人与车辆普遍搭载同步多相机设备，但许多流式3D基础模型面向单目输入，如何高效利用相机阵列几何信息仍是挑战。
AI.method: 冻结前端利用标定联合感知同步视角；Rig-Resampler 压缩特征；CausalBridge 采用带键值缓存的因果注意力；轻量头回归平台位姿；周期性重锚定协议保证长序列稳定。仅训练这些模块（共74.6M参数），以相对位姿为唯一监督。两阶段训练：群体重定位预训练 + 因果平台训练。
AI.result: 在 NCLT、TartanGround、KITTI-360 及自采人形机器人数据集 ZJH 上，训练仅用仿真、真实评估为零样本；相比所评估的非神谕单目流式与平台感知离线模型，平移和旋转漂移更低，同时保持低推理成本。消融与受控相机数量实验揭示了增益来源，并考察了更长训练窗口对更长时域推理的影响。
AI.conclusion: 冻结多视角3D基础模型配合轻量可训练流式模块，可有效将相机阵列几何与基础模型几何先验迁移到流式里程计，实现稳健且低成本的多相机位姿估计；代码已开源。

title: ComputerSD: Online Self-Distillation from Real-Time Feedback for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Online training enables computer-use agents (CUAs) to improve through interaction with executable environments. However, existing methods primarily rely on sparse outcome rewards, which provide no supervision for intermediate actions.
