On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers token-level learning signals through privileged rescoring, but directly applying it to CUA online training presents two challenges: fixed guidance may become misaligned with the student's current state, and guidance-induced probability shifts may conflict with step-level correctness. We introduce ComputerSD, an online self-distillation method for CUAs that converts real-time feedback from executed GUI transitions into guidance for policy learning. A fine-tuned GUI analyzer produces guidance and a step-level value score after each action; the guidance provides privileged context, while the score regulates the resulting OPSD signals. ComputerSD jointly optimizes token-level OPSD and trajectory-level GRPO in a fully asynchronous training framework. On OSWorld-Verified, ComputerSD outperforms outcome-only GRPO by 1.9 and 4.1 percentage points on the general-purpose Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and specialized EvoCUA-8B backbones, respectively. Evaluation in out-of-distribution settings further supports the generalizability of ComputerSD. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of learning from real-time feedback through online self-distillation for CUAs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComputerSD，一种面向计算机使用智能体（CUA）的在线自蒸馏方法，将真实 GUI 交互过渡中的实时反馈转化为策略学习指导，并结合 token 级 OPSD 与轨迹级 GRPO 异步训练，在 OSWorld-Verified 上显著优于纯结果奖励的 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有 CUA 在线训练方法主要依赖稀疏的结果奖励，无法为中间动作提供监督信号。on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）虽能通过特权重打分提供 token 级学习信号，但直接用于 CUA 在线训练存在两个问题：固定指导可能与学生当前状态失配；指导引发的概率偏移可能与步骤级正确性相冲突。
AI.method: ComputerSD 将已执行 GUI 过渡的实时反馈转化为策略学习指导。每次动作后，经微调的 GUI 分析器生成指导（提供特权上下文）和步骤级价值分数（用于调节 OPSD 信号）。方法在完全异步训练框架中联合优化 token 级 OPSD 与轨迹级 GRPO。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，ComputerSD 相较仅用结果奖励的 GRPO，在通用骨干 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 和专用骨干 EvoCUA-8B 上分别提升 1.9 和 4.1 个百分点。分布外（OOD）评估进一步支持其泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过在线自蒸馏从实时反馈中学习，对计算机使用智能体是有效的。

title: cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproducibility crisis. Benchmarks are based on complex infrastructure with varying machine and container configurations that confound the evaluation of the execution speed of CUAs. Towards addressing this gap, we propose cua-speedrun, which introduces standardized infrastructure and task sets, with a focus on evaluating the speed and efficiency of CUAs. cua-speedrun uses a uniform virtual machine setup and execution pipeline, along with a common agent interface that enables single-agent implementations to operate seamlessly across different benchmarks. Across four different CUA benchmarks, we evaluate how reasoning effort, agent harnesses, and environment latency affect performance, speed, and cost. We find no single model family is optimal for all three; none of the open-weight models are on the frontier, and also, unintuitively, for some models increasing the reasoning effort can speed up task completion, while faster environment input-output can slow down overall task completion time. We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison. We believe cua-speedrun will enable structured progress towards fast, efficient CUAs, unlocking new real-world use cases and applications. All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at https://cuaspeedrun.com.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 cua-speedrun，一个标准化基础设施与任务集，用于评估计算机使用代理（CUA）的速度与效率。
AI.motivation: CUA 虽在多项基准上超过人类，但其速度与成本成为广泛部署的关键障碍。现有 CUA 基准因复杂基础设施、机器与容器配置各异而面临可复现性危机，无法可靠评估执行速度。
AI.method: cua-speedrun 采用统一的虚拟机环境与执行流水线，并提供通用代理接口，使单代理实现可跨不同基准无缝运行；在四个 CUA 基准上评估推理强度、代理框架与环境延迟对性能、速度和成本的影响，同时通过缩减任务集进行统计功效分析。
AI.result: 没有单一模型家族在三者（性能、速度、成本）上均最优；开源权重模型均未达到前沿水平；反直觉地，对某些模型提高推理强度可加快任务完成，而更快环境 I/O 反而可能拖慢整体完成时间；可有效缩减多数基准任务集而不显著降低统计功效。
AI.conclusion: cua-speedrun 为快速、高效 CUA 的结构化进展提供支撑，助力解锁新的实际应用场景；代码、基础设施与分析均已公开。

title: Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning
summary: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

AI.tldr: 提出"语言预算多语言遗忘"(language-budgeted multilingual unlearning)任务，并发布跨语言遗忘张量基准(174语言-文字对、25种复述类型)与COVER方法，用少量源语言选择实现跨语言知识抹除。
AI.motivation: 在一种语言中遗忘某事实并不能保证其在其他语言中被移除：改变查询语言甚至回答语言就能重新打开"已被遗忘"的知识，形成跨语言漏洞。而"在所有语言上都做遗忘"既不可扩展，也会加剧对无关模型能力的损害，因此需要研究在有限语言预算下如何选择源语言以最大化跨语言擦除效果。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"语言预算多语言遗忘"任务：选择语言子集以最大化跨语言擦除；2) 构建Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor基准，覆盖174个语言–文字对与25种原子改写(paraphrase)类型，用于考察遗忘是否在同一知识的不同语言表达间泛化；3) 提出COVER，基于预测哪些未获遗忘监督的语言能被覆盖来选择源语言；部署时仅需无害校准数据与冻结模型访问权限。
AI.result: 作者发现"朴素地挑选单项强源语言"并不能可靠地组合成强源语言集合，这促使了COVER的设计。在三个模型家族、两个互不相交的遗忘集上，COVER相对均匀源语言选择将平均留出残差访问(held-out residual access)降低7.8%–27.3%；增益在低资源语言的真实新闻文档上也成立，使用LORELEI语料的人工翻译数据验证了从合成基准到真实场景的外推。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言遗忘存在漏洞，需在语言预算约束下进行源语言选择；COVER以低成本校准与冻结模型访问实现更优的跨语言擦除，并在多模型家族与真实低资源语言数据上验证了有效性。

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"野生"AI文本对语言模型预训练的影响。作者发现2026年网络数据中AI生成token占比达27.5%–31.1%，通过训练800个不同AI比例的语言模型并拟合缩放律，提出新的缩放律（分离收益项与危害项），能准确预测AI文本对人类文本损失的影响，并给出数据筛选与预处理建议。
AI.motivation: 网络文本构成预训练数据主体，且日益由AI生成。这类"野生"AI文本来自多种模型、面向人类读者、在语料中无标注，与合成数据或模型坍缩场景不同。作者希望探究这类AI文本如何影响语言模型预训练，并解决现有缩放律（如Hoffman等2022）无法预测该行为的问题。
AI.method: 使用Pangram对经FineWeb质量过滤的2026年6–8月网络数据进行AI生成标注。预训练800个语言模型，改变加入的AI token与人类token的比例，并对人类文本与AI文本的留出损失拟合缩放律。提出包含独立收益项和危害项的新缩放律，使其在无AI文本时退化为Chinchilla律。
AI.result: 2026年6月网络数据中27.5%的token被标为AI生成，8月升至31.1%。对于数据匮乏的模型，加入AI token最初降低人类文本损失，但收益趋于饱和并迅速转为危害；对于人类文本预算高的模型，AI token几乎立即提高损失，而等量新人类token持续降低损失。现有缩放律无法预测该行为。新缩放律在更小模型上拟合后，可预测大至3.6倍模型的人类文本留出损失，误差比现有最佳律低41%。
AI.conclusion: 建议：当目标为人类文本时过滤AI文本；在扩充数据集前重复使用人类文本再引入AI生成网络文本；分别报告人类文本与AI文本的验证损失。AI文本在目标为AI文本时仍有价值。作者发布WildAI（83B token含AI、主题、格式标签的语料）、全部800个模型及代码于 https://github.com/pangramlabs/WildAI。

title: Looped Diffusion Transformer
summary: Improving text-to-image models has traditionally relied on increasing model size or the number of denoising steps. In this work, we explore an alternative way to scale computation by repeatedly running shared Transformer blocks within each denoising step, effectively increasing computational depth while keeping the parameter count fixed. This looped computation enables iterative refinement of internal representations without explicit reasoning tokens. However, naive looping fails to consistently improve image quality. We trace this problem to weak supervision across intermediate loops and unregulated attention updates that progressively erode local information. To overcome these challenges, we propose Looped Diffusion Transformer (Looped-DiT), which combines deep supervision across intermediate loops with self-modulating attention to stabilize looped feature updates. Under matched-parameter and matched-compute settings, Looped-DiT consistently outperforms non-looped baselines. Notably, a 260M-parameter looped model can surpass a model 6.5x larger across multiple text-to-image benchmarks while requiring 4.9x lower inference compute. Beyond this performance gain, we find that looped computation can offer a more effective form of iterative computation for diffusion models, with increasing loop depth yielding larger gains than adding more denoising steps under a fixed inference budget. Furthermore, deeper loops can progressively correct mistakes made in earlier loops, exhibiting behaviors suggestive of latent reasoning. Together, these results show that looped computation offers a promising way to scale visual generation models.

AI.tldr: 提出Looped-DiT，通过在每步去噪中重复运行共享Transformer块来扩展计算深度，在参数与计算量匹配的条件下持续优于非循环基线，260M模型可超越6.5倍大的模型且推理计算量低4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 传统提升文本到图像模型的方式依赖增大模型规模或增加去噪步数。本文探索一种替代性的计算扩展途径：在每个去噪步内重复运行共享Transformer块，在参数量不变的情况下增加计算深度，从而实现内部表示的迭代精炼，且无需显式推理token。
AI.method: 发现朴素循环无法稳定提升图像质量，原因是中间循环间的监督信号薄弱，以及不受调控的注意力更新逐步侵蚀局部信息。为此提出Looped-DiT，结合中间循环的深度监督与自调制注意力（self-modulating attention）来稳定循环特征更新。
AI.result: 在参数匹配与计算匹配设置下，Looped-DiT持续优于非循环基线。260M参数循环模型在多个文本到图像基准上超越6.5倍大的模型，同时推理计算量低4.9倍。固定推理预算下，增加循环深度带来的收益大于增加去噪步数；更深的循环能逐步纠正早期循环的错误，表现出潜在推理般的特性。
AI.conclusion: 循环计算为扩散模型提供了一种更有效的迭代计算形式，是扩展视觉生成模型规模的有前景途径。

title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://github.com/lzk901372/glare
summary: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对双人对话中听者行为生成的数据、建模与评估三重缺口，构建了约147小时的听者-说话者配对数据集（64,557条事件级反应标注，涵盖点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉、惊讶六类），提出基于flow-matching transformer的音频驱动基线GLARE（含Qwen2-Audio韵律条件与时序反应损失），并设计了反应导向的评估协议（R-F1、R-tIoU、R-ATD、R-FID）。实验表明其在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均优于已有听者头生成方法。
AI.motivation: 双人对话中的听者行为生成尚不充分：生成自然听者行为需要知道何时反应、如何反应以及反应类型。现有双人对话数据集缺乏细粒度的听者反应标注；同时，从说话头与视频生成领域继承的评估指标只衡量视觉真实感，无法反映听者的反应是否恰当。
AI.method: 工作沿三方面展开：(1) 数据：基于RealTalk与Seamless Interaction构建听者头专用数据集，约147小时说话者-听者配对视频，含64,557条事件级反应标注，覆盖点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉、惊讶六类；(2) 模型：提出音频驱动的基线GLARE，基于flow-matching transformer，采用Qwen2-Audio导出的韵律条件，并引入时序反应损失对逐帧反应进行显式监督；(3) 评估：提出反应导向评估协议，联合度量反应发生（R-F1）、时序对齐（R-tIoU）、非对称时序偏差（R-ATD）与反应区域视觉质量（R-FID）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，相比已有听者头生成方法，所提方法在视觉保真度与反应级指标上均取得一致提升。这表明反应感知的数据、建模与评估对于生成自然的听者行为至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 反应感知的数据、建模与评估是生成自然听者行为的关键要素，为双人对话中听者头生成提供了更贴近行为层面的研究框架与基准。

title: Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts
summary: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping that characterizes the effective-parameter gain from looping and how sparsity raises this gain. The laws predict the held-out loss of looped models more accurately than prior alternatives, and recover the standard dense and MoE scaling laws as special cases. Beyond prediction, the fitted laws provide a principled foundation for designing looped MoE models under compute and memory constraints. Downstream evaluations further demonstrate the complementary benefits of the two axes: sparsity delivers ~3x active-parameter efficiency, recurrence yields ~2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning, and joint scaling further advances the performance frontier. As a practical extension, we show these gains hold at trillion-token scale: at matched training compute, a looped MoE with law-derived recurrence matches a ~2x larger non-looped MoE on the reasoning benchmarks, while enabling test-time scaling through recurrence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个同时建模循环结构（recurrence）与稀疏专家（MoE）的缩放定律——Loop Scaling Laws，能更准确地预测循环模型的损失，并为在算力与显存约束下设计循环MoE模型提供理论基础。
AI.motivation: 循环（recurrence）与稀疏专家（MoE）是两条互补的高效扩展路径：前者在固定参数下提升计算深度，后者在固定激活计算量下扩大总容量。然而现有缩放定律仅孤立地建模二者之一，缺乏统一框架，无法指导二者联合设计。
AI.method: 提出Loop Scaling Laws，核心是"有界的、稀疏条件化的循环映射"（bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping），刻画循环带来的有效参数增益以及稀疏性如何提升该增益；模型同时纳入循环、稀疏性、模型规模与数据量。
AI.result: 该定律对循环模型留出损失的预测精度优于既有替代方案，并能退化为标准dense与MoE缩放定律；下游评测显示稀疏带来约3倍激活参数效率、循环在推理上带来约2倍总参数效率；在万亿token规模上，匹配训练算力时，采用定律导出循环配置的循环MoE可媲美约2倍大的非循环MoE，并支持通过循环实现测试时扩展。
AI.conclusion: 循环与稀疏是互补的两条扩展轴，联合缩放可进一步推进性能前沿；该定律为在算力与显存约束下设计循环MoE提供原理性依据，且结论在万亿token规模下依然成立。

title: Atomizer-IO: Beyond Pixels, Patches and Grids
summary: Most vision architectures assume that observations lie on a regular grid, an effective abstraction for natural images but a restrictive one for sensing data whose channels, temporal sampling, spatial resolution, and geometry can vary. Generic set-based architectures remove the grid, but also remove useful spatial inductive biases. We introduce Atomizer-IO, an architecture that places observations first and derives structure from their physical relationships. Building on top of an atomic representation of the data, each observation is described by its measurement and acquisition metadata, while local cross-attention maps observations to anchor points that can be arbitrarily placed. We evaluate this design by progressively relaxing the grid assumption, from varying input raster configurations and incomplete channel sets to flexible output density and, ultimately, inputs without a raster grid. Atomizer-IO is competitive with flexible EO-specific architectures on most tasks, while offering post-training control over inference cost and competitive compute--performance trade-offs. The same formulation extends without architectural redesign to unordered 3D point clouds, showing that the atomic interface generalizes beyond regular raster inputs. These results suggest that pixels, patches, and grids do not need to define the interface of a sensing architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出Atomizer-IO架构，以观测为核心、从观测的物理关系中推导结构，用测量值与采集元数据描述每个观测，并通过局部交叉注意力将观测映射到任意放置的锚点，从而摆脱规则网格假设。
AI.motivation: 多数视觉架构假设观测位于规则网格上，这对自然图像有效，但对通道、时间采样、空间分辨率与几何均可变化的多模态传感数据而言过于受限；通用集合式架构虽去除了网格，却也丢掉了有用的空间归纳偏置。
AI.method: 在数据的原子化表示之上，每个观测由测量值与采集元数据描述；采用局部交叉注意力将观测映射到可任意放置的锚点，由此从观测间的物理关系中推导结构。
AI.result: 通过逐步放松网格假设（变化输入栅格配置、不完整通道集、灵活输出密度，直至无栅格输入）进行评测：在多数任务上与灵活的地球观测专用架构相当，同时提供训练后对推理成本的控制以及有竞争力的算力—性能权衡；同一形式无需架构重设计即可扩展到无序3D点云。
AI.conclusion: 原子接口可超越规则栅格输入推广到更一般的传感数据，表明像素、图块与网格不必再定义传感架构的接口。

title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
summary: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 对300个冻结场景、6个生成器和19个对齐评测器进行协议审计，发现在渲染与描述配置变化下，分数波动常超过生成器间差异，排行榜点估计冠军不稳定，但经过选择感知的推断后没有确认的排名反转。
AI.motivation: 在渲染图像评测中，相机设置与一句描述措辞本身就是测量协议的一部分。作者要回答：当生成场景固定不变时，仅改变评测协议是否足以改变文生3D排行榜结果。
AI.method: 使用来自6个生成器的300个冻结场景，对一个感知质量对照与19个对齐评测器变化8个渲染与描述因子，并测试4种定向场景退化。分析配置方差与生成器间方差、提示自举下界，以及配对协议边际包络与选择感知的联合推断。
AI.result: 17/19个对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，其中11/19提示自举下界大于1；排名比分数更稳定，但18/19个评测器在某些配置下改变点估计冠军；配对包络显示部分比较方向保持，个别配对点估计区间相反，但全搜索联合推断下无反转存活；即使无提示对照，也没有评测器在布局乱序上的平局校正方向判别超过67%。
AI.conclusion: 观察到的冠军变化只是描述性现象，并非生成器优越性被确认的改变。审计将分数稳定性、决策不确定性与定向敏感性区分开，建议同时报告（生成器、分数、卡片ID）以及依赖协议的比较和考虑选择的不确定性。

title: MatLoom: Layered Text-to-Material Generation in a Compact Program Space
summary: Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it. We introduce MatLoom, a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models. Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit. A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate's remaining source fixed. On a curated benchmark of 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics. Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search. Retained programs have a median length of 21 lines when pooled across backbones. In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 participants and 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2% of choices, compared with 19.3% for the most-preferred baseline. Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.

AI.tldr: MatLoom是一种紧凑的、面向图层的文本到材质生成语言，配合预训练语言模型使用。每个程序由带alpha遮罩的图层组成，图层共享的空间表达式定义覆盖范围与PBR通道，从而显式表达图案、颜色和浮雕之间的依赖关系。在141条提示、6种骨干模型的基准上，最佳配置在四项平面布局提示对齐指标上均优于三种扩散基线；在30人、20条提示的盲测四方比较中获得59.2%的选择率。
AI.motivation: 材质生成不应只产生外观，还应产生构造它的规则。现有方法（如扩散模型）通常只输出最终外观图像，丢失了材质的构造结构，不利于后续编辑与复用。作者希望生成既可解释、又可编辑、且作为资产一部分保留其构造过程的材质。
AI.method: 提出MatLoom，一种紧凑的、面向图层的文本到材质生成语言，用于配合预训练语言模型。每个程序组合带alpha遮罩的图层，图层共享的空间表达式定义覆盖范围与PBR通道，使图案、颜色和浮雕之间的依赖关系显式化。独立解释器将程序求值为材质贴图，同时源代码保留命名字段与图层参数以供后续创作。无需任务特定微调，流程采用解析器引导的修复与基于预览的评审来修订材质设计，随后在固定每个候选剩余源代码的前提下搜索噪声种子。
AI.result: 在141条提示、6种骨干模型的精选基准上，最佳配置在全部四项平面布局提示对齐指标上的平均分均高于三种扩散基线。其初始程序在BLIPScore均值上已超过三种基线（在评审或种子搜索之前）。跨骨干模型汇总后，保留程序的中位长度为21行。在涉及30名参与者和20条提示的盲测四方比较中，其渲染结果获得59.2%的选择率，而最受偏好的基线为19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的可执行程序提供了一种生成提示对齐材质的方式，同时将材质的构造过程保留为资产的一部分。MatLoom通过语言化、图层化的程序表示，在无需微调的情况下实现了优于扩散基线的提示对齐表现，并具备可解释性与可编辑性。

title: I Have a Stream: Making Self-Supervised Learning Work on Continuous Video
summary: Self-supervised learning draws inspiration from infant visual development, yet standard training pipelines bear little resemblance to it: images are independently sampled and globally shuffled across epochs. We study self-supervised learning from continuous video streams, where frames are consumed in temporal order using strict sliding-window batches, without global reshuffling or multi-epoch replay. To this end, we construct WT++, a 95-hour urban walking-tour video dataset for streaming pretraining. Combined with a comprehensive evaluation suite we find that contrastive and distillation-based methods struggle in this setting, while MAE is more robust but still falls short of standard i.i.d. pretraining. We find that high inter-batch similarity, caused by sliding-window consumption across consecutive batches, does not explain this gap. The main challenge is high intra-batch similarity, where frames within each batch are near-duplicates. To mitigate this, we propose StreamMAE, which preserves the core MAE reconstruction objective while adapting the input pipeline with stream-aware regularization and motion-biased crop selection. StreamMAE outperforms streaming baselines, matches i.i.d. MAE trained on the same video data, remains competitive with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, and scales positively as the pretraining stream grows from 12 to 95 hours.

AI.tldr: 论文研究连续视频流下的自监督预训练，构建WT++数据集并提出StreamMAE，通过流感知正则化和运动偏向裁剪缓解批内高相似性问题，性能追平i.i.d. MAE并可正向扩展。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习灵感源自婴儿视觉发育，但标准训练流程将图像独立采样并跨epoch全局打乱，与该过程差异很大。作者希望研究更贴近真实视觉经验的连续视频流预训练设定。
AI.method: 构建95小时城市步行游览视频数据集WT++，采用严格滑窗批次、按时间顺序消费帧、不做全局重打乱与多轮回放。在此设定下系统评测对比学习与蒸馏方法，发现它们表现不佳、MAE更鲁棒但仍落后于i.i.d.预训练。分析发现主要挑战是批内高相似性（批内帧近乎重复），而非批间相似性。据此提出StreamMAE，保留MAE重建目标，引入流感知正则化与运动偏向裁剪选择。
AI.result: StreamMAE优于流式基线方法，追平在同一视频数据上训练的i.i.d. MAE，与ImageNet预训练MAE相比仍具竞争力，并随预训练流从12小时扩展到95小时呈正向扩展。
AI.conclusion: 连续视频流预训练的主要障碍是批内冗余而非批间冗余，通过流感知正则化与运动偏向裁剪可有效缓解，StreamMAE使流式自监督预训练达到与标准i.i.d.预训练相当的效果并具备良好扩展性。

title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
summary: Evolutionary search with large language models (LLMs) can stall when progress requires external knowledge the model lacks. Supplying relevant documents helps, but simply adding web search tool can keep returning the same pages as solutions change. We introduce EvoDuet, a bi-level optimization method that co-evolves solutions and search queries with fixed model parameters. At each iteration, a retrieval gate lets the LLM assess its knowledge gap and choose to retrieve new documents, reuse stored ones, or proceed without them. An inner loop refines queries and ranks documents by the solution scores they are predicted to yield; an outer loop generates candidates in parallel from these documents and records the evaluated outcomes for later searches. Across 21 optimization tasks with one candidate per iteration, EvoDuet raises OpenEvolve's normalized discovery gain from 74.1% to 78.0% with GPT-5.6-Luna and from 61.3% to 82.3% with Gemini-3.8-Flash, whereas Qwen3.5-9B does not benefit. Our best runs surpass the previously reported best scores on eight tasks, including Swap Reduction on Q20 and Rosetta, and match them on three more. EvoDuet also improves with other scaffolds (e.g., Top-K, EvoX) on Sums/Diffs and Denoising, demonstrating its applicability across evolutionary search scaffolds.

AI.tldr: EvoDuet：一种双层优化方法，通过协同演化解与检索查询，缓解LLM进化搜索中外部知识缺失导致停滞的问题。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的进化搜索在进展依赖模型所缺乏的外部知识时会停滞；补充文档有帮助，但简单加入网络搜索工具会在解变化时反复返回相同页面，检索与搜索过程脱节。
AI.method: 在固定模型参数下协同演化解与搜索查询的双层优化。每次迭代通过检索门让LLM评估知识缺口，选择检索新文档、复用已存文档或直接继续；内层循环优化查询，并依据预测解得分对文档排序；外层循环基于这些文档并行生成候选解，并记录评估结果供后续检索使用。
AI.result: 在21个优化任务、每轮一个候选解的设定下，EvoDuet将OpenEvolve的归一化发现增益在GPT-5.6-Luna上从74.1%提升至78.0%，在Gemini-3.8-Flash上从61.3%提升至82.3%，而Qwen3.5-9B未获益。最优运行在八个任务上超过此前最佳成绩（含Q20与Rosetta上的Swap Reduction），并在另外三个任务上持平；在Sums/Diffs与Denoising上，搭配Top-K、EvoX等其他脚手架亦有提升，显示跨脚手架适用性。
AI.conclusion: 检索与解演化协同（而非静态叠加搜索工具）是提升LLM进化搜索的有效途径，且效果依赖基础模型能力并具备跨脚手架泛化性。

title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
summary: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Ego4WAM，在统一的世界-动作模型框架下系统研究自我中心人类数据的对齐、监督与使用策略对机器人学习的影响。
AI.motivation: 自我中心人类数据可扩展机器人学习经验，但人机对齐程度、行为覆盖与监督形式差异大；现有工作虽显示数据规模越大效果越好，却不清楚哪些数据属性真正驱动下游机器人性能提升，以及如何在整个训练流程中使用这类数据。
AI.method: 在固定模型骨干的统一世界-动作模型框架下，对具有不同对齐程度与监督形式的自我中心人类数据进行系统性研究，解耦人机对齐、数据时长与任务多样性、动作监督以及数据使用策略各自的影响。
AI.result: 对齐的人类演示显著提升分布外泛化能力并降低目标任务对机器人数据的需求；数据时长与任务多样性对下游能力影响不同；仅有视频监督（无动作标签）依然有效，可为后续视频-动作训练提供良好基础。通过真实机器人与 RoboDojo 的闭环策略评估验证了上述发现。
AI.conclusion: 不应将数据时长视为唯一的缩放维度；Ego4WAM 表明对齐、任务多样性、可用监督与使用策略共同决定自我中心人类数据对机器人学习的价值。

title: Image Classifiers are Efficient Self-Supervised Video Representation Learners
summary: We introduce VideoMSN, a Masked Siamese Network framework for efficient self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning in videos. Instead of relying on heavy 3D architectures or reconstruction-based autoencoders for learning with unlabeled data, we repurpose standard image Vision Transformers by representing videos as super images which are grids composed of frames sampled from videos. From each super image, we construct two views: one with spatial patch masking and the other with temporal frame masking, ensuring no information leakage across frames. A shared Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder aligns their embeddings using a masked Siamese loss, capturing both motion and appearance cues without reconstruction. Our decoder-free formulation leverages an image foundation model towards efficient video representation learning. Starting from pretrained DINO-v3 and DeiT-v3 image encoders, VideoMSN achieves state-of-the-art performance on Kinetics-400, UCF101, and HMDB51 while requiring up to $32\times$ fewer and $160\times$ fewer video pretraining epochs compared to prior video self-supervised learning methods. Our proposed approach also shows strong performance in low-shot classification, confirming the transferability of the learned representations in a label-scarce scenario. Project Page: https://cvir.github.io/projects/videomsn.

AI.tldr: VideoMSN 是一种无解码器的掩码孪生网络框架，通过超图像与双视图掩码实现高效视频自监督时空表征学习。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督方法依赖重型 3D 架构或基于重建的自编码器，计算开销大、预训练效率低。作者希望复用标准图像 ViT 与图像基础模型，以更低成本获得高质量视频表征。
AI.method: 将视频表示为"超图像"（由采样帧组成的网格），从中构造两个视图：一为空间块掩码，一为时间帧掩码，并确保帧间无信息泄漏；共享 ViT 编码器用掩码孪生损失对齐两视图嵌入，无需重建与解码器，基于预训练 DINO-v3 和 DeiT-v3 图像编码器初始化。
AI.result: 在 Kinetics-400、UCF101 和 HMDB51 上达到最优性能，视频预训练轮数较此前方法最多减少 32 倍和 160 倍；在低样本分类场景同样表现强劲，验证了所学表征的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 复用图像基础模型的免解码器掩码孪生范式，能够以显著更低的训练成本实现高效且可迁移的视频时空表征学习。

title: AssemblyWorld: Rethinking 3D Assembly with General-Purpose Agents
summary: The task of 3D assembly requires translating an understanding of parts and their relationships into precise spatial arrangements. Can pretrained general-purpose agents assemble objects through visual interaction without additional assembly-specific fine-tuning? To investigate this question, we introduce AssemblyWorld, an interactive 3D environment in which agents inspect rendered views and manipulate supplied rigid parts, guided by images or assembly manuals when available. Agents perceive part geometry through 2D views rather than direct access to mesh vertices or faces, while their resulting assemblies are evaluated geometrically. Building on this environment, we construct AssemblyWorldBench, comprising 100 assembly tasks across 80 objects spanning furniture, industrial assembly, and fracture reassembly. Evaluating eight agent systems reveals substantial differences in their capabilities. The strongest system achieves 80.9% part accuracy but 59.4% complete-assembly success. The evaluated open-source systems lag substantially behind their stronger closed-source peers in both execution reliability and assembly accuracy. Analyses of visual references, interaction trajectories, and failures show how agents revise assemblies while leaving residual positioning errors. AssemblyWorld provides a common setting for both assessing the capabilities of interactive assembly agents and characterizing the gap between approximate structure recovery and precise reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式3D环境AssemblyWorld及基准AssemblyWorldBench（80个物体、100项装配任务），评测8个智能体系统；最强系统零件准确率80.9%、完整装配成功率59.4%，开源系统显著落后闭源系统，揭示了近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练的通用智能体能否在不进行装配专项微调的条件下，仅通过视觉交互完成3D装配任务；同时缺乏统一的评测环境来考察智能体在"零件理解—空间精确排布"上的能力，以及近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建交互式3D环境AssemblyWorld：智能体仅通过渲染的2D视图感知零件几何，无法直接访问mesh顶点或面，可借助图像或装配手册操作刚性零件，其装配结果以几何方式评估。基于此环境构建AssemblyWorldBench，包含覆盖家具、工业装配、断裂重组三大类的80个物体、100项装配任务，并对8个智能体系统进行评测，分析视觉参考、交互轨迹与失败案例。
AI.result: 各系统能力差异显著；最强系统零件准确率80.9%，但完整装配成功率仅59.4%；开源系统在执行可靠性和装配精度上均大幅落后于更强的闭源系统；失败分析显示智能体能不断修正装配，但仍残留定位误差。
AI.conclusion: AssemblyWorld为评估交互式装配智能体提供了统一平台，可用于刻画近似结构恢复与精确重建之间的能力鸿沟，并推动通用智能体向高精度装配方向发展。

title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 27 pages (10-page main text), 5 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://vitex-bench.github.io/ v2: correct the ViTeX-Edit-14B results, add ablation study on disabling glyphs
summary: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 ViTeX-Bench 基准套件（含 ViTeX-Dataset 与三轴评估协议），用于视频场景文本编辑，并发布开源参考编辑器 ViTeX-Edit-14B。
AI.motivation: 视频生成日趋逼真可控，但视频编辑发展滞后，尤其是需保留原场景动态的精确局部编辑。视频场景文本编辑（替换店面招牌、白板、产品标签等表面文本）须保持周边内容、运动与相机动态。图像场景文本编辑研究充分，但兼具高视觉质量、时序一致性与编辑局部性的视频场景文本编辑仍缺乏探索。现有配对真实视频数据有限，且通用视频编辑指标无法直接度量目标文本是否随时间保持正确。
AI.method: 构建 ViTeX-Bench：ViTeX-Dataset 含 387 段真实 720p 视频，带文本区域掩码与编辑指令，其中 230 段为经审核、流水线生成的配对编辑用于训练，157 段为冻结评测集。评估协议通过 13 项指标衡量文本正确性、视觉与时序质量、编辑局部性，每轴设一项主指标并进行帕累托权衡比较。辅以 OCR 校准、人工评估与标注敏感性分析支持分数解读。同时发布 ViTeX-Edit-14B，在配对训练集上微调，采用运动对齐的字形-视频条件。
AI.result: 在来自四个编辑家族的八种基线方法中，准确的文本、时序稳定性与场景保持难以同时达成。ViTeX-Edit-14B 取得 CharAcc 0.688，为所评估的视频原生编辑器中最高均值，并在原始编辑器输出中具有最低的可比文本裁剪 Warp。
AI.conclusion: ViTeX-Bench 为研究视频场景文本编辑中的上述权衡提供了可复现的基础。

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
summary: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Physis-Lang 自演化框架，将"物理语言"作为数据筛选、模型训练与视频生成的共享可优化表示，无需引入视觉/潜在/数值/规划等额外信号即可提升视频世界模型的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型生成的视频虽视觉逼真，却常违反基本物理原理。主流做法认为自然语言不足以承载可靠生成所需的物理知识，因而引入视觉、潜在、数值或规划等额外信号。本文重新审视这一假设，探索语言本身作为物理知识表示的潜力。
AI.method: 以语言刻画物理过程的相关实体、成因、交互、支配原理、时间演化与结果；构建 PhysCapBench，将物理过程分解为原子断言，用召回率与精确率评估描述质量；通过智能体循环迭代分析断言级错误并优化生成物理描述的指令；再将模型缺陷转为文本描述，用语言引导检索找到覆盖缺失物理过程的多样化视频。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准上，基于 Wan 与 Cosmos 骨干均取得一致的物理合理性提升；从开源 Cosmos3-Nano 出发的 Physis-Lang 增强模型超越了领先的闭源 Veo 3.1。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言足以作为可优化的物理知识表示，统一贯通数据、训练与生成三阶段，可持续自我演化并显著提升视频世界模型的物理可信度。

title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出Ranking-PE，将提示进化搜索中的正确性矩阵替换为成对排序矩阵，使列均值等于经验AUROC，在无额外模型调用下显著提升多模态临床诊断的排序性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在临床诊断中的应用日益广泛，但其适配流程仍以准确率为目标。临床数据类别严重不平衡，恒定多数类预测器可轻松超过90%准确率却在临床上无用，因此需要采用对类别不平衡不敏感、无阈值的AUROC作为优化目标。
AI.method: 聚焦MLLM的提示优化。针对GEPA等反思式方法使用逐实例正确性矩阵（列均值为准确率、驱动候选选择）的问题，提出成对级帕累托提示进化（Ranking-PE）：将每个正确性行替换为(正例,负例)实例对上的成对排序行，若候选提示给正例打分高于配对负例则记1，由Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恒等式，列均值即为经验AUROC。该替换应用于提示进化搜索所读取的三个层面——决定帕累托支配的分数矩阵、给反思LM的逐例反馈、以及最终候选选择，且不增加模型调用、无需代理损失。
AI.result: 在MIMIC的三个疾病上，基于准确率的提示进化会损害排序性能；Ranking-PE逆转这一现象，在微调Qwen3-VL-8B上比准确率配方高+5.8 AUROC百分点，在MedGemma-4B上高+16.2个百分点。消融实验检验了各设计组件，并表明医学级视觉骨干（通过视觉编码器微调SFT或医学预训练获得）是提示搜索无法替代的前提条件。
AI.conclusion: 该配方将反思式提示进化从纯文本数据扩展到多模态临床决策，通过以AUROC为导向的成对排序目标替代准确率目标，有效缓解类别不平衡带来的临床无效性问题。

title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究RLVR下LLM对任务无关提示特征的敏感性，提出半事实信用增强策略优化（SCAPO），通过将半事实稳定性纳入token级信用分配来改进GRPO，在多个模型与数学基准上提升推理准确率与泛化性。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽提升了LLM推理能力，但模型预测对任务无关的提示特征仍敏感。作者通过半事实提示干预（保持问题与答案不变）揭示token级敏感性差异显著；同时指出GRPO将同一结果优势分配给所有响应token，可能强化虚假依赖，故需更细粒度的信用分配。
AI.method: 提出SCAPO，一种因果启发的GRPO变体。方法在半事实干预下测量固定响应的token概率漂移，用归一化稳定性分数在训练早期降低相对不稳定token的优势，且不因稳定本身给予额外信用；同时发现解码时抑制高漂移token候选可在不更新权重下提升准确率。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base与Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，SCAPO相对GRPO在AIME 2024-2026准确率分别提升5.63与4.17个百分点；在两个模型规模下，SCAPO在多数评估的数学基准及所有评估的分布外基准上取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 半事实稳定性可作为RLVR中有效的训练信号，通过更细粒度的信用分配提升推理能力与泛化性。

title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
summary: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

AI.tldr: PACT是一个端到端模型，从单目视频联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力，通过引入可学习的接触力token、时序Transformer和物理监督，并构建数据标注流水线与攀岩基准ForceWall，在接触与接触力估计上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 人体运动、环境接触与交互力受共同物理规律支配，但现有方法通常将视觉姿态重建与接触、力估计分离，这种分阶段处理限制了联合推理并会在阶段间传播误差。此外，接触力标注稀缺，缺少配有力真值的真实场景数据与基准。
AI.method: 在人体重建基础模型上加入可学习的接触力token，以及融合视觉特征与世界空间运动的时序Transformer；多个联合预测头分别精修人体姿态并估计接触与接触力；采用基于物理的监督约束重建运动与交互力的一致性。为缓解力标注稀缺，设计了结合接触标注与物理驱动的运动-力优化的数据标注流水线，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督；并提出真实攀岩基准ForceWall，包含攀岩视频及由力传感器获得的接触力真值。
AI.result: 实验表明接触与接触力估计达到SOTA，优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互场景。同时验证了联合学习框架的有效性与ForceWall基准的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合学习是从视频中恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效途径，统一建模姿态、接触与力可避免阶段误差累积并提升泛化能力。

title: Multimodal Flow: Unified Flow Modeling of Language and Vision in Embedding Spaces
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and model: https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow
summary: We present Multimodal Flow, a fully continuous generative model of language and vision. Most unified multimodal models either model both language and quantized images as discrete tokens or combine discrete language prediction with continuous image generation. The former introduces a visual quantization bottleneck. The latter requires modality-dependent objectives and sampling procedures. Fully continuous modeling avoids these trade-offs and enables a shared generative process, but remains underexplored for multimodal pretraining. Multimodal Flow introduces a unified continuous architecture that integrates multimodal continuous representations with a shared chunk-causal flow backbone. It organizes text blocks and images as ordered continuous hyperchunks, preserving textual token order and visual spatial structure. The backbone learns a single vector field over these hyperchunks through Flow Matching. Joint attention enables cross-modal interaction, while modality-specific feed-forward networks process each modality. The model predicts multiple target chunks in parallel during training and generates hyperchunks sequentially at inference. We instantiate MF-1 and pretrain it on multimodal data. Across 0.6B, 1.2B, and 1.6B scales, continued pretraining consistently improves multimodal modeling. With only 150B pretraining tokens, MF-1 achieves an average score of 82.8 across GenEval and DPG-Bench and 75.3 across VQAv2, MMBench, and POPE, remaining competitive with unified models trained on substantially more data. Under matched data, optimization, and parameter budgets, Multimodal Flow further outperforms representative hybrid and discrete models. These results establish continuous chunk-based embedding flow modeling as a new fully continuous paradigm for unified multimodal modeling. The related code and model are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/Multimodal-Flow.

AI.tldr: 提出 Multimodal Flow，一种面向语言与视觉的全连续生成模型，通过共享 chunk-causal flow 骨干在连续超块上做 Flow Matching，实现统一多模态建模。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型要么将语言与量化图像都建模为离散 token（引入视觉量化瓶颈），要么用离散语言预测加连续图像生成（需模态相关目标与采样流程）。全连续建模可规避上述权衡并共享生成过程，但在多模态预训练中仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 将文本块与图像组织为有序连续超块（hyperchunks），保留文本 token 顺序与视觉空间结构；骨干通过 Flow Matching 学习超块上的单一向量场；联合注意力实现跨模态交互，模态特定 FFN 分别处理各模态；训练时并行预测多个目标块，推理时顺序生成超块。实例化 MF-1 并在多模态数据上预训练。
AI.result: 在 0.6B、1.2B、1.6B 规模下，继续预训练持续提升多模态建模。仅用 150B 预训练 token，MF-1 在 GenEval 与 DPG-Bench 平均 82.8，在 VQAv2、MMBench、POPE 平均 75.3，与训练数据多得多的统一模型相当。在匹配数据、优化与参数预算下，优于代表性混合模型与离散模型。
AI.conclusion: 连续 chunk-based 嵌入流建模可作为统一多模态建模的新全连续范式。代码与模型已开源。

title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出 PixelDense，通过语义与几何双投影流加权重正交惩罚，将多类密集预测基础模型作为 REPA 对齐目标，解耦语义与几何梯度，在像素空间扩散模型中实现更快的收敛与更强的生成、重建及编辑性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 REPA 的表示对齐目标几乎只采用 DINOv2、CLIP 等语义编码器，而近期分析表明对齐效果的关键在于空间结构而非全局语义，因此面向密集预测的基础模型（如 SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2）虽适合捕捉空间结构，却未被充分用作 REPA 目标。此外，简单叠加多个教师反而低于最佳单一几何教师，因为语义与几何梯度在同一去噪器投影中相互竞争。
AI.method: 将 DINOv2 与 SAM2 路由到语义投影流，将 Depth Anything v2 与 Metric3D v2 路由到几何投影流，并施加权重空间正交惩罚，使两条流处于不相交子空间；四个教师模型在训练期间冻结、推理时丢弃。
AI.result: 在 PixelGen 与 DeCo 上以单一配方应用：GenEval、DPG-Bench、HPS v2.1 均提升，PixelGen-XXL 的 GenEval Overall 从 0.7927 提升至 0.8093，优于所有单教师与未分解多教师变体；在部分噪声重建中，COCO 与 Flickr30K 上 τ=0.5 时全景 PQ 最高提升 53.1%、深度 AbsRel 降低 36.0%；从随机初始化训练可达基线峰值 GenEval 的 1.23 倍加速；SDEdit 编辑在 PIE-Bench 上各编辑强度均更好保留源背景与布局，背景 PSNR 最高提升 2.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: PixelDense 验证了以密集预测基础模型为对齐目标、并通过语义与几何双流解耦可有效提升扩散 Transformer 的训练效率与生成质量，避免多教师梯度冲突，同时在生成、重建和编辑任务上取得一致增益。

title: EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights
summary: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

AI.tldr: EurekaBench是一个跨领域基准，用于评测AI智能体开展长周期实验并发现解释观测现象的机制的能力，覆盖6个领域、26个任务与306条科学洞见。
AI.motivation: 受牛顿通过迭代分析观测数据、以数学方程描述规律并反复修正理论而发现万有引力定律的启发，作者希望衡量AI智能体能否做出类似的科学发现，即从观测中提炼机制。
AI.method: 构建EurekaBench跨领域基准，包含经专家验证的26个长周期任务，覆盖神经科学、计算机科学、化学、天体物理、地球物理与等离子体物理，共306条预期由所发现机制支撑的科学洞见；评测框架从三个维度考察：遵循已知科学约束的能力、所发现机制的预测准确性、以及机制能否产生科学洞见或指导未来研究。
AI.result: 当前AI智能体往往过度专注于预测精度优化，在这一点上甚至超越人类科学家，但在推导科学洞见方面存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体在科学发现中的预测能力与洞见生成能力存在失衡，EurekaBench揭示了以洞见为导向的评测必要性，为后续提升AI科学发现能力提供方向。

title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). 5 pages
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究语言操作能否被摊销为潜向量：通过训练一个小网络读取少样本支撑集的几何结构并对冻结GPT-2的残差流施加输入条件化的加性更新，发现屈折等生产性规则可零样本摊销甚至超越ICL，而记忆性配对（反义）则无法摊销。
AI.motivation: 近期理论表明静态任务向量等价于单个合成示例，在高秩映射（如词级双射）上必然失败。作者将这一问题语言化：探究哪些语言操作可以从提示中摊销出来，以区分可泛化的生产性规则与依赖示例的记忆性配对。
AI.method: 训练一个260万参数的小网络，读取少样本支撑集的几何特征（质心、主子空间、谱，一次性计算并缓存），在冻结的GPT-2-large/XL中间层对查询的残差流产生输入条件化的加性更新。覆盖八种屈折方向和一种词汇关系，采用禁止方向间倒序对泄漏的规范划分，并与10-shot ICL及提取的任务向量对比。
AI.result: 呈现三种机制。正向屈折：ICL较强（0.67-0.89）而任务向量崩溃（≤0.06），该变换以严格零样本成本匹配ICL。词元化方向：冻结GPT-2能执行但10个示例系统性地无法传达（1.5B下ICL仅0.13-0.48），该变换不被ICL上限约束，达到0.78-0.92，最高超ICL +72点（过去时→现在时：0.85 vs 0.13）。任意配对（反义）：所有摊销方法在各规模、容量和随机种子下均停滞在ICL的约一半。控制实验显示支撑流形作为因果必要的任务指纹：错误任务流形使准确率崩溃至≤0.06，仅查询变体无法区分共享输入空间的任务，留一任务迁移为零。
AI.conclusion: 生产性规则可以摊销为潜任务表示，有时比提示传达效果更好；而记忆性配对则无法摊销。这从语言角度验证并扩展了静态任务向量的理论局限。

title: Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models
summary: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察了评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性三者的交互作用，发现后训练会削弱多语言模型的语法能力，且低资源语言受损最重；隐藏的语法知识仅在高资源语言中可测，需采用语言导向的多范式评估协议。
AI.motivation: 关于多语言模型语法能力的结论随测量方式不同而差异巨大，但评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性之间的交互作用尚未被系统研究，这可能导致对低资源语言能力的系统性低估。
AI.method: 在覆盖101种语言的句法最小对立对基准MultiBLiMP上，评估来自六个模型家族的基座模型与后训练模型，并采用四种评估方法进行对比。
AI.result: 三点主要发现：(1) 后训练会降低语法能力，该效应随模型规模增大而部分减弱，但低资源语言承担最高代价；(2) 后训练模型保留了无法通过显式提示表达的语法知识，但仅在高资源语言中可测，因为低资源场景下基线接近随机水平，几乎没有可隐藏的知识；(3) 母语提示能恢复低资源语言上原本隐藏的能力，说明只有高资源语言可直接从无提示概率中探测。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用语言导向、多范式的协议，以避免系统性地低估低资源语言的能力。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.tldr: Memorizon 将"长跨度监督"与"长跨度注意力"解耦：训练样本可覆盖任意长跨度，但仅对最后 k 个 chunk 计分，每个计分 chunk 通过相机共视检索 top-K latent 组成共享 bank（上界 kK），使序列长度有界。相比滑窗基线提升重访一致性，且 100s→400s 仅增加 12% 步时。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型需要在重复到访同一地点时保持渲染一致性，但直接监督重访需同时包含两次到访、跨度常达数分钟，全跨度稠密注意力带来二次复杂度，使长跨度监督代价高昂。核心痛点是：监督需要长跨度，注意力却不必覆盖整段历史。
AI.method: 解耦长跨度监督与注意力：1) 训练样本覆盖任意长度跨度，但只在最后 k 个 chunk 上计分；2) 每个计分 chunk 不 tokenize 其前序历史，而是按相机共视（camera co-visibility）各自检索 top-K latent；3) 各 chunk 检索请求的并集构成共享 bank，规模受 kK 约束，故序列长度与跨度无关；4) 最短跨度时等价于常规训练；bank 引入一次性开销，此后延长跨度几乎不增成本。
AI.result: 1) 相比滑窗基线，检索在全部 split 上提升重访一致性；2) 跨度长到足以覆盖每次返回的首次到访时，再提升 24%–30%，但图像质量有代价；超过该跨度后延长无益；3) 用另一 episode 填充 bank 使重访相关性下降 83%，证明模型确实利用了检索内容；4) 时长从 100s 增至 400s，步时仅增加 12%。
AI.conclusion: 长跨度监督不必然要求长跨度注意力；通过共视检索构建有界 latent bank，可在近似恒定计算成本下实现长跨度重访监督，并显著提升流式世界模型的重访一致性。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably serve as evaluators of physical plausibility in generative content. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysVista，一个基于"感知-推理-评估"闭环认知框架的视觉语言模型物理智能评测基准，联合评估物理状态感知、物理动态推理与物理合理性判断，并区分事件级与尺度级推理，融合真实与AI生成视频，实验揭示当前VLM在物理理解上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM虽展现强多模态推理能力，但能否真正捕捉真实世界动态背后的物理一致性尚不明确。既有基准评测多为碎片化设计，聚焦孤立认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的内在协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断VLM是否能可靠充当生成内容物理合理性的评估者。
AI.method: 提出PhysVista基准，采用受人类"看-推理-评估"过程启发的闭环认知框架：联合评估物理状态感知、物理动态推理和物理合理性评估；进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理以实现细粒度分析；同时纳入真实世界视频与AI生成视频，支持跨领域及新兴生成场景的评测。
AI.result: 在多种VLM上进行的大量实验表明，模型在物理推理与物理合理性评估方面存在显著局限，暴露出视觉识别与真正物理理解之间持续存在的差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前VLM物理理解的不足，为构建更具原则性、物理奠基的多模态智能指明方向。

title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文比较五种上下文策略在四个开源LLM上的纵向临床推理表现，发现“如何选择与呈现相关证据”比“提供多少病史”更关键。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床推理要求LLM跨越较长病史识别并整合相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能处理更多信息，但提供更多病史并不必然使证据更易获得或提升推理质量，因此需考察上下文组织方式的影响。
AI.method: 在MedLoCoMo数据集上，对四个开源权重LLM比较五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid），评估答案正确性、对查询—证据距离的鲁棒性，以及在前提不成立问题上的弃答表现。
AI.result: Episodic与Hybrid总体准确率最强；Recent Context在证据距离增大时退化最明显，而Episodic与Hybrid在长距离下保持最高准确率。对抗性问题分析显示，在可回答问题上的强表现并不必然转化为面对不支持结论时的成功弃答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的纵向推理不仅取决于LLM可访问多少病史，更关键地取决于相关证据如何被选择并呈现以供推理。

title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
summary: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对齐诱导的不忠实"（AIU）这一新失效模式，即对齐模型在涉及不安全或敏感内容时系统性地偏离输入且不披露修改，与能力驱动的不忠实不同，其源于后训练机制对输入遵循性的人为覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已探讨能力与对齐、能力与忠实性之间的权衡，但"对齐—忠实性冲突"这一第三重张力尚未被充分探索。作者旨在揭示并量化这一被忽视的冲突。
AI.method: 构建受控数据集 FaithConflict，用于隔离能力驱动冲突与对齐驱动冲突；设计两套互补分类法：行为层面（B1-B8）与思维链推理层面（C0-C6）；跨模型、跨规模及中间训练检查点进行评估，并测试基于提示的缓解方法。
AI.result: AIU 随模型规模增大而加剧，且加剧速度超过能力驱动的不忠实，呈现"反向缩放定律"；中间检查点显示该现象在后训练阶段被放大，其中 DPO 阶段差距增长最大且最不易被察觉；基于提示的缓解手段无法解决该问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的设计与评估中存在"能力—对齐—忠实性"三元悖论，提示工程无法消解该困境，需在训练机制与评估框架层面重新审视三者的权衡。

title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

AI.tldr: FORTE：一种免训练的两阶段查询感知关键帧选择框架，通过自适应相关性打分与全局关键帧优化，在有限打分预算下实现长视频问答的最优帧子集选择。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的关键帧选择方法通常在固定的均匀采样候选池中搜索，导致候选池外的证据永远无法被选中。在相关性打分预算有限的条件下，核心挑战在于如何自适应地将评估分配到有潜力的帧，同时持续探索代表性不足的时间区域。
AI.method: FORTE 包含两阶段：（1）自适应相关性打分：从稀疏、均匀分布的观测出发，利用高效高斯过程相关性预测器估计未打分帧的相关性，借助时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算从立方复杂度降至关于帧数的线性复杂度（固定带宽）；（2）打分阶段通过平衡预测相关性与时间覆盖度来决定下一个打分的帧，兼顾有潜力区域与欠代表区域。（3）全局关键帧优化：最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，并推导出精确算法，利用对数覆盖结构在池规模线性时间内（固定最终帧预算）找出最优子集。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在所有测试的打分预算下均取得所比较选择器中最高的观测平均准确率；进一步评估表明其在不同相关性打分器与下游 MLLM 上均保持一致性有效性。
AI.conclusion: FORTE 以免训练方式将关键帧选择建模为自适应探索与全局优化的联合问题，突破了固定候选池的限制，并具备线性时间效率，在长视频多模态问答中展现出稳健且可迁移的优越性能。

title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

AI.tldr: 该论文从"优势能量"视角分析多奖励RL中的批次级信号不平衡，提出密度感知奖励聚合（DARA），通过学习批次自适应权重加速多目标行为学习。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习需同时满足多个行为目标，GDPO的奖励级归一化虽保留了组内相对信息，但不同目标仍存在学习进度不均的问题，需要一个可量化该不平衡并据此校准奖励贡献的机制。
AI.method: 论文引入"优势能量"（一个奖励在一批数据上其归一化优势的平方和）作为分析工具。在理想化GDPO归一化下证明该能量正比于"活跃组密度"，即该奖励在rollout组中提供非零相对优势的比例，从而揭示批次级残留信号不平衡。基于此提出DARA，推导反平方根密度校正，对活跃频率低的奖励赋予更大权重；权重由每个rollout批次计算，训练中自适应更新，且不改变底层策略优化目标。
AI.result: 在工具调用与数学推理任务上，DARA比GDPO更快学到目标行为：工具调用中达到高格式合规所需训练步数最多减少26%，数学推理中达到接近饱和的长度合规所需步数最多减少65%，同时最终性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 优势能量与活跃组密度的正比关系为多奖励LLM训练中的批次级信号不平衡提供了理论刻画与校准依据；DARA以批次自适应、反平方根密度权重的方式在不改动策略目标的前提下加速多目标行为习得，代码已开源。

title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
summary: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence. Project page: https://GeWu-Lab.github.io/Gestalt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gestalt，一种围绕多模态交互构建的新型大型多模态模型范式。它以"多模态交互金字塔"组织建模过程，采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，在图像生成、多模态理解及纯文本任务上均取得强劲表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态的独特特性及其相互关系，导致发展遇到瓶颈。受人类多感官感知多阶段特性的启发，作者希望从模态特异处理、跨模态对齐到深层多模态整合的渐进过程来重新组织多模态建模。
AI.method: 提出"多模态交互金字塔"（multimodal interplay pyramid），将多模态建模组织为从模态特异处理、经跨模态对齐、到深层多模态整合的递进过程。在此指导下，Gestalt 采用统一离散扩散框架（unified discrete diffusion framework）和交互分区架构（interplay-partitioned architecture），并使用可学习的交互 token（interplay tokens）作为跨模态交换与整合的中介；该金字塔同时用于组织数据组织方式与训练策略。
AI.result: 在图像生成、多模态理解和纯文本评测上均取得强劲性能，表明 Gestalt 在显著提升跨模态整合的同时能够保留模态特异信息，有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型的优势。
AI.conclusion: Gestalt 为统一多模态智能提供了一条有前景的路径，通过交互金字塔与离散扩散框架的协同，兼顾跨模态整合与模态特异信息的保留。

title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
summary: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图像裁剪领域标注数据存在的主观性和离散网格刚性两大问题，提出将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上的多峰、连续且尖锐的偏好场（CPF），并据此训练基于VLM和GRPO的裁剪模型CPIC，同时构建重校准基准CPICD。
AI.motivation: 审美图像裁剪任务依赖标注数据进行监督，但现有数据集长期存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 人类标注的主观性；(2) 局限于固定采样网格的刚性离散性。这些缺陷不仅限制了模型的准确性与泛化能力，还严重扭曲了公平评测。因此亟需一种能真实刻画人类裁剪偏好的建模范式，并修复现有基准的评测危机。
AI.method: 作者提出连续偏好场（CPF），将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上的多峰、连续、尖锐的场，通过四个步骤（1）峰值聚类、（2）离格精炼、（3）负向塑形、（4）场组装，从离散标注中恢复稠密的偏好景观。基于CPF奖励，采用GRPO优化训练基于VLM的裁剪模型CPIC。此外构建CPICD，利用CPF修正主流基准中的网格绑定伪影，对现有真值框进行全面重校准。
AI.result: CPIC克服了模板坍缩问题，取得当前最优（SOTA）性能，并展现出卓越的域外泛化能力。CPICD为主流基准建立了严谨可靠的评测基础。大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC和CPICD的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过将裁剪偏好从离散标注提升为连续偏好场，同时解决了数据标注缺陷、模型训练与基准评测三大问题，为图像裁剪研究提供了新的建模范式和可靠的评测基础，代码、模型与数据均已开源。

title: Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Global South in AI
summary: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

AI.tldr: 本文修正了Gural与Murmann就地卷积闭式解中的欠分配与过估计错误，并推广至任意步长、膨胀、填充与矩形核，提出RiP卷积，实现更省内存的逐位一致推理。
AI.motivation: CNN推理在微控制器等受限硬件上受激活内存而非计算限制，直接就地卷积可消除双缓冲开销，但已有内存最优闭式解假设条件苛刻且存在错误，需修正并推广。
AI.method: 识别现有闭式解的两种失效情形（欠分配(k-1)C_in mod (C_out-C_in)、关键腿离开输出网格导致最高2432倍过估计），修正并推广至任意参数；提出RiP卷积，输入右对齐读取、输出左对齐自零写入，利用分段仿射断点O(1)求最小安全间隙，保持行主序访问。
AI.result: 10000个随机层无损坏；84层中58层与herringbone工作区完全一致，81层误差≤5%，平均省24.8%内存；部署于Pico 1/2后，11个MCUNet模型峰值激活内存降12.5%-33.3%，周期数不变且输出逐位一致，Pico 1可容纳模型数由6增至9。
AI.conclusion: RiP卷积在保持逐位一致与性能不变的前提下显著降低激活内存，修正并超越了原有内存最优就地卷积方案，提升了受限硬件上的模型部署能力。

title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
summary: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 JAx（Just Align x）：一种面向像素空间生成模型的预测监督方法，通过在保持 JiT 输入分布的前提下，用马尔可夫退化将带噪学生观测与更干净观测耦合，使干净图像预测跨噪声水平对齐。JAx 无需外部编码器、不改变架构与采样流程，在 ImageNet 256×256 上稳定提升 FID 并加速收敛。
