AI.motivation: 表征对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益难以可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测任务。在 JiT 中发现，辅助特征对齐虽提升语义特征获取，却削减了对干净图像预测所需的图像变化信息的获取，导致辅助目标与去噪任务之间存在错配。这提示应改变思路：辅助监督应改进预测目标本身，而非施加一个独立的表征目标。
AI.method: 提出 JAx（Just Align x）：一种预测监督方法，对齐跨噪声水平的干净图像预测。该方法通过保持原始 JiT 输入分布的马尔可夫退化，将带噪学生观测与更干净观测耦合；在此耦合下，更干净状态的 oracle 预测与最优 JiT 目标具有相同条件均值，且条件目标协方差不更大，因此 oracle 预测对齐在常数意义上保持总体 JiT 目标，同时提供更低方差的训练目标。为在非完美 EMA 教师下实用化，JAx 结合真值监督与可靠性门控耦合带，依据预测风险选择邻近教师状态。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，JAx 在 JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16 上一致提升 FID 并加速收敛，且无需外部编码器，也不改变架构或采样流程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低；消融实验表明增益不能仅由时间重加权解释。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间监督为像素空间生成模型提供了一种简单且有原理依据的替代方案，可取代表征对齐。理论上，耦合式 oracle 预测对齐在保持总体目标的同时降低目标方差；实证上，其一致提升生成质量与收敛效率，且实现开销低。

title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
summary: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Waldo 多语言 QA 基准（12K 问答对，基于维基百科），刻画跨语言知识不对称下的"查询语言偏好"。发现当某一语言版本仅缺失事实时，模型多会跨语言取证；但当各语言版本对同一事实存在冲突时，模型强烈倾向于采用查询语言对应的文档，导致语义等价查询因用户语言不同而得到不同答案；并验证了机制干预与 LoRA 微调两种缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益成为多语言知识密集型信息检索接口，会综合多语言证据作答。已有研究指出模型存在"查询语言偏好"，但多在同等多语言知识可得的前提下考察。当不同语言来源对同一事实的叙述不完整或相互矛盾时，该偏好会产生实质后果：用户获得的信息取决于模型选择采信哪些来源。因此需要针对跨语言知识差异这一更现实的场景进行刻画。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Waldo 基准：从维基百科抽取 12K 问答对，覆盖两类跨语言知识差异——知识缺口（某事实在一种语言存在、在另一语言缺失）与知识冲突（不同语言版本对同一事实给出冲突版本）。2) 在 5 种语言、8 个模型上进行评估，分析查询语言偏好在不同差异类型下的表现。3) 提出并比较两种缓解策略：机制层面消融与查询语言偏好相关的注意力头；基于 LoRA 的训练。
AI.result: 在知识缺口情形下，当某一语言版本仅缺少相关事实时，模型通常不论文查询语言为何都会采用另一语言的证据；在知识冲突情形下，模型回答强烈对齐查询语言所在语言的文档，使语义等价的查询因用户语言不同而引出不同版本的事实叙述，即查询语言偏好被显著放大。缓解方面，LoRA 训练可将偏好差距最多缩小 61.5%。
AI.conclusion: 查询语言偏好在跨语言知识冲突下最具破坏性，会使用户所获事实随查询语言而系统性变化，损害多语言信息检索的可靠性与一致性。知识缺口与知识冲突应区别对待：前者模型多能跨语言补全，后者则暴露明显偏好。机制消融与 LoRA 训练尤其是后者，可作为有效的缓解手段，其中 LoRA 最多降低 61.5% 的偏好差距。

title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
summary: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 Legal Research Bench (LRB) 基准，含 413 道专家编写的美国法律检索开放问题，用全通过式评分与来源验证评估 13 个前沿模型，最强模型仅 42.9% 全对。
AI.motivation: 法律检索是核心且耗时的流程，需辨别支配性权威、验证其有效性、调和法条与判例并综合出有据可依的答案，适合检索密集型语言模型代理。但自动化价值取决于可靠性：漏引权威、过时引用或错误结论都会使看似合理的答案不可用，因此需要可靠的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 LRB 基准，包含 413 道由专家撰写的美国法律检索开放问题，每题配金标准答案、支撑权威和二元评分量表。在具备网页搜索、判例检索、页面解析与检索工具的测试框架中评估 13 个前沿模型，采用全通过式评分与来源验证：仅当所有必需标准均满足且引用权威可验证时才算正确。同时以专家律师验证 LLM 评审，确保分数与律师判断一致。
AI.result: 代理表现远未可靠：测试中最强的 Claude Opus 4.8 全对率仅 42.9%。性能因任务场景差异显著：不同法律领域的全通率不同，在需要调和冲突权威的问题上更低。跨模型看，更多轮次、工具调用与推理成本并不能预测更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: LRB 为法律检索代理提供了带来源验证的严格评测，揭示当前前沿模型在真实法律研究工作流中可靠性不足；增加计算投入不等于提升准确性，可靠性仍是自动化法律检索的关键瓶颈。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks 1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task 2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task 1 and 0.6919 on Task 2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task 1a, joint training on Tasks 1a and 1b performed best for Task 1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task 2. Probability averaging further improved Task 1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Qwen2.5-Instruct的QLoRA统一框架，通过任务定制化训练与聚合策略完成自杀风险分级、证据短语抽取与多标签因素识别三任务，官方榜单综合得分0.7738。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅要求预测风险严重程度，还需给出支撑性语言证据及帖子中表达的风险与保护因素；现有工作往往只关注单一分类任务，缺乏对证据抽取与多标签因素识别的统一建模，且不同任务输出结构差异大，需要针对性的训练目标与结果聚合方式。
AI.method: 以Qwen2.5-Instruct为基座，采用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）与答案掩码的因果语言建模目标进行适配。训练策略分三路：任务1a/1b与风险分类三任务联合训练用于风险分级；任务1a与1b联合训练用于证据抽取；任务2单独适配用于因素识别。聚合层面按任务定制：对32B与72B模型的风险概率取平均，证据短语采用跨折共识（cross-fold consensus）合并，因素标签基于折外（out-of-fold）操作点做率匹配（rate matching）校准。
AI.result: 官方榜单综合得分0.7738，其中Task 1为0.8089，Task 2为0.6919。消融显示：三任务联合训练在Task 1a最优，Task 1a+1b联合训练在Task 1b最优，任务2则任务专用训练最优；当组件模型误差互补时，概率平均可进一步改善Task 1a。
AI.conclusion: 在统一语言模型框架下，应针对每个任务的输出结构分别设计训练目标与聚合策略；任务间联合训练对证据相关任务有增益，而多标签因素识别更依赖任务专用适配，模型集成在多模型误差互补时能带来额外提升。

title: Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation
summary: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对对话生成中回复多样性低的问题，提出在序列到序列模型中引入混合解码器（Mixture of Decoders），在CVAE框架下让每个解码器学习专门的topic，从而提升生成回复的多样性，并在开放域聊天语料上取得优于强基线的定量与人工评测结果。
AI.motivation: 序列到序列对话回复生成模型存在回复多样性低的问题。作者假设其根源在于这类模型倾向于学习到一个退化的单峰（uni-modal）回复分布，而非多模态分布，因此难以生成多样化的回复。
AI.method: 将混合模型思想与序列到序列模型结合：在模型中引入多个解码器（mixture of decoders），并设法使每个解码器学习专门的话题（specialized topics）。整个模型建立在条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架下。
AI.result: 在开放域聊天语料（open domain chat corpus）上进行评测，结果显示该方法在定量指标和人工评测上均优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将混合解码器引入CVAE框架的序列到序列模型，并使各解码器学习专门话题，可以有效缓解单峰分布导致的低多样性问题，提升对话回复生成的多样性。

title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

AI.tldr: HAWK通过选择性融合目标模型中间层隐状态、直接提供压缩视觉隐状态给浅层drafter、并训练drafter建模自身提议后目标预测的变化，提升了LVLM投机解码的接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 投机解码在LLM上已实现显著无损加速，但在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）上效果有限：轻量drafter难以利用丰富的多模态信息；同时标准蒸馏仅沿原始训练轨迹监督drafter，未建模drafter自身提议后目标预测的偏移，导致drafter偏离轨迹时与目标分歧增大，后续步骤接受率下降。
AI.method: HAWK包含三部分：(1) 基于表示相似度选择有信息量的目标层，并学习如何组合其隐状态；(2) 在视觉信息方面，直接向drafter提供来自目标模型的压缩视觉隐状态，而非原始视觉token，使浅层drafter更易利用；(3) 训练drafter捕捉其自身提议后目标预测的变化，提升多步起草中与目标的一致性。
AI.result: 在SmolVLM-256M、十个多模态基准上，贪心解码下平均接受长度从3.32提升至4.08，相对EAGLE-3的加速比从2.19x提升至2.60x；采样解码下接受长度从2.89提升至3.41，加速比从1.92x提升至2.19x。
AI.conclusion: HAWK通过改进特征融合、视觉信息传递与多步起草一致性训练，有效缓解了LVLM投机解码中drafter利用多模态信息不足及偏离轨迹后接受率下降的问题，显著提升了接受长度与推理加速比。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
summary: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

AI.tldr: RuleEvolve：面向编码智能体的自进化编码规则框架，通过变异与评判迭代优化规则池，在多个框架、模型与基准上超越人工设计与既有提示优化基线。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体性能高度依赖底层编码规则，但现有规则多为手工设计且固定不变，导致人力成本高且往往次优。
AI.method: 维护候选编码规则池并迭代改进：每轮由LLM驱动的mutator模块基于现有候选项生成变异体，再由judge模块评估变异体，并将表现最优者用于更新规则池。
AI.result: 在两个编码智能体框架、四种骨干LLM和三个基准上的广泛评估表明，RuleEvolve在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（如token消耗）方面均优于人工工程与现有提示优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 自进化的编码规则优化可有效替代固定的人工规则，提升编码智能体的正确性与效率，并具备跨框架、跨模型与跨任务的泛化能力。

title: Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23068698)
summary: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

AI.tldr: Lingtai 是一种无需训练的“概念遥测层”，在每步解码时将残差状态投影到无标签构建的概念锚点库上，得到逐步概念坐标信号。该信号与预测不确定性稳健关联，并揭示任务条件下的活动结构与执行特异轨迹，但不提供稳定的正确性坐标，开销仅 0.7–1.6%。
AI.motivation: 在线观察大语言模型自回归推理中所计算内容的现有方法，多需训练探针或难以在推理时实时获取信息，缺乏无需训练且无需标注的概念级可观测手段。
AI.method: 提出 Lingtai 概念遥测层：在每个生成步骤，将残差状态投影到领域特定的命名概念锚点库（161 个锚点用于代码实现）。锚点构建不使用标注概念示例、结果标签、梯度拟合或激活空间优化；输出结构化的逐步概念坐标信号。在代码生成与小学数学推理上评估，并进行问题身份、token 位置、token 类型、正确/错误混合、随机锚点及 K-means/PCA 投影对照。进一步分析活动熵形状与完成级弹性对齐下的轨迹检索。
AI.result: 概念坐标信号与预测不确定性稳健关联，该关联在问题身份与 token 位置控制下仍存在，不归因于单一 token 类型，在 GSM8K 上不能由简单正确/错误混合解释，也不能被匹配随机锚点复现；在 K-means 与 PCA 投影中显著更弱或方向不一致。发现两种结构：随任务条件变化的活动-熵形状（HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K 不同），以及执行特异轨迹身份——强局部惯性但弱重实例化不变性：在匹配重执行子集上 k=32 损坏仍以 62.0% 检索到存档轨迹，而全新执行仅 11.7–16.0%。匹配审计未发现该标量概念活动信号在测试协议下提供稳定正确性坐标，故将正确性视为外部输入。
AI.conclusion: Lingtai 可作为无需训练、低开销的概念遥测层，用于在线刻画模型推理中的不确定性相关活动与执行轨迹结构；但其标量概念活动不足以替代正确性信号，正确性需外部提供，且相关结构的因果与泛化意义仍待进一步验证。

title: PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026)
summary: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PhysicsMate——一个基于孟加拉国 NCTB 9-10 年级物理课程、由知识图谱支撑的 1834 条问答基准，并通过统一低秩适配（LoRA）在 0.6B/1.7B/4B 三种规模上验证了闭卷准确率的显著提升，并给出可在资源受限环境离线部署的量化方案。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国中等教育缺乏与课程对齐的 STEM 解题评测基准；通用语言模型在物理问题所需的专业术语、单位规范和公式推导上表现不佳。因此需要构建课程锚定的基准与适配方法，以支持课程对齐的物理学习。
AI.method: 1) 依据 NCTB 9-10 年级物理教学大纲构建 1834 条问答对；2) 构建多关系知识图谱，包含 1760 个节点、2600 条边、10 种本体类型；3) 采用统一的低秩适配（LoRA）配方，在 0.6B、1.7B、4B 参数规模模型上进行适配；4) 进行节点类型维度的收益分析；5) 将 4B 模型量化并打包为小型离线二进制以支持本地推理。
AI.result: 三个规模上闭卷准确率均显著提升，分别提升 +5.5、+15.0 和 +23.3 个百分点；节点类型分析显示，结构化课程知识（物理量与具名定律）受益最大，而定义松散的实体级知识受益最小；4B 模型经适配与量化后可形成小型离线二进制，支持资源受限环境下的本地推理。
AI.conclusion: PhysicsMate 证明了课程锚定的知识图谱基准与统一 LoRA 适配能有效提升多规模模型的物理解题能力，且收益随模型规模增大而增强；量化后的离线方案为连接性与硬件受限环境提供了可行的课程对齐物理学习支持路径。

title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
summary: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VisionQ，首个基于同行评审计算机视觉论文对比图的基准，用于"标准条件化的视觉判别"任务，要求评判模型在指定视觉标准下选出作者认可的最优输出。
AI.motivation: 定性对比图是计算机视觉论文的核心证据，VLM 越来越多被用于评判它们，但现有基准只给出标量质量或整体偏好打分，导致模型可能因错误的视觉理由而选对图像却获得奖励，缺乏可解释且可验证的评判标准。
AI.method: 构建 VisionQ 基准：包含 1,409 篇 CVPR/ICCV 论文、1,800+ 验证过的对比图和 3,911 个人工标注数据点（将方法裁剪图与作者陈述的视觉主张关联）；建立六轴、51 叶的视觉标准分类体系；设计隐藏方法名、图注和论文身份的标准条件化评测协议，按标准分别报告准确率；并提出 DPO 微调的 Gemma-4-E4B 评判模型 VisionQ-Judge，基于对称证据对训练。
AI.result: VisionQ-Judge 将"最后选项"预测降低 7.0 个百分点，在留出测试集上准确率提升 2.5 个百分点。对 20 个开源与闭源 VLM 评判模型评测显示，最强模型仅达 63.1% 准确率（随机为 32.2%），且不同标准间可靠性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有 VLM 评判模型在视觉判别上远未可靠，且性能随评判标准剧烈波动；VisionQ 提供了标准条件化、可验证的评测框架与数据集，推动更可信的定性对比图评判研究。

title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

AI.tldr: 本文为循环语言模型（Looped LM）建立实用训练配方：将从头训练预算从7.7T降至310B token，受控对比下1.4B LoopLM在全部12个基准上超越同参数量密集模型，并提出将预训练密集模型低成本转为循环模型的极简配方。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层块来增加有效深度，但现有大规模训练配方需多阶段、消耗数万亿token，且循环带来的收益难以与数据、训练差异分离，因此需要更高效的训练配方并隔离循环本身的贡献。
AI.method: (1) 开发计算高效的全新训练流程：预训练+高质量中训练，配合学习率预热与更强的出口门控正则化，实现无需先前多阶段调度的稳定循环训练；(2) 在受控条件下（相同数据与token预算）对比1.4B LoopLM与参数匹配的密集模型；(3) 提出最小化转换配方：仅一个可学习的输入混合标量与平滑出口损失，无步骤特定参数，应用于Qwen3-1.7B-Base。
AI.result: 训练预算从7.7T降至310B token并保持强推理性能；1.4B LoopLM在全部12个基准上超过同参数密集模型（GSM8K +14、MATH +10、DROP +22），在同等推理算力下逼近3.9B密集模型的数学推理与阅读理解，仅用36%参数量；Looped Qwen在两种数据设置下每个基准均优于相同继续训练的密集基线，在精选混合数据上GSM8K、MATH、MMLU-Pro取得统计显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 循环语言模型从零训练的成本大幅降低，并可实用地引入现有预训练检查点，同时有效隔离了循环结构本身带来的性能增益。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的AR内容自动评估与优化框架:构建RateAR基准(ICC(2,5)≥.90),评测11个商用VLM,其预测与主观评分Spearman相关最高0.8695,并据此实现自动调整系统,21人用户研究中>90%认为改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
AI.motivation: AR头戴显示受限于场景几何约束、空间抖动和时间不稳定,难以优化终端用户的沉浸感与舒适度。传统用户研究是视觉质量评估的标准方法,但成本高、可扩展性递减、灵活性差,成为迭代式应用设计的瓶颈。因此需要自动化的AR内容评估与优化方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建RateAR基准:采集多场景、多环境条件下的AR图像与视频,在物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知维度上达到良好至优秀的评分者信度(ICC(2,5)≥.90);2) 在该基准上评测11个商用VLM,评估其质量预测与人类主观判断的相关性;3) 开展消融实验,比较不同提示策略,发现上下文提示在与人评对齐和引入复杂度线索之间取得更好平衡;4) 基于上述发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统并开展21人用户研究。
AI.result: VLM质量预测与人类主观评分高度相关,Spearman秩相关最高达0.8695;上下文提示优于其他提示策略,与人类评分对齐更佳且复杂度线索更均衡;在21人用户研究中,超过90%的参与者认为该系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
AI.conclusion: VLM可作为AR视觉保真度评估的可扩展替代方案,缓解用户研究在成本与可扩展性上的瓶颈;所提自动化框架与调整系统在实证中验证了有效性,为迭代式AR应用设计提供了自动化评估与优化路径。

title: Bayesian Fine-tuning Yields Language Models that are as Bayesian as their Beliefs Allow
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used for tasks that require reasoning about hidden variables from a few observations, for which Bayesian inference is the normatively correct solution. While supervised fine-tuning of an LM on the outputs of an optimal $\textit{Bayesian}$ model leads to near-Bayesian behavior, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the true answers for the task falls short of it. But behavior alone does not tell us $\textit{why}$ tuning on a $\textit{Bayesian}$ or an $\textit{oracle}$ (true answers) signal differs: whether the resulting LM represents Bayesian beliefs, acts on them, or turns them into a choice the way Bayes' rule does. To compare them, we formulate increasingly demanding requirements for an LM to count as a Bayesian decision maker, spanning its behavior, representations, and computations, and test them on a flight recommendation task. The Bayes-trained LM acts Bayesian, encodes quantities of Bayes' rule in its middle layers, and uses the encoded belief for the recommendation to a certain extent. The oracle-trained LM differs from it both in the beliefs it holds and whether it reads beliefs out into recommendations. Exchanging beliefs between the LMs transfers a part of the Bayesian advantage. Bayes fine-tuning thus installs usable Bayesian beliefs in an LM for reasoning under uncertainty in a way standard SFT on oracle answers cannot, highlighting the advantage of nuanced supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文对比了在贝叶斯信号与真实答案信号下微调语言模型的效果，提出多层级判定标准检验LM是否为贝叶斯决策者，发现在航班推荐任务中贝叶斯微调使LM编码并部分使用贝叶斯信念，而真实答案微调则不能。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地用于从少量观测推断隐藏变量的任务，贝叶斯推断是规范性正确解法。已有研究发现对最优贝叶斯模型输出做监督微调可带来接近贝叶斯的行为，而标准SFT（用任务真实答案）则达不到。但仅凭行为无法解释两种信号差异的根源：LM是在表征贝叶斯信念、据此行动，还是像贝叶斯法则那样将其转化为选择。因此需要更细致地比较两者的内在机制。
AI.method: 作者为"LM可算作贝叶斯决策者"制定了逐级提高的要求，涵盖行为、表征与计算三个层面，并在航班推荐任务上进行测试。通过对比贝叶斯微调（在最优贝叶斯模型输出上训练）与oracle微调（在真实答案上训练）的LM，考察其信念表征与读出方式，并进行信念交换实验。
AI.result: 贝叶斯微调的LM表现出贝叶斯行为，在其中间层编码了贝叶斯法则的相关量，并在一定程度上将所编码的信念用于推荐。oracle微调的LM在持有的信念以及是否将信念读入推荐两方面均与之不同。在两个LM之间交换信念可以转移部分贝叶斯优势。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯微调能在LM中安装可用于不确定性推理的、可用的贝叶斯信念，这是标准SFT（基于oracle答案）所无法实现的，凸显了细致监督信号的优势。

title: Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurReps 2026: Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.

AI.tldr: 该文研究曲率作为表示特性的实现敏感性问题，通过在hZACH-ViT上对比欧氏、Poincaré与球面原型头，发现固定曲率下Poincaré的对抗攻击成功率最低但干净MacroF1也最低；端到端曲率干预（降至c=0.1）可提升干净精度却显著提高强攻击成功率，说明曲率的鲁棒性效应依赖于尺度、温度与数值保护，而非内在的双曲鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 曲率常被视为表示的固有属性，但其经验效应还受坐标尺度、学习到的logit温度与数值保护机制影响。作者希望厘清曲率与这些实现因素如何交互，并检验“双曲几何天然更鲁棒”这一常见假设是否成立。
AI.method: 构建紧凑型Vision Transformer（hZACH-ViT），配备欧氏、Poincaré与球面三种原型头；在三个MedMNIST数据集、五个随机种子上匹配骨干架构、种子初始化、每类50样本的训练子集与优化协议。比较固定曲率c=1下的PGD与CE+DLR多起点攻击，并进行端到端曲率干预（Poincaré降至c=0.1），结合层次化自助法置信区间分析。
AI.result: c=1时Poincaré在全部12个数据集-预算单元中类宏平均PGD攻击成功率最低，强攻击下亦然，但干净MacroF1最低。降至c=0.1后，15个配对种子-数据集比较中干净MacroF1全部提升并消除硬边界截断，但OrganAMNIST上强攻击成功率从89.7%升至99.3%（配对差+9.57点，95%层次自助CI [+5.52,+14.03]）。c=1时40–47%干净Poincaré特征被硬截断，继承映射的径向雅可比接近零，无量纲攻击轨迹异常长且低效。球面头作为对照，其曲率变化是精确尺度规范，攻击差异很小。
AI.conclusion: 结果不支持内在的双曲鲁棒性，而是揭示了一个实现敏感区间：曲率、尺度与Poincaré边界的接近程度共同决定了干净识别性能与对抗表示运动的组织方式。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SemanTok，一种灵活的变长视频 tokenizer：将冻结的 DINO 特征输入编码器，并添加轻量头使每个保留的 token 前缀即可重建这些语义特征，从而在语义对齐与视频保真度上同时取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有灵活变长 tokenizer 仅在解码器早期隐状态上施加表示对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可部分依靠带噪输入满足该目标，导致语义对齐不足。作者希望让每个 token 前缀本身都承载语义信息，以提升 AR 视频世界模型的保真度与语义质量。
AI.method: SemanTok 将冻结的 DINO 特征送入编码器，并附加轻量预测头，要求从每个保留的 token 前缀单独重建 DINO 特征，从而在粗到细的变长 token 序列中实现逐前缀的强语义对齐。
AI.result: 201M 的 SemanTok AR 模型可匹敌或超越 3.4 倍规模（约 683M）的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型，更大的 SemanTok AR 模型保真度进一步提升；在分布外类别上仍保持语义对齐；在包括纯噪声在内的各噪声水平下解码器语义对齐更高；重建与生成均表现良好，短 token 前缀预测成本更低且生成保真度更好，像素细节交由后续 token 补足。
AI.conclusion: SemanTok 通过逐前缀重建冻结 DINO 特征，实现了高语义对齐与高视频保真度的灵活变长视频 tokenizer，在效率与质量上优于现有方法，适合用于基于 AR 的视频世界模型。

title: Towards Robust Numerical Claim Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for claim verification, yet remain brittle for numerical reasoning: even small changes in value can sharply degrade accuracy. We show that this brittleness persists in frontier LLMs, but can be mitigated through adversarial fine-tuning on numerically perturbed examples. Using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, small Qwen3 models (0.6B$\unicode{x2013}$8B) reach 98.7% accuracy on label-flipping perturbations, outperforming larger zero-shot models and frontier systems (GPT-5.4 Pro (74.0%) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (73.9%)). The gains generalise to unseen perturbation types, indicating robust numerical decision boundaries rather than memorised edits. Robustness also transfers without target-domain data, significantly improving cross-lingual performance in Spanish. We further show that the same fine-tuning recipe confers robustness to evidence-side perturbations, using the VitaminC dataset.

AI.tldr: LLM在数值推理上很脆弱，但经数值扰动样本的对抗微调后可大幅提升鲁棒性，小模型表现甚至超过前沿系统。
AI.motivation: LLM虽广泛用于主张验证（claim verification），但在数值推理上仍然脆弱：数值的微小变化就会导致准确率急剧下降。作者希望验证这种脆弱性在前沿LLM中是否依然存在，并寻找缓解方法。
AI.method: 采用参数高效微调（parameter-efficient fine-tuning），在数值扰动样本上进行对抗微调，模型为小型Qwen3（0.6B–8B）；此外在VitaminC数据集上验证该微调方案对证据侧（evidence-side）扰动的效果。
AI.result: 在标签翻转（label-flipping）扰动上达到98.7%准确率，超过更大的零样本模型及前沿系统（GPT-5.4 Pro 74.0%、Gemini 2.5 Flash 73.9%）；增益可泛化到未见扰动类型，并能在无目标域数据的情况下迁移，显著提升西班牙语跨语言表现；同样对证据侧扰动有效。
AI.conclusion: 对抗微调能构建稳健的数值决策边界，而非记忆化编辑，具有良好的泛化性与跨语言、跨扰动类型的迁移能力。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.tldr: 提出Soundwich，一个免训练框架，将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转化为可生成与共享视频同步、可独立编辑的多音轨（stems）生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型通常只生成单一混合音轨，缺乏源级控制，与实际工作流中语音、音乐、音效、环境声分离且可编辑的需求不符。
AI.method: 通过共享场景表示跨音轨传递全局音视频上下文以保持独立生成声音的连贯性，并路由每个音轨与其对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互以提升一致性；无需训练，基于冻结的流匹配模型。
AI.result: 实验与人类评估显示在时间控制、源分离和自然度方面均有提升，并支持源级编辑且保持连贯的音视频生成；各音轨可与视频保持同步，并支持独立重定时、静音、替换或重混。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich实现了在连贯音视频生成中灵活的源级编辑，为多音轨同步可控的联合音视频生成提供了有效方案。

title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.

AI.tldr: 提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD，通过分离全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数，并结合调制感知的方向性聚合策略，缓解遥感图像分类中数据异构带来的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在遥感领域因无需直接访问本地数据即可协同训练而受关注，但客户端间数据分布异构（地理差异、季节变化、成像与大气条件不同）会显著降低FL性能。
AI.method: 在骨干网络中引入轻量调制模块与本地批归一化层，将全局共享表征参数与客户端特定适配参数分离；全局参数在客户端间协同优化，客户端特定参数保留在本地；并提出调制感知的方向性聚合策略，依据本地调制更新的对齐程度动态调整各客户端聚合权重，抑制来自异构数据的冲突更新，增强适配行为一致客户端的贡献。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上的实验结果表明，在异构遥感数据分布下，FedMAD优于当前最先进的联邦学习算法。
AI.conclusion: FedMAD通过参数解耦与方向性聚合有效应对遥感数据异构问题，提升联邦遥感图像分类性能；代码将开源。

title: How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models
summary: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.

AI.tldr: 压缩语言模型的"翻转率"（argmax token 改变的比例）直接由总变差（TV）度量，而非 KL 散度；在 802 个扰动副本上二者比值中位数为 1.05 且无需拟合常数。
AI.motivation: 部署依赖稠密模型输出的场景需要知道压缩后有多少决策发生改变，但现有压缩报告通常用 KL 散度来刻画模型偏移，KL 并不能直接回答"改变了多少决策"这一问题。
AI.method: 在 19 个开源模型的 802 个压缩/扰动副本上，覆盖 5 个语料与 9 类机制上互不相关的扰动族；将翻转率与 TV、KL、Hellinger 距离等逐 token 一阶统计量进行对比；并进行两项预注册检验（留出代码语料、三个带真实 kernel 的新模型）以及在 vLLM 投机解码中的验证。
AI.result: 翻转率与 TV 的比值中位数为 1.05（无拟合常数）；KL 只能通过其平方根及一个在模型和语料间变化达四倍的因子转化为翻转率，因其先对 token 求平均再开方；逐 token 平均的一阶统计量（如 Hellinger 距离）可避免此问题但报告少见。在两个压缩机翻转率相差 ≥10% 时，KL 在 11% 的情况下把更小散度错误分配给改变决策更多者，TV 仅 1%。预注册检验中，留出代码语料上八个模型比值均成立而关于 KL 的三个预测各有一半以上失效；三个真实 kernel 新模型在 38 个检查点中有 37 个落在区间内，但两个模型在代码上比值降至 1 以下。vLLM 投机解码中，teacher forcing 下测得的 TV 预测贪心草稿接受率的平均相对误差为 1.1–2.4%，且无需 KL 所需的针对性校准。
AI.conclusion: 总变差而非 KL 散度才是"压缩后决策改变比例"的正确直接度量；一阶逐 token 统计量比 KL 更具可比性与部署实用性，但预注册检验也揭示了该方法在代码语料等情形下的边界。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM驱动发现中"历史迭代种群"与最终发现成功率的关系，提出12种模块化harness并在5个任务上评测，发现发现过程脆弱、易发生模式坍缩，且早期发现表现可预测最终成功，据此提出"并行探索初始化"干预方法，在多种harness和应用上获得稳定增益。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于算法、定理、药物等新发现，通常依赖harness提示模型迭代优化目标函数。然而，历史迭代种群（population of previous iterates）如何影响发现成功率尚不清晰，harness设计对结果的影响缺乏系统刻画，且现有提升多样性的干预效果不稳定，因此需要厘清其内在机制并寻找更普适的改进方案。
AI.method: 作者将以往harness设计工作进行泛化，构建了包含12种harness的"Modular"套件，并在5个多样化发现任务上刻画其性能。通过分析迭代种群的多样性，识别出模式坍缩（mode collapse）这一常见失败模式，并评估主流SOTA harness及多样性诱导干预的效果。基于"早期发现表现可预测最终成功"的观察，提出一种通用干预：先进行并行探索阶段，用以初始化后续的迭代优化过程。
AI.result: 发现成功率具有脆弱性且对harness设计高度敏感；模式坍缩（迭代多样性急剧下降）是普遍失败模式；主流SOTA harness和旨在延缓坍缩的多样性干预带来不一致的增益；早期发现的表现对最终成功具有预测性；所提并行探索初始化方法在多种harness和目标应用上取得稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM驱动的发现过程中，迭代种群的初始化至关重要。与其在迭代中被动地维持多样性，不如通过初始阶段的并行探索为后续迭代优化提供良好起点，该方法普适且能稳定提升发现成功率。

title: Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions
summary: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.

AI.tldr: 提出FTC，一种面向LLM注意力的序列化结构化压缩框架，在固定存储预算下联合利用Q/K/V头结构并逐层适配压缩后模型，无需微调即取得最优困惑度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM注意力后训练压缩常被建模为独立的矩阵近似，既忽略了注意力各投影间的共享结构，也未考虑先前压缩带来的表示漂移（representation shift），导致压缩效果受限。
AI.method: FTC为序列化结构化压缩框架：在每个压缩步骤中将近似适配到当前已压缩模型，同时在固定存储预算下联合利用原生Q/K/V头结构；输出投影单独处理，以应对注意力之后表示的变化；整个过程无需微调或基于梯度的恢复。
AI.result: 在7个6B至32B参数的decoder-only LLM上，FTC在5个现代GQA模型的每个测试保留率下均取得最低WikiText-2困惑度，激进压缩下增益最大；改进可迁移到下游任务，且在32B规模上依然显著。
AI.conclusion: FTC通过序列化适配与头结构联合建模，有效缓解表示漂移与结构忽略问题，在无需微调的前提下实现了跨规模、跨保留率的一致且可迁移的注意力压缩优势。

title: Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models
summary: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督方法从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格表征，在9个教师模型超10万条数学推理轨迹中发现6种反复出现的风格；通过重要性加权微调学生模型显式控制风格，在6个数学推理基准上提升Pass@k，并证明风格影响解题正确性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在训练中同时学习内容与风格，二者纠缠导致输出中的风格变化难以识别与控制。作者希望探究模型回复中反复出现的风格是否可被无监督发现，并能被显式控制，从而将风格作为一种可控且能提升推理表现的资源。
AI.method: 设计算法从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格的表示，先在受控数学问答设置上验证有效性；随后将该方法应用于9个不同教师模型的10万余条经验证推理轨迹，无监督地发现6种反复出现但分布不均衡的风格；再用重要性加权对较小的学生模型进行微调，使其在显式风格条件下生成回答，以平衡语料中各类风格的贡献。
AI.result: 在6个数学推理基准上，该方法相比在相同数据上的标准微调提升了Pass@k；请求风格与实际生成风格之间高度一致；风格影响正确性——解题概率取决于所条件的风格，且不同问题受益于不同风格。
AI.conclusion: 模型生成数据中的风格变化可被无监督发现并显式化，这不仅提供了对输出风格的控制手段，也成为提升推理性能的来源。

title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
summary: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个基于用户历史记录的个性化图像生成统一基准（含两个互补任务与多维度评估协议），并提出PEARL方法，将多模态推理器与冻结图像生成器耦合于交错"推理-反思"循环中，以差分数据奖励优化，在两项任务上平均提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有个人化图像生成局限于从精选视觉示例进行条件合成，未能刻画"用户是谁"；而真实用户的个人语境更为丰富，包含随时间积累的评论、帖子、图像、标题与元数据。真正个性化的生成器应利用这些历史来生成契合用户生活方式与审美偏好的图像。为此需要一个统一的基准与相应方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个基于用户历史的个性化图像生成统一基准，包含两个互补任务与多轴评估协议，评估目标保真度、视觉质量、用户可区分性、与用户历史的语义对齐以及任务特定效用；根植于真实电商与社交媒体场景。2) 两个任务为：个性化场景生成（将给定物体置入反映用户偏好与生活方式的场景）与个性化创意生成（就指定主题生成符合用户审美与视觉身份的新图像）。3) 提出PEARL：将多模态推理器与冻结图像生成器耦合，在交错"推理-反思"循环中运行，并用差分数据奖励优化。
AI.result: 在两个任务上，PEARL均优于强基线，在个性化指标上平均提升15%。
AI.conclusion: 个性化图像生成应转向基于用户历史这一更丰富语境的方向；该工作通过统一基准与PEARL方法验证了该范式的有效性，并设定了多维评估标准。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分离亮度与色度监督，研究3DGS中几何与外观学习的主导因素，发现几何形成强烈依赖亮度信息。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS从RGB监督中联合学习几何与外观，难以分离亮度与色度对学习表征的贡献，因此需要一种受控实验来解耦二者作用。
AI.method: 在不同通道监督下训练模型，冻结非外观参数（位置、尺度、旋转、不透明度），用相同求解器重新估计外观，再比较留出集重建效果。基于11个基准场景、每个4次独立运行进行实验。
AI.result: 仅亮度学得的几何在留出集重建上平均比RGB训练几何低0.085 dB。删除色度后，足够表达的求解器可在冻结几何上重拟合至原质量或略好。高阶球谐对亮度贡献更大，平均提升PSNR 1.44 dB，对色度仅0.19 dB，但镜面表面色相仍随视角变化。几何形成阶段亮度优势更大。仅色度监督产生的几何比仅亮度监督差3.9-5.5 dB，致密化解释部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 标准3DGS中的几何形成强烈由亮度主导但非亮度独有，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成后恢复。

title: What Do Verifiable Rewards Teach Video-Language Models About Time? A Controlled Multi-Model Study
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has produced large reasoning gains in language models, and verifiable video benchmarks make it applicable to causal-temporal video question answering. We study what RLVR teaches video-language models about time. We fine-tune four open models (Qwen3-VL-8B/4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Gemma-3-12B) with group relative policy optimization under three data recipes: verified (synthetic CLEVRER questions with exact answer and event-order rewards), unverified (self-supervised pretext tasks over 43,751 real web videos), and a 1:1 mixture, plus a verified+real arm that adds 4,000 verifiable questions on real video. Each cell is evaluated in-domain and on out-of-domain real video (a NExT-QA temporal stress set and an MVBench subset), with frames in order, shuffled, and absent. (1) Verified training yields large in-domain gains that shrink as base competence grows (+14 to +19 points on weaker models; +6 on the strongest). (2) Much of the gain is non-visual: accuracy with no frames rises nearly as much as with frames. (3) Verified-only training can severely degrade out-of-domain accuracy with no sign during training: Qwen3-VL-8B loses 26.7 and 25.2 points on the two real-video sets, while the mixture never significantly degrades a model trained on it. Adding real verified questions removes that loss (-2.3 points, within noise of base) and keeps a +9.3 in-domain gain, so the cause is narrow synthetic-only data, not verification. (4) No recipe induces temporal-order grounding: across 41 evaluations the ordered-versus-shuffled gap is indistinguishable from zero in 39 and marginal in two, despite an event-order reward. Verifiable rewards improve benchmark accuracy without temporal understanding. Report no-frame controls, and mix in real video to guard against out-of-domain degradation.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）对视频语言模型时间理解能力的实际影响。作者用GRPO微调四个开源模型，设计verified、unverified、混合及verified+real四种数据配方，并在域内及域外真实视频上以帧有序、打乱、缺失三种条件评估。结论：可验证奖励能提升基准准确率，但主要收益是非视觉性的、且不产生时间顺序接地，纯合成数据训练还会导致严重的域外退化。
AI.motivation: RLVR已在语言模型推理上带来大幅提升，且可验证的视频基准使其适用于因果-时间视频问答。然而，尚不清楚RLVR究竟让视频语言模型学到了关于"时间"的什么——即它提升的是真正的时序理解，还是仅利用了捷径或非视觉线索。作者希望厘清可验证奖励对时间建模的作用，并识别训练数据配方带来的潜在风险。
AI.method: 采用GRPO对四个开源模型（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Gemma-3-12B）微调，设置三种数据配方：verified（合成CLEVRER问题，含精确答案与事件顺序奖励）、unverified（对43,751个真实网络视频的自监督 pretext 任务）、二者1:1混合；另加一个verified+real臂（在真实视频上增加4,000个可验证问题）。每个实验单元在域内及域外真实视频（NExT-QA时间压力集与MVBench子集）上评估，输入帧分有序、打乱、缺失三种条件。
AI.result: (1) 可验证训练在域内带来大幅提升，但随基座能力增强而收窄（弱模型+14至+19分，最强模型+6分）。(2) 大部分增益是非视觉的：无帧输入的准确率提升几乎与有帧时相当。(3) 纯verified训练会严重损害域外准确率且训练中无任何征兆：Qwen3-VL-8B在两个真实视频集上分别下降26.7和25.2分，而混合配方从未显著退化；加入真实视频可验证问题后该损失消失（-2.3分，在基座噪声范围内）并保留+9.3分域内增益，说明原因是狭窄的纯合成数据而非验证本身。(4) 没有一种配方能诱导时间顺序接地：在41项评估中，有序与打乱帧的差距在39项中与零无法区分，另2项仅为边际差异，尽管存在事件顺序奖励。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励能提升基准准确率，但并未带来真正的时间理解。作者建议：报告中必须包含无帧对照（no-frame control）以排除非视觉捷径，并混合真实视频数据以防止域外退化。

title: Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces
summary: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出强化表征几何中信号-噪声分解（SNF）与信号-信号分解（SSF）的正则化方法，实验表明SNF正则化能提升模型性能并显著改善对图像失真的鲁棒性，而SSF正则化无明显增益。
AI.motivation: 既有理论研究指出表征几何的若干基本属性影响深度网络的推理能力，包括信号-噪声分解（SNF，将信号从噪声中分离）与信号-信号分解（SSF，将任务相关信号与任务无关信号分离）。作者希望验证在训练中显式强化这两种几何属性是否能够塑造表征结构并提升模型性能，尤其是在存在分布外图像失真的生物医学场景下。
AI.method: 构建分别强化SNF与SSF的正则化器，并将其与L2正则化基线网络进行对比。在CIFAR-100分类任务上评估正则化器对表征几何与性能的影响；随后在经MedMNIST-C五种严重程度腐蚀处理的BloodMNIST数据集上测试鲁棒性。进一步分析不同正则化条件下的噪声子空间结构，并在留出数据上估计腐蚀诱导的主导方向，将其从表征中投影剔除。
AI.result: 强化SNF可提升模型性能，而强化SSF未带来提升。在受MedMNIST-C腐蚀的BloodMNIST上，SNF正则化器带来更大的性能增益。分析表明，SNF正则化模型将噪声表征在与类别相关信号不同的独立子空间中；由于该几何结构显式可分，可在留出数据上估计腐蚀诱导的主导方向并从表征中投影去除，从而带来显著的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 强制信号-噪声分解的正则化器可在推理时存在分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务中产生显著改进，并揭示表征塑造影响模型性能的关键：将干扰变量与类别变量隔离，比维持类别变量自身的分解表征更为重要。

title: Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自监督学习中网络宽度与深度对贪心逐层训练与端到端反向传播训练效果的影响，发现网络越宽，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练的优势越小，在较浅且极宽的网络中贪心逐层训练甚至表现更好。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习训练的主流方式，已有研究探索了更简单的替代训练机制，但局部优化网络（不进行误差端到端反向传播）在何种架构条件下能学到与端到端训练相当的表示仍不清楚。作者希望在自监督学习这一大规模预训练框架下回答该问题。
AI.method: 在卷积网络的自监督学习中，系统考查网络宽度与深度两个架构因素，对比贪心逐层训练与端到端自监督训练的效果，并对两种训练方式下网络所形成的表示进行几何分析。
AI.result: 在更宽的网络中，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练的性能优势逐渐缩小；在相对较浅且极宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练甚至取得更高的性能。表示分析显示，极宽的贪心训练网络比端到端反向传播网络具有更有利的表示几何。
AI.conclusion: 网络宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配，表示几何上的差异是贪心逐层训练性能提升的潜在机制。

title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Token-Budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI)，用低分辨率 Video Preview 提供全局覆盖，并构建紧凑的高分辨率 Evidence Set，联合解决证据定位与预算分配；通过特权自蒸馏（answer-aware teacher 指导测试时策略）缓解帧级监督缺失，单一策略支持 1/6/12/24 token/帧四种预览分辨率的设置，在有限视觉预算下提升问答准确率与时间证据定位效果。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答受限于视觉 token 成本高以及现有 VLM 上下文窗口固定。长视频问题需要较广的时间覆盖，但答案往往只由少量关键片段支撑，因此如何在有限高分辨率帧预算下高效定位这些片段成为核心问题。
AI.method: 提出 token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing（VEI）：在给定密集低分辨率 Video Preview 条件下构建紧凑高分辨率 Evidence Set。将 VEI 建模为策略，联合求解 evidence localization（定位问题相关时刻）与 budget planning（决定高分辨率帧预算分配）。实现为推理流水线：Video Preview 提供廉价全局覆盖，Video Evidence Indexing 构建 Evidence Set，Answer Generation 融合两者完成 VQA。针对帧级监督缺失，采用 privileged self-distillation，由 answer-aware teacher 在 student 生成的 indexing traces 上指导正常测试时策略；并探索 1、6、12、24 视觉 token/帧的预览，训练单一策略支持全部四种分辨率。
AI.result: 实验表明，Video Evidence Indexing 在有限视觉预算下提升准确率；self-distillation 进一步同时提升 QA 准确率与时间证据定位效果。
AI.conclusion: token-budgeted VEI 有效缓解长视频问答的视觉 token 成本与固定上下文宽度限制，通过 evidence localization 与 budget planning 的联合优化，以及特权自蒸馏提供的隐式帧级监督，在受限预算下实现更优的问答性能与证据定位，单策略可覆盖多预览分辨率。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 提出"嫁接"(grafting)方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将其权重更新加到已后训练模型上，从而在不重跑后训练的情况下近似忠实的中训练干预效果。
AI.motivation: 预训练阶段形成的信念会决定模型如何从后续训练中泛化，因此对预训练进行干预是对齐研究的关键。合成文档微调(SDF)旨在改变模型信念，理想情况下应混入预训练/中训练语料，但每次语料改动都需完整重跑后训练才能评估效果，迭代慢且昂贵。常见做法是直接在已后训练模型上做SDF，但会遗留伪影、损害能力，并导致"现实漂移"(reality drift)——模型把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在。
AI.method: Grafting：先在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后把学到的权重更新直接加到后训练模型上，复用已有的后训练流程来近似忠实的中训练干预。在最大284B参数的多个模型家族上验证，任务包括植入虚假事实、训练失准的模型生物体、施加宪法式中训练干预。
AI.result: Grafting植入目标信念的强度与在后训练模型上直接做SDF相当，同时平均将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失降低一半以上，并且更接近忠实的完整中训练运行结果。
AI.conclusion: 由于无需重做后训练，同一适配器可应用于任意后续检查点，研究者只需一次微调成本即可快速迭代预训练干预方案。

title: Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals
summary: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that this is insufficient for synthetic data, and that group-level signals (i.e., estimates of utility that account for interactions among data samples) are necessary for effective data curation. First, we show that individual-level signals are blind to how samples jointly affect training: synthetic datasets with different compositions can be indistinguishable under individual-level influence yet differ sharply under group-level influence, and curating by the latter yields better downstream performance, particularly in generative capability. Second, we find that group-level signals matter more as training pipelines become increasingly synthetic: among widely used data curation methods, only those incorporating them improve over baseline, with gains increasing when weights capturing relations among samples are amplified. Finally, we translate these findings into practice -- for model developers under a compute budget, we offer a cheap diagnostic that prioritizes which groups of synthetic data most need group-level estimation, recovering much of the benefit of full group-level scoring at a fraction of the compute cost.

AI.tldr: 本文指出合成数据筛选不能只看单样本效用（个体级信号），必须考虑样本间相互作用（群体级信号），并给出可落地的低成本诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 合成数据已成为LLM训练（含自主、长时程任务）的关键数据来源，但大规模使用会损害生成能力，因此需要判断哪些合成数据值得训练。现有数据筛选实践依赖个体级信号（孤立估计每个样本的训练效用），作者认为这对合成数据不足。
AI.method: 对比研究个体级信号与群体级信号：构造个体级影响下不可区分、但群体级影响差异显著的合成数据集；在预训练与后训练场景中对比含/不含群体级信号的主流筛选方法，并考察样本间关系权重放大的效应；最后设计低成本诊断方法，优先定位最需要群体级估计的数据组。
AI.result: 个体级信号无法反映样本的联合影响，按群体级信号筛选可带来更好的下游性能，尤其在生成能力上更明显；训练管线越合成化，群体级信号越重要，只有纳入该信号的方法才优于基线，且关系权重放大时增益更大；所提诊断方法以远低于全量群体级打分的算力开销，恢复了大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据筛选应以群体级信号为核心，尤其在合成比例不断上升的训练管线中；面向算力受限的开发者，可通过低成本诊断近似全量群体级打分的收益，实现更高效的合成数据管理。

title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出变分终端速度流匹配（VTV-FM），通过最小化加速度能量为静态数据推导缺失的终端速度，实现二阶相空间流匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配方法大多使用一阶桥，源与目标样本配对后路径为恒定速度的直线运动；即便结合最优传输改进配对，桥本身仍是线性，难以建模曲线运动、加速度与方向变化。改用二阶相空间动力学的自然思路面临障碍：学习该桥需要静态数据集不提供的目标侧终端速度信息。
AI.method: 提出VTV-FM二阶流匹配框架，通过最小化加速度能量推导缺失的终端速度，为静态数据给出闭式补全；同一最小加速度变分构造同时定义最优传输配对代价与训练所用的加速度目标。
AI.result: 在低维数据集、PDE支配的物理场以及CIFAR-10上的实验表明，VTV-FM在传输几何与生成质量上优于一阶及高阶流匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 最小加速度变分构造可统一地为二阶流匹配提供终端速度补全、OT配对代价与训练目标，无需静态数据之外的额外信息，并有效提升生成性能。

title: Can large language models unlock discrete data in ophthalmic diagnostic reports?
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Presented at the Association for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology (ARVO) Annual Meeting, Denver, Colorado, May 4, 2026
summary: Objective: To assess the accuracy and efficiency of a large language model (LLM) using two prompt strategies to extract structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports. Methods: Twenty deidentified reports across four types (Visual Field, OCT Glaucoma Overview, OCT retinal nerve fiber layer Single Exam, and OCT Thickness Map; n = 5 each) were processed using two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines and compared with a reconciled manual ground truth. Schema-Constrained used Structured Output mode with a predefined JSON Schema; Prompt-Only used a detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON. Outcomes were value accuracy, formatting accuracy, and extraction time. Results: Schema-Constrained value accuracy was 100.00% for Visual Field and RNFL Single Exam, 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview, and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only achieved 100.00% across all four report types. Formatting accuracy was 100.00% for Schema-Constrained across all report types and 100.00% for Prompt-Only except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction. Conclusions: In this small proof-of-concept dataset, general-purpose LLM-assisted pipelines extracted structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDFs with high accuracy and substantially reduced processing time. Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy. These complementary strengths support further evaluation of hybrid, validation-aware workflows for research and clinical data abstraction.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较两种 GPT-4o 提示策略从眼科诊断 PDF 报告中提取结构化数据，二者准确率高且将提取时间缩短约 92%。
AI.motivation: 评估通用大语言模型从眼科诊断 PDF 报告中抽取结构化数据的准确性与效率，并比较不同提示策略的表现差异。
AI.method: 20 份去标识化报告，涵盖 4 种类型（视野、OCT 青光眼概览、OCT 视网膜神经纤维层单次检查、OCT 厚度图；每类 n=5），采用两条 GPT-4o 流水线：Schema-Constrained 使用结构化输出模式配合预定义 JSON Schema；Prompt-Only 使用详细指令提示后经 Python 转 JSON，并与人工复核的金标准对比。评价指标为数值准确率、格式准确率和提取时间。
AI.result: Schema-Constrained 数值准确率为视野与 RNFL 单次检查 100.00%、青光眼概览 97.45%、厚度图 98.00%；Prompt-Only 四类均为 100.00%。格式准确率 Schema-Constrained 四类均 100.00%，Prompt-Only 除 RNFL 单次检查（90.14%）外均为 100.00%。单份报告平均提取时间由人工复核 56.51 s 降至 Schema-Constrained 5.04 s、Prompt-Only 4.70 s，约减少 92%。
AI.conclusion: 在该小型概念验证数据集上，通用大语言模型流水线以高准确率从眼科诊断 PDF 中提取结构化数据并大幅缩短处理时间；Prompt-Only 数值准确率最高，Schema-Constrained 输出符合 schema 且格式准确率 100%，两者互补，支持进一步评估混合式、带验证机制的工作流。

title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sapien，一个用于强制执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，通过扩展正则表达式支持有状态谓词、延迟策略生成与作用域语义检查，在保持接近无约束智能体效用的同时，有效拦截恶意工具调用。
AI.motivation: 上下文安全防御通常通过合成任务特定的策略并强制执行来阻止 AI 智能体采取越权行为。然而在多步任务中，哪些动作是合法的往往取决于智能体此前已完成的操作和已获取的信息，静态策略难以刻画这种依赖关系。
AI.method: Sapien 是一个强制执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎。其策略用扩展正则表达式指定允许的工具调用序列，并加入三类扩展机制：有状态谓词（stateful predicates）、延迟策略生成（deferred policy generation）以及作用域语义检查（scoped semantic checks）。
AI.result: Sapien 的效用与无约束智能体相差仅几个百分点。即便智能体被完全劫持，Sapien 策略能在 AgentDojo 上排除 93–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上排除 62–85% 的攻击；在长周期任务上，其拦截攻击数量约为工具白名单（tool allowlists）的两倍。
AI.conclusion: Sapien 表明，引入有状态机制与延迟生成的上下文策略可在几乎不损失智能体效用的前提下显著提升多步任务的安全性，优于传统工具白名单方案。

title: Spatially Gated Diffusion for Localized Counterfactual Chest Radiograph Editing
summary: Editing a chest radiograph requires completing the requested change while preserving unrelated content. We study a latent diffusion editor with an instruction-independent source trajectory and an instruction-conditioned editing trajectory. A learned gate mixes their post-sampler candidates at each executed step, and a separate image-space mask composites the decoded proposal with the source. On 2,400 MIMIC-derived requests, 2,244 outputs met the joint target, preservation, quality, and coverage rubric (93.5%), and target completion was 97.4%. Joint validity exceeded a matched composition-only control by 1.7 percentage points (paired patient-cluster 95% interval, 0.6--2.8). At a fixed learned mask, the learned-gate proposal improved joint validity by 1.6 points (0.8--2.4); at a fixed learned proposal, the learned mask improved it by 2.6 points (1.7--3.5). Across three training seeds, mean joint validity was 93.5% with a 0.3-point sample standard deviation. A blinded 240-request assessment yielded adjudicated joint validity of 93.3% for the full editor and 91.7% for composition only. Protected-region mean absolute error decreased from 0.0190 in the raw proposal to 0.0075 after composition. These findings distinguish recurrent-gating effects on the proposal from preservation through final composition in the assessed cohort.

AI.tldr: 提出一种潜在扩散编辑器，通过指令无关源轨迹与指令条件编辑轨迹的学习门控混合，并辅以图像空间掩码合成，在胸片编辑中同时实现目标修改与无关内容保留。
AI.motivation: 胸片编辑需在完成指定修改的同时保留无关内容，现有方法难以兼顾目标完成度与保留性，因此需要研究可分离地处理“编辑提议”与“最终合成”两阶段机制。
AI.method: 采用潜在扩散编辑器，包含指令无关的源轨迹与指令条件的编辑轨迹；每个执行步用学习门控混合两者后采样候选，并以独立图像空间掩码将解码提议与源图合成；通过固定门控/固定掩码的消融、多随机种子与盲法评估进行验证。
AI.result: 在2400条MIMIC派生请求中，2244条输出满足联合目标/保留/质量/覆盖标准（93.5%），目标完成率97.4%；联合有效性较仅合成对照高1.7个百分点（95%区间0.6–2.8）。固定掩码下学习门控提议提升1.6点（0.8–2.4）；固定提议下学习掩码提升2.6点（1.7–3.5）。三个种子平均联合有效性93.5%（标准差0.3点）。盲法240请求中，完整编辑器裁决联合有效性93.3%，仅合成为91.7%；受保护区域MAE由0.0190降至0.0075。
AI.conclusion: 学习门控主要影响编辑提议质量，而保留性主要通过最终图像空间合成实现，二者贡献在本评估队列中被明确区分。

title: Paying for Too Many Tokens? Valid and Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Annotation with Simple Heuristics
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines that can enable cost-aware VLM annotation in CSS.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了短视频VLM标注中的三种省成本启发式策略（抽帧、图像网格压缩、单模态），在情感与主题分类两项计算社会科学任务上沿分类准确率、下游推断有效性与每视频token成本三个维度进行评测，发现准确率与推断有效性会背离、文本单模态已具强表现、2×8图像网格（经镜头切换检测）可用约15%成本逼近全视频理解。
AI.motivation: VLM可实现大规模视频标注，但成本高昂：60秒短视频以1帧/秒处理即需数百万token。研究者常用抽帧、图像网格压缩、单模态等启发式降本，但这些策略究竟省不省成本、是否保留下游结论尚不明确，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 以短视频为对象，在两个计算社会科学任务（情感分类、主题分类）上系统评估各启发式配置，沿三条文献中通常被分开处理的轴进行度量：分类准确率、下游推断的有效性、每视频token成本。
AI.result: (1) 准确率与有效性出现背离：准确率最高的配置可能产生错误结论；(2) 模态价值无保证：仅用文本即可获得强性能，说明增加模态可能只增成本不增信号；(3) 成本可与视频时长解耦：经简单镜头切换检测构建的单个2×8图像网格可达到全视频理解水平（κ差异在约0.05以内），token成本仅约15%。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，提出可指导计算社会科学中成本感知VLM标注的实践指南（guidelines）。

title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
summary: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个针对视频生成模型后训练与对齐的系统综述，将后训练统一为对齐框架，区分隐式与显式对齐，并把现有方法归纳为四类：监督微调、自训练与蒸馏、偏好与奖励方法、推理时方法，同时梳理数据集、基准与评测，并讨论开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从短视频低质量发展到高分辨率、长时长、复杂时空动态序列，尽管大规模预训练赋予模型强生成先验，但预训练视频模型仍难以可靠地遵循人类意图、保持时间一致性、满足物理与安全约束。与图像和文本生成相比，视频生成的对齐面临独特挑战：误差随时间累积、运动与外观耦合、多目标权衡、时间属性监督有限。这些挑战需要系统化的后训练策略，在不从头重训的前提下适配预训练模型。
AI.method: 综述性研究，无实验方法。作者提出统一的后训练框架，依据对齐信号施加方式区分隐式对齐与显式对齐，并将现有方法分为四大类：(1) 监督微调；(2) 自训练与蒸馏；(3) 偏好与奖励方法；(4) 推理时方法。同时系统梳理常用数据集、基准与评测实践。
AI.result: 构建了首个视频生成后训练与对齐的综述性分类体系，提供了一致的视角，说明对齐信号如何在训练与部署阶段塑造模型行为，并整合了数据集、基准与评测实践的系统性梳理。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为可控、可靠的视频生成模型提供了结构化概念基础与实践指导，并指出开放挑战：可扩展奖励设计、长时程时间一致性、稳定性与表现力权衡、安全感知生成。

title: TabJoinBench: A Benchmark for Joinable Table Discovery
summary: Join discovery aims to identify tables from large data repositories that can augment a query table with complementary information, enabling downstream tasks such as data exploration, feature engineering, and business intelligence. Although numerous join discovery methods have been proposed, existing studies rely on method-specific benchmark construction, making reproducible and fair comparison difficult. We present TabJoinBench, a benchmark for evaluating join discovery methods across semantic, relational, and hybrid data lake scenarios. TabJoinBench constructs query-candidate pairs using source-specific validation strategies, systematically introduces structural, representation, and semantic changes through composable perturbations while preserving reliable ground truth.
