We evaluate representative join discovery methods spanning set-based, feature-based, and learned approaches, together with general-purpose language-model embedding baselines, and publicly release the processed datasets, ground-truth annotations, and generation pipeline to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future research.

AI.tldr: 提出 TabJoinBench，一个跨语义、关系与混合数据湖场景的 join discovery 评测基准，采用源特定验证策略构建 query-candidate 对并通过可组合扰动引入结构、表示与语义变化，同时保留可靠 ground truth；评测了 set-based、feature-based、learned 及通用语言模型嵌入基线，并公开数据、标注与生成流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 join discovery 研究依赖方法特定的基准构建方式，导致结果难以复现且缺乏公平比较。
AI.method: 构建 TabJoinBench：针对语义、关系、混合三类数据湖场景，用源特定验证策略生成 query-candidate 对；通过可组合扰动系统性地引入结构、表示与语义变化，同时保持可靠 ground truth；并对 set-based、feature-based、learned 方法及通用语言模型嵌入基线进行统一评测。
AI.result: 对代表性 join discovery 方法与通用语言模型嵌入基线完成了统一评测，并公开了处理后的数据集、ground-truth 标注和生成流水线。
AI.conclusion: TabJoinBench 为 join discovery 提供了可复现、公平的比较平台，支持后续研究。

title: Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms
summary: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"拒绝"行为的激活引导分解到组件级，发现拒绝方向集中于稀疏的注意力/MLP组件（28-48%）与约50%的残差流维度，各保留约85-101%的引导效果，表明拒绝行为由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）能操纵大语言模型行为，但其干预的机制基础尚不明确；作者希望弄清拒绝行为究竟是弥散编码还是由可识别的结构化机制承载。
AI.method: 在四个开放权重模型上，将拒绝引导分解为组件级干预，逐一识别足以复现完整行为效果的稀疏注意力与MLP组件子集，并进一步定位这些组件内承载信号的残差流维度。
AI.result: 拒绝方向集中于仅占上游组件28-48%的稀疏组件机制，仍保留88-101%的引导有效性；在组件内进一步集中于约50%的残差流维度，保留组件机制基线的85-98%，符合"特权基"结构。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏性体现在两个层面——被引导的组件与被引导的维度；拒绝并非弥散编码于Transformer中，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装，为理解与引导拒绝行为的机制基础提供了依据。

title: Align Then Reason: A Multimodal Lip-Sync Judge for Dubbing
summary: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. Existing visual speech recognizers and video-language models are poorly suited to this setting: even when fine-tuned to recover spoken content from lip motion, they remain largely insensitive to temporal errors. We introduce $\textit{Align Then Reason}$ (ATR), a multilingual lip-sync judge that first establishes a monotonic alignment between frame-level lip representations and the phonetic units of the candidate line, then reasons over this alignment to make the final judgment. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. The gains generalize across LLM families, reaching mean AUC improvements of 45.9% and 46.6% over the best baseline for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, respectively. They also transfer across datasets to three unseen MuAViC languages. Furthermore, we evaluate on two downstream tasks built from real dubbing lines. On dub-line reranking, ATR-9B outperforms the best lip-reading baseline by 52.0%, while on script-to-clip assignment, ATR-9B improves over the best lip-reading baseline by 17.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出Align Then Reason（ATR）多语言配音口型同步评判方法：先建立帧级唇部表征与候选台词音素单元的单调对齐，再让LLM基于该对齐进行内容与时序的联合推理，在七语言基准及下游任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 配音质检需要无参考的评判器：在仅有静音视频与候选文本、尚无配音音频的情况下，判断台词是否在内容与时序上与说话者可见口型匹配。现有视觉语音识别器与视频-语言模型即便经微调恢复唇动内容，仍对时序误差基本不敏感，无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: ATR先对帧级唇部表征与候选句的音素单元做单调对齐，再由对齐评分器向LLM同时提供每个音素单元的局部证据与经过校准的全局对齐分数，使LLM能够联合推理内容与时间。方法为多语言设计，并可与不同LLM族（Qwen3.5 2B/4B/9B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B）结合。
AI.result: 七语言基准上，相对对应Qwen3.5 SFT基线，2B/4B/9B推理器的平均AUC分别提升59.4%、50.2%、50.8%；跨LLM族泛化：LLaMA-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B分别较最佳基线提升45.9%与46.6%；并可迁移到三个未见过的MuAViC语言。下游任务：配音行重排序中ATR-9B较最佳唇读基线提升52.0%，脚本到片段分配中提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: ATR通过“先对齐、后推理”的范式，将唇部表征与音素单元显式对齐并提供局部与全局证据，有效解决了现有模型对时序误差不敏感的问题，在多语言、跨模型族、跨数据集及真实配音下游任务上均取得显著且可泛化的性能提升，为无参考配音质量评判提供了可行方案。

title: Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统性探究训练数据与上下文数据如何影响LLM的内部概率与言语化概率两种不确定性读数，发现二者均受分布性不确定性与断言性不确定性影响，且言语化概率与内部概率的对齐程度超出独立追踪同一来源的预期，表明言语化概率可用于探测模型内部分布。
AI.motivation: LLM在采样分布中携带内部不确定性（生成某答案的概率），也能以文字或数值表达置信度（言语化不确定性）。已有研究认为内部概率反映训练数据的相对频率，言语化概率反映训练数据中的显式概率断言。但除两者恰好一致的情形外，尚不清楚这两种读数是否对齐。这限制了对言语化不确定性何时可作为训练频率或模型内部分布代理的理解。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过干预数据中潜在的不确定性来源（分布性不确定性与断言性不确定性），系统探究训练数据与上下文数据如何影响LLM的概率读数。
AI.result: 内部与言语化两类概率读数均同时受训练数据中的分布性不确定性和断言性不确定性影响；且言语化概率与内部概率的对齐程度超出了二者独立追踪同一不确定性来源时的预期水平。
AI.conclusion: 言语化概率与内部概率的对齐不仅是各源独立追踪的结果，表明言语化概率可作为探测模型内部分布的有效手段。

title: VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at Grounding Language Models: Learning Faithfully and Efficiently (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/sachinkg12/yukti/releases/tag/veritygate-groundlm-2026-v1.0.0 Supplementary artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22668710
summary: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.

AI.tldr: VERITYGATE 是一个四门校验器（证据ID、实体、数字、主张类型），针对固定 schema 检查 LLM 解释是否遵循结构化系统证据；在 r=0/1、3 个模型、900 实例下，修复前不合格率 47.9%–80.3%，一次修复将存活率提升至 28.0%（mini）与 54.3%（Sonnet），但存活率与输出量需联合报告。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的解释可能流畅却不遵循结构化系统提供的证据，即"声明有据"与实际推理脱节。作者希望提供一个可操作、schema 层面的校验机制，量化这种偏离，而非直接度量全文幻觉。
AI.method: 提出 VERITYGATE 四门校验器，分别检查声明的证据 ID、实体、数字与主张类型，仅验证固定 schema 而非散文中每个事实。实验设 r=0 与 r=1，各 900 实例（450 组成对的有据/无据样本），使用 GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B、Claude Sonnet 4.6；统计修复前拒收率、单次修复后的主张存活率与每例验证主张数，并辅以小型人工研究与领域特定的 GPT-4o 评判测试。
AI.result: 修复前 80.3%（mini）与 47.9%（Sonnet）的主张被拒收（属校验器拒收率，非散文幻觉率）。一次修复使主张存活率从 19.7%→28.0%（mini）、52.1%→54.3%（Sonnet）；每例验证主张数变化为 mini +0.14、Llama −0.71、Sonnet −0.47。第二次 Sonnet 修复无明显增益。r=1 时 Gate 4 覆盖 97.0%、98.7%、100% 的失败主张。人工研究支持规则但显示 schema 检查与正确散文间存在差距；GPT-4o 评判测试存在顺序效应，故仅作有用性检查。
AI.conclusion: schema 层面的证据一致性校验可揭示 LLM 解释中大量不合规主张，一次修复有效但增益有限，且必须同时报告存活率与输出量以避免误判；Gate 4 是关键失效门。作者公开代码与数据。

title: PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes
summary: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出PLDiv——一种基于持久景观(persistence landscapes)的无监督多样性度量，通过刻画数据几何表示中邻域随样本逐步连接而演化的结构组织，量化数据集的结构多样性，并在文本生成、图像嵌入、指令数据与推理轨迹等场景中与基线方法竞争且与语义坍缩标签高度一致。
AI.motivation: 现代数据流水线越来越多地将人工创建/人工整理的数据与AI生成数据混合用于训练和评估。数据集增长时往往添加语义冗余样本而非扩展语义覆盖，从而降低整体质量。现有多样性度量主要概括词汇变化、熵或成对相似度，对底层数据分布"形状"的刻画有限，难以揭示结构性冗余。
AI.method: 提出PLDiv，一种源自持久景观(persistence landscapes)的多样性度量。它基于数据的几何表示，通过分析近邻样本逐步连接时数据邻域如何演化，将拓扑结构组织信息汇总为一个可解释的标量，无需任务特定监督。
AI.result: 在衡量文本生成的固有多样性、图像嵌入的多样性，以及检测指令数据集与推理轨迹中的语义坍缩时，PLDiv与所评估的基线方法相比具有竞争力，且在语义坍缩场景下与多样性标签高度一致。
AI.conclusion: PLDiv能有效支撑合成数据监控、数据集构建、数据增强与生成模型评估等应用。

title: Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建词元级增量轨迹（token-wise incremental trajectories），通过逐步增加上下文并重复计算上下文词嵌入（CWE），刻画嵌入随话语展开的演化过程。以花园路径句为测试案例，轨迹再现了花园路径加工特征，并能可靠区分歧义句与消歧对照句；所提位移度量对句子类型具有高预测力，且话语级信息在CLS与普通词汇词元上均可恢复。
AI.motivation: Transformer类大语言模型（如RoBERTa）以上下文词嵌入表示文本，同一词元的嵌入随上下文变化。现有研究多依赖静态或句子级表示，缺乏对嵌入随话语逐步展开而动态演化过程的刻画，也难以说明话语级信息在何种表征尺度上被编码。作者希望借助具有明确加工特征的歧义现象（花园路径句）检验这种增量视角的可行性。
AI.method: 构造词元级增量轨迹：对句中每个词元，随着词逐步加入句子，反复重算其CWE，得到该词元表征随上下文递增的演化序列。以花园路径句及其匹配的消歧控制句为测试集，提出多种量化跨上下文增量的表征位移（representational displacement）指标，并用轨迹信息预测句子类型；进一步在探索性分析中将该方法推广到其他歧义与误导相关语言现象。
AI.result: 词元级轨迹再现了花园路径加工的已知特征，如关键区域附近的加工扰动（disruption），并能可靠区分花园路径句与匹配的消歧控制句。所提位移指标显示轨迹信息对句子类型具有很高的预测力。歧义相关信息不仅可从句子级CLS表示中恢复，也可从普通词汇词元中恢复，表明话语级信息分布在多个表征尺度上。其他歧义与误导相关现象中观察到定性相似的轨迹结构。
AI.conclusion: 词元级增量轨迹为利用大语言模型研究特定话语的意义构建提供了一个有前景的框架，并揭示话语级信息在多表征尺度上的分布式编码特性。
